description.en:
The course is designed as the one in which all courses in the undergraduate program in the Department of Civil Engineering can be finally integrated. The aim is to help students integrate knowledge learned from the fundamental and advanced courses and to evaluate the performance of students based on the core abilities required in the program. Students can accomplish engineering practice design or project in a form of team work based on their specific interests, and can present their results. This training can strengthen the development of professional knowledge and skills of students to attain the program educational objectives and to meet the needs for engineering practice.
The engineering practice design or project in this course include:
(1) Structural and material engineering practice design or project
(2) Geotechnical engineering practice design or project
(3) Construction management practice design or project
(4) Ecological engineering and disaster prevention practice design

syllabi.outline: 本課程為土木工程結構設計重要課程之一，除授於學生瞭解鋼筋混凝土之基本力學原理及實務設計與施工規定外，並深入探討鋼筋混凝土構件的細部設計學理，並建立鋼筋混凝土結構之正確設計理念，以使得實務與理論得以並重，培養對鋼筋混凝土構建之各種桿件的分析與設計能力。另此課程為土木工程之基本設計課程，為房屋結構設計之先修課程。

description.zh: 運用無人機技術做為測遙工具為一新穎科技，本課程以航空動力學為前題，分別介紹定翼及旋翼型無人機運作原理，基於航空攝影目的介紹飛行及航拍任務規劃。同時藉由實作，學生將自行組裝及設計無人機，並實際自行拍攝影像、產製所需之空間資訊，如:正射、地形等地理資訊系統圖資。
description.en: The Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), commonly known as a drone, is an aircraft without human pilot on board that flies autonomously, and is now been used widely for many aspects because of its convenience, high resolution, efficiency, etc. This course introducing first the aerodynamic of different drone frames, as well as the basic photogrammetry. Then try to design and assembly our drones. By using the home-made drones, the students will learn how to do the mission planning and take photos. Finally, the students should generate the geomatic information from their acquired images.

syllabi.outline:
環境工程與科學的領域，對不論是注重水與空氣品質的國家與城市，抑或是污染物本身而言，均正持續地擴展，並具有國際性與全球性的影響。
     本課程目的旨在提供一般初學者對環境工程有一個廣泛的認識，第一部分包括環境系統工程的基礎知識以及建立簡單的工程模型，和對處理技術提出定性的描述；第二部分則包含水體污染和空氣污染及其防治的途徑與措施，固體廢棄物的處理與利用等。課程冀望藉由簡單明淺的講授，培育具土木背景學生必備的環境工程基礎知識，且提升其環境意識及相關知識技能，激發對研究環境工程的興趣，進而達到環境保護之目的。

description.zh: 受到全球氣候變遷影響，加以國土地理環境限制與不當的開發利用，導致台灣在開發新水資源與永續利用上均面臨嚴峻挑戰。本課程之目的在於教導學生如何妥善規劃運用有限水資源，減少洪澇、旱災等之衝擊，以達成有限水資源永續經營與利用目標。課程以水文學為基礎，包含各項地表、地下水資源之評估、開發與經營管理，亦包含各項水工結構物之最佳化設計或安全性分析。
description.en: Affected by global climate change, coupled with geographical and environmental restrictions and improper development and utilization, Taiwan faces severe challenges in the development of new water resources and sustainable utilization. The purpose of this course is to teach students how to properly plan and utilize limited water resources, reduce the impact of floods, droughts, etc., so as to achieve the goals of sustainable management and utilization of limited water resources. The course is based on hydrology and includes the assessment, development and management of various surface and underground water resources, as well as the optimal design or safety analysis of various hydraulic structures.

description.en:
The course is designed as the one in which all courses in the undergraduate program in the Department of Civil Engineering can be finally integrated. The aim is to help students integrate knowledge learned from the fundamental and advanced courses and to evaluate the performance of students based on the core abilities required in the program. Students can accomplish engineering practice design or project in a form of team work based on their specific interests, and can present their results. This training can strengthen the development of professional knowledge and skills of students to attain the program educational objectives and to meet the needs for engineering practice.
The engineering practice design or project in this course include:
(1) Structural and material engineering practice design or project
(2) Geotechnical engineering practice design or project
(3) Construction management practice design or project

description.zh: 為使學生對高分子物理有所認識，本課程之設定將涵蓋所有高分子物理之相關課題，其主要內容分以下兩大部份(I)高分子之非結晶性質(II)高分子之結晶性質。而兩大部份中，又各分以下數單元講述: (I) 高分子之非結晶性質 (a) 高分子鏈之機率結構 (b) 分子鏈之運動方式 (c) 高分子熱力學 (d) 自由體積理論(含Tg ,Tα,Tβ,Tγ之探討) (e) WLF經通曲線 (II)高分子之結晶性質 (a) 結晶晶格之分析 (b) 高分子結晶度及順向度之估計 (c) 結晶度對高分子機械性質，導電性質，及熱性質之影響 (d) 溶液晶體與熔融晶體之比較 (e) 熱結晶及張力結晶之比較
description.en: This course is designed to make students theroughly understand the problems related to polymer physics. The main content will include two major topics:(I)Amorphous Polymer(II)Crystalline Polymer. The detailed items included in the course are: (I) Amorphous Polymer (a) Random-Walk Theory for Chain Configuration (b) Chain Conformation and Movements (c) Polymer Thermodynamics (d) Free Volume Theory (including the study on Tg ,Tα,Tβ,Tγ…etc.) (e) WLF Master Curve (II)Crystalline Polymer (a) Unit Cell Analysis (b) Polymer Crystallinity and Orientation Measurement (c) Effect of Crystallinity on Mechanical, Dielectrical, and Thermal Properties of Polymeric Materials (d) Solution Crystals vs. Melt Crystals (e) Thermal Induced Nucleation vs. Stress Induced Nucleation.

Organic chemistry, textile, chemical engineering and other related fields are combined in the course. The invited industrial teachers propose the issues which encountered currently in the industry. Then, the teacher leads the students to conduct group discussions. The purpose is to cultivate students' ability to solve problems and read papers and periodicals. The invited industrial teachers provide questions. The teacher will assist student in the preparation of materials and practice oral reports. In addition, at least one report is required during a semester, and the final poster achievement exhibition. The scores will be determined based on the attitude of the students to participate in the classroom, the report materials and the poster achievement exhibition.

description.zh: 本課程結合有機、紡織、化工等相關領域，邀請業師命題目前業界遇到之瓶頸，由授課教師帶領學生進行分組討論，目的在培養學生解決問題與論文期刊選讀之能力，每組學生必須針對專一之問題尋找最近相關的資料。業師命題，由授課老師協助學生資料之準備及練習口頭報告。且一學期至少須報告1次，與期末海報成果展，學期成績將以學生在課堂上參與的態度、報告資料及海報成果展決定。
description.en: Organic chemistry, textile, chemical engineering and other related fields are combined in the course. The invited industrial teachers propose the issues which encountered currently in the industry. Then, the teacher leads the students to conduct group discussions. The purpose is to cultivate students' ability to solve problems and read papers and periodicals. The invited industrial teachers provide questions. The teacher will assist student in the preparation of materials and practice oral reports. In addition, at least one report is required during a semester, and the final poster achievement exhibition. The scores will be determined based on the attitude of the students to participate in the classroom, the report materials and the poster achievement exhibition.

description.zh:
本課程以高分子加工時所遇到之問題，分單元講述，其內容包括：
(I) 高分子加工學之基礎: (a)輸送現象, (b)高分子黏彈學, (c)高分子混煉。 
(II) 高分子加工學之應用: (a)壓模法, (b)沖模法, (c)反應沖模法, (d)絲線成形等專題。
description.en:
The course focuses on the "trouble shooting" in the polymer processing. Both theoretical and practical topics will be included. The main contents are divided into the following units: 
(I) Fundamental studies: (a) Transport phenomena (b) Viscoelastic properties of polymer melt, (c) Polymer compounding and blending. 
(II) Practical studies: (a) Compression molding, (b) Injection molding,, (c) Reaction injection molding, (d) Fiber formation, and (e) Membrane formation.

syllabi.outline: 本課程的授課主要講述高分子材料相關加工技術的種類、內容包含了高分子基礎原理、 加工機制以及運用。此外也會在課程中介紹目前工業上的生產程序以及相關聯之技術，修習的學生可藉由本課程系統性的了解高分子加工在各式高分子材料之應用與發展。

description.zh: 本課程內容包括邏輯閘的特性與功能測試，能利用積體電路完成各種基礎邏輯電路的組裝及設計，並能利用電子儀器進行量測、檢修。探討最佳化組合邏輯之演算法，可規劃邏輯元件，組合邏輯之VLSI設計，使用MSI與標準電路元件設計多層邏輯，使用閘陣列設計，循序邏輯之元件，循序邏輯之分析與合成，VLSI之設計與測試技巧，各種CAD軟體工具介紹。基礎邏輯閘實驗、組合邏輯實驗、加法器及減法器實驗、組合邏輯應用實驗、正反器邏輯實驗、循序邏輯電路應用實驗。

syllabi.outline:

1. Introduction
2. Deterministic and Random Signal Analysis
3. Digital Modulation Schemes 
4. Optimum Receivers for AWGN Channels 
5. An Introduction to Information Theory
6. Block and Convolutional Channel Codes 
7. Spread Spectrum Signals for Digital Communications

description.zh: 1. 簡介；2. 組合邏輯系統設計；3. 標準組合邏輯模組；4. 算術組合模組與網路；5. 順序邏輯系統設計；6. 標準順序邏輯模組；7. RTL系統；8. 資料及控制子系統；9. 微處理器設計。10.數位系統設計之原則與方法；11. ASM (Algorithm StateMachine) Chart 之應用與序向邏輯方法：傳統式合成法、多工器控制法、One-Hot 法、ROM-Based 法；12. ASIC所需之基本 SSI/MSI 元件；13.使用 SSI/MSI 基本元件解決邏輯問題；14.採用數位系統設計之原理與方法，利用 ASIC之基本元件，再配合基本閘設計 ALU、CPU 控制器、中斷控制器、DMA 控制器等 IC 元件；15.Bit-Slice 計算機設計；16.微程式設計；17.Hardwired CPU 設計。
description.en:
1. Introduction; 2. Design of combinational systems; 3. Standard combinational modules; 4. Arithmetic combinational modules and networks
5. Design of sequential network; 6. Standard sequential network; 7. Register transfer level (RTL) systems; 8. Data and control subsystems; 9. Design of a microcomputer; 7.Principles of digital system design; 8.ASM chart 9.SSI/MSI component 10.Application of ASIC component 11.Bit-Slice machine 12.Hardwared CPU design.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級下學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In second semester, Junior students also can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 任何計畫、產品或服務之壽命週期起始自需要分析，其次為決定需求和規格，接著為設計和執行，最後經由使用階段，在支援和維護下完成此計畫。而在進行經濟分析，應對貨幣之時間價值、投資報酬率、損益平衡、公司債券、現金流量、有效利率、最小成本壽命、通貨膨脹、成本估計、折舊、所得稅、資金成本、更新分析、敏感性分析和風險決策分析等要點，以求估計值之準確性、方案抉擇決策之正確性。
description.en: Engineering / management analysis of the economic aspects of public and private project proposals. Decisions involving the expenditure of capital funds. Alternative sources of funds; time value of money; methods of evaluating alternative project.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在探討工程或專案投資之經濟決策分析，包括貨幣的時間價值、通貨膨脹的等值計算、現值分析、等額年金分析、投資報酬率分析、成本效益分析、折舊與所得稅、建立專案的現金流量分析、設備更新 ( 重置 ) 決策。

description.zh: 本課程在二技為2學分。人因工程旨在研究調查人類的能力、限制、行為和其他特性等知識，而應用於工具、設備、系統、任務、工作和環境等的設計，以提高人類生活品質及生產力。所探討的內容可歸納如下：人因工程的研究方法、人體設計、人員的感覺歷程、人員的資訊處理、人員的體力活動、人機介面設計、作業環境、安全與衛生等。
description.en: Human factors is dedicated to discover and survey human beings' capability, limit, behavior and other futures.  And then apply it to the design of tools, facilities, systems, works and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity.  The course includes research approaches, physical design, human being's feeling process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.

syllabi.outline:
Human factors and ergonomics is dedicated to discover and survey human beings’ capability, limit, behavior and other features. And then apply it to the design of tools, facilities, systems, works and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity. This course includes research and scientific approaches, physical design, human beings' sensory process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.
The aim of this course is to inspire students for human factors science through evidence-based approaches in improving products and systems by considering human capabilities and needs (also socio-technical factors) when interacting with products & systems. In this course we step from theory to practical implementation.

description.zh: 統計數據分析是一種利用數據對遇到問題進行適當推測的藝術(有時是最好)，本課程是一門以微積分為基礎的統計學分析的入門課程，旨在幫助學生學習描述性和推論性的統計程序，以及在不同領域中使用有用的數據分析。在回顧描述性統計和一些必要的概率分佈後，我們將討論區間估計、點估計、假說檢定方差分析、線性回歸分析、因子設計、聚類分析的基本概念、分類和支持向量機，並伴隨著實踐和理論練習。因此這些技能將為學生提供一個基礎，培養學生獨自進行分析和有效評估他人統計分析結果的能力。
description.en: ‘Statistical data analytics’ is the art of using data to make appropriate (sometimes, best!) conjectures about problems encountered. This course is a calculus-based introduction to statistics and data analytics, and so designed to help students learn the introductory descriptive and inferential statistical procedures, and useful data analytics that are used in diverse areas. After a review of descriptive statistics and some necessary probability distributions, we will discuss interval and point estimation, hypothesis tests, ANOVA, linear regression analysis, factorial designs, and basic concept of cluster analysis, classification, and support vector machines accompanying practical and theoretical exercises. Consequently, these skills will provide the student with a basis to conduct their own such analyzes and to evaluate critically others’ uses of statistical analysis results.

syllabi.outline: This course is an introduction to statistical computing and will be taught in Python. Python is widely used not only in the engineering but also in natural science, medicine, biology, physics, and business. This course will introduce you to a vibrant and growing community of open source data analysts that is pushing the state of the art in data analysis and presentation. (Another benefit to you as students is that open source software is free!) This course’s main objective is to: learn how to take raw data, explore it, and present the results in a useful way. Thus, in this course, you will learn all of the basic skills needed to do each of these steps with the statistical language Python.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級下學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In second semester, Junior students also can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 任何計畫、產品或服務之壽命週期起始自需要分析，其次為決定需求和規格，接著為設計和執行，最後經由使用階段，在支援和維護下完成此計畫。而在進行經濟分析，應對貨幣之時間價值、投資報酬率、損益平衡、公司債券、現金流量、有效利率、最小成本壽命、通貨膨脹、成本估計、折舊、所得稅、資金成本、更新分析、敏感性分析和風險決策分析等要點，以求估計值之準確性、方案抉擇決策之正確性。
description.en: Engineering / management analysis of the economic aspects of public and private project proposals. Decisions involving the expenditure of capital funds. Alternative sources of funds; time value of money; methods of evaluating alternative project.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在探討工程或專案投資之經濟決策分析，包括貨幣的時間價值、通貨膨脹的等值計算、現值分析、等額年金分析、投資報酬率分析、成本效益分析、折舊與所得稅、建立專案的現金流量分析、設備更新 ( 重置 ) 決策。

第17-18週   工程經濟專案探討與期末報告

description.zh: 本課程在二技為2學分。人因工程旨在研究調查人類的能力、限制、行為和其他特性等知識，而應用於工具、設備、系統、任務、工作和環境等的設計，以提高人類生活品質及生產力。所探討的內容可歸納如下：人因工程的研究方法、人體設計、人員的感覺歷程、人員的資訊處理、人員的體力活動、人機介面設計、作業環境、安全與衛生等。
description.en: Human factors is dedicated to discover and survey human beings' capability, limit, behavior and other futures.  And then apply it to the design of tools, facilities, systems, works and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity.  The course includes research approaches, physical design, human being's feeling process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.

syllabi.outline:
Human factors and ergonomics is dedicated to discover and survey human beings’ capability, limit, behavior and other features. And then apply it to the design of tools, facilities, systems, works and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity. This course includes research and scientific approaches, physical design, human beings' sensory process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.
The aim of this course is to inspire students for human factors science through evidence-based approaches in improving products and systems by considering human capabilities and needs (also socio-technical factors) when interacting with products & systems. In this course we step from theory to practical implementation.

description.zh: 本課程在二技為品質管理實習。使學生瞭解品質管理的觀念、原理、領域。品管部門的組織、功能，如何管理產品或服務的品質，品管的工具、方法，如何持續改善品質的方法，品質表示法，如何評估品質管理成效，相關法令，品質管理未來趨勢。
description.en: This course let the students understand the concepts, theories, and areas of qualify control, organization and functions of quality department. syllabi.outline:
設計工學（Engineering Design）是一門跨學科的領域，結合工程學和設計學的原理，旨在創造功能性、美觀且實用的產品、系統和服務。其核心在於利用科學和工程知識解決實際問題，並通過創意設計滿足用戶需求。

本課程旨在培養學生設計工學的綜合能力，涵蓋從設計規劃、服務串接、配置發展、整合設計、設計驗證到工業化的設計理論與方法應用。

課程將以工學原理為基礎，從設計流程展開，對接最新的設計趨勢，如可持續設計、數位製造、物聯網、虛擬與擴增實境（VR/AR）和用戶體驗設計等技術。

這些新技術正在擴展設計工學的專業範疇。課程將通過實際演練方式加深學生對這些概念的理解。

下學期課程將在上學期的基礎上，從標竿產品與競品分析出發，深入探索工學基礎與創新設計方法的結合，幫助學生進一步掌握設計工學的核心價值。本學期重點強調跳脫框架的創新設計，利用實體的模型建置、測量與優化、加入XR、AI等前沿技術導入應用，實現更具前瞻性與實用性的創新設計開發。
Engineering Design is an interdisciplinary field that combines principles from engineering and design to create functional, aesthetically pleasing, and practical products, systems, and services. Its core lies in using scientific and engineering knowledge to solve real-world problems and meet user needs through creative design.

This course aims to develop students' skills in design engineering, covering design planning, service integration, configuration development, integrated design, design verification, and industrial design.

The course follows engineering principles and design processes, connecting with trends like sustainable design, digital manufacturing, IoT, VR/AR, and user experience design. These technologies expand the scope of design engineering. Through practical applications, this course will deepen students' understanding of these concepts.

The second-semester course builds upon the foundation established in the first semester, starting with benchmark product and competitor analysis. It delves into the integration of engineering fundamentals and innovative design methodologies to help students further grasp the core value of design engineering. This semester emphasizes out-of-the-box innovative design, leveraging physical model construction, measurement, and optimization, along with the integration of cutting-edge technologies such as XR and AI to achieve forward-looking and practical innovative design development.

講解新產品開發流程的企畫、設計、製造等知識，並演練運用解決複雜的產品設計開發問題之系統化設計方法、快速手繪以及立體電腦模型表現，延續並運用大一與大二課程所學之美學、人因工程、工學、電腦繪圖等各方面知識與技能。

syllabi.outline:
課程講解新產品開發流程的企畫、設計、製造等知識外，演練解決複雜的產品設計開發問題之系統化設計方法，延續並運用大一與大二課程所學之美學、人因工程、工學、電腦繪圖等各方面知識與技能。課程將以聯合國可持續發展目標（SDGs）和大學社會責任（USR）之議題，培養學生在設計過程中考量產品的社會影響。學生可將他們的設計應用於合作項目，直接回應產業及社會需求，體驗專業技能對社會產生正面影響的過程。
This course goes beyond teaching the knowledge of planning, designing, and manufacturing in the new product development process. It involves practicing systematic design methods to solve complex product design and development issues, continuing and utilizing the knowledge and skills learned in aesthetics, ergonomics, engineering, and computer-aided drawing from freshman and sophomore courses. The course is structured around the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and University Social Responsibility (USR) initiatives, aiming to cultivate students' consideration of the social impact of products during the design process. Students will have the opportunity to apply their designs in collaborative projects, directly responding to industry and societal needs, and experiencing the positive impact their professional skills can have on society.

syllabi.outline:
本課程綜合了室內設計的所有基礎課程，包括室內設計基本原理、基礎製圖、施工圖、手繪透視渲染、電腦3D渲染、建築結構、室內建築、裝飾材料、園林綠化、室內園藝等課程。 主要重點是激發創造力的培訓。 透過實際的設計練習，學生將學習設計方法和解決問題的技巧，同時開發相應的工業設計產品。
This course integrated all foundational courses in interior design, including basic principles of interior design, basic drafting, construction drawings, hand-drawn perspective rendering, computer 3D rendering, architectural structure, interior architecture, decorative materials, and courses in landscaping and interior gardening. The primary focus is on training that stimulates creativity. Through practical design exercises, students will learn design methods and problem-solving skills while developing corresponding industrial design products concurrently.

description.zh: 探討家具製造之最新技術，側重量產設備及其與產品工程的關係。介紹木材加工原理及最新量產設備之性能，以便依據家具特徵如組件形狀，材料性質，及產量多寡等考量，提出有效率的加工計畫（製造流程）。講授家具製造作業程序（從原料接受、備料、細作、裝配以迄塗裝、包裝、發貨等其間之種種細節），特別是以計量的觀點來看家具製造問題，以避發生瓶頸，製造系統整体概念之培養，尤為重點。
description.en: Survey of furniture manufacturing technology emphasizing mass production equipment and its relationship to furniture product engineering.This course provides students with an understanding of the principles of wood machining processes and the capabilities of modern production woodworking equipment. Students learn to develop efficient process plans (machining sequences) based on product characteristics such as part geometry, material composition, and production volume.Emphasis is on operations, and the integration of many types of equipment into a manufacturing system. This course specially requires the students to view the manufacturing process in quantitative terms.

syllabi.outline:
探討家具製造之最新技術，側重量產設備及其與產品工程的關係。介紹木材加工原理及最新量產設備之性能，以便依據家具特徵如組件形狀，材料性質，及產量多寡等考量，提出有效率的加工計畫（製造流程）。講授家具製造作業程序（從原料接受、備料、細作、裝配以迄塗裝、包裝、發貨等其間之種種細節），特別是以計量的觀點來看家具製造問題，以避發生瓶頸，製造系統整体概念之培養，尤為重點。
Survey of furniture manufacturing technology emphasizing mass production equipment and its relationship to furniture product engineering. This course provides students with an understanding of the principles of wood machining processes and the capabilities of modern production woodworking equipment. Students learn to develop efficient process plans (machining sequences) based on product characteristics such as part geometry, material composition, and production volume. Emphasis is on operations, and the integration of many types of equipment into a manufacturing system. This course specially requires the students to view the manufacturing process in quantitative terms.

五. 家具製程，以系統家具設計與產銷為例的 DOWNTIME 與 4M 概念

description.zh:
了解各種珠寶種類材質、製作技術、製造流程及設備並應用設計的基
礎能力,發揮珠寶首飾的設計創意、造形表達；學習珠寶首飾描繪表現
技法及基礎製圖法。
description.en:
The course is concerned with the design and production of 
jewellery , siversmithing and related products and is 
delivered through a programme of lectures and practical 
design projects in terms of types of materials,techniques of
production , and its processes and equipments. Based on the 
foundation of design skills, the students can practice the 
techniques of presentation and drawing, and learn how to 
create new designs of jewellery and its related products.

syllabi.outline:
使學生進一步瞭解首飾設計觀念，佐以各種蠟模製作技術實習，加強其設計深度與製作能力；並進而將此概念技巧延伸至日常生活器物之創作。
(本課程評分著重在蠟模技法的創意發想,操作過程與模型表現)
*修習本課程需有金工基礎為佳
syllabi.schedule:
1. 課程簡介   [第1週]
	2. 蠟模製作技術 ─ 硬蠟戒指 (需鑄造)  [第2週]
	3. 蠟模製作技術 ─ 硬蠟別針  [第3-4週]
	4. 蠟模製作技術 ─ 堆蠟及模具塑形  [第5-6週]
	5. 蠟模製作技術 ─ 蠟槍成形及車蠟  [第7-8週]
	6. 蠟模製作技術 ─ 軟蠟片、線成形  [第9週]
	7. 鑄件修飾加工  [第10週]
	8. 首飾零件、結構認識與製作  [第11週]
	9. 進階金屬著色技法  [第12週]
	10.首飾量產技術  [第13週]
	11.期末作品報告 ─ 文、圖、實物---一套至少兩件,需鑄造  [第14-18週]
syllabi.assessment:
平時出席與學習態度---遲到早退、聽講態度、清掃工作…(50%)
	作業進度與作品表現-----創意與工藝水準(30%)
	期末作品(20%)  *請注意未交期末作品有可能導致不及格

*本課程以實習為主，因工安理由不接受未修課同學旁聽。
同學須切實遵守金工教室規則與安全注意事項，並聽從教師與助理人員之指示，以維護工作安全。如有違者而造成自己或他人之損傷及工具器材損失，應自行負責。
*不得以舊作品或現成品改造當成作業繳交,一律視同作弊不及格
  *未請假曠課達三次者視為不及格
*同學下課前需將工作區域打掃乾淨，並將金工教室共用器材、工具放回原位。
*教室內所有因吃、喝所產生的垃圾需自行帶走。 
*公用金工器具櫃不得以不當方式強行打開；鑰匙借後需立即歸還工設辦公室。
  *感冒同學請戴口罩以交互傳染。

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級下學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。

description.zh:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
description.en:
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year—Foundations of Architectural Design
Training in fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year— People and Space and Internal Elements of Architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing essential aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, the physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type, and form, etc.
■ Third year—Urban Architecture
Focus on environmental systems or urban structures relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year— Graduation Project

syllabi.outline:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下：
■ 第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。
■ 第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。
■ 第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
■ 第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。

This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year—Foundations of Architectural Design
Training in fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year— People and Space and Internal Elements of Architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing essential aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, the physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type, and form, etc.
■ Third year—Urban Architecture
Focus on environmental systems or urban structures relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year— Graduation Project

description.zh: 本課程介紹都市計劃領域中相關的重要概念與都市發展議題，並將社會學、心理學、經濟學、統計學、地理學、管理學及建築學等相關領域之基礎知識綜合導入課程中，以增廣同學對於都市計劃研究與專業之認識。講授內容包括：1.都市發展簡介；2. 都市理論介紹；3.重要規劃理論導讀都市發展與規劃；4.當代都市規劃重要議題。
description.en: The course introduces urban planning from several respects, and will respectively introduce the basic concepts of urban planning, such as Sociology, Crowd Psychology, Economics, Statistics, Geology, Urban Management, and Architecture. The program includes specific contents : 1.  Brief history of urban development；2. Urban planning concepts； 3. Important theories of or urban planning；4. Contemporary issues of urban development/planning.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹都市計劃領域中相關的重要概念與都市發展議題，並將社會學、心理學、經濟學、統計學、地理學、管理學及建築學等相關領域之基礎知識綜合導入課程中，以增廣同學對於都市計劃研究與專業之認識。講授內容包括：1.都市發展簡介；2. 都市理論介紹；3.重要規劃理論導讀都市發展與規劃；4.當代都市規劃重要議題。本課程亦預計結合本校USR大學社會責任實踐計畫，透過專題式學習與案例分析調研，帶領學生盤點地方發展議題並研擬對策，透過由下而上的規劃思維，翻轉傳統城鄉空間的建構規劃，強化與社會族群的關係，並進行空間再造的提案，其中包括：社會計畫、設施計畫、營造計畫、執行措施等階段工作內容，並著手進行計畫實踐之實務操作等。從城市中的空間變革到地方創生/社區營造，強化學生對建築專業之社會實踐/社會責任的體認，以期培養學生博雅的品格，開拓生命視野。
The course introduces urban planning from several respects, and will respectively introduce the basic concepts of urban planning, such as Sociology, Crowd Psychology, Economics, Statistics, Geology, Urban Management, and Architecture. The program includes specific contents : 1.  Brief history of urban development；2. Urban planning concepts； 3. Important theories of or urban planning；4. Contemporary issues of urban development/planning.

description.zh: 實務專題課程為建築專題設計（畢業設計）的輔助課程，分二學期：第一學期為前置課程，主要訓練學生具備獨立思考和建立自主觀點的能力，依教師專長指導學生探討和發展設計議題、收集相關資料和進行案例分析、自訂設計方法與流程、並提出畢業設計的研究方向；第二學期旨在加強學生在建築實務工作各領域的能力，結合設計課程的操作，對特定之實務課題（例如：空間計畫、結構分析、細部設計與大樣圖模、施工圖、機電配置、材料實驗、構築實作、綠建築檢討、CFD模擬、施工管理、法規檢討、BIM模型、競圖報告書、設計方法論、參數演算、動畫製作、專業rendering等項目）進行深入探討並提出專題報告。
description.en: The course works together with Special Topics on Architectural Design (Thesis Design) in two semesters. The first semester is preparatory course which trains students to think independently and establish independent perspective. Teachers of different fields guide students to explore design issues, collect data, have case study, develop design methodology, and propose future direction for thesis design . The second semester aims to enhance students' abilities in practice, such as planning, structural analysis, detail drawing, shop drawing, electrical and mechanical system, materials experiments, tectonic construction, green building evaluation, CFD simulation, construction management, regulatory review, BIM modeling, competition reports, design methodology, parametric algorithms, animation, rendering and so on.

syllabi.outline:
本課程採用分組教學，就教師之專長指導學生在建築實務工作之各領域進行資料搜集，對特定之課題提出報告，訓練學生深入的接觸並膫解實際的工作，以培養學生發掘問題，解決問題之執業能力。
課程概要：
1 範  疇：建築或景觀之設計理論與實務，同學或可以從哲學、美學、歷史、 社會與文化、生活現象為出發，或藝術如電影、文學、繪畫等媒材與建築空間之類比或隱喻關係。然而，真正的題材存在於極細微且具體的事物（一個人、一個動作、一首歌、一部電影、一件作品、一本書、一幅畫、家（或辦公）中的一方場所、某一個瞬間、某一群人、某一個地方、或某一個念頭….等等）開始。
2 目  的：如漢寶德所說：大學教育在於使成理性的過程，做一個會思考、有想法、具備論述能力的人。
3 方  法：發掘問題、探索、推演邏輯與判斷、歸結，是一種思維與邏輯訓練。
4 知識論建立：文本閱讀、解讀與內（深）化。
5 個人洞察與論述
syllabi.schedule:
◆ 本組以兩學期進行延續性專題探索為原則。
◆ 上課以seminar研討方式為主，針對同學的專題展開不同層次和層面的實質內容討論。
◆ 旨在培養學生成為有思考和批判能力，察覺自我的內在意識，同時具有洞察事物本質、以及透視現象、建立論述、重構自我的能力！
◆ 方法
1.  透過多元閱讀，看見世界。
2.  透過理論，超越現實的局限性。
3.  回歸事物本身（去蔽），洞察事物本質（反經驗）。
4.  假設：任何事物都是獨一的，無需典範、沒有前例！
◆ 主題與方向：依學生興趣自定
1. 透過本課程界定畢業設計方向與題材。
（參考曾指導此方向的學長姐有：陳文、沈銘宸等十餘位）
2. 從自我出發的探索
（參考曾指導的此類型題材的有：觀察自己的母親、個人夢境的解析等）
3. 參加重要的設計競圖

syllabi.outline:
實務專題課程為建築專題設計（畢業設計）的輔助課程，分二學期：第一學期為前置課程，主要訓練學生具備獨立思考和建立自主觀點的能力，依教師專長指導學生探討和發展設計議題、收集相關資料和進行案例分析、自訂設計方法與流程、並提出畢業設計的研究方向；第二學期旨在加強學生在建築實務工作各領域的能力，結合設計課程的操作，對特定之實務課題（例如：空間計畫、結構分析、細部設計與大樣圖模、施工圖、機電配置、材料實驗、構築實作、綠建築檢討、CFD模擬、施工管理、法規檢討、BIM模型、競圖報告書、設計方法論、參數演算、動畫製作、專業rendering等項目）進行深入探討並提出專題報告。
The course works together with Special Topics on Architectural Design (Thesis Design) in two semesters. The first semester is preparatory course which trains students to think independently and establish independent perspective. Teachers of different fields guide students to explore design issues, collect data, have case study, develop design methodology, and propose future direction for thesis design . The second semester aims to enhance students' abilities in practice, such as planning, structural analysis, detail drawing, shop drawing, electrical and mechanical system, materials experiments, tectonic construction, green building evaluation, CFD simulation, construction management, regulatory review, BIM modeling, competition reports, design methodology, parametric algorithms, animation, rendering and so on.

syllabi.outline:
實務專題課程為建築專題設計（畢業設計）的輔助課程，分二學期：第一學期為前置課程，主要訓練學生具備獨立思考和建立自主觀點的能力，依教師專長指導學生探討和發展設計議題、收集相關資料和進行案例分析、自訂設計方法與流程、並提出畢業設計的研究方向；第二學期旨在加強學生在建築實務工作各領域的能力，結合設計課程的操作，對特定之實務課題（例如：空間計畫、結構分析、細部設計與大樣圖模、施工圖、機電配置、材料實驗、構築實作、綠建築檢討、CFD模擬、施工管理、法規檢討、BIM模型、競圖報告書、設計方法論、參數演算、動畫製作、專業rendering等項目）進行深入探討並提出專題報告。
The course works together with Special Topics on Architectural Design (Thesis Design) in two semesters. The first semester is preparatory course which trains students to think independently and establish independent perspective. Teachers of different fields guide students to explore design issues, collect data, have case study, develop design methodology, and propose future direction for thesis design . The second semester aims to enhance students' abilities in practice, such as planning, structural analysis, detail drawing, shop drawing, electrical and mechanical system, materials experiments, tectonic construction, green building evaluation, CFD simulation, construction management, regulatory review, BIM modeling, competition reports, design methodology, parametric algorithms, animation, rendering and so on.

description.zh: 本課程是敷地計畫學的延續，授課目標在培養學生對於建築基地的實務規劃與設計能力。授課內容著重敷地計畫學所探討的理論及技術如何應用於實際的操作層面。以校外專家配合教學，介紹各種實際案例並分析其優缺點。學生透過課堂的討論及實地的調查、分析及校外的參訪，來瞭解敷地計畫的所涵蓋的重點實務工作，進而研習各項課題的解決對策與方法，使其具備建築相關業界所需的專業知識及技能。
description.en: The course is to explore the practical skills on site planning and design techniques. Teaching materials cover the basic components and their various applications of the site planning. Professional experts are invited to join the training program. Both advantages and disadvantages of each case are introduced and analyzed. Through class discussions and field studies, students can recognize the actual contents and issues during the site planning and design process. Strategies and solutions to the planning and design problems will be facilitated to help students to get the better professional abilities to qualify related architectural design works’ needs.

description.zh: 車輛動力系統實驗內容包括: (1)熱工與引擎實驗；(2) 動力系統相關裝置實驗；(3)整車動力性能實驗。學生將學習車輛動力系統分析的基本技能，並練習如何應用適當工具量測、診斷、與分析車輛動力系統主要性能，課程著重學生實作演練。
description.en: This course aims to train students in understanding the fundamental analysis of vehicle powertrain, and utilizing tools to measure, diagnose, and analyze the major characteristics and performance of the vehicle powertrain. Topics include: (1) Thermal engineering and engine experiments, (2) Powertrain related devices experiments, and (3) Vehicle performance experiments.

description.zh: 車輛控制實驗內容包括: (1)利用Matlab/Simulink設計控制器；(2)輸入/輸出訊號處理；(3)車輛控制應用實務。學生將學習車輛控制的基本要求，並練習如何應用適當工具設計與實踐控制器，課程著重學生實作演練。
description.en: This course aims to train students in understanding the fundamental vehicle control requirements, and utilizing tools to design and implement the controller. Topics include: (1) Controller design using Matlab/Simulink, (2) Input/output signal processing, and (3) Practical application of vehicle control.

description.zh: 「鐵道車輛系統與維修基地」課程，乃為培養具有鐵路車輛分析設計及檢修技術操作能力之人員，掌握鐵道裝備設計製造、檢修的基礎知識與應用能力，具有鐵道車輛製造、檢修、運用、管理等綜合職業能力和創新精神的高素質技能型專門人才。本課程將從鐵道車輛基本結構開始介紹，並探討鐵道車輛與鐵道基礎之互制關係。而後導入各式特殊鐵道車輛設計之原理與用途，如：高速客車、傾斜式列車、自導向系統….等，並研討各種車型之行駛穩定性與脫軌風險計算方式。最後介紹鐵道車輛維修之概念與實務，並介紹維修基地之設計與配置，再導入先進預兆健康預防檢修法與AR技術於檢修之應用與發展。
description.en: This course of "Railway Vehicle System and Maintenance Depot" will cover the basic design criteria of the railway vehicle, its sub-systems and integration. We will discuss factors that affect the design, sizing, manufacturing and maintenance of the sub-systems of the railway vehicle, including their integration with other sub-systems to work as one complete train. Various factors affecting reliability, accessibility and maintainability will be addressed. Then several types of vehicle (high-speed-vehicle, tilting train, self-guide bogie will be introduced to determine the dynamic stability and derailment risk. Finally, the design of maintenance depot will be studied and the latest technologies (PHM, AR) on railway vehicle maintenance will be introduced.

name.zh: 鐵道車輛技術與跨領域設計
name.en: Engineering Technology and Interdisciplinary Design for Railway Vehicle

description.zh: 本課程開授之目標，在讓修習之學生能將鐵道車輛之工程技術與跨領域設計相互融合，在工程分析面能配合跨領域人文設計之需求，並在人文設計面瞭解工程之規範與要求。本課程內容包括鐵道車輛之系統基本架構、鐵道車輛結構及動態之基本工程分析技術、鐵道車輛車廂之功能性設計、及鐵道人文文化；本課程並配合軌道單位之校外參訪，讓課堂所學能與實務技術融合。本課程是以跨院合授的方式，由鐵道車輛技術研發中心、車輛系、文化事業發展系之師資共同參與授課。
description.en: This course aims to provide students the knowledge of engineering technology and interdisciplinary design for railway vehicles.  Design of railway vehicles should consider both the engineering and interdisciplinary cultural design at the same time.  A designer should consider not only engineering regulations and requirements, but also concepts of cultural design.  This course covers basic introduction of railway vehicle system, basic analysis of vehicle structures and dynamics, vehicle interior and exterior functional design, and railway culture.  The industrial tour in this course helps students to realize the theoretical and practical parts of railway vehicles.  This course is a joint lecture instructed by professional faculties from Railway Vehicle Research Center, Department of Vehicle Engineering, and Department of Cultural Vocation Development.

syllabi.outline:
課程名稱：鐵道車輛技術與跨領域設計
本課程開授之目標，在讓修習之學生能將鐵道車輛之工程技術與跨領域設計相互融合，在工程分析面能配合跨領域人文設計之需求，並在人文設計面瞭解工程之規範與要求。本課程內容包括鐵道車輛之系統基本架構、鐵道車輛結構及動態之基本工程分析技術、鐵道車輛車廂之功能性設計、及鐵道人文文化；本課程並配合軌道單位之校外參訪，讓課堂所學能與實務技術融合。本課程是以跨院合授的方式，由鐵道車輛技術研發中心、車輛系、文化事業發展系之師資共同參與授課。
Course Title: Engineering Technology and Interdisciplinary Design for Railway Vehicle
This course aims to provide students with the knowledge of engineering technology and interdisciplinary design for railway vehicles.  Design of railway vehicles should consider both the engineering and interdisciplinary cultural design at the same time.  A designer should consider not only engineering regulations and requirements, but also concepts of cultural design.  This course covers the basic introduction of railway vehicle systems, basic analysis of vehicle structures and dynamics, vehicle interior and exterior functional design, and railway culture.  The industrial tour in this course helps students to realize the theoretical and practical parts of railway vehicles.  This course is a joint lecture instructed by professional faculty from the Railway Vehicle Research Center, the Department of Vehicle Engineering, and the Department of Cultural Vocation Development.

description.en:
This course will direct students to learn the ability of reading and writing Japanese journals, papers engineering instruction manuals or reference materials. 
This course include:
1.  papers reading practice
2.  translation skill
3.  technical writing

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授日語基礎語法，以期建立自學興趣與啟發閱讀日文資料之能力。前階段教授五十音、助詞、形容詞及動詞變化等基礎；後半階段將學習句型結構及產業界實務日文。本教學著重日語基礎之語法架構練習,學成後亦能自行取得日本新科技知識，語言是持續不斷的自我精進和與時俱進的學習,以期未來可廣泛應用於未來工作及日常生活中.

This course teaches Japanese basic grammar, in order to establish students' ability to read and understand Japanese technical articles. The first half of the course teaches Japanese syllabary, auxiliary words, adjectives and verb conjugations, and then introduces Japanese grammar structure, common sentence patterns, etc… Focusing on the concepts and methods necessary for Japanese reading so that students can still enhance themselves and apply in work and daily life to read instructions and manuals of equipment or products.

syllabi.assessment:
Students will write three senior project drafts, one of five pages, one of ten pages, and one of fifteen pages and will write useful peer reviews for one another. 

In the springs semester, the final grade is based predominantly on effort and participation (but partially still on writing results). The excellent student will

1) Set deadlines and meet those deadlines. 

2) Meet the length requirement for drafts.

3) Stay in communication with me and keep me updated on the progress of the draft, any challenges, etc. 

4) Take the time to give useful feedback to group members and work well with other group members. 

5) Take feedback seriously and work to improve from draft to draft (This is even more important than meeting the length requirement.) 

6) Show the ability to stay strong through obstacles and frustrations in order to write a strong project (and talk to me early if you are having trouble). 

7) Have a strong direction for the paper, in which they are in conversation with interesting outside sources and yet making original, debatable, and clear claims, which they support with analyzed evidence. 

8) Follow the rules and conventions for academic honesty, including citation rules and making sure all ideas are their original ideas, thought up independently. 

Students who do all of the above will do well in the spring semester. Points will be taken off as needed for problems, but students are encouraged, if they make a mistake an any area, to be in clear communication with me about the mistake and just to fix the mistake as soon as possible. The one major issue students need to watch out for is plagiarism as failures in citation and/or AI writing could lead students to receive a zero. Students should make sure they understand these expectations and cite appropriately.

description.en: This is an introductory course to Chinese-English interpreting. The course provides a practical insight into different modes of interpreting and introduces skills and aptitude integral to interpreting progressively. Students learn basics of sight translation and short consecutive interpreting. Topics include public speaking, active listening skills, paraphrasing, multitasking, recall and memory, and gist extraction followed by basic CI note-taking techniques.

description.zh: 為什麼要閱讀或研究莎士比亞? Catherine Belsey 回答道：是為了莎翁的獨特性。如她所言：「莎士比亞不僅是英語世界上流社會文化的精華，亦為其整體文化的精髓。」因為莎劇的辭彙，迄今仍通用於英語世界，並已融入日常生活之結構中。這現象不僅發生在現在的英國，自莎翁的時代開始，莎翁的語彙在全世界就從未停止流通過。何況，莎翁震撼人心的詩歌和劇場藝術，無人出其右的人性掌握，以及非凡的人生哲學思維與洞見，向來受到世人的珍愛。如世人常謂：莎士比亞的語言可觸發我們的想像力，為我們在人生的各個層面(包括職業層面)提升溝通效率。為了這些重要的理由，本課程將引導學生欣賞莎士比亞的若干劇作。
description.en: Why Shakespeare? Catherine Belsey answers that it is because of his singularity. As she observes, "Shakespeare is part and parcel of English-speaking culture, and not only high culture." For "phrases from the plays are still current, woven into the fabric of everyday life" in Britain now and have, in fact, been circulated in the world since the early modern era. Besides, Shakespeare has been cherished for his powerful poetry and stagecraft, his nonpareil grasp of human nature, and his remarkable philosophical insights into life. As people often observe, Shakespeare may trigger our imagination with his language and promote effective communication in every aspect of our life, including that of our careers. For these important reasons, this course aims to guide students to appreciate Shakespeare by focusing on a number of his plays.

description.zh: 本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

syllabi.outline:
本課程探討企業倫理的基本概念與實務應用，幫助學生理解企業在全球化時代中的社會責任及道德決策。本課程涵蓋責任倫理、社會企業、會計倫理、職場倫理、企業社會責任、資訊倫理、金融倫理、環境會計及人力資源管理等議題，透過國際趨勢與實務案例，分析企業如何在商業競爭與道德責任間取得平衡。

課程將透過理論學習與個案討論，引導學生思考企業道德挑戰，並強化其分析與決策能力。特別關注永續發展目標（SDGs）、環境社會與公司治理（ESG）、人工智慧道德（AI Ethics）等最新趨勢，幫助學生掌握企業倫理在現代商業環境中的角色。期望培養學生成為具備企業倫理意識的專業人才，能夠在未來職場中推動企業永續發展與社會責任實踐。

The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

課程目標：
本課程旨在教授學生如何使用Python進行網路爬蟲，並應用於金融數據分析。學生將學習如何從台灣證交所網站爬取上市櫃公司的財務報表、資產負債表及股票歷史交易數據，並使用Pandas進行數據處理與分析。此外，學生將學習如何繪製K線圖，並透過實際案例應用於股票市場分析。課程結束時，學生需完成一個專題研究，展示其數據爬取、處理與可視化的能力，並能獨立解決金融數據分析中的實際問題。

課程描述：
這是一門結合網路爬蟲與金融數據分析的實務課程。課程從Python基礎與網路爬蟲技術開始，逐步引導學生學習如何使用Python爬取台灣證交所的公開數據，並使用Pandas進行數據清理與分析。學生將學習如何處理金融數據中的缺失值、合併不同來源的數據，並進行數據可視化（如K線圖）。課程將透過實際案例（如股票歷史數據分析與財務報表分析）讓學生將理論應用於實務。課程強調動手實作，旨在培養學生在金融數據分析領域的專業技能，為未來從事金融科技或數據分析相關工作奠定基礎。

Course Objectives:
This course aims to teach students how to use Python for web scraping and apply it to financial data analysis. Students will learn how to scrape financial statements, balance sheets, and historical stock trading data from the Taiwan Stock Exchange website, and use Pandas for data processing and analysis. Additionally, students will learn how to plot K-line charts and apply these skills to real-world stock market analysis through practical case studies. By the end of the course, students will complete a research project demonstrating their ability to scrape, process, and visualize data, and solve practical problems in financial data analysis.

Course Description:
This is a practical course combining web scraping and financial data analysis. Starting with Python basics and web scraping techniques, the course will guide students through the process of scraping public data from the Taiwan Stock Exchange and using Pandas for data cleaning and analysis. Students will learn how to handle missing values in financial data, merge data from different sources, and perform data visualization (e.g., K-line charts). Through practical case studies (e.g., historical stock data analysis and financial statement analysis), students will apply theoretical knowledge to real-world scenarios. The course emphasizes hands-on practice, aiming to equip students with professional skills in financial data analysis and prepare them for careers in fintech or data analysis.

description.zh: 介紹計算機演算法的設計與分析,內容包含了: 函數成長, 遞迴關係, 排序及序列統計, 基礎與進階資料結構, 動態規劃, 貪婪演算法, 搜尋, 圖形與幾何演算法, 字串比對, NP-completeness, 近似演算法, 及平行與分散式演算法.
description.en: This course gives a broad introduction about the design and analysis of computer algorithms. General topics to be covered include: growth of functions, recurrences, sorting and order statistics, fundamental and advanced data structures, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, searching, graph and geometry algorithms, string matching, NP-completeness, approximation algorithms, parallel and distributed algorithms.

5.基礎UI設計與多國語言
6. 核心應用程式設計

9. OpenGL ES

Open-source software is extremely important to the development of the information world, especially system software and middleware. GNU/Linux developed rapidly in the 1990s and entered the Internet era in the late 1990s. The open-source web server Apache HTTP Server, which is used by the most servers in the world, came into being, and then the legendary open-source Apache Project was born. So far, various open-source communities have continued to improve and optimize existing software, and continue to develop new projects with great influence, including OpenStack, Hadoop and Spark, which are widely used to build cloud services and massive data computing. The most widely used Android work environment on smartphones and tablets. Open-source system software and intermediary software have become an important foundation in the era of Internet of Things and massive data analysis. High efficiency, immediacy, and good communication and cooperation between machines are the keys to application development in this era. In addition to high efficiency, In addition to a stable and secure operating system, more high-quality, highly optimized system software and middleware are needed.

description.zh: 本課程介紹機器視覺之基本概念、原理及衍生應用，同時輔助以開放的影像函式庫來實作訓練；課程中由基礎的基本影像分析入門，並逐步導入機器視覺理論與方法，二維影像校正與立體視覺等內容；課程中將介紹機器視覺系統的相關資源與實作能力的培養，並進一步延伸至影像量測、機器學習與機器人領域的範例應用。
description.en: The field of machine vision has been growing at a fast pace. As in most developing fields, not all aspects of machine vision that are of interest to active researchers are useful to the designers and users of a vision system for a specific application. This course is intended to provide a balanced introduction to machine vision. Basic concepts are introduced with only essential mathematical elements. The details to allow implementation and use of vision algorithms in practical applications are provided, and engineering aspects of techniques are emphasized.

name.zh: 自然語言處理與文件探勘
name.en: Natural Language Processing and Text Mining

description.zh: 在各種應用領域中，非結構化的文件相當普遍。如何精確有效地從文件中擷取出重要資訊並分析語意，將有助於彙整不同想法。本課程介紹基本的自然語言處理技術，包括: 語彙組成、語法分析、語意分析等，以及常見的文件探勘方法。除了介紹詞性標註 (POS tagging)、關鍵詞擷取 (keyterm extraction)、中文斷詞 (word segmentation)之外，也將探討不同的字詞與文件表達方式，並應用深度學習方法進行有效的語意分析，如: 情緒分析、意見探勘等。
description.en: Unstructured text docuemnts are very common in various applicaton domains. How to extract important information from texts and analyze their meanings is very helpful to aggregate various ideas. In this course, we are going to introduce the basic techniques in Natural Language Processing including: lexical, syntactic, and semantic anlaysis, and common text mining methods. In addition to POS tagging, keyterm extraction, and word segmentation, we are going to discuss different word and document representations, and apply deep learning methods in effective semantic analysis such as sentiment analysis and opinion mining.

description.en: The purpose of the course is to introduce the present social sciences research technique and the religious characteristic, and lets students understand how to discuss and explain religion phenomenon. Wish through the understanding of "Philosophy of Religion "、" Comparative Religion " and "Phenomenology of Religion ", students can analyze the problems of life. Emphasis is on culture and the influence of life, as religion is a foundation supporting culture where problems of  life can stimulate the adaptation and development of religion.

description.zh: 本課程始自ㄧ系列關於「現代哲學」的演講，特別著重於那個階段的幾個主要的思想家，如笛卡兒、史賓諾莎、洛克、休姆，與柏克萊。藉此讓我們得以瞭解理性主義、經驗主義，與唯心論。接下來，我們會探討：企圖整合理性主義和經驗主義的康德批判哲學、馬克思的歷史唯物主義、達爾文的進化論、佛洛伊德的心理分析，與當代的ㄧ些重要理論，如存在主義、海德格、邏輯實證論，與分析哲學。
description.en: The course starts with a series of lectures on the history of modern philosophy with an emphasis of some major thinkers during that period of time such as Descartes, Spinoza, Locke, Hume, and Berkeley.  By doing so, we would learn outstanding thoughts concerning Rationalism, Empiricism, and Idealism.  We then shall move onto Kant with a particular look at his attempt of combining Rationalism and Empiricism into his Critical Philosophy.  Afterwards, we will study Historical Materialism and the theory of Evolution provided by Marx, and Darwin, respectively, followed by a look at Freud’s psychoanalysis and some other major accounts in our time such as Existentialism, Heidegger, logical positivism and analytical philosophy.

description.zh: 「展演藝術與表達」是一門符合現代精神與消費文化的課程，將過去展示消費與文化演出的精神融合成為新的趨勢。隨著時代的變遷，從過去以展示品及表演者為主的角色轉變為與消費者大眾的互動精神為主的概念。表演活動範圍也由純粹的表演活動，擴及商品消費空間及觀眾互動；而展示也由靜態之展覽，擴及表演空間與活動的加入，以有利於開擴展示品之魅力。因此將包含設計與藝術的整合、動態與靜態的表現、環境空間與人類行為的結合、參觀行為與學習行為的互動、消費娛樂與文化教育的交流等，表達多元展演精神與「整體藝術」的跨域表現。課程內容包括：展演藝術的定義、特質、起源與類別範圍等基本原理分析，並探討相關案例分析，最後透過實際創作方式進行演練，達成展演藝術與表達的課程目標。

syllabi.outline:
「展演藝術與表達」是一門符合現代精神與消費文化的課程，將過去展示消費與文化演出的精神融合成為新的趨勢。隨著時代的變遷，從過去以展示品及表演者為主的角色轉變為與消費者大眾的互動精神為主的概念。表演活動範圍也由純粹的表演活動，擴及商品消費空間及觀眾互動；而展示也由靜態之展覽，擴及表演空間與活動的加入，以有利於開擴展示品之魅力。因此將包含設計與藝術的整合、動態與靜態的表現、環境空間與人類行為的結合、參觀行為與學習行為的互動、消費娛樂與文化教育的交流等，表達多元展演精神與「整體藝術」的跨域表現。
"Performance/Display Art and Expression " is a course in line with the modern spirit and consumer culture, presenting a new trend which improves the past demonstration of consumption and cultural performances. With the changing times, public-oriented concept inviting consumer interaction replaces the past means in showing predominantly the goods and the main performers only. The scope of the performances shifts from sheer performing activities to expanded consumer goods space and audience interaction; the past static display/exhibition now adds performance space and activities so as to better introduce the charm of the goods. The course, therefore, will cover the integration of arts and design, dynamic and static performance/display, the integration of environmental space and human behavior, the interaction between visitor behavior and learner behavior, as well as the exchanges in consumer entertainment and culture education.

description.zh: 本課程旨在引導學生認識文化資產的基本概念、範疇與類別，了解文化資產的意義與價值，以及管理運用的重要性。介紹國內文化資產保存維護情形、管理組織、政策制定、重要母法及相關行政法規等。另援引探討不同類型文化資產管理實例，幫助學生習得文化資產管理實務知能及相應行政法規。

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋數位時代中一手檔案史料的整理與數位化過程，著重檔案資料的典藏管理與加值應用。課程目標在於培養學生的檔案智能，包括：1. 認識檔案資料類型與特性，以及數位保存的相關概念；2. 理解檔案編排分類與描述著錄等資訊組織的基本原則3. 具備檔案資料查找、評估與運用數位典藏等檔案專業素養。
description.en: This course will introduce the basic concepts and practical issues in modern archives administration. And then, focus on the long-term preservation and open access of digital archives. By attending the class students will: (1) Understand basic concepts of archival materials relating to digital preservation. (2) Gain in-deep understanding the principles of archives arrangement and information organization. (3) Possess the archival intelligence to find, evaluate and use the digital information.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將帶領同學認識並學習，文化機構如何在當代管理與應用龐大資源檔案？數位典藏的圖像如何進行授權應用？ 課程將從數位典藏檔案的文化價值與功能，進一步探索文化機構如何管理這些重要資源，並聚焦數位典藏圖像授權的法規與操作框架，培養同學在文化與創意產業領域的實務能力。 課程也將探索授權合作如何跨足不同領域，如藝術、設計、商業應用等，並解析文化藝術契約的實務案例，並邀請專業客座業師介紹數位科技行銷認證，藉以認識文化檔案的多元價值。 最後階段我們將探討數位圖像授權的代表性資料庫，延伸到當代檔案典藏的最新趨勢，並關心徵集的策略與倫理。課程將以期末成果發表作結，實際思考數位典藏與授權應用的潛力與可能性。

description.zh: 金屬工藝應用是一門以實作應用為主，概念講述為輔的金工課程，透過實際工藝技術進行教學，提供學生具基礎金工器物的製作能力，進而設計應用於生活物件，引導學生具系統性設計及製作能力，轉化概念成實技製作的專業，希望學生藉完成金屬工藝作品，將生活經驗中的價值與意涵融入，創造出屬於個人風格之設計。
description.en: The course ?Metalwork and Design? focuses mainly on practical application, while employing concepts thereof supplementary. The class is taught through demonstration and actual execution of arts and crafts techniques, thus providing students with the basic skills for utensil manufacturing. Followed by designing applicable day-to-day objects, the ultimate goal is to equip students with systematic designing and manufacturing aptitude, hence transmuting concepts into solid expertise. What we desire to achieve is that the students' completed work of art will be a blend of personal significance and practical value derived from everyday experiences.

syllabi.outline:
課程以循序漸進的方式，協助學生在陶瓷產品設計上所需能力支持及思維釐清。加強同學在材料運用上的廣度及深度，並學習自行發展主題性創意產出。課堂上以個別指導及分組討論的模式，協助學生發展自我的創作脈絡，以建立自我在產出概念及創意思考上的模式。
課程針對同學在陶瓷成型技術與知識基礎訓練之後，有異於過往以陶藝創作思維及思想批判性為主軸的教育模式，改以彩繪陶瓷文化傳承及鶯歌產業創生之社會問題導向，課程內容包括認識鶯歌陶藝發展問題、地方產業沒落問題、地方創生政策、及其他有關文化永續與社會實踐的視野。切入工藝創生與文化永續之議題，輔助學生建立工藝與社會人文議題關連性之整合概念。

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹期貨、選擇權與相關衍生性金融商品的理論基礎與實務概念，了解衍生性金融商品在套利、避險與投機策略上的應用。課程內容包含期貨與選擇權兩個部分：在期貨議題方面，主要介紹期貨市場的組織結構、期貨契約的理論價格、以及避險策略；在選擇權議題方面，則是涵蓋選擇權市場的介紹、選擇權的理論價格、交易策略、與市場資訊分析。藉由對期貨與選擇權理論基礎的建構，期望能強化同學對於衍生性金融商品的實務應用能力。
description.en: This course is designed to introduce students to the theoretical and practical aspects of financial futures, options, and other derivatives. Derivatives have become one of the most important tools of modern finance, from both the academic and the practical standpoint. They are used for compensation, speculation, yield enhancements of investments, and, most importantly, for risk management. This course consists of two parts. The first part of the course deals with futures issues including the structure of futures markets, pricing of futures contracts, and hedging with such contracts. The second part of the course deals with options issues including options markets, strategies, pricing, and hedging analysis. Students will learn about the theoretical underpinnings and the practical applications in real world of derivative securities.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級下學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In second semester, Junior students also can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 藝術與新意的遇合，一切就從分享開始! 不論黑白彩色、平面立體、抽象具象、靜態動感，藝術一向變化多端，不論抒發情感、宣揚宗教、服務政治或是傳達思想，藝術從來不缺理由，別說你不懂藝術!因為在二十一世紀裡，藝術已不僅是貴婦們的權力，身為未來設計師與建築師的您們，應該積極讓藝術存在於你生活的週遭，不論分享美感經驗、探討觀點流派、解析藝術風格、從事文化創意設計，亦或是批判現今藝術社群，你都擁有發聲的權力。而此系列講座中的十場演講，都是在不同藝術領域中，從事創作多年的佼佼者，透過大師講座的平台，讓大師們進入校園，與全校師生一同分享這藝術與新意的無限饗宴。
description.en: When art meets innovation, everything starts from sharing! No matter art is black or white, flat or three-dimensional, abstract or concrete, motionless or active, it has always been protean. When art is used to express feelings, advocate religions, propagandizing politics, or transmitting thoughts, it never needs any reason. Don't say that you don't know what art is! In the 21st century, art is no longer the privilege of wealthy ladies. But you all, the future designers and architects, should work harder to make yourself inseparable with art. When you are sharing your own experience about esthetics, exploring different art sects, analyzing art styles, engaging in cultural creative design, or criticizing the contemporary art sects, you have the right to speak up. The ten speeches in this series will be delivered by many experts from different fields. It would be our honor to have them in the campus and share their fruition of art with all of the staff and students.

When art is used to express feelings, advocate religions, propagandizing politics, or transmitting thoughts, it never needs any reason. Don't say that you don't know what art is! In the 21st century, art is no longer the privilege of wealthy ladies. But you all, the future designers and architects, should work harder to make yourself inseparable with art. When you are sharing your own experience about esthetics, exploring different art sects, analyzing art styles, engaging in cultural creative design, or criticizing the contemporary art sects, you have the right to speak up. 
In various artistic domains, through actual visits and lectures, let's share together the endless feast of art and innovation.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在以專題設計方式，訓練學生確認並建立需求、發展設計選擇方案、製作設計的互動形式、設計評估的專業知能，並以設計專案方式演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組合作或獨自創作完成一媒體設計主題。上學期課程以題目釐定、資料蒐集、分析調查、設計定義、構想發展、程式設計、雛型製作等活動為教學內容；下學期則進行觀察測試、使用性評估、程式調校、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容，以培養學生具備互動設計專題製作之專業知能。
Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of media design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. The course's learning materials in the first semester include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在以專題設計方式，訓練學生確認並建立需求、發展設計選擇方案、製作設計的互動形式、設計評估的專業知能，並以設計專案方式演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組合作或獨自創作完成一媒體設計主題。上學期課程以題目釐定、資料蒐集、分析調查、設計定義、構想發展、程式設計、雛型製作等活動為教學內容；下學期則進行觀察測試、使用性評估、程式調校、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容，以培養學生具備互動設計專題製作之專業知能。
Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of media design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. The course's learning materials in the first semester include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

name.zh: 體驗行銷互動設計專題
name.en: Project of Experiential Marketing Interaction Design

description.zh: 本課程設定為專題實務的課程。將導引學生透過簡單但完整的專案，認知互動設計於體驗行銷的實踐規劃。本課程也也將討論現在以及未來互動設計於使用者行為、服務行銷、以及品牌管理整合發展的議題與趨勢。
description.en: This is a practical course that will lead students to do a simple but comprehensive project for implementing interaction design in experiential marketing. This course covers contemporary topics in experiential marketing and includes discussion of recent and future developments in the integration of interaction design with consumer behavior, services marketing, and brand management.

syllabi.outline:
本課程設定為個案與專題實務的課程。在18周的課程中將引導學生透過不同類型的實務專案認知互動設計於體驗行銷的實踐規劃。本課程也將討論當前以及未來的互動設計於使用者行為、OMO行銷、以及品牌管理整合發展的議題與趨勢。
This is a practical course that will lead students to do some simple but comprehensive projects for implementing interaction design in experiential marketing. This course covers contemporary topics in experiential marketing and includes discussions of recent and future developments in the integration of interaction design with consumer behavior, OMO (Online merge Offline) marketing, and brand management.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1	互動式廣告研究課程介紹與要求– 學生發表對本課程的想像和預期學習目標

Week 4	互動式廣告的核心目標:引發行動與互動 (OMO 虛實融合的互動行銷)
Weekv5	互動式廣告的廣告效果 (What & How)
Week 6	互動式廣告運用的媒體平台(Paid Media, Owned Media, Earned Media)

Week 13	金犢獎互動廣告實務專案操作-2  (60%完成度)
Week 14	奧美廣告創意總監演講- 奧美觀點:數位時代的互動式廣告
Week 15	金犢獎互動廣告實務專案操作-3  (80%完成度)
Week 16	金犢獎互動廣告專案之小組互評及反饋
Week 17	金犢獎互動廣告專案最終修改完成作品分享會
Week 18	期末學習心得分享與線上問卷填答

description.zh: 課程重點將介紹企業識別系統(CIS)主要的三個要素，包含理念識別系統(MI、MIS)、活動識別系統(BI、BIS)、視覺識別系統(VI、VIS)，課程目標將介紹CIS系統的功能、導入時機以及開發、規劃設計和執行程序，讓學生理解各個系統，並瞭解各系統功能的相輔相成、環環相扣，進而整合出一個整體的識別系統。
description.en: This course presents three elements of corporate identity system, which are mind identity system (MI, MIS), behavior identity system (BI, BIS) and visual identity system (VI, VIS). Students will be introduced to all systems and learn about how these systems work together.

syllabi.outline:
This course explores the three pillars of Corporate Identity System: Mind Identity System (MIS), Behavior Identity System (BIS), and Visual Identity System (VIS). It aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills to create effective logo designs that embody an organization's ethos, behavior, and visual identity.
Course Objectives
1.Understand the principles of MIS, BIS, and VIS in the context of logo design.
2.Learn to integrate conceptual thinking with practical design skills.
3.Develop logos that effectively communicate a brand's identity.
4.Analyze real-world examples of successful corporate identity systems.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1-3: Introduction to Corporate Identity Systems
Overview of CIS: Definition and Importance
Understanding Mind Identity System (MIS)
Exploring Behavior Identity System (BIS)
Fundamentals of Visual Identity System (VIS)
Week 4-6: Deep Dive into Mind Identity System (MIS)
Psychological aspects of branding
Conceptualizing brand personality
Case studies analysis
Week 7-9: Exploring Behavior Identity System (BIS)
Brand behavior and consumer perception
Aligning brand values with behavior
Workshop: Developing a BIS strategy
Week 10-12: Mastering Visual Identity System (VIS)
Elements of visual identity: Color, Typography, Imagery
Logo design principles and techniques
Software and tools for logo creation
Week 13-15: Integrated CIS Approach in Logo Design
Synthesizing MIS, BIS, and VIS in logo creation
Project: Designing a logo with a comprehensive CIS approach
Peer reviews and critiques
Week 16: Final Project and Presentation
Develop a complete CIS for a hypothetical or real company
Present the project, highlighting the integration of MIS, BIS, and VIS

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年(一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年(一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

syllabi.notes:
1. The content of each week in this course is related to SDGs 4: Quality Education. This course is to educate students to establish lifelong habits and methods for learning Chinese.
2. Each week's content in this course is related to “Expectations”. Learning Chinese is also a part of learning Taiwan’s high-quality moral culture. Through rewards and praise, this course helps students understand and set reasonable and high-quality moral goals. This course achieves the purpose of rewards and praise through classroom Q&A and discussion.

description.zh: 本課程旨在整合應用程式與設計，完成互動設計作品。為達成此目標，本課程培養學生熟悉與整合互動設計的理論、方法與應用，以具互動性的設計議題，訓練學生獨立創作或分組合作設計，藉此訓練學生創意思考、應用科技與新知的實作能力，同時也可結合產學合作專案於教學活動內，達到務實致用的目標。
description.en: This course applies design and programming into interaction design projects. To achieve this goal, students will familiarize the theories, methodology and implications of interaction design in this course. By interaction design issues, students create and implement ideas by brainstorming through independent study or cooperative learning. For competition without any gap, industry-academic cooperation is one way to prepare student’s critical competencies same as the desired competencies required by the industry.

syllabi.outline:
Course Objectives:
Understand the fundamental principles and applications of interactive design.
Develop creative design skills to complete individual or group interactive design projects.
Foster teamwork and communication skills.
Explore the applications of various interactive design media and platforms.
Teaching Methods: Lectures, group discussions, hands-on guidance, case studies, and project presentations.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Course Introduction
Overview of the course and expected outcomes.
Introduction to the fundamentals of interactive design with case studies.
Student introductions and group assignments.
Week 2: Interactive Design Theories and Tools Overview
User experience design and human-computer interaction theories.
Introduction to commonly used tools (e.g., Figma, Unity, Processing).
Week 3: Topic Selection and Requirement Analysis
Guide students in selecting their interactive design topics.
User research and goal setting.
Week 4: Creative Brainstorming and Concept Development
Brainstorming activities.
Each group presents initial concept sketches.
Week 5: Storytelling and User Journey Design
Crafting user stories and journey mapping.
Group feedback and discussions.
Week 6: Technical Experimentation and Prototype Testing
Guide students in creating low-fidelity prototypes using design tools.
Test user interaction experiences and record feedback.
Week 7: Design Refinement
Provide guidance to further refine interactive designs.
Discuss visual design and technical details.
Week 8: Midterm Review
Groups present their design progress.
Feedback and improvement suggestions from the instructor and peers.
Week 9: Motion and Responsive Design
Teach principles of animation and interaction effects.
Apply these concepts to student projects.
Week 10: Multisensory Interaction Design
Explore the application of sensory elements such as sound and touch.
Group experiments and sharing.
Week 11: Technical Integration
Guide students in integrating various technologies into their projects.
Solve technical challenges and difficulties.
Week 12: Mid-Stage Testing and User Feedback
Groups showcase their interim results.
Conduct simulated user testing and collect improvement suggestions.
Week 13: Iteration and Optimization
Analyze testing results and iterate designs.
Ensure the technical and design feasibility of the projects.
Week 14: Final Touches
Refine the interactive experience and visual details of projects.
Discuss strategies for project presentations.
Week 15: Final Project Production
Groups focus on completing their final projects.
Address technical issues and offer guidance.
Week 16: Presentation Rehearsal
Groups conduct mock presentations.
Collect feedback and make final adjustments.
Week 17: Final Project Presentation
Showcase final projects to the instructor and peers.
Group feedback and evaluations.
Week 18: Course Review and Reflection
Class discussion on course takeaways and challenges.
Instructor summary and evaluations.

Participation and Discussions: 20%
Midterm Review Report: 30%
Final Project Presentation: 50%

description.zh: 課程重點將介紹企業識別系統(CIS)主要的三個要素，包含理念識別系統(MI、MIS)、活動識別系統(BI、BIS)、視覺識別系統(VI、VIS)，課程目標將介紹CIS系統的功能、導入時機以及開發、規劃設計和執行程序，讓學生理解各個系統，並瞭解各系統功能的相輔相成、環環相扣，進而整合出一個整體的識別系統。
description.en: This course presents three elements of corporate identity system, which are mind identity system (MI, MIS), behavior identity system (BI, BIS) and visual identity system (VI, VIS). Students will be introduced to all systems and learn about how these systems work together.

syllabi.outline:
This course explores the three pillars of Corporate Identity System: Mind Identity System (MIS), Behavior Identity System (BIS), and Visual Identity System (VIS). It aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills to create effective logo designs that embody an organization's ethos, behavior, and visual identity.
Course Objectives
1.Understand the principles of MIS, BIS, and VIS in the context of logo design.
2.Learn to integrate conceptual thinking with practical design skills.
3.Develop logos that effectively communicate a brand's identity.
4.Analyze real-world examples of successful corporate identity systems.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1-3: Introduction to Corporate Identity Systems
Overview of CIS: Definition and Importance
Understanding Mind Identity System (MIS)
Exploring Behavior Identity System (BIS)
Fundamentals of Visual Identity System (VIS)
Week 4-6: Deep Dive into Mind Identity System (MIS)
Psychological aspects of branding
Conceptualizing brand personality
Case studies analysis
Week 7-9: Exploring Behavior Identity System (BIS)
Brand behavior and consumer perception
Aligning brand values with behavior
Workshop: Developing a BIS strategy
Week 10-12: Mastering Visual Identity System (VIS)
Elements of visual identity: Color, Typography, Imagery
Logo design principles and techniques
Software and tools for logo creation
Week 13-15: Integrated CIS Approach in Logo Design
Synthesizing MIS, BIS, and VIS in logo creation
Project: Designing a logo with a comprehensive CIS approach
Peer reviews and critiques
Week 16: Final Project and Presentation
Develop a complete CIS for a hypothetical or real company
Present the project, highlighting the integration of MIS, BIS, and VIS

description.zh: 本課程之目的要使學生瞭解品質管理的觀念及原理。品管部門的組織、功能。如何管理產品或服務的品質，品質的工具、方法。學習品質表示法，持續改善品質的方法，評估品質管理成效。學習相關法令，品質管理的未來趨勢。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the concepts and principles of quality management. Organization and function of quality control department. How to manage the quality of products or services, quality tools, methods? Learn quality representations, methods for continuous improvement of quality, and evaluate the effectiveness of quality management. Study related laws and regulations, the future trend of quality management.

description.zh: 本課程為一門「總整課程」(Capstone course)，由2-4位學生組成。與指導教授討論及擬定專題研究的題目，在教授的指導下進行實驗研究，並將研究結果寫成專題報告。包括培養以下四種能力：1.整合(integration)，2. 收尾(closure)，3. 反思(reflection)，4. 過渡(transition)。
description.en: This course is a "Capstone course" consisting of 2-4 students. Discuss and formulate the topic of topic research with the guidance professor, conduct experimental research under the guidance of the professor, and write the research results into a special report. Including the cultivation of the following four abilities: 1. integration, 2. closure, 3. reflection, and 4. transition.

The topic of the special project is discussed and decided together by the students and the advisor. Under the face-to-face instruction of the advisor the student will conduct the research and experiments, and the final report at the end of the semester. The students can't change their chosen topic during the semester, except after the grade of the term being filed and under the consents of the original advisor and new advisor.

description.zh:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

description.zh: 此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

This course is designed to enable students to develop the principles and skills necessary for public speaking. Included will be guidelines for giving a speech and displaying body language, as well as practice sessions for delivering prepared speeches and impromptu speeches.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為五專部工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週4小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en:
The course is aimed directly at the five-year-degree-program students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to
emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester, and 4 lecture hours per week.

description.en: This course aims at providing an English-speaking environment to allow students learn about the speaking strategies and common expressions used in different situations. Stimulating themes and authentic content will be used to engage students and generate lively conversation, such as thought-provoking newspaper, magazine articles, and video films. Activities include role-playing, task-based pair and small-group discussion for maximum practice and personalization.

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.
