description.zh:
本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。
課程內容：包含四大階段
（一）勞作教育理念介紹：選取勞作教育相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含勞作教育意義、勞作教育前測作業說明
（二）勞作教育實作階段：勞作課程分三項不同情境施作。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須於各實作階段課程進行討論與反思，並撰寫心得報告、完成後測作業。
（四）期末成果分享：勞作教育期末成果分享，並辦理獎勵工作。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

syllabi.outline:
期望學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，並從實作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，同時建立學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。

Students are expected to understand the concept of labor education through campus environment maintenance and cleaning activities. Through hands-on courses, students will develop an entrepreneurial spirit of not fearing hardship, difficulty, or dirt. Additionally, the activities aim to instill the values of diligent work, care for belongings, and the simultaneous use of both hands and mind. These experiences will help cultivate well-rounded character, correct values, and a strong work ethic in students.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程旨在為學生奠定紮實的英語文法與句型結構基礎，幫助學生掌握不完整句、連寫句、誤置修飾語、不連結修飾語、錯誤平行結構等關鍵文法知識。於此基礎上，課程將進一步培養學生的段落寫作技巧，包括敘述、描述、闡釋和論證等，使學生能撰寫條理分明、結構嚴謹之段落。
description.en: This course provides a solid foundation in English grammar and sentence construction, helping students master key grammatical elements like sentence fragments, run-on sentences, misplaced modifiers, dangling modifiers, and faulty parallelism. Building upon this grammatical foundation, this course further develops students’ paragraph writing skills through techniques such as narration, description, exposition, and argumentation, enabling students to craft well-structured paragraphs.

syllabi.outline: Main objective of this course is threefold: (1) to provide a review of essential grammar skills to construct sentences that convey ideas effectively and clearly; (2) to compose a paragraph that has clearly stated topic sentence with adequate development and appropriate organization; (3) to identify and correct sentence structure and syntactic problems.

name.en: Literature for Children and Young Adults

description.zh: 本課程的主旨在針對兒童文學與青少年文學的經典之作，給予學生閱讀與分析上的訓練，並培養學生對不同文學主題和寫作風格的鑑賞能力。
description.en: Focusing on some of the masterpieces in children's literature and young adults' literature, this course aims at sharpening up the students' reading and analyzing skills and to cultivate their appreciation for different literary themes and writing styles.

syllabi.outline: Objectives:It is the goal of the course to help  our  students  learn  English language and related cultural background knowledge through children and young adult literature with all its inherent cultural and educational significance.The treasure of literature, especially suitable and meaningful for children and teenagers, will be explored in a variety of learning activities in the class, including reading, discussions, role plays, creating picture books, and analyzing film adaptations with the aim to cultivate students’ full language skills and to enrich their cultural literacy in order to build a sound foundation for their future studies.

name.en: English Communication and Application II (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

syllabi.outline:
ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。
課程內容：包含四大階段

（二）勞作教育實作階段：勞作課程分三項不同情境施作。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須於各實作階段課程進行討論與反思，並撰寫心得報告、完成後測作業。
（四）期末成果分享：勞作教育期末成果分享，並辦理獎勵工作。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

本科目旨在探討人們的選擇行為，亦即如何利用有限的資源，以滿足人類無限的慾望。個體經濟學著眼於價格機能之方析，範圍涵蓋：消費者行為、廠商理論、各種市場的結構分析、以及公共部門的決策。
Economics explores choice behavior of human beings. Especially, it concerns how people make choice in order to satisfy their unlimited desire under limited resources. Microeconomics focuses on the analysis of price mechanism which involves consumer behavior, firms' decision making, structure of various markets, and public sector.

syllabi.outline:
一、	課程宗旨與目標
有句名言闡述企業經營的全貌，「唯一不變的，就是變」。 在快速競爭的時代，企業經營所面臨的課題無論在政治、經濟、企業經營以及環境議題各個層都面臨劇烈的挑戰。透過本課程能夠帶給學生時時更新的管理知識以及企業策略的思維，輔以全球以及臺灣本土的個案，讓學生能夠對照不同思維的管理模式。相信對企業管理能夠有更新的視野以及感受。

name.en: English Communication and Application II (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。
課程內容：包含四大階段
（一）勞作教育理念介紹：選取勞作教育相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含勞作教育意義、勞作教育前測作業說明
（二）勞作教育實作階段：勞作課程分三項不同情境施作。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須於各實作階段課程進行討論與反思，並撰寫心得報告、完成後測作業。
（四）期末成果分享：勞作教育期末成果分享，並辦理獎勵工作。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本課程以計算機硬體及軟體之基本介紹為始，逐步引入程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Python及C語言為基礎，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入C++程式語言。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練及其在資訊工程上之應用，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計專業之基礎。
description.en: To familiarize the student with basic computer programming concepts. Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer solutions, as well as an introduction into the syntax and semantics of the Python,C and C++ programming language. An important objective of the course is to present effective methods of program design using modular construction and structured programming notions of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

syllabi.outline: 本課程介紹計算機程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Python/C語言為基礎，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入程式設計技術。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練及其在資訊工程上之應用，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計專業之基礎。 實習目的使學生熟悉計算機應用程式設計之環境、方法、及原則。內容含程式設計環境、程式語言結構、基本函數、流程控制、與資料結構。

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。上述課程內容將是資工系專業需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc..

syllabi.outline:
本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

name.en: English Communication and Application II (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。
課程內容：包含四大階段
（一）勞作教育理念介紹：選取勞作教育相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含勞作教育意義、勞作教育前測作業說明
（二）勞作教育實作階段：勞作課程分三項不同情境施作。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須於各實作階段課程進行討論與反思，並撰寫心得報告、完成後測作業。
（四）期末成果分享：勞作教育期末成果分享，並辦理獎勵工作。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本課程的目的是為了：1.驗證物理理論之真實性，2.培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3.培養同學數據處理的能力，4.啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。
description.en: In this course there will be 1 credit for each of two semesters, and 3 laboraborial hours per week. The first semester experiments involve mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, and waves, etc.. The second semester experiments contains electromagnetics, optics, and modern physics, etc.. The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 介紹單位換算與有效數位，元素的原子結構、化學方程式平衡與計算，反應熱，氣體與氣體定律，大氣層與環境污染，週期表，化學鍵，化合物的分子結構，熱力學，動力學，反應機構，平衡常數，氧化與還原，酸鹼反應，電化學，混合物的分離及現代科技材料，奠定良好化學基礎。
description.en: The course is designed for chemical engineering major. The topics explore chemistry at a greater depth and with more emphasis on concepts, problems, and calculations. Topics include significant figures, thermochemistry, gases, quantum theory and the electronic structure of atoms, periodic relationships, chemical bonding, chemical reaction, oxidation-reduction reaction, chemical kinetics, chemical equilibrium, acids and bases, changes of states, synthetic polymer materials, electrochemistry.

syllabi.outline:
本課程在介紹及闡述化學原理及物質之性質，著重於現代化學理論及概念之導入。內容包括氣體、計量化學、原子結構、化學鍵、物質狀態、能量轉換、酸鹼理論、氧化還原反應、金屬及非金屬元素、電化學、有機化學、核化學。
Introduction to the principles of chemistry and properties of matter, which are explained in terms of modern chemical theory with emphasis on conceptual problems. Individual topics include gas, stoichiometry, atomic structure, chemical bonding, and the states of matter, energy relation, acid-base theory and oxidation-reduction reactions, the chemistry of metallic and nonmetallic elements, nuclear chemistry.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標乃是協助學生透過有意義之社區服務活動，認識服務學習理念，從服務學習中體驗服務的意義，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。
課程內容：包含三大類
（一）志願服務基礎課程：選取志願服務相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含服務學習理論、內政部志願服務法所訂定之六大主題（志願服務的內涵、志願服務倫理、自我了解及自我肯定、志願服務經驗分享、志願服務法規之認識、志願服務發展趨勢），或非營利組織、服務機構之介紹等等。
（二）社區服務：選擇服務機構前往服務，於本學期內完成授課教師所規定服務時數或內容。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須進行服務經驗分享與討論，並撰寫與繳交服務日誌、心得報告。
description.en:
This course is geared to expand and intensify students' learning beyond classroom by introducing service learning as an integral part of holistic life learning experience. Apart from class work, students will be able to not only understand the significance of services and experience the true value of such learning through various forms of community work. The course is designed to deepen their learning and life experience.
I. Core curricula of services: The course is structured on the framework of six themes in service learning by theory and practice as well as legal regulations regarding community services enacted by the Ministry of the Interior. The six themes respectively are: significance of service; standards of service; self-comprehension and affirmation; sharing service experience; service law and trends; and non-profit and service organizations.
II. Community service: Students select or be arranged to service organizations and are responsible for completing service assignments

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.schedule:
第1週  課程說明
第2週  閱讀寫作討論
第3週  生命設計及人物訪談：本週將介紹生命設計思考理論，幫助同學創造理想人生；並介紹職涯測驗以進行自我深度探索；同時將介紹訪談寫作，透過訪談以充分了解他人處境，打造自身生命原型體驗。 
第4週  理解溝通：本週將運用桌遊遊戲來進行自我深度探索；同時引導同學針對未來工作進行資料蒐集。 
第5週  全校運動會停課
第6週  履歷自傳寫作：本週將介紹履歷及自傳寫作方法及相關原則。
第7週  職場表達：本週將運用桌遊遊戲讓同學體驗自我表達與交流，同時討論面試技巧。
第8週  專題講座
第9週  履歷自傳討論及面試活動：本週將採取小組修改討論，協助同學修改整潤履歷自傳；同時於課堂練習表達及面試技巧。 
第10週  企畫書發想：本週將介紹設計發想技巧，並進行實作練習。
第11週 企畫書結構與評估：本週將介紹企畫書書寫要點及評估原則，並進行實例討論。
第12週  小組討論：本週為小組討論時間，協助同學準備期末企畫專題。可備筆電，以利作業。
第13週  企畫書撰寫：本週將說明企畫書的內容結構，並進行小組討論。可備筆電，以利作業。
第14週  企畫提案設計及小組討論：本週將說明企畫提案設計技巧，並進行實例討論；同時也安排小組討論時間，協助準備期末企畫提案。可備筆電，以利作業。
第15週  企畫書小組提案1
第16週  企畫書小組提案2
第17週  企畫書小組提案3
第18週  學期回顧與個別討論

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline: Our school's general physics courses are specially designed for students with engineering backgrounds. The main purpose is to encourage students to participate in the exploration of the mysteries and laws of the operation of nature, and to provide a solid foundation for subsequent professional courses. The content of this course includes mechanics, thermodynamics, acoustics, electromagnetism, optics and modern physics. The professor can design the course based on three hours per week and two semesters, and then consider the different needs of each department to strengthen or omit certain chapters.

syllabi.outline: 本課程是以靜力學為範疇，主要是探討靜力平衡下物體受力的情形及穩定性的問題，其重點著重在力的分析。由於是基礎學科，因此授課方式以課堂講授為主，同學課後於課本習題練習為輔，以加深學生在力學觀念之認知。本課程設計之目標乃是希望充實同學在基礎力學方面之專業知識，俾便與大二材料力學等課程能夠相銜接，同時能夠瞭解力學在工程上之簡單應用。期待學生透過本課程對於力學的概念，能奠下好的基礎。

name.zh: 程式設計與人工智慧(二)

description.zh: 本課程介紹可用於人工智慧與自動化技術之程式設計之進階觀念及應用，內容包含Python程式語言與C++視窗程式設計語言，並引入物件導向程式設計的觀念與方法。其內容涵蓋：1.視窗程式簡介，2.物件導向程式設計概念，3. 物件導向程式結構與類別觀念，4.物件導向程式多型與封裝觀念，5.Python程式語言設計。本課程著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，使修習者具備物件導向程式設計與人工智慧技術之基礎。
description.en: This introductory course covers the fundamentals and applications of programming design applicable to artificial intelligence and automation, including: 1.introduction to Window programming, 2.design concept of object-oriented programming (OOP). 3.structure and class in OOP. 4. encapsulation and overloading in OOP. 5.Python programming design. 7.fundamental concept and capability of OOP and Python languages for artificial intelligence.

syllabi.outline: 本課程介紹可用於人工智慧與自動化技術之程式設計基礎觀念及應用。主要目標使學生具有視窗程式設計概念，再引入物件程式設計的觀念與方法，其內容涵蓋：視窗程式簡介，物件程式設計簡介，程式設計語言以C語言為基礎，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入C++程式語言與Python程式語言。教學著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，使修習者奠定程式設計之基礎。

name.en: English Communication and Application II (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標乃是協助學生透過有意義之社區服務活動，認識服務學習理念，從服務學習中體驗服務的意義，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。
課程內容：包含三大類
（一）志願服務基礎課程：選取志願服務相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含服務學習理論、內政部志願服務法所訂定之六大主題（志願服務的內涵、志願服務倫理、自我了解及自我肯定、志願服務經驗分享、志願服務法規之認識、志願服務發展趨勢），或非營利組織、服務機構之介紹等等。
（二）社區服務：選擇服務機構前往服務，於本學期內完成授課教師所規定服務時數或內容。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須進行服務經驗分享與討論，並撰寫與繳交服務日誌、心得報告。
description.en:
This course is geared to expand and intensify students' learning beyond classroom by introducing service learning as an integral part of holistic life learning experience. Apart from class work, students will be able to not only understand the significance of services and experience the true value of such learning through various forms of community work. The course is designed to deepen their learning and life experience.
I. Core curricula of services: The course is structured on the framework of six themes in service learning by theory and practice as well as legal regulations regarding community services enacted by the Ministry of the Interior. The six themes respectively are: significance of service; standards of service; self-comprehension and affirmation; sharing service experience; service law and trends; and non-profit and service organizations.
II. Community service: Students select or be arranged to service organizations and are responsible for completing service assignments

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

syllabi.outline:
本課程中英雙語授課。This course will be taught bilingually in Chinese and English. 

線性代數為科學與工程的基礎數學工具，本課程教授線性代數的基本概念與運算技巧。課程大綱包括：矩陣、線性聯立方程組、線性轉換、向量空間、特徵值及特徵向量、正交性與最小平方估計。
This course Linear Algebra
- is a mathematics course.
- is useful and fundamental to EECS/CSIE (and many other discipline) students.
- emphasizes both computations and concepts.
- guides you to read an English textbook.
- requires hard work.
本課程
- 為數學課
- 為電資/資工領域(及許多其他專業領域)學生基礎課程
- 計算與概念並重
- 引導同學閱讀英文教科書
- 需要同學用功讀書
syllabi.schedule:
課程資料將透過北科i學園+、FB、Teams、或Zuvio公布。
課程進度：
1. Matrix Operations (Sections 2.1 and 2.2) 矩陣運算
- To learn basic matrix arithmetic operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication power, transpose, and inverse. 矩陣加、減、乘、乘方、轉置、反矩陣
2. Linear Equations (Sections 1.1 to 1.5) 線性方程式
- To understand the basic terminologies and notations of matrices and systems of linear equations, in the forms of vector equation and matrix equation. 線性聯立方程組、向量方程式、矩陣方程式
- Solving a system of linear equations by reducing a matrix to its echelon form. 解線性聯立方程組、階梯型式
Test #1
3. Introduction to Linear Independence and Linear Transformation (Sections 1.7, 1.8, and 2.3) 線性獨立與線性轉換
- First exposure to key concepts such as linear independence and linear transformation. 線性獨立與線性轉換初探
- More about the matrix inverse. 更多有關反矩陣
- To summarize the concepts for systems of n linear equations in n unknowns. 綜整n個變數n個線性方程式
Midterm Exam
3. Vector Spaces (Chapter 4) 向量空間
- Introduction to vector spaces. 向量空間簡介
- Fundamental subspaces of a matrix: column space, row space, and null space. 矩陣子空間：行空間、列空間、零空間
- Basis, coordinate system and dimension. 基底、座標系統和維度
Test #2
4. Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors (Chapter 5) 特徵值與特徵向量
- To understand the meaning of eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a matrix, and the approaches to find them. 矩陣特徵值與特徵向量的意義與計算方式
- Diagonalization of a matrix (linear transformation). 矩陣的對角化
5.  Orthogonality and Least Squares (Chapter 6) 正交性與最小平方
- To introduce inner product of vectors, and thus the geometric concepts of length, distance, and angle (perpendicularity). 向量內積，長度、距離、角度(垂直)
- To be familiar with the use of orthogonal bases. 正交基底
- Least-Squares approximation. 最小平方估計
Final Exam

description.zh: 本課程介紹ARM CPU 及以ARM CPU為核心之微算機系統。內容包含：ARM CPU介紹，ARM CPU指令集，SRAM、DRAM、及Flash Memory之介紹，時序圖之閱讀，記憶體及I/O解碼，串列I/O及並列I/O之介紹，計時及計數器之使用，震盪器介紹，A/D及D/A轉換，中斷之使用，及應用實例之介紹。

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標乃是協助學生透過有意義之社區服務活動，認識服務學習理念，從服務學習中體驗服務的意義，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。
課程內容：包含三大類
（一）志願服務基礎課程：選取志願服務相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含服務學習理論、內政部志願服務法所訂定之六大主題（志願服務的內涵、志願服務倫理、自我了解及自我肯定、志願服務經驗分享、志願服務法規之認識、志願服務發展趨勢），或非營利組織、服務機構之介紹等等。
（二）社區服務：選擇服務機構前往服務，於本學期內完成授課教師所規定服務時數或內容。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須進行服務經驗分享與討論，並撰寫與繳交服務日誌、心得報告。
description.en:
This course is geared to expand and intensify students' learning beyond classroom by introducing service learning as an integral part of holistic life learning experience. Apart from class work, students will be able to not only understand the significance of services and experience the true value of such learning through various forms of community work. The course is designed to deepen their learning and life experience.
I. Core curricula of services: The course is structured on the framework of six themes in service learning by theory and practice as well as legal regulations regarding community services enacted by the Ministry of the Interior. The six themes respectively are: significance of service; standards of service; self-comprehension and affirmation; sharing service experience; service law and trends; and non-profit and service organizations.
II. Community service: Students select or be arranged to service organizations and are responsible for completing service assignments

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

syllabi.outline: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數，12.常微分方程。

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline:
此課程旨在使學生理解自然界中常見的物理現象，進而領會物理-生活-科技之關聯。教學以工程背景學生所需要的物理基礎搭配實務探討來進行。主題涵蓋力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學等物理相關的觀念與應用。
This course aims to enable students to understand common physical phenomena in nature and then understand the connection between physics, life and technology. The teaching is based on the physical foundation required by students with engineering background and practical discussions. Topics cover physics-related concepts and applications such as mechanics, thermodynamics, acoustics, electromagnetism, and optics.

description.zh: 課程介紹電腦基本常識、人工智慧相關應用、程式設計簡介，內容包含資料型態、流程控制、函式、副程式、陣列與字串、檔案、應用程式設計以及類神經網路與深度學習簡介。
description.en: The course introduces basic computer concept, AI-related applications and programming technique. The contents include data types, flow control, functions, subroutine, arrays, strings, files, neural networks, deep learning and their applications.

syllabi.outline:
This course emphasizes understanding the algorithms behind programming solutions, rather than focusing solely on mastering a specific programming language. You will learn how to conceptualize, develop, and implement algorithms to solve engineering problems, with a dual-language approach to demonstrate versatility. Lectures will utilize Fortran to teach algorithmic fundamentals, while Python will be used to replicate tasks, showcasing how the same logic translates across languages.

An integral component of this course is leveraging Generative AI tools, such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, and Replit, to aid in code generation, validation, and exploration of new programming paradigms. Students will develop skills to critically evaluate AI-generated code, refine it to meet their objectives, and learn new coding languages by building upon existing knowledge. Through this approach, you will gain confidence in creating robust and adaptable solutions for engineering challenges.
syllabi.schedule:
Part I: Theory and Tools (2-3 weeks)
1. Introduction to Programming and GenAI Tools: Overview of the importance of programming in engineering, introduction to Generative AI tools like ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, and Replit, and their role in coding. Discussing the choice of programming languages and fundamental programming concepts.
2. Development Environment: Introduction to the Linux platform, vim editor, compilers, interpreters, and data visualization tools such as gnuplot. Focus on data collection, analysis, and visualization techniques.
Part II: Fundamentals of Programming (7 weeks)
1. Input and Output: Techniques for reading from and writing to different data sources.
2. Variables and Declaration: Understanding data types, variable declaration, and scope.
3. Mathematical Functions: Utilizing built-in math functions for engineering calculations.
4. Control Structures: Implementing loops (do loops) and conditional statements (if statements) for flow control.
5. Arrays and Data Handling: Managing and manipulating arrays for efficient data storage and retrieval.
6. Subroutines and Modules: Creating reusable code with subroutines and modules; introduction to random number generation.
Part III: Algorithm Development (4-6 weeks)
1. Data Sorting: Techniques and algorithms for sorting data effectively.
2. Statistical Analysis: Implementing algorithms for statistical computations and data interpretation.
3. Probability and Histograms: Coding solutions for probability calculations and histogram generation.
4. Regression Analysis: Developing algorithms for regression analysis to model and predict data trends.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

name.en: English Communication and Application II (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

syllabi.outline:
課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh:
本課程目標乃是協助學生透過有意義之社區服務活動，認識服務學習理念，從服務學習中體驗服務的意義，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。
課程內容：包含三大類
（一）志願服務基礎課程：選取志願服務相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含服務學習理論、內政部志願服務法所訂定之六大主題（志願服務的內涵、志願服務倫理、自我了解及自我肯定、志願服務經驗分享、志願服務法規之認識、志願服務發展趨勢），或非營利組織、服務機構之介紹等等。
（二）社區服務：選擇服務機構前往服務，於本學期內完成授課教師所規定服務時數或內容。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須進行服務經驗分享與討論，並撰寫與繳交服務日誌、心得報告。
description.en:
This course is geared to expand and intensify students' learning beyond classroom by introducing service learning as an integral part of holistic life learning experience. Apart from class work, students will be able to not only understand the significance of services and experience the true value of such learning through various forms of community work. The course is designed to deepen their learning and life experience.
I. Core curricula of services: The course is structured on the framework of six themes in service learning by theory and practice as well as legal regulations regarding community services enacted by the Ministry of the Interior. The six themes respectively are: significance of service; standards of service; self-comprehension and affirmation; sharing service experience; service law and trends; and non-profit and service organizations.
II. Community service: Students select or be arranged to service organizations and are responsible for completing service assignments

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.outline: 數位技術的應用已成為設計與視覺化溝通上重要的一環。然而數位輔助工具的使用，仍需操作者能以立體的方式去形容所要建構的物件或空間。因此培養學生三維觀察、思考、與想像視覺化的能力依舊是現在設計教育所不可或缺的。本課程便是藉由徒手繪與數位操作的平行訓練，來培養學生在設計上所需要的三維思考想像與傳達呈現的能力。

description.zh: 掌握形式從屬機能旨意，熟悉施作技術限制與創意可行性，學習從設計到實作的落實，透過各種機械設備操作、加工技術學習，實際接觸及操作真實材料，了解材料種類、性質、加工過程、組裝知識、技術與美學等，以呈現設計作品之原型與成品。
description.en: Based on “Form follows Function”, student will learn interacts and limitations among technology feasibility and creative application, in order to master sequential implementations form design ideas to real works. Students are required to operate various mechanical equipment and processing technologies, thus to realize the types and nature of the materials, processing procedure, as well as the assembly of knowledge, technologies and aesthetics to format intended design prototypes and establishments.

name.zh: 程式設計與人工智慧導論
name.en: Fundamentals of Programming and Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹程式設計的基本概念和技術，以及人工智慧的發展和應用。課程內容涵蓋程式語言的基本語法，以及人工智慧的基礎觀念與理論，並藉由編程練習及AI工具操作來進一步了解人工智慧應用以及程式設計的潛在應用。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts and techniques of programming, as well as the development and application of artificial intelligence. The course content covers basic syntax for the programming languages, along with the fundamental concept theories of artificial intelligence. Through programming practices and AI tool manipulations, the students can gain a further understanding of the artificial intelligence application and the potential application via programming.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將介紹程式設計的基礎，透過腳本式語言及基礎程式語言的應用，培養學生程式設計的基本能力。本課程除加強技術開發能力外，也將導引學生，如何透過獨立思考來面對問題及分析問題，並透過程式的撰寫來解決問題。
This course will introduce the fundamental of computer programming design. Student will learn the capability of programming design using script language and basic programming language. This course will also provide the knowledge and methods for students to realize and analyze specific problem independently. So that they can using computer program to solve the problems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以Creo Parametric(Pro/E) 2.0為教學載具，針對實體造型功能(包括擠出、旋轉、掃瞄、混成、使用曲面、邊界曲面、圓角、倒角…)，且加入拔模、薄殼等進階特徵，綜合應用範例介紹。
本課程為延續性課程，應有先修前學期電腦輔助繪圖與設計基礎者為宜，且以設計學院學生優先。

description.zh:
設計的溝通扮演著如何將設計理念成功地傳達以及讓使用者清楚的理解設計本意的重要角色。
本課程將透過設計思考過程藉由文字、口說、圖面等達到設計溝通之目的及訓練，經由了解設計領域應用之文字搭配口說及圖面進而增進設計者說明設計概念的溝通能力。
課程內容包含設計溝通的基本原則、技巧及策略，以及如何利用不同的溝通媒介及工具來傳達設計理念。
課程操作包含案例分析搭配實際的簡報演練及口說訓練讓同學們累積應用經驗。
description.en:
Design Communication plays an important role in how to successfully deliver design concepts and have users understand the design intention clearly. 
This course will practice and reach the goal of design communication through design thinking by vocabulary uses, verbal speeches, and image presentations.  From understanding the proper application of design language including vocabularies and diagrams in various design fields, designers may improve their skills of concept presentation and communication.  
The course content includes basic principles, techniques, and strategies in design communication as well as how to use different media and tools to deliver design concepts.
Course activities include case studies with presentation practice and oral speech to help students have experiences in actual application.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標乃是協助學生透過有意義之社區服務活動，認識服務學習理念，從服務學習中體驗服務的意義，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。
課程內容：包含三大類
（一）志願服務基礎課程：選取志願服務相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含服務學習理論、內政部志願服務法所訂定之六大主題（志願服務的內涵、志願服務倫理、自我了解及自我肯定、志願服務經驗分享、志願服務法規之認識、志願服務發展趨勢），或非營利組織、服務機構之介紹等等。
（二）社區服務：選擇服務機構前往服務，於本學期內完成授課教師所規定服務時數或內容。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須進行服務經驗分享與討論，並撰寫與繳交服務日誌、心得報告。
description.en:
This course is geared to expand and intensify students' learning beyond classroom by introducing service learning as an integral part of holistic life learning experience. Apart from class work, students will be able to not only understand the significance of services and experience the true value of such learning through various forms of community work. The course is designed to deepen their learning and life experience.
I. Core curricula of services: The course is structured on the framework of six themes in service learning by theory and practice as well as legal regulations regarding community services enacted by the Ministry of the Interior. The six themes respectively are: significance of service; standards of service; self-comprehension and affirmation; sharing service experience; service law and trends; and non-profit and service organizations.
II. Community service: Students select or be arranged to service organizations and are responsible for completing service assignments

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.
College of Engineering： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.

description.zh: 本課程主要以人文學的研究方法為主，使修課者對人文學科之研究方法有基本的認識，熟悉資料蒐集、分析與詮釋的方式，以及培養研究的能力，並應用所學，在課程期間完成一份研究報告。以歷史學門為例，其課程內容包括學科的定義、史料的蒐集與辨別能力，歷史的詮釋，及歷史研究的侷限性等等問題。
description.en: This course is primarily based on the research methods of humanities. Students who select this course will have a basic understanding of the research methods of humanities. Besides, they will be familiar with the mode of data collection, analysis and interpretation, moreover, their capacity of doing research will be trained up. They have to finish a research report by applying what they have learned during this course. Take the history as an example, this course includes the definition of the subject, the interpretation of the history, and the limits of historical research. Besides, students will also learn how to collect and identify historical data in the course.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在說明人文學科的研究方法，建立學生研究的基本認識，課程涵蓋：建立問題意識、資料蒐集、資料庫使用、研究架構等，同學將了解研究方法不只是用於撰寫學術論文，同時也是建立策展論述的方法，期待本課程訓練將培養同學開展議題的能力。

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生瞭解管理學基本概念，奠定紮實的理論根基，使其具備分析、處理實際問題以及開創的能力，進而能應用於文化事業經營，以利往後修習進階課程訓練的基礎。本課程主要內容包含管理學概論、管理在企業組織的功能、現代化的組織設計、組織領導與策略規劃、執行與績效考核、企業經營職能、企業的e化管理、非營利事業管理、企業的外在環境(政府文化創意產業政策)、創業管理、企業的社會責任等。本課程特色在於進行每個單元時，均輔以國內外文化創意產業有關的個案，以利學生理解。
description.en: This course presents the basic concepts and processes of management for students with cultural vocation development majors. Topics will include: the introduction to management, managing and the manager's job in an organization, modern organizational design, leadership and strategic planning, implementing and controlling , organizational effectiveness and performance, function roles of organization, e-business management, non-for-profit business management, external context of business (the government policy on cultural and creative industries), entrepreneurship management, corporate social responsibility etc. Students will develop skills and knowledge related to the manager function and required in the field of cultural creative industries. This course can also provide a basis for understanding the managerial implication of related cases in cultural creative industries. The featured course: each unit of this course will be facilitated by cultural and creative industries-related cases.

description.zh: 本課程是為大一學生所開的課程，它同時結合了美學與藝術史的討論。美學是一門研究人類感性知識的學科，與藝術史的發展息息相關。本課程嘗試在東西方平面藝術及其作品的討論中，融入東西方美學思想和審美意識，使美學與藝術史能夠相互印證。並希望課堂上的同學們能將課堂的內容化為文化創意的元素。
description.en: This course is for first-year students, combines aesthetic and art discussions. Aesthetics is a discipline that studies human perceptual knowledge and closely related to the development of art history. This course attempts to integrate Eastern and Western aesthetic ideas and aesthetic consciousness into the discussion of Eastern and Western art and its product, so that aesthetics and art history can corroborate each other. Expect that students in the classroom can turn the content of the class into cultural and creative elements.

description.zh: 文化史課程以台灣各地的文化變遷為主。本課程授課內容，是透過物質生活(衣、食、住、行)，集體生活(社會、政治組織)，精神生活(文學、藝術、哲學、宗教信仰)等之介紹，讓學生對台灣文化有更進一步的認識與了解。授課方式以口頭講授為主，討論及書面報告為輔，使得上課方式更為生動與活潑。
description.en: The course of History and Culture mainly focuses on the evolution in terms of culture that takes place in every part of Taiwan. The contents of this course including the introduction of material life (clothing, food, housing and transportation), collective life (society, politics, and organization), and spiritual life (literature, art, philosophy and religious belief). Students will obtain further cognition and acquaintance about Taiwanese culture. The teaching mode is by giving students a lecture orally, and students have to discuss and hand in written reports. The teaching style is more vivacious.

description.zh: 本課程旨在探究文化與科技的關係，以及科技社會結構如何影響我們的思考。在科技與社會快速變化的過程中，課程將帶領學生發掘科技創新的可能性，這也促使許多文化實踐需重新思考，以適應此刻以媒體驅動的社會，以及如何將它們被應用於策展、文化活動和相關的創作中。本課程亦涉及科技本質上的探索，以了解它如何與文化變革密切相關，包括人文、社會科學、虛擬創作、人工智慧、數位典藏、媒體藝術和媒體傳播等面向上。
description.en: The course examines the relationship between culture and technology and how tech-social structure works to shape our ideas. Exploring the possibilities of technological innovation in rapid change, many cultural practices need to be rethought and reworked for a further media-driven society and how they are adopted into curating exhibitions, cultural events, and related productions. The course also addresses the nature of technology in general to understand how it is linked closely with cultural change, in terms of humanities, social sciences, virtual contents, artificial intelligence, digital archives, media art, and media communication.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在探討文化與科技的互動關係，這門課程中將培養同學對於跨領域產業的數位韌性、識讀與提案能力。本課程將帶領學生理解，科技如何融入文化與藝術領域，並在數位化轉型時代中如何推動創新與社會平權。課程涵蓋理論學習、實務案例分析與跨域思考，從數位策展、數位敘事到文化保存技術，多元理解文化科技的應用價值。課程分為三大部分：第一部分介紹文化科技的基礎概念與發展歷程，幫助學生建立全面的知識框架；第二部分聚焦理解文化產業的數位化實踐，包括數位策展與敘事等應用，配合參與實作練習，設計創新數位文化體驗；第三部分則強調文化保存與社會議題，透過客座業師分享，探討如何運用科技促進文化平權與資產保護等實踐；並增進科技與藝術的跨域協作之理解。

description.zh: 學習邏輯思考的目的在於幫助我們培養一種邏輯能力，使我們能夠邏輯理性地以語言進行思考。要達成上述目的，我們首先要了解語言做為一種符號的內在邏輯架構。我們要明白什麼是概念、與概念所指涉的對象、與概念具備的意義和觀念；然後，語句的性質，包含其真假值，它們與字詞和概念的關係。之後，如何用語句去建構論證。為了建構論證，我們要學習傳統的歸納法、三段論法、自然演繹法的基本推論規則與自然語言和形式語言之間的翻譯。總之，我們要會在生活中如何理性地思辨問題並有效地與他人溝通。課程講授將配合一些心理測驗、課堂遊戲與電影教學。
description.en: The purpose of learning “Logical Thinking” is to help us acquiring a kind of ability in virtue of which we will be able to think logically and rationally.  To achieve that goal, we need to know the innate logical structure of our language.  That means, we will need first to grasp the essence of concepts including their reference, meaning, and ideas. Then, we shall study the essence of sentences including their truth-value and the relations with words and concepts.  After that, we shall learn how to establish a sound argument. For that purpose, we plan to study induction, syllogism, basic rules of inference in the method of natural deduction in quantificational logic, and translation between natural and formal language.  In a word, we will be able to speculate problems in our life rationally and communicate with others effectively.   The lecturing of the course will mix with psychological texts, games and practices in the classroom, and scientific films or regular movies.

description.zh: 本課程旨在引導學生通過包浩斯開啟的基礎幾何練習，理解點、線、面，乃至線條、方塊、色彩等元素影響視覺性、閱讀性的因素，最後，通過與藝術理論的交互驗證和課堂討論，以進入當代藝術創作精神。
description.en:
The course aims to explore the possibilities with forms, lines, rhythms, and content in contemporary visual arts. The pedagogy of the course is inspired from the Bauhaus, which is one of the most significant modern movements in the history of art and design.  
In class, the mission is to guide the students to experiment the variety of geometric shapes, from lines to circles and from circles to triangles, pursuing the essence and the spirits within the contemporary art. As practicing visual arts, the students not only learn how to develop an artwork, but also rethink the significant relation between art forms and meanings through the tutor-led and group discussions.

name.zh: 日本文化產業與地方創生
name.en: The Cultural Industry and Placemaking of Japan

description.zh: 「地方創生」概念源自日本，目前已提升至日本國家戰略的政策層級。在臺灣，?政院宣布2019年為「地方創生元?」，可?地方社區的經營再造亦已成為台灣未來重點發展趨勢。 本課程承接上學期【日本社會與文化】，著重介紹其中的文化產業發展如何進一步應用在地方創生。透過台日之間在地方創生的理論與實踐上的比較，讓學生能有效掌握社會脈動，貢獻所學。
description.en: The concept of “Place Making" originated from Japan and has been promoted to the policy level of Japan's national strategy. In Taiwan, the Executive Yuan announced that 2019 will be the "first year of placemaking," and the innovation of local communities has become a key development trend in the future. This course continues from the previous semester [Japanese society and culture], focusing on how the development of the cultural industry can be further applied to local innovation. By comparing the theory and practice of local creation between Taiwan and Japan, students can effectively grasp the social pulse and contribute what they have learned.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。
課程內容：包含四大階段
（一）勞作教育理念介紹：選取勞作教育相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含勞作教育意義、勞作教育前測作業說明
（二）勞作教育實作階段：勞作課程分三項不同情境施作。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須於各實作階段課程進行討論與反思，並撰寫心得報告、完成後測作業。
（四）期末成果分享：勞作教育期末成果分享，並辦理獎勵工作。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在幫助學生建立若干關鍵的企業財務概念。首先，我們將介紹資金的時間價值，這是財務學中最基本的構成要素。在資金時間價值的基礎上，我們將學習如何運用折現模型進行債券與股票定價，以及評估投資專案的價值。最後，我們將探討金融市場中的風險與報酬，包括投資組合理論、資本資產定價模型、資金成本以及資金募集。在這門課程中，學生將學習企業如何進行財務決策以及金融市場的運作方式。
This course aims to help students establish several essential corporate finance concepts. First, we introduce the time value of money, a fundamental building block in finance. We learn the bond and stock pricing and investment projects evaluation using a discounted model following the time value of money section. Finally, we discuss the risks and returns involved in financial markets, such as portfolio theory, capital assets pricing model, the cost of capital, and fund raising. In this class, students will learn how a company makes financial decisions and the operation of financial markets.

本課程主要介紹資訊系統在目前數位時代的公司所扮演的角色，課程介紹內容涵蓋：資訊系統基本理論與實務、電子商務、ERP、供應鏈管理系統、顧客管理系統、資訊安全、資料探勘、商業智慧、人工智慧、工業4.0等熱門趨勢議題。資訊服務被廣泛應用在各個不同領域以及產業，本課程適合任何想對資訊系統有進一步瞭解的同學。上課方式為教師授課、實務操作，並兼以同學分組課堂報告及討論為主。

本課程目的有三：
(一)	訓練學生畢業後從事資訊管理相關領域之執行、導入及開發的工作。
(二)	建立學生對總體數位科技環境的認知，提升未來職場技術能力及觀念性技能的開發。
(三)透過分組討論、實務操作及資料分析，學習基礎知識以及評估未來更多創新的資訊應用模式。

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

本課程目標乃是協助學生透過有意義之社區服務活動，認識服務學習理念，從服務學習中體驗服務的意義，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。
課程內容：包含三大類
（一）志願服務基礎課程：選取志願服務相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含服務學習理論、內政部志願服務法所訂定之六大主題（志願服務的內涵、志願服務倫理、自我了解及自我肯定、志願服務經驗分享、志願服務法規之認識、志願服務發展趨勢），或非營利組織、服務機構之介紹等等。
（二）社區服務：選擇服務機構前往服務，於本學期內完成授課教師所規定服務時數或內容。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須進行服務經驗分享與討論，並撰寫與繳交服務日誌、心得報告。
description.en:
This course is geared to expand and intensify students' learning beyond classroom by introducing service learning as an integral part of holistic life learning experience. Apart from class work, students will be able to not only understand the significance of services and experience the true value of such learning through various forms of community work. The course is designed to deepen their learning and life experience.
I. Core curricula of services: The course is structured on the framework of six themes in service learning by theory and practice as well as legal regulations regarding community services enacted by the Ministry of the Interior. The six themes respectively are: significance of service; standards of service; self-comprehension and affirmation; sharing service experience; service law and trends; and non-profit and service organizations.
II. Community service: Students select or be arranged to service organizations and are responsible for completing service assignments

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程旨在瞭解設計的基本要素與美的形式原理，應用各種媒材的特性與構成，從平面及立體的構成的實作練習中，激發出設計美感與創造力。透過「使用者—產品—環境」三者間互動關係的深入探討，掌握住視覺傳達與多媒體的基本語彙，作為互動設計的基礎，創造出全新的體驗與感受。
description.en: The course is to prepare students for understanding the basic elements of design and the form and principle of art. To achieve these goals, the course provides opportunities for students to apply characteristics and compositions of diverse media for the form of two-dimension and three-dimension in practice. Also, the course arouses student’s design aesthetics and creativity. To explore the context of user-product-environment, students understand visual communication and multimedia language as a basis of interaction design toward completely new experiences and sensation.

description.zh: 本課程旨在為互動媒體脈絡提供學生創意思考與企劃故事腳本，使學生瞭解互動媒體實務運作時，最前端的構思與規劃所需要的知識與技能，以及與不同領域專業的溝通表達。本課程包括一系列的腳本企劃、使用者體驗、創意呈現，以及互動媒體企劃實務案例探討。本課程之評量是以分組討論與腳本企劃報告為主。

The assessment of this course depends upon the group discussion and script planning report.

description.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts and techniques of programming, as well as the development and application of artificial intelligence. The course content covers basic syntax for the programming languages, along with the fundamental concept theories of artificial intelligence. Through programming practices and AI tool manipulations, the students can gain a further understanding of the artificial intelligence application and the potential application via programming.

description.zh: 在這個e化的時代，傳送訊息的表現手法如文字、影像、聲音、影片等都被廣泛的運用，組織這些文字、影像、聲音、影片等資料的就成了一個必須重視的課題。本課程將導覽文化創意產業之定義、起源與當前文化創意產業之背景，進而將藝術與文化產業整合於數位內容中；課程規劃重點包含建立學生對數位產品的基本認識，解說數位產品設計的流程與步驟，介紹數位產品設計的方法。
description.en: In the electronic age, text, image, sound, and video are all widely used; organizing this data has become an important issue. This course focuses on the definition, origin, and background of cultural creativity. The curriculum includes building a basic understanding of digital products, explaining the process and procedures of how digital products are designed, and introducing the design methods for digital products.

description.en: This course will provide student in the field of interaction design the application skill, principle, planning, limitation and conversion techniques of 2D/3D graphic design by using computer-aided design software package.

syllabi.outline:
The major goal of this class aims to give students basic 3d modeling and rendering techniques meanwhile help them to have abilities to realize the design from concept to final output. In the class we will provide the tutorial of Blender. Blender now is the most useful tools for interior design and have been widely used in different practices. Through practicing the commands and techniques with multiple exercises and practices, students will have general understanding about how the software works meanwhile get the fundamental abilities to get into design industries.
  Student will be asked to finish a complete conceptual design project in the end of semester, it should be drawings, renderings, animations and one 3d model included. Students’ learning outcome must be showed in this package and will be the critical criteria of semester grading.

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年(一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年(一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.
