syllabi.outline:
The major goal of this class aims to give students basic 3d modeling and rendering techniques meanwhile help them to have abilities to realize the design from concept to final output. In the class we will provide the tutorial of Blender. Blender now is the most useful tools for interior design and have been widely used in different practices. Through practicing the commands and techniques with multiple exercises and practices, students will have general understanding about how the software works meanwhile get the fundamental abilities to get into design industries.
  Student will be asked to finish a complete conceptual design project in the end of semester, it should be drawings, renderings, animations and one 3d model included. Students’ learning outcome must be showed in this package and will be the critical criteria of semester grading.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。
課程內容：包含四大階段
（一）勞作教育理念介紹：選取勞作教育相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含勞作教育意義、勞作教育前測作業說明
（二）勞作教育實作階段：勞作課程分三項不同情境施作。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須於各實作階段課程進行討論與反思，並撰寫心得報告、完成後測作業。
（四）期末成果分享：勞作教育期末成果分享，並辦理獎勵工作。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。

description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.outline:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

Students must intern for 1 day every Friday to the enterprise. If students cannot match to the enterprise, they must return to the original training unit to help training the other athletes, or take an internship to the enterprise during the summer vacation.

description.zh:
概論，熱力學第一定律，理想氣體及純物質，熱力學第二定律。
本課程之學習目標是要學習熱力學基本觀念。內容包含物質熱力學特性、改變能量形式之基本原理、熱力學第一定理、熱力學第二定理、封閉系統與開放系統的能量與質量分析、熵增定理、可用能、蒸汽動力廠等。
description.en: The learning objective of this course is to learn the basic concepts of thermodynamics. Contents include material thermodynamic properties, basic principles of changing energy forms, the first law of thermodynamics, the second law of thermodynamics, energy and mass analysis of closed systems and open systems, the entropy increase theorem, available energy, steam power plants, etc.

name.zh: 電機控制系統設計與模擬
name.en: Design and Simulation of Electric Machine Control Systems

description.zh: 此課程包含以下主題：(1)直流馬達、伺服馬達、及永磁交流馬達的建模、控制系統設計與模擬，(2)馬達速度及位置觀測器設計與模擬，(3)數位控制及驅動器設計與模擬。
description.en: The contents of this course include: (1) Modeling, control system design, and simulation of DC motor, servo motor and permanent magnet synchronous motor. (2) Motor speed and position estimator design and simulation. (3) Digital control and driver design and simulation.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的主要目的在使用Matlab/Simulink軟體，建立馬達及其控制系統的模型，以模擬的方式學習馬達控制系統設計的方法。控制的馬達包含直流馬達、永磁交流馬達、及無刷直流馬達等三種。系統設計的主題包含：(1)位置、速度及電流控制，(2)數位控制，(3)觀測器設計，(4)直接轉矩控制，(5)脈寬調變模，(6)交流-直流轉換。

The objectives of this course are using Matlab/Simulink software as the simulation tool to learn practical control schemes for electric machines. Three types of machines are studied: DC Machine, permanent magnetic synchronous machines (PMSM), and brushless DC (BLDC). Control projects include: (1) position, velocity, and current control, (2) digital control, (3) estimators, (4) direct torque control, (5) pulse width modulation (PWM), (6) AC-DC conversion.
syllabi.schedule:
1. Introduction of Matlab/Simulink, DC Motor model, speed control (lab1)
2. PMSM model and V/H control (lab2)
3. Current control and frequency response measurement (lab3)
4. Digital position control (lab4)
5. Position control with velocity estimator (lab5)
6. DC-AC Inverter (SPWM) (lab6)
7. 清明節補假
8. Discontinuous PWM schemes (lab7)
9. Mid-term exam.
10. Position and velocity estimation with extended back-EMF (lab8)
11. Sensorless vector control with extended back-EMF (lab9)
12. Sensorless vector control with stator flux estimator (lab10)
13. Initial position detection with square voltage HFVI (lab11)
14. PMSM control simulation with Simscape (lab12)
15. PMSM control system with input AC-DC converter (lab13)
16. BLDC commutation (lab14)
17. Speed control of BLDC (lab15)
18. Final exam.

Final exam: 40%

description.en:
This class starts from the review of random process and mainly provides an introduction to information theory. The following is a rough description of the material covered in this class.

    (1) Entropy, Relative Entropy, and Mutual information

    (2) Asymptotic equipartition theorem

    (3) Entropy rates of stochastic processes

    (4) Data compression (Huffman coding, Shannon codes, Kraft

inequality, etc.)

    (5) Information theory and gambling

    (6) Channel Capacity

    (7) Differential entropy

    (8) Gaussian Channels

syllabi.outline: This course aims to study basic and advanced topics in information theory. The course focuses on the concept of information theory,  including entropy, source coding, channel capacity, rate distortion theory, and differential entropy, ...etc. The calculation of channel capacity and rate distortion will be used as computer projects for real implementation. Advanced topics will further cover Gaussian channel and some coding theory.

name.en: Multimedia Service in Heterogeneous Network Environment

description.zh: 本課程介紹異質多網多媒體的特性與架構，包含：有線及無線網路的內容介紹，以及整合有線及無線網路成為異質網路的概念，其中將針對IEEE 802.21 Media Independent Handover (MIH)教導學生針對異質網路垂直切換的原理及技術。最後，對於多媒體服務技術及原理做介紹，包含：VoIP服務以及視訊串流服務的介紹，以及如何針對 多種異質網路整合多媒體服務的介紹，藉此提升學生對於新世代異質多網多媒體服務之認識。
description.en: This course introduces the characteristics and architecture of multimedia service in heterogeneous network environment. First, wired and wireless networks, e.g., 3G/3.5G/4G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and other popular wireless access techniques, would be introduced one by one. Then, by describing the theory and technology of IEEE 802.21 Media Independent Handover (MIH), this course would show how to integrate multiple different networks into heterogeneous network environments and how to handoff among them. Finally, regarding multimedia service, VoIP and video streaming services would be taken into consideration. This course would introduce how to provide multimedia services over heterogeneous network environment. Therefore, students can learn the next-generation techniques about multimedia services in heterogeneous network environment from this course.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹異質多網多媒體的特性與架構，在多媒體部分，介紹多媒體基本組成、編解碼(Codec)原理、串流(Streaming)協定；在網路部分，介紹常用之有線(Ethernet)及無線網路(Wi-Fi、Bluetooth、Cellular/Mobile)，以及針對多媒體設計之網路機制，最後，配合研究所性質，透過論文導讀方式介紹當下視訊串流(Video Streaming)的最新發展，藉此提升學生對於新世代異質多網多媒體服務之認識。

1. 修課學生可從本課程學習多媒體串流(Multimedia Streaming)。
2. 修課學生可從本課程學習異質化網路(Heterogeneous Networks)。
3. 修課學生可從本課程練習相關軟體實作(Software Implementation)技巧。

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces students to the process of data science, covering problem formulation, data acquisition, modeling and analysis, and presentation and integration into action. Students will learn useful skills as well as basic statistical methods by completing several hands-on problems focused on real-world data. This course starts with a brief introduction to multivariate data analysis and data summarization including visualization. Then it extends to focus on using data to develop predictive capabilities using supervised and unsupervised machine learning models (regression, classification, clustering, PCA, etc.).

syllabi.outline: 此課程旨在以人為本，研究人機互動系統之設計與評估。從了解與採集使用者的需求開始，最終提出可能的創意解決方案來提高使用者的滿意度與舒適性。本次課程將重點著重在高齡化的偏鄉族群、特殊的職業人員與旅客碳足跡，讓學生在課程中學習相關評估老年人需求與行為活動力之方法、人機互動原則、3D人體掃描、產品通用設計與碳排放評估等知識，搭配實際參與人因工程相關實驗與儀器操作，並且至真實場域進行實際的訪談、工作坊與數據採集，透過實際場域進行調查，讓學生了解離島老年人行為模式與需求、和特殊職業人員的肌肉骨骼不適與工作環境危害等，透過創意發想與設計思維，最終提出可能的改善方案或產品設計理念回饋於場域與社會，落實以人為本，改善不舒適、提高生活品質與社會福祉之功效。除此之外，也介紹人機互動知識的相關應用案例，透過分享國際刊物論文，了解人機互動前沿研究。透過規劃小組實驗實作，藉此了解人因工程實驗的進行與後續設計應用，以提升人的舒適與安全。

description.zh: 機器視覺檢測乃結合光學設備 ` 影像處理 ` 與電腦輔助計算處理 , 藉由擷取受測物影像之特徵進行後續各種應用(如檢測 ` 辯識等)。 為確保機器視覺應用之精確度及速度,受測物影像必須依用途進行不同前處理以突顯特徵 , 後以不同之演算法則判斷之擷取特徵是否符合應用要求。 機器視覺近年來大量使用於各產業,除提昇製造業之產品品質外,對人身安全認證之生物科技亦功不可沒 。
description.en: Machine vision has been extensively used in inspection and biometrics in recent years. This course provides the fundamentals and practical applications of machine vision for graduate students. Increasing the knowledge and capability in machine vision for a well-trained industrial engineer is the final goal of this course.

syllabi.outline:
本課程為程式語言之延伸，主要以python為程式語言，學習以下之相關主題
1. CPU 及 GPU-based DIP(影像處理)  - CV2 及 Kornia: 為PyTorch之延伸 ，主要介紹: Image Load/Save/Display、enhancement、Filtering、Edge detection、Morphology、Warp * Geometry Transformation、Color、Segmentation、Data augmentation等

2. 深度學習: 以PyTorch、TorchVision為主，介紹基本Torch語法，再深入介紹CNN網路架構 (LeNet、ResNet、DenseNet、EfficientNet)，Object Detection網路 (FRCNN、Mask RCNN、Yolo)、AutoEncoder、UNet(Semantic Segmentation)、Anomaly Detection、GAN等應用 (視課程進度)

主要工作包括：課堂作業、期末考、期末競賽 (Project)、Paper Reading

name.en: Time Series Analysis and Process Adjustment

description.zh: 本課程主要目的在於教導學生如何利用時間序列分析、品質製程管制、工程製程控制等方法來達成先進製程控制的目的。課程講述之內容包含下列課題:製程監控、製程調整、離散動態製程、時間序列模型、轉換方程模型、最佳回饋控制器、指數加權移動平均控制、遞迴式估計與自適應控制等。

syllabi.outline: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of time series analysis and process control techniques, with an emphasis on coding and conducting experiments, such as verifying results from research papers. Students will learn to analyze time-dependent data and apply various forecasting and process monitoring methods. Key topics include time series preprocessing, regression analysis, ARIMA models, and advanced techniques such as statistical process control, CUSUM, EWMA, and multivariate monitoring. The course also covers real-time contrasts and includes paper reading and presentations to explore contemporary applications in time series analysis and process control. Basic programming skills is expected.

description.en: In this course, students are expected to demonstrate independent thinking, develop a reasonable experimental design, conduct ergonomics evaluations on products by collecting both physiological and psychological data, and ultimately apply the findings to redesign products. This ensures that the products align more effectively with the needs and perceptions of users.

description.zh: 本課程著重於隨機流量網路(stochastic flow network)的可靠度評估、分析和決策。在整個課程中，我們將介紹與隨機流量網路相關的數值分析方法、模擬技術和最佳化問題。此外，我們將在隨機流量網路模型的框架內深入探討最快路徑、多商品、路由政策和負載管理問題等主題。學生將有機會將這些方法和模型應用到實際系統中，包括電腦網路、電信、城市交通系統、電力傳輸網路和製造系統。
description.en: This course emphasizes the reliability evaluation, analysis, and decision-making aspects of stochastic flow networks. Throughout the course, we will introduce analytical methodologies, simulation techniques, and optimization problems related to stochastic flow networks. Furthermore, we will delve into topics like quickest path, multi-commodity, routing policies, and load management issues within the framework of stochastic flow network models. Students will have the opportunity to apply these methodologies and models to practical systems, including computer networks, telecommunications, urban traffic systems, power transmission networks, and manufacturing systems.

description.zh: 這是一門研究所課程，內容包括多元數據分析和高等回歸應用。本課程的目標是確保工業工程與管理領域的研究生能夠解釋、實現和操作幾種不同類型的基本回歸分析。本課程主要致力於高等回歸分析。重點是發展一個嚴格的微積分計算及矩陣代數為基礎的最小平方法(OLS)、違反回歸假設、假說檢定及一般線性模型。此外，本課程的重點是協助學生理解分析技術這部分的領域知識，如:統計的基本概念(描述和推理統計，概率分佈)，簡單線性回歸、多元線性回歸、邏輯回歸及對數線性模型之應用。
description.en: This course covers multivariate data analysis as well as advanced regression applications. The course is primarily devoted to advanced regression analysis. Th? emphasis is on developing a rigorous calculus and matrix algebra-based understanding of ordinary least squares (OLS), violations of regression assumptions, hypothesis testing, and the general linear model. In addition, the emphasis of this course is on the acquisition and understanding of analytical techniques such as basic concepts of statistics (descriptive and inferential statistics, probability distributions), simple linear regression, multiple linear regression, logistic regression, log-linear model.

description.en:
The course objective is to introduce students about key principles of project management and the use of project scheduling software.
This course discusses the factors necessary for the successful project management.  Topics include project management concepts, needs identification, the project manager, teams, project organizations, project communications, project planning, scheduling, control and associated costs.  Project management software tools will be an integral part of the course.

description.en: This course mainly introduces the basic concepts of  Medical Engineering, including anatomy and physiology, biomechanics, rehabilitation engineering and assistive device technology, biomaterials, tissue engineering, biomedical electronics, biomedical sensing systems, biomedical signal processing, biomedical image processing, biomedical ultrasound, biomedical optics and laser.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在教授醫學工程的基本概念，特別著重於雷射醫學的應用與發展。學生將學習相關理論、技術及臨床應用，為未來在生物醫學與醫療科技領域的研究與實踐奠定基礎。

This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts of biomedical engineering, with a focus on laser medicine applications and advancements. Students will gain theoretical knowledge, technical skills, and insights into clinical applications, laying the groundwork for research and practice in biomedical and medical technology fields.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 (2/20/2024):
解剖學及生理學 (Anatomy and Physiology):
介紹人體結構與功能，為生醫工程的應用提供基礎知識。
Overview of human anatomy and physiology as foundational knowledge for biomedical applications.

Week 2 (2/27/2024):
生物力學 (Biomechanics):
探討人體運動與機械力之間的關係及其在醫學中的應用。
Study of the relationship between human motion and mechanical forces in medical applications.

Week 3 (3/6/2024):
復建工程及輔具科技 (Rehabilitation Engineering and Assistive Technology):
設計及應用輔助裝置以提升患者生活品質。
Design and application of assistive devices to enhance patient quality of life.

Week 4 (3/13/2024):
生醫材料 (Biomaterials):
分析各種生醫材料的特性及其在醫療設備和植入物中的應用。
Examination of properties of biomaterials and their applications in medical devices and implants.

Week 5 (3/20/2024):
生醫光學基本原理及其在診斷與治療中的應用 (Biomedical Optics – Principles and Applications):
探討光學技術在診斷與治療中的應用，包括光譜、光學成像及光子技術。
Study of optical technologies in diagnostics and treatment, including spectroscopy, optical imaging, and photonics.

Week 6 (3/27/2024):
雷射技術在醫學中的發展 (Laser Technology in Medicine):
雷射技術在牙科、皮膚科及手術中的診斷與治療應用。
Advancements of laser technology in diagnostics and therapy, focusing on applications in dentistry, dermatology, and surgical procedures.

syllabi.outline: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。因此本課程主要強調專利策略與專利布局分析在企業界的運用分析。

高科技產業的專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出數十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利申請策略開始，告訴同學專利申請上常見的錯誤，如何以較低的成本取得、維護我國專利，並利用我國專利進行全球專利佈局。
Patent litigation, either initiation or defense, has become one of the high-tech industrial strategies, and more and more patent suit cases have forced the manufacturers to undertake patent design around. In fact, the industrial fields in Taiwan, theoretically, do not feel strange on design around and patent strategies. However, in practice, they perform much less. That is the reason why Taiwan still has to pay more than five billion US dollars each year for royalty. This course will start from patent filing strategy, getting patent claims well known, then following with introduction on orientation of patent strategies, and providing theory and practice on patent strategies. The outline of this course is given as follows: Patent claim interpretation; Process of patent infringement analysis; Requirements of patent design around; Patent strategy analysis; Practice on patent strategies; and Study on patent cases.

description.zh: 本課程旨在建立學生於醫學工程領域相關之知識。課程將為學生建立從小至基礎分子生物理論到大至人體以期具備生物相關領域之基礎知識，接續搭配基礎光電理論的建立並探討其應用於醫學工程相關領域之儀器及設備，內容亦因應時事而帶入課程討論，以期學生能對於醫學工程領域有更深一層之了解。此課程將以概論之方式進行，歡迎對此領域有興趣之同學學習。
description.en: Students taking this course will develop fundamental knowledge in the biomedical engineering field. Students will increase knowledge in biology and photoelectronics. The related equipment and apparatus applied in the biomedical engineering field will de be introduced. The course will also include current news to the students for expanding their knowledge in the biomedical engineering field. This course is an introductory course. The students who are interested in this field are welcomed to attend this course.

syllabi.outline:
With an aging population driving significant growth in healthcare-related industries, Electrical Medical Engineering has emerged as a crucial interdisciplinary field. Combining engineering principles and technologies, this discipline contributes to biological research and the advancement of medical science. The primary focus is to provide insights beneficial for diagnosing, treating, and preventing diseases.

This course specifically emphasizes laser medicine, a specialization within Electrical Medical Engineering. Recognized as one of the 20th century’s greatest inventions, laser technology has revolutionized various medical fields, offering innovative solutions for both clinical applications and research.

This course will delve into the following topics:

1. Introduction to Medical Electrical Engineering
2. Basic principles of laser
3. Diverse applications of laser in medicine
4. Laser applications in dentistry
5. PBM PhotoBioModulation applications in Medicine and Dentistry
6. Advanced thesis writing in laser medicine

description.zh: 顆粒物質充斥在日常生活且廣泛應用在許多工業問題中，例如筒倉、流體化床以及積層製造等等。本概論式課程將提供學生顆粒物質流的基礎概念以及模擬方法，並對其實際應用問題能有更深入的了解。課程將從顆粒物質的基本流動特性開始介紹，進而介紹顆粒物質流的離散模擬方法。此課程最後一部分將實際展示在工程上以及工業上所遇到的顆粒物質流問題。
description.en: Granular materials are ubiquitous in our daily lives and have attracted growing interest in many industrial applications, such as silo storage, fluidized bed, additive manufacturing, etc. This course is an introductory course to provide the general concepts and simulation methods of granular material flows, and a comprehensive understanding for its applications. The course will start from the basic flow characteristics of granular materials, and then move to the discrete simulation approaches. The final part of this course will demonstrate the practical engineering and industrial problems of granular material flows.

syllabi.outline: Granular material flows commonly occur in many industrial applications and nature hazards, such as fluidized beds, additive manufacturing, and debris avalanche. To provide a comprehensive understanding of granular materials flows, this course will be divided into three parts. First, we will explore the fundamental flow characteristics of granular materials and their rheological models. Next, we will examine simulation techniques for granular material flows, focusing on discrete element method (DEM). Finally, we will introduce the two-phase suspension system, followed by an exploration of practical industrial and geophysical applications of these complex flows.

name.zh: 無人機攝影測量概論與實作

description.zh: 運用無人機技術做為測遙工具為一新穎科技，本課程以航空動力學為前題，分別介紹定翼及旋翼型無人機運作原理，基於航空攝影目的介紹飛行及航拍任務規劃。同時藉由實作，學生將自行組裝及設計無人機，並實際自行拍攝影像、產製所需之空間資訊，如:正射、地形等地理資訊系統圖資。
description.en: The Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), commonly known as a drone, is an aircraft without human pilot on board that flies autonomously, and is now been used widely for many aspects because of its convenience, high resolution, efficiency, etc. This course introducing first the aerodynamic of different drone frames, as well as the basic photogrammetry. Then try to design and assembly our drones. By using the home-made drones, the students will learn how to do the mission planning and take photos. Finally, the students should generate the geomatic information from their acquired images.

name.zh: 物件導向程式設計與資料庫應用

description.zh:
物件導向程式設計以類別與物件為核心概念，輔以靜態的屬性及動態的方法，能夠直覺並且系統化地描述真實世界的事物，再輔以封裝、繼承、多型、介面等機制，能夠有效率地達到程式碼的共享及再利用，因此物件導向程式設計的功能不但被各式各樣的程式語言所廣泛支援，亦已形成了一門獨立的學問。

而資料庫是重要、普遍且實用的資訊管理核心技術。但在另一方面，資料庫的開發與實作過程對於理解物件導向程式設計更是一個良好的契機與範例。本課程將以土木營建領域的範例出發，教導修課同學開發輔助工程資訊管理之資料庫系統，並在資料的分析處理及使用者介面的實作上導入物件導向程式設計的概念。
description.en:
Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) is a programming paradigm based on the concept of class and objects. With properties and methods that can describe the features of classes, a programmer can model the real world objects in an systematical way. In addition, the three important mechanisms of OOP, which are encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism, also enable a programmer to reuse and share their code easily and efficiently. 

Base on the Architecture/Engineering/Construction applications, this course aims to train the enrolled student for developing the basic OOP concepts, analyzing the database schemas, as well as implementing the OOP skills on information systems developments.

name.zh: 民生建設物聯網於綠智與韌性營建
name.en: Infrastructure IoT to Green-Intelligent and Resilient Construction

description.zh:
為使土木營建背景的學生具備跨域學習與創用能力，本課程扣合當前重要時趨(如SDGs, ESG, LCA, USR等)於民生基礎建設之因應；擇採相關物聯網數位科技作為課程編排，介紹內容如無線感測、低工耗遠域網路邊緣運算、雲端管理、數位平台、綠能蓄電、人工智能、低/無代碼等專案開發的理與例，以符綠智營建之踐履，以臻永續經管之倡議。
為求哲科合一，課程亦將思與學之認識與方法作簡扼介紹(系統思考與問題導向學習)。
description.en:
To achieve interdisciplinary learning and Innovative creativity for civil engineering students, this course presents the Internet of Things (IoT) to social infrastructure development including green-intelligent construction/maintenance and resilient adaptation briefly. To aim at the initiate of sustainable development goals (such as SDGs, ESG, LCA, USR) applied to civil engineering, some vital issues in this course would be focused as follows,
WSN (Wireless Network), LPWAN (Low Power Wide-Area Network),
Edge Computing, e-Cloud Management, Digitized Platform (PaaS/IaaS/SaaS), Green Energy and Cell, Artificial Intelligences, Low- & No-code techniques, etc.
Meanwhile, Systems Thinking (ST) and Problem-based Learning (PBL) , which are crucial for philosophy of science, would be introduced for this holistic approach.

syllabi.outline:
為使土木營建背景的學生具備跨域學習與創用能力，本課程扣合當前重要時趨(如SDGs, ESG, LCA, USR等)於民生基礎建設之因應；擇採相關物聯網數位科技作為課程編排，介紹內容如無線感測、低工耗遠域網路邊緣運算、雲端管理、數位平台、綠能蓄電、人工智能、低/無代碼等專案開發的理與例，以符綠智營建之踐履，以臻永續經管之倡議。
為求哲科合一，課程亦將思與學之認識與方法作簡扼介紹(系統思考與問題導向學習)。
To achieve interdisciplinary learning and Innovative creativity for civil engineering students, this course presents the Internet of Things (IoT) to social infrastructure development including green-intelligent construction/maintenance and resilient adaptation briefly. To aim at the initiate of sustainable development goals (such as SDGs, ESG, LCA, USR) applied to civil engineering, some vital issues in this course would be focused as follows,
WSN (Wireless Network), LPWAN (Low Power Wide-Area Network),
Edge Computing, e-Cloud Management, Digitized Platform (PaaS/IaaS/SaaS), Green Energy and Cell, Artificial Intelligences, Low- & No-code techniques, etc.
Meanwhile, Systems Thinking (ST) and Problem-based Learning (PBL) , which are crucial for philosophy of science, would be introduced for this holistic approach.

description.en: The focus of this course is the application of the basic principles of rock mechanics.  Three types of applications are to be covered in this semester-long course: rock slopes, rock foundations, and rock tunnels.  The students are expected to complete assignments in each of the above three categories.  To prepare students with no previous academic work in rock mechanics, this course will review the classification systems of rock masses (such as the RMR and the Q systems).  Also, the stereographic projection is a required tool, which will be introduced in this course.

description.zh: 在現代的工程設計與分析中，普遍應用到相關的電腦模式。儘管大部份工程應用電腦模式均以定率式的物理關係作為基礎，但引用電腦模式進行設計，必須考慮隱含在模式輸入與控制參數的不確定性，及其所產生模式輸出的不確定性。因此，適當的評估模式輸出的不確定性應包含在基本的設計當中。
description.en: In modern engineering designs and analyses, computer models are frequently used. Despite the fact that deterministic relationships are used in most compiterized models for engineering,the model outputs are indeterministic due to the uncertain and stochastic nature of the model inputs and parameters. All the uncertainty may contribute to the stochsticity of the input parameters of a corresponding model which, in turn, result in output uncertainty. Therefore,proper assessment of model outout uncertainty is essential.

description.zh: 應用定量分析法於水資源規劃與管理，並介紹系統分析、本益比之評估、多目標規劃與風險評估。
description.en: Quantitative analytical methods in water resources planning and management; introduction to systems analysis, benefit/cost, multi-objective planning and risk assessment.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to introduce the configuration of system analysis and water resources system.  Secondly, it elaborate the theoretical bases and operation procedures of common deterministic mathematical programming methods (linear programming, dynamic programming and nonlinear programming).  Finally, several water resources systems based on the characteristics of surface water, reservoirs and cities will be depicted and perform the optimal and most effective planning, development, management and operation of water resources (including water quantity and water quality).
Objectives:
(1)To understand concepts and algorithms for optimization using linear, integer, network, nonlinear, and dynamic programming;
(2)To understand the concepts of optimization as applied to water resources problems.

description.zh: 為涵養水量、維護水質以及保育水土資源，對於集水區內土地的使用，應有適當的規劃與管理牽涉的問題，一般以水資源利用、水質控制、管理計畫等課題加以涵括。因此本課程包含水資源情勢分析、水利法規、水權管理、點源及非點源污染管理、地下水規劃與管理、民眾參與及生態工法於集水區治理工程之應用等，俾提供適度發展及兼顧自然生態機能的集水區社區總體生活，達成「水、土、林、人」四贏之水資源保育總體目標。
description.en: In order to preserve water quantity, to protect water quality, and to conserve soil and water resources, it is necessary to institute appropriate land use regulations in a watershed. In general, it is included water resources utilization, water quality control and management. Therefore the major topics are water resources tendency, water law, water right, point and non-point sources pollution control, ground water management, public participation, ecological working method, etc. With appropriate public participation, the government can work together with people in community development in a manner which will enrich local cultural characteristics, and provide ideas for a sustainable growth, which would lead to a high quality of life and also would protect the watershed's ecology . The ultimate goal of making these efforts is to achieve a " water-soil-trees-men ", four-win situation.

description.zh: 平行運算指的是將需要耗費大量電腦CPU時間的複雜工程模擬問題平行化，分散到不同處理器上同時同步執行，以求能在合理的時間內獲致結果，並應用在工程設計或理論建構上。在本課程中將介紹平行運算的原理（Concurrency and Synchronization），分辨可平行化和不可平行化的問題，探討平行運算的演算法和可計算性，以及介紹將程式平行化的實用技術，並分析程式容錯性和可靠度（Fault Tolerance and Reliability），以幫助學生將平行運算應用在土木工程和學術研究中，學生將有機會使用平行化程式語言（High Performance Fortran）開發應用程式，本課程先修課程為程式設計，建議研究所同學選修。
description.en: Parallel computing is a methodology to handle complex engineering problems by distributing the intensive computation work to different processors to process simultaneously in order to obtain the results in a reasonable amount of time. This course will introduce the basic theory of parallel computing, teach how to identify problems that are parallelizable, and demonstrate how to apply the principles of parallel computing to civil engineering problems. Students will have opportunities to obtain hands-on experience by developing their own parallel programs (using High Performance Fortran). The prerequisite of this course is computer programming. It is suitable for graduate students to choose as an elective.

syllabi.outline: This course covers the basic concepts, techniques, and technologies involved in parallel computing as well as programming exercises. Emphasis will be placed on understanding the importance of parallel computing in modern scientific computing and artificial intelligence (AI) applications. The course will introduce students to various parallel programming models and tools, including C/C++ programming, multi-processing in Python, OpenMP (in C) for multi-threading, and GPU programming using CUDA and OpenCL. Web-based programming using JavaScript will be included for user interface of some hands-on exercises. No prior programming experience is required.
syllabi.schedule:
W1-2: Introduction to Parallel Computing
Overview of Parallel Computing: History, applications, and relevance in modern computing.
Importance in Scientific Computing and AI: How parallelism drives advancements in simulation, data analysis, and machine learning.
Basic Concepts: Types of parallelism (data parallelism, task parallelism), and understanding the computational model.
Performance Metrics: Speedup, efficiency, and Amdahl's Law.

Exercise: Parallel procedural design, diagram representation, speed-up/performance analysis of summing N numbers

Exercise: Parallel procedural design, diagram representation, speed-up/performance analysis of vector addition

Exercise: Parallel procedural design, diagram representation, speed-up/performance analysis of matrix multiplication


W3-4: Parallel Computing in C Programming
Introduction to C for Parallel Programming: Basics of C, memory management, and multi-core programming.
Shared Memory and Multi-threading: Using threads and synchronization in C.
Hands-on Exercises: Writing and testing parallel programs in C.

W5-6: Web-based Parallel Programming with JavaScript
JavaScript and Asynchronous Programming: Event loop, Promises, and asynchronous functions.
Web Workers: Introduction to parallelism in web browsers using JavaScript.
Hands-on Exercises: Implementing parallelism in web applications using JavaScript.

W7-8: Multi-processing in Python
Python for Parallel Computing: Introduction to the Python multiprocessing module.
Process-based Parallelism: Differences between threading and multiprocessing in Python.
Hands-on Exercises: Implementing parallel algorithms using Python for large-scale data processing.

W10-11: Module 5: Multi-threading with OpenMP
Introduction to OpenMP: Basics of multi-threading in shared memory systems.
Parallel Directives: Using OpenMP directives to parallelize loops and sections of code.
Optimization Techniques: Strategies to improve parallel performance.
Hands-on Exercises: Writing parallel programs with OpenMP in C/C++.

W12-13: Introduction to GPU Programming
The Basics of GPU Computing: Understanding GPU architecture, SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) model.
CUDA Programming: Introduction to CUDA, writing and optimizing kernel functions.
OpenCL Overview: General-purpose GPU programming with OpenCL.
Hands-on Exercises: Simple GPU-accelerated programs using CUDA and OpenCL.

Module 14-16: Advanced Topics and Future Directions
Scalable Parallel Systems: Clusters, grids, and cloud computing.
Parallel Algorithms: Techniques and frameworks for designing efficient parallel algorithms.
Emerging Technologies in AI: The role of parallel computing in deep learning and big data analytics.
Research Trends: Future developments in parallel computing and hardware.

W17-18: Final Project Presentations

description.zh: 地表和地下水的非點源污染，已經成為全世界各地區相當嚴重的環境問題。非點源污染本身複雜的特性導致集水區內污染物承載推估與污染源之標定非常困難。本課程之目的以介紹非點源污染之污染源特性及傳輸途徑為起點，教導學生學習使用最新的科技與工具，去建立最有效可行的最佳管理作業(Best Management Practice, BMP)之配置計劃，以達到集水區內非點源污染之削減目標。學生們將學習應用與統合地理資訊系統、遙測資料、水文暨水質數理模式、以及專家系統去解決集水區內非點源污染的控制問題。
description.en: Nonpoint source (NPS) pollution of streams, lakes, and estuaries has been a critical concern throughout the world.  The difficulty in both identifying and assessing nonpoint source pollution resides precisely in the complex nature of NPS.  This course aims to expose students to state-of-the-art tools and techniques for developing effective Best Management Practice (BMP) allocation plans to control NPS pollution at the watershed scale.  The foundations of this course will be focused on definition of NPS pollution, NPS pollutant dynamics in bioenvironmental systems, watershed hydrology and NPS pollutant transport, as well as BMPs for NPS pollution control.  Students will next learn how to apply Geographic Information System (GIS), Remote Sensing (RS), hydrologic modeling and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies to the solutions of NPS pollution problems in watersheds.  The tools and techniques presented are flexible and students will be able to apply them to solve NPS type of proble

本課程的目的是教授基本和先進的解決方案技術，包括精確和近似的方法，以解決廣泛的傳導傳熱問題。 其中包括多維穩態和暫態分析，重點是與傳熱相關的基礎物理學和基礎數學。因此，本課程將通過各種形式的控制傳熱方程的形式化求解技術來強調能量平衡和邊界條件的概念。
The goal of this course is to teach basic and advanced solution techniques, including exact and approximate approaches, for a wide range of conduction heat transfer problems. Included are both multidimensional steady state and transient analyses, with emphasis on the fundamental physics and underlying mathematics associated with heat transfer. Accordingly, this course will stress the concepts of energy balance and boundary conditions with a wide range of formal solution techniques for the solution of governing heat transfer equations.

syllabi.outline:
This course will teach the knowledge-based control methods, mainly focuses on Fuzzy logic control and Gray system (and neural network if time is available).  The Fuzzy method includes Fuzzy Logic theory and Fuzzy Logic Control.  
From this course, students can understand Fuzzy theory and can apply FLC and Grey in mechanical, electrical, or vehicle systems.  The topics covered in this lecture include: fuzzy set, membership function, fuzzification / defuzzification, fuzzy reasoning and inference, FLC design, FLC applications, grey theory, grey prediction, gray modeling, and grey control (and neural-network if time is available).  This lecture needs all students to do a 2- or 3-person team project to design and implement a fuzzy logic control to a real system.  Before the core lessons, a review of system dynamics will be provided.

description.zh: 透過自駕車理論與實務的課程講述，以及搭配業師實作經驗分享，除可以使修課同學對自駕車研究有基本概念之外，也可以藉本堂課引發對新興車輛技術研究領域與其實際應用之興趣。本課程涵蓋內容為自駕車軌跡規劃與控制、先進駕駛輔助控制設計、自駕車感知資料處理及物件偵測演算法、及AI技術應用於自駕車相關功能設計。本課程根據授課主題搭配實驗單元與期末專題，配合使用Matlab/Simulink、CarSim、Python、AI ToolBox等工具軟體，讓修課同學可應用課堂所學來進行自駕車演算法與技術開發，及透過模擬結果分析與驗證。
description.en: This course aims to teach the lessons of autonomous vehicle (AV) theory and practical applications. Moreover, with the experience sharing and cooperative lecturing from industrial experts, students can gain more knowledge about the fundamental concepts of AV research. The course introduces major contents including path planning and tracking control design, advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), perception data processing and detection algorithms, and AI-based technologies in the applications of AV. The course will arrange some labs and the term project to provide students, through conducted simulation analysis and verification, with an in-depth understanding of the emerging technology of AV.

description.en: Engineering optimization concepts,Linear progrsmming methods, Nonlinear programming Methods, Multi-objective optimization, Introduction to Modern mathematical programming techniques,Optimum design of precision machine components and systems.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title: Engineering Optimization Methods and Applications
The course focuses on the fundamental theory and concepts of "Engineering Optimization Methods," "Linear Programming," "Nonlinear Programming," "Multi-objective Function Optimization," "Modern Mathematical Planning Methods," and "Cross-Attribute System Optimization." Hands-on practices using optimization software and term projects are some key elements. Students will report their term projects at the end of the semester. Throughout the semester, students can better understand the optimization principle and apply it to their daily activities. The University Social Responsibility (USR) concept will be brought into the class this semester. Guide students to apply the optimization method in their term projects, vehicle designs, and research applications.
syllabi.schedule:
Course Title: Engineering Optimization Methods and Applications
a. Week,   b. Topic
1、	Outline of teaching syllabus and design (Chapter 1)--A general overview of the course. The USR program is introduced into the class. Students are encouraged to use the vehicles used in USR as the course term project. Guide students to apply optimal methods in the USR vehicles.
2、	Formulation of the optimization design problem (Chapter 2).
3、	Formulation of the optimization design problem (Chapter 2). 
4、	Optimizing design by drawing method (Chapter 3). Introduce the lightweight design concept by using fewer materials and still satisfying the design requirements. 
5、	The basic concept of optimal design (Chapter 4) (Use USR simplified 3D printing model for lightweight design optimization exercises.)
6、	Optimal Design Concepts: Global Optimization and Lagrange multipliers (Chapter 4).
7、	Optimal Design Concepts: KKT (Chapter 5). (Introduce the general design concept for electric vehicles. Use the vehicle of the USR project as an example for design improvement.) 
8、	Linear Programming: Initial Basic Feasible Solution (Chapter 6).
9、	Midterms, Solving Linear Programming (Chapter 6) & Semester Project planning.
10、	Linear Programming: Duality (Chapter 7); Numerical Methods for Unconstrained Optimal Design (Chapter 8)
11、	Numerical Methods for Unconstrained Optimal Design (Chapters 8 and 9)
12、	Numerical methods for unconstrained optimal design (Chapter 9). 
13、	Numerical Methods for Constrained Optimal Design (Chapter 10). (Introduce the design optimization software and use the USR vehicle as an example to conduct various design analyses and optimization.)
14、	Numerical Methods for Constrained Optimal Design (Chapters 10 and 11).
15、	Numerical Methods for Constrained Optimal Design (Chapter 11).
16、	Other physical applications. Report on term projects/USR vehicle project design optimization.
17、	Report on project/USR optimal and lightweight design for different systems, and/or sub-systems. 
18、	Final exam.

description.zh: 本課程之目的為訓練學生計算冷凍空調設備之蒸發器、冷凝器之熱傳與壓損的能力，以提升冷凍空調設備之設計能力。內容包括兩相流之流譜分析與動量方程式、兩相介面之表面張力作用、熱沸騰與冷凝等相變化之基本現象、兩相流之沸騰與冷凝熱傳性能之計算與分析、兩相流之流力現象分析與壓損之計算、蒸發器與冷凝器之熱傳增強技術等。
description.en: This course offers traning of advanced design techniques of evaporators and condensers in the HVAC & R applications.  The subjects in this course are: the two phase flow regime, analysis of momentum and energy equations for two phase flow, method of prediction of pressure drop of two phase flow, fundamental phenomena of condensation and evaporation, calculation of heat transfer coefficient of convective condensation or evaporation, heat transfer enhancement techniques for condensation and evaporation.

description.en: The concepts of thermal energy and electrical energy will be included in the Energy Engineering; the different energy system which will be introduced is as follows: renewable energy, traditional thermal power plant and cogeneration power system.

syllabi.outline:
•	ENERGY ENGINEERING is a branch of Engineering science that deals with production, transformation, transmission, storage and use of energy and is the most recent engineering disciplines to emerge. 
•	This course is a basic course taught entirely in English. 
•	The aim of this course is to provide introductory knowledge to students who have not studied Environmental Energy Science as a subject. 
•	Students can gain basic knowledge about Energy sources, production of energy, Energy Management, Energy Laws and most importantly about Bioenergy Engineering. 
•	This deals with sustainable methods of producing clean energy and thereby preventing hazardous environmental issues through significant energy efficiency improvements and sustainable use of resources.
•	This course also has an important objective of motivating non-native English students to improve their English language skills like conversing, discussing and writing assignments in English.
•	These practices will help them deliver better English presentations and also enhance their thesis and paper writing abilities.

name.en: Advanced course on facility system of semiconductor and photonic fabrication plants.

description.zh: 本課程為半導體與光電廠務設進階課程, 主要針對半導體與光電廠務設施作深入的論述，課程包含廠務設施的九大系統：冰水機系統、排氣系統、電力監控系統、壓縮空氣系統、氮氣系統、純水系統、真空系統、製程冷卻水系統及外氣空調系統。期使修習本課程之學生有一和實務聯結之機會，並和理論作相相互映證。有校外教學且學生必需完成一小型計劃.
description.en: This advanced course aims to provide students a broad scope of hand-on knowledge on the facility system of a semiconductor or photonic fabrication factory. The facility system includes nine sub-systems: chilled water system, exhaust air system, compressed air system, process cooling water (PCW) system, vacuum system, ultra pure water (UPW) system, power and monitoring system, nitrogen system and make-up air system. Course material is basically based on and closely linked with field operational experience. A factory visit tour will be arranged. A mini-project will be carried by participating students.

name.zh: 離岸風電之熱流與空氣動力學基礎
name.en: Foundation and Analysis of Thermo-Fluid and Aerodynamics on Offshore Wind Power

description.zh: 離岸風力發電是在海上建設風力發電廠，電廠通常建於大陸礁層(棚)，利用風能進行發電，它較陸上風力發電具有更高的風速，所以能提供更多的電力。面對全球溫室氣體減量趨勢與達成非核家園願景，政府已規劃2025年再生能源發電占比20％之政策目標，為達成此一政策目標，政府規劃以太陽光電及離岸風電作為主力，其中離岸風力原規劃於2025年累計達3 GW（10億瓦）。為了讓學生了解離岸風力發電熱流與空氣動力學之基本原理與應用，特別於大四與研究所共同合開這門課。本課程內容主要包括:(1)離岸風電簡介，(2)流體力學分析基礎與其應用於風機之分析，(3)熱傳學分析基礎與其應用於風機之分析，(4)空氣動力學基礎與其應用於風機之分析，(5)電腦輔助離岸風機之氣動分析。
description.en: Offshore wind power is the use of wind farms constructed in bodies of water, usually in the ocean on the continental shelf, to harvest wind energy to generate electricity. Higher wind speeds are available offshore compared to on land, so offshore wind power’s electricity generation is higher per amount of capacity installed. In the face of the trend of global greenhouse gas reduction and the realization of the non-nuclear homeland vision, the government has planned a policy goal of renewable energy generation in the proportion of 20% in 2025. In order to achieve this policy goal, the government plans to use solar photovoltaic and offshore wind power as its main force. Among them, offshore wind power was originally planned to reach 3 GW (1 billion watts) in 2025. To assist students to understand the principle and application of thermo-fluid and aerodynamics on offshore wind power, this course is opened for seniors of undergraduate students and graduate students. description.zh: 這是一門旨在介紹基礎統計原理和方法的課程，並包括R語言的教學。本課程的總體目標是建立研究生在單變量統計的知識與技術。本課程著重概念理解應用，不涉及公式推導。主題包括單變量和雙變量分佈的介紹，數據展示，描述統計，標準常態分佈，學生t分佈，用於測試平均值的推斷統計方法，相關性，以及簡單/多元線性回歸。本課程還向學生介紹R數據分析系統。本課程無先修課程的要求。
description.en: This is a course designed to provide an introduction to the principles and methods of statistics using R. The overall goal of the course is to provide graduate students with a foundation to quantitative data analysis that will allow them to build future skills. This course provides an applied approach to statistical analysis for research. Topics include introduction to univariate and bivariate distributions, data displays, descriptive statistics, the standard normal distribution, student’s t-distribution, inferential statistical methods for testing means, correlation, and simple/multiple linear regression. This course also introduces the student to the R data analysis system. No formal course prerequisites.

syllabi.outline: This is a course designed to provide an introduction to the principles and methods of statistics using R. The overall goal of the course is to provide graduate students with a foundation for quantitative data analysis that will allow them to build future skills. This course provides an applied approach to statistical analysis for research. Topics include an introduction to univariate and bivariate distributions, data displays, descriptive statistics, the standard normal distribution, student’s t distribution, inferential statistical methods for testing means, correlation, simple/multiple linear regression, and mediation. This course also introduces the student to the R data analysis system. No formal course prerequisites.

name.en: Philosophy of Technological and Vocational Education

description.zh: 本課程在探究技職教育的本質、目標、歷史發展及相關哲學思潮，期培養學生發展批判思考能力分析技職教育相關議題。
description.en: This course is designed to investigate the purpose, essence, history,    and related philosophical thinking of Vocational and Technological Technical Education (VTE)；to develop students forming critical thinking to analyze the current issues in VTE.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹技職教育之歷史發展與相關哲學思潮，綜採行歷史學、社會學、哲學與比較教育學的觀點，以專題討論的方式進行。期達成以下目標-
一、使學生瞭解技職教育的歷史發展與哲學理念
二、使學生瞭解台灣技職教育的變遷
三、使學生能比較及分析國內外技職教育之差異
四、使學生能以宏觀的視野與脈絡來透視技職教育問題並提出改革建議。
syllabi.schedule:
1.課程介紹
2..技職教育的理念
3.技術在歷史中的演化
4.技職教育哲學(一)
5.技職教育哲學(二)
6.Edgerton的技術史觀
7.中國古代科技思想對技職教育的啟示
8.戰後台灣的技職教育發展（一）1945-1965
9..戰後台灣的技職教育發展（二）1966-1987
10.戰後台灣的技職教育發展（三）1988-迄今
11.全球化對技職教育研究的啟示
12.其他技職教育史哲相關文獻評論

description.en: The course aims to (1) understand the definition, essence, and function of human resources development, (2) cultivate the fundamental capability of human resource development. It covers the definition and essence of human resources development, demand evaluation of human resource development, planning of human resource, learning theories, training method; curriculum designing and compilation, evaluation of training development, and international human resource development. The course is conducted through lectures, discussions, field trip activities, and colloquia.

syllabi.outline: This course is an introduction and overview to the discipline of Human Resource Development. description.en: This course is designed for students who have taken one-year undergraduate organic chemistry course. It is divided into the three fundamental aspects of the study of organic chemistry:reactions, mechanisms and structure. A student who has completed this course should be able to approach the literature directry, with a sound knowledge of modern basic organic chemistry.

description.zh:
本課程以高分子加工時所遇到之問題，分單元講述，其內容包括：
(I) 高分子加工學之基礎(a)輸送現象(b)高分子黏彈學(c)高分子混煉。
(II)高分子加工學之應用(a)壓模法(b)沖模法(c)反應沖模法(d)絲線成形  等專題。
description.en:
The course focuses on the "trouble shooting" in the polymer processing . Both theoretical and practical topics will be included. The main contents are devided into the following units :
(I)Fundamental Studies:(a)Transport Phenomena (b)Viscoelastic Properties of  Polymer Melt (c)Polymer Compounding and Blending.
(II)Practical Studies:(a)Compression Molding (b)Injection Molding (c)Reaction Injection Molding (d)Fiber Formation (e)Membrane
      Formation.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹一系列的生物分子及這些生物分子所扮演的角色。課程從認識細菌、植物、動物細胞及各種細胞胞器開始，接著探討蛋白質、酵素、DNA、RNA結構和功能及他們在生命中的重要性。再論及DNA複製及轉錄和RNA轉譯成蛋白質的重要性及機制。PCR和DNA重組技術的重要性是安排在最後來介紹。
description.en: This course is to introduce a series of biomaterials and their functions. Begins from bacterial, plant, and animal cells and the differences between these cell organs. To learn of DNA, RNA, proteins, and enzymes base on their structures and functions. The phenomena of DNA replication and translation, and RNA translation will be studied. The PCR method and DNA recombinant technology also included in this course.

description.zh:
講述有關低溫電漿的特徵、性能及有機高分子纖維、生醫素材方面的應用。因高分子表面的改質，使濕潤性、接著性、染色性、帶電性、印刷性等獲致改善，附與高機能功能性。並針對處理時的條件，包括氣體的種類、真空度、壓力、功率、時間、流量等因素，探討對高分子素材表面改質的影響和效果。
配合SEM、ESCA、接觸角等儀器的分析、觀測高分子表面構造的變化及成分的變異，以研究高分子表面的改質。
description.en:
Lecture for the characteristic of low temperature plasma. as  well as its application in organic polymer fiber and biomedical material. The submicron modification of polymer surface can improve wettibility, adhesion, dyeing behavior, electrification, and printing properties for endow material with high performance. Explain for the plasma treating conditions, such as gas  variety、vacuum、 pressure、power、 time、 flow rate etc., are also discussed in order to study their influence and effect in 
Polymer Material surface modification. The surface structure and component change are analyzed by SEM, ESCA and contact angle instruments to investigate the modification on polymer surface.

description.zh: 課程兩個主要目標為光譜學方法及分離方法。光譜學方法內容含紫外、可見、紅光、核磁、x-ray等光譜法。電子譜及質譜也將被討論。分離方法方面有液層、氣層、膠層等層析法。分離後串聯之光譜分析也會學習。
description.en: Two major goals of this course are spectroscopy and separation methods. Spectroscopy methods include ultraviolet, visible, infrared, nuclear magnetic, and x-ray spectroscopies.Election and mass spectrometry are also included. Separation methods are: gas, liquid, and gel chromatographies. In addition, GC-MS,LC-MS, GC-IR, etc. will be studied.

description.en: Organic Spectroscopy Special Topics is an essential knowledge for identification of organic molecular structures. It is also a very useful tool for researches on the behavior of organic molecules. This course is aimed to introduce the basic principles and applications of the organic spectroscopy to students. The students will also practice in the class on analyzing the sample spectra so that they can apply these techniques to their research work.

description.en: This course explores the principles of sustainable development in green chemistry technologies, including renewable resources, minimizing waste, and employing eco-friendly processes. Students will acquire the skills to design innovative materials with a diminished environmental footprint, delve into green synthesis   and green energy.

description.zh: 本課程針對在不同物理和化學機制下顏色產生的原因，如振動和簡單的激發解釋了白熾（如：火焰）、氣體激發（如：霓虹管、極光）和震動與旋轉（如：藍冰和水）的顏色等，以及染料和顏料之化學結構、製造方式和基本化性予以闡述，以便對色料的相關應用有較為明晰的瞭解。
description.en: This course targets at the color derived from a variety of physical and chemical mechanisms are summarized. Includes vibrations and simple excitations to explain the colors of incandescence (e.g., flames), gas excitations (neon tube, aurora), and vibrations and rotations (blue ice and water). And also chemical structure, manufacturing and properties of main dyes and pigments are studied. Further applications of the color stuff are explained.

description.zh: 本課程區分為四個實習，共一學年之都市設計實習，每學期應從事幾項實習，依該學期之情況而定：(一)大型基地開發之建築規劃與都市設計實習：參照台北市都市發展局擬定之「都市設計與土地使用開發許可」之審議標準，練習建築、敷地與都市設計三者整合關係之設計實習。(二)都市更新地區都市設計實習：以台北市更新地區為範例，選定基地範圍從事都市更新地區之改造，建立地區未來像，並擬定都市設計準則。(三)都市計畫通盤檢討地區都市設計實習：依據都市計畫通盤檢討第八條規定，都市計畫通盤檢討地區必須依據該地區之交通、產業、文化、生態及基地等因素，擬定都市設計準則；以台北市都市計畫通盤檢討為例，練習都市設計準則之訂定，或以都市計畫細部計畫為例，研擬土地使用分區管制與設計準則。(四)新發展區都市設計實習：選定一個地區，可能是擴大都市發展地區或新市鎮、新社區之規劃設計實習。
description.en: There are four exercises for one academic year. The exercises to be undertaken depend on when and how it is appropriate:(1) Exercise on building planning and urban design for large-scale land development project(2) Exercise practice on urban design for district renewal planning(3) Exercise of overall review district urban design out of the total urban design (4) Exercise on urban design for new development area

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要目的為透過真實的場域案例，連結本所其他專題課程涵蓋之理論與台灣規劃實務的各個面向，讓學生熟悉都市設計的操作。本學期課程內容結合USR計畫，將基地訂於「台北市北投中繼市場與其週邊社區」，預計讓學生利用創新技術（例如：3D空間掃描建模、混成實境技術進行參與式規劃等），從社區使用者的角度出發，進行新建公有市場在不同尺度的規劃準則設定，且將部分空間單元以圖面搭配模型的方式呈現，進一步藉由參與式規劃工作坊搜集居民建議來完善最終成果。期待經由門課，一方面讓學生於真實場域實習社區尺度的都市設計操作，一方面實踐大學社會責任（USR）的參與精神，產生對社會/區實質的貢獻。

name.zh: 當代城市中都市社會基礎設施再思
name.en: Rethinking urban social infrastructure in contemporary cities

description.zh:
由於九零年代後，城市急速擴張與超越領域性(de-terrorization)的連結等新興狀態萌生，基礎設施(infrastructure)的定義逐漸開始難以精確認定，而身為城市興衰論述的經常主體，基礎設施自身的論述與再定義卻在空間學門中成為那缺落的一塊。

基於此，本課程期望透過幾項特定學門角度，提供一個對於基礎設施為研究主題的論述框架，進而連結建築學門與相關空間學門間對於當代全球城市論述中之縫隙，能在跨學門田野研究中提出他種可能性(alternatives)。 本課程將以兩種方項進行基礎設施當代性的"實踐"; 部分課程內容將邀請德國杜賓根大學台灣研究中心，以空間社會學角度提供授課交流。另一部分將透過雙邊學生，以共同主題進行台北與德國城市的實際田野調查並以比較分析的方式進行合作討論。課程架構則以建築學與空間社會學為主軸剖析，分為五個部分:全球城市與多尺度論述，當代基礎設施與建築/地景對話，社會基礎設施的物質性與再生產，看不見的基礎設施與田野調查為總結。預計學生能透過不同學門角度的切入、於不同文化背景學生間合作討論、多種教學方式的引導，培養基礎辯證思考之能力並進一步對當代都市基礎設施的空間性研究之興趣。
description.en:
In the contemporary word, especially in globalized cities, infrastructure is hard to define for many reasons and at some points infrastructure is also often invisible to its users.

This class will therefore seek to rethink the subject of infrastructure from particular perspectives which frame the structure of this module. We then proposed a join-class with Taiwan study centre at University of T?bingen, Germany for wider debates and teaching possibilities as well. There will be two academic discourses-Architecture and sociology involved and formed into five sessions which can be seen in course syllabus. In so doing, it will focus on firstly by reading theory; secondly, by examining specific case studies that illustrates how these theories manifests themselves; and thirdly, by considering how these infrastructures may be changing the understanding of contemporary globalized cities and reproducing urban networks in different fields and countries.

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

2.	Detail of "Participation"
Each participant needs to prepare a brief introduction to the (non-architectural) social background of one cultural period of time. This will be the tuned in of the class of the day for 20 minutes.
(Week 02) Dutch and Spanish Empires in the 17th Century (relationship with the world)
(Week 03) 17th. C. to 19th. C. China (relationship with the rest of the world)
(Week 04) Japan before 1895 (westernization)
(Week 05) Japanese colonial power in Taiwan and China 
(Week 10) social background in the first half of the 20th-century China
(Week 11) Japanese architecture after WWII 
(Week 12) global modernist architecture esp. after WWII
(Week 13) ideology of Chinese origin before and after 1945 (from 1940s to 1960s)
(Week 14) global trends of architectural regionalism
(Week 16) from postmodern architecture to Deconstructivism in the world

3.	Detail of "	Mid-term presentation": proposal for the final report 20%
In the first half of the courses, students have to outline their interests of Taiwanese architecture in certain approaches. They might be architectural styles (ex. Regionalism, modernism, etc.), structural systems, materials (ex. Brick, RC, etc.), particular types of architecture, one or two individual architects, etc. Students should present their plans of their final reports in the mid-term class about 10 minutes, in order to collect some feedback from colleagues and class instructor for further develop to achieve the final report.

4.	Detail of "	Research thesis": 30%
One should submit his/her thesis by 6/20 12:00pm to Dr. Wu. The words of the thesis should not be less than 3000 words. It should be in thesis format (word) instead of brief presentation format (power point).
The final report should present the development and influences from the past to the present (or particular period).

description.zh: 本課程以都市再生理念為中心，講述推動都市再生過程中面對相關文化資產保存議題之理論與實際操作架構。第一部份探討歷史文化保存相關理念手法。第二部份探討各國文化保存再生案例實踐之相關課題與借鏡，第三部份針對台灣本土都市更新過程中面臨歷史文化保存議題深入研討。
description.en:
This course regards urban revitalization as the central concept to discuss about the theory & implementation of history & culture conservation issues of urban revitalization. This course consisted of three parts. 
The first part is considered of relevant concepts & strategies of history and culture conservation. The second part is to survey different implemented examples of history and culture conservation of different country. The third part involves the regional issues by local-oriented issues of Taiwan. A few of cultural conservation topics are introduced to be further interpreted.

name.en: Disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage

description.zh:
我國古蹟與歷史建築之文化遺產防災計畫實施現況，至今因欠缺有系統之調查研究，因此難以了解問題點所在。此外台灣現有之古蹟與歷史建築多為日治時期所遺留下來，而日本至今已有相當多具有良好防災計畫之古蹟與歷史建築案例，應可作為我國相關研究參考，但國內對此課題亦缺少有系統之調查。
本課程的授課內容如下：1.概論 2.文化遺產防災之重要性3.文化遺產防災之基本策略4. 文化遺產防災之進行方式5.文化遺產之災害種類與對策。
description.en:
Due to the lack of systematic research work carried out in Taiwan, it is difficult to find out the problems of the current disaster prevention plans for the cultural heritage. Taiwan has many existing vestiges and relics from Japanese colonial period at the moment. Despite the fact that there are numerous excellent examples of disaster prevention plans in Japan for us to consult and to research, little systematic work regarded the subject can be found in the literature in our own country. 
The course content about followings: 
1. Introduction
2. Importance of disaster prevention of cultural heritage
3. Disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage 
4. Approach of disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage
5. Type of cultural heritage disaster and guideline

description.zh: 國際能源署(IEA)呼籲全球國家訂定淨零碳排路徑，國內也發佈「台灣 2050 淨零路徑及策略」，具體宣告了淨零碳排的目標期程與行動方案，針對建築部門納入低碳(低蘊含碳)建築評估(Low Embodied-carbon Building Rating System, LBERS)，藉由標準化、透明化的建築資訊來剖析建築生命週期各階段對環境的影響，以培養永續淨零概念並具備評估整棟建築生命週期的碳足跡、甚進一步提出減碳熱點，了解建築物的節碳潛力所在。了解國內外淨零碳排路徑策略、具備建築物生命週期的整體流程概念、具備建築碳足跡計算操作能力。
description.en: IEA (The International Energy Agency) proposes to set a global net carbon emission roadmap, and domestically launch a net target and action plan, targeting the building sector, the Low Embodied-carbon Building Rating System(LBERS) a simple and effective assessment tool to evaluates the carbon footprint of a building's life cycle through standardized and transparent building information, the impact of various stages of the building life cycle on the environment is analyzed step by step. This course not only evaluates the carbon footprint of the entire building life cycle but also further identifies carbon hotspots and provides carbon reduction strategies, hence understanding carbon savings potential of buildings.

syllabi.assessment:
Grading Policy
1. Research Ideas (25%): 
Originality: Are the ideas innovative or bringing fresh perspectives?
Relevance: Are the ideas aligned with the field of study and research objectives?
Feasibility: Are the ideas realistic and achievable within the scope of the research?

2. Critical Thinking (25%)
Depth of Analysis: Does the student critically engage with existing literature or problems?
Argumentation: Are arguments well-structured, logical, and supported by evidence?
Problem-Solving: Does the student demonstrate the ability to critically address challenges?

3. Research Tools (25%)
Proficiency: Is the student skilled in using appropriate research tools (e.g., statistical software, databases)?
Selection: Are the tools chosen suitable for the research questions and methodology?
Application: Is the student able to effectively apply the tools to gather and analyze data?

4. Research Motivation (25%)
Commitment: Does the student exhibit consistent effort and enthusiasm throughout the research process?
Curiosity: Is there a demonstrated eagerness to explore and learn?
Independence: How well does the student take initiative and responsibility for their research?

《高效率實驗室管理術》由臺大化學系 - 劉如熹教授帶領兩位學生 -   黃文澤博士及莫誠康博士耗時多年集結、編寫而成的心血結晶。
本書是一本關於實驗室管理的實用指南，深入探討了如何打造一個高效、創新且可持續發展的實驗室，並對研究管理與行政管理兩大核心進行了詳細剖析。

description.zh:

生物力學是一門整合醫學與工學的學科。本課程介紹並討論十大主題：(1)脊椎生物力學、(2)關節生物力學、(3)骨折生物力學、(4)復健生物力學、(5)運動生物力學、(6)心血管生物力學、(7)植入物設計原理、(8)手術器械設計原理、(9)矯具設計原理與(10)病床與輪椅設計原理。
description.en: Biomechanics is a multi-discipline branch incorporating medicine and mechanics. Ten topics are introduced and discussed in this class: (1) spinal biomechanics, (2) joint biomechanics, (3) trauma biomechanics, (4) rehabilitation biomechanics, (5) sport biomechanics, (6) cardiovascular biomechanics, (7) implant design, (8) instrument design, (9) orthotice design, and (10) sickbed and wheelchair design.

syllabi.outline:
生物力學是一門整合生物醫學與力學的學科。本課程涵蓋生物力學基礎概念與理論之介紹，並分別討論以下各主題：(1)生物力學概論、(2)植入物與矯具、(3) 骨骼生物力學、(4) 髖關節生物力學、(5) 膝關節生物力學、(6)足部生物力學、(7) 脊椎生物力學、(8) 牙科生物力學、(9) 人體動作分析、(10)電腦輔助工程分析在生物力學之應用。各主題中亦將介紹各式植入物與輔具於臨床醫學上之應用。

Biomechanics is a multi-disciplinary science which integrates biomedical and mechanical subjects. This course covers the basic principles of biomechanics and its applications in the following topics: (1) Introduction to biomechanics; (2) Prosthetics and orthotics; (3) Bone mechanics; (4) Hip joint biomechanics; (5) Knee joint biomechanics; (6) Biomechanics of foot and footwear; (7) Spine biomechanics; (8) Dental biomechanics; (9) Human motion analysis; (10) Applications of CAE in biomechanics. The related prothetic and orthotic devices will also be introduced in selected topics.

The subject also provides the basis for more advanced work in finite element analysis, mechanics of composite materials, fracture mechanics.

name.en: Foundations and Advances in Artificial Intelligence II

description.zh:
本課程深入探討人工智慧領域的基礎知識和最新技術，包括機器學習、深度學習、自然語言處理、生成對抗網絡等領域。課程還介紹了最新的AI技術趨勢，包括注意力機制、自監督學習、大型AI通用模型和元學習等，並提供了相關領域的案例研究和實習操作。
課程運作模式：學員將參與課堂討論和小組活動，以促進想法交流和知識分享。學生可根據課程選擇進階專題研究，深入探討特定主題並提交最終報告。最後三週專題研究將被評估並可獲得額外獎勵，學生可在學期中向授課教師報名參與專題研究。
description.en:
Course Overview: This course delves into the fundamentals and latest advancements in the field of artificial intelligence, covering topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and generative adversarial networks. The course also introduces the latest trends in AI technology, including attention mechanisms, self-supervised learning, large-scale AI models, and meta-learning, and provides case studies and hands-on exercises in related areas.
Course Execution: Participants will engage in classroom discussions and group activities to facilitate idea exchange and knowledge sharing. Students may choose to undertake advanced research projects on specific topics of course and submit final reports. The final three weeks of research projects will be assessed and eligible for additional rewards. Students can sign up for research projects with the course instructor during the semester.

本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

In the era of technological & social growth at an exponential speed, more than ever, business leaders across the globe are facing even more challenging issues, not just economic aspects but also legal and ethical aspects.  In this elite IMBA program of NTUT, this course is specifically designed for developing future leaders for corporations & organizations in various business domains.  
How to simultaneously achieve the corporate objectives and fulfill the ethical responsibilities without compromising fundamental principles and standards of conduct when facing dilemma is imperative for us to learn and ponder upon. 
With this vision and mission in mind, the lecturer is committed to inspire the students’ talent within as in all the other executive management programs.  
This IMBA course will equip all participating international students with multiple pillars of those grounds in being great leaders in the future, including building fundamental mindset and value system for managing challenging issues both economically and ethically, framework of strategic thinking and organizational structuring, and practical cross-cultural business cases and simulations. 
All IMBA students who participate in this course will be expected to be well-prepared with passionate learning attitude to JOIN proactively group discussions, cross-cultural idea brainstorming, business scenario simulation, deductive-and-inductive reasoning practice, individual and team projects, and business case studies. 
It Is My Since Wish and Mission to develop You, to become great leaders of the future for bettering our world humanity advancement!  This course is specifically designed to develop and enhance all the wonderful qualities essential for You.

description.en: nternational Advertising and Media Strategy takes a market-oriented approach to the total campaign. The course interrelates planning, creative and technical skills with emphasis on problem-solving and marketing communications.

syllabi.outline:
As a master’s level elective, this course covers advertising and media through a solid understanding of culture, communication, society, and consumer behavior, with an emphasis on analysis-based decision-making. 

This class teaches from a high strategic perspective—how C-level marketing directors determine the marketing and branding strategies, which get implemented by junior staff through advertising and media. This course is therefore NOT about learning how a marketing executive in a company uses Facebook, IG, and Google SEO to advertise online or in traditional media.


Firstly, this course introduces the fundamental concepts relevant to understanding the development of strategies. Long before the execution of advertising and media campaigns by delegated, regional staff, marketing strategies are developed at a high level—drawing from an understanding of culture, communication, consumer behavior, as well as marketing and branding.

Secondly, this class covers the practical skills necessary for the data analysis, which are used to to develop marketing strategies that underpin advertising and media campaigns. Rather than an abstract approach, this course also emphasizes knowing how to do—drawing from the strategy-setting practices in the top 100 international brands.

Therefore, Students will also follow this process in the course. Students will 1) learn solid conceptual knowledge, 2) apply them to conduct data analysis, 3) determine marketing strategies, from which to 4) develop advertising and media plans that are evidence-based, coherent, and impactful.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹企業進行國際化策略以及多國籍企業營運與其功能性（價值鏈活動）之議題。期使學生瞭解當代企業國際化營運的重要性與其內涵，並建立整體的概念。同時，藉由精選案例之探討，提供學習者了解企業進行國際化與國際營運管理相關的實務作法。如此，將使學習者得將國企理論與概念運用於實際案例，培養分析能力。
description.en: The course is mainly for the students to understand the importance of international business strategies of MNC (Multi-Nation Company) which includes the business models, value chain and the functionality. In the mean time, the students will have a clear picture of MNC's daily operation by well-selected case study. The ultimate goal is to apply the theory into the real business world and to have an advanced analysis capability at the end of the course.

syllabi.outline:
一、	Course Objective
Understanding international business management from the global perspective, students will learn the role of international monetary institutions as well as political and economic factor that influence foreign direct investments.。
In addition, this course provides insight into factors that influence internationalization, entry strategies into foreign markets such as exporting, licensing, joint-ventures and tools to manage and evaluate risks and changes of international operations. This course has an interdisciplinary approach by providing insights on how the international political environment affects business decisions such as internationalizing or global production. MBA students are very welcome to attend this course

name.zh: 網路行銷研究與資料分析

description.zh: 網際網路與相關應用程式從根本上改變了消費者日常生活的各個方面。行銷從業人員也已經將他們的工作轉移到了網路上。本課程的目的在於幫助學生認識網路資料分析在數位行銷領域中的作用，並實際應用網路分析工具和技術來監控網路行銷活動的績效。課程主題包括：Web數據分析與行銷簡介、Web日誌分析、網站表現指標和關鍵績效指標、網站監控和趨勢分析、網路廣告及網路分析的未來趨勢。
description.en: The Internet and web applications have fundamentally changed nearly every aspect of our daily lives. Marketing practitioners have shifted their efforts online. This module aims to help students recognise the role of web analytics within the digital marketing landscape, and practically apply web analytics tools and technologies to monitor performance of web based marketing activities. Topics to be covered include: Introduction to web analytics and web data driven marketing; Web server log analysis; Web metrics and key web performance Indicators; Web monitoring and trends analysis; Dashboard design; Navigation analysis; Online advertising; Future trends of web analytics.

The primary purpose of this course is to cultivate student's ability to gain data insights. Therefore, this course uses cases and relevant literature to explain concepts and guide students to analyze and interpret data. It is mainly divided into three parts:
1. Build students' consumption theories and concepts through cases and literature;
2. Students interpret and analyze data to gain consumption and marketing insights;
3. Data managers share their practical experience.

syllabi.outline: 以消費者為重心已蔚為目前市場行銷的重要潮流。了解消費者決策過程也成為行銷領域研究的主流。一般而言，消費者的購買決策制定過程決定產品與服務的購買結果，主要包括五個階段：(1)問題察覺、(2)資訊搜尋、(3)方案評估、(4)購買選擇、(5)購後過程。消費者的購買決策制定過程深受各種不同因素之影響。本課程強調如何藉由理論概念、實例討論與實作方式進一步了解消費者，並將此知識應用於行銷策略上。此外網際網路為一整合媒體,有別於傳統之行銷環境,在網際網路上消費者與媒體可以產生高度的互動,並且也可能產生虛擬經驗.本課程也從消費者行為理論出發,探討在網際網路環境下之消費者行為。課程以哈佛式個案討論為主。

description.en: The objective of this course is to help the graduate students whose topics of master's theses or graduate projects are related to creativity development, creative design skills and methodology, to prepare their preliminary studies. This course provides the necessary theoretical tools and case studies, and its contents contain (1) design creativity research based on artificial intelligence, psychology, anthropology and linguistics, as well as (2) exercises of creative design techniques: rule-based reasoning and case-based reasoning, schematic analogy and association, product ethnography, pattern language and experiential scenario.

description.zh: 設計是一個相當多元的領域，是技術的化身、美學的表現和文化的象徵。它是社會、經濟、技術、藝術、心理學和生理學的結合。本課程旨在構建學生對設計原理和理論的認識，提高學生對美感和設計作品的鑑賞能力，並為他們提供專業術語。這些知識構成了幫助年輕從業者實現其藝術目標並在高專業水平上執行項目工作的核心。本課程基於對現代設計行業的概述，期望建立一個關於設計思維主題的全景視角。
description.en: Design is a quite multiplex domain, technical incarnation, esthetics performance and cultural symbol. And it is the union of the social, economics, technology, arts, psychology, and physiology. The course aims to structure students’ knowledge about the principles and theories of design, improve their abilities to appreciate the aesthetic sense and design works, and provide them with professional terminology. This knowledge constitutes the core which helps young practitioners to attain their artistic objectives and perform project work on a high professional level. This course is based on an overview of the modern design industry, expect to establish a panorama perspective on the subject of design thinking.

「永續城市」目標，在於透過住居、運輸、防災、環保、資訊建設、社會安全、民眾參與、文化傳承等不同面向，建構具包容、安全、韌性及永續特質的城市與鄉村。

description.zh: 本課程將專注於創新產品與混合實境的設計研究實務，期望透過虛實整合與使用者經驗的核心概念，應用研究方法深入探究設計問題與使用者經驗中的痛點，探討實體端產品設計和虛擬端的服務設計之各種實務應用，進而透過設計方法與軟硬體技術落實創新概念，最終達到設計出符合與滿足使用者在未來生活中的各種設計服務與體驗。
description.en: This course will focus on the design research case study of innovative products and mixed reality. It is expected that through the core concepts of virtual-real integration and user experience, it will apply research methods to deeply explore design problems and pain points in user experience and explore physical product design and virtual reality. We will integrate various possibilities of service design with industry case study. Then, we intend to utilize the implemented innovative concept by design methods, software, and hardware technologies to achieve the design services and experiences that meet and satisfy users in future life.

name.zh: 生活環境設計專案研究
name.en: Project Research of Living Environment Design

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於藉由專業養成，累積實務技能，期能在室內裝修設計及材料技術之各面向，並展現生活環境設計實務操作能力。藉由國內外設計競賽主題與各項產學合作設計案進行實際演練，著重於資料蒐集、需求分析、創新構想與成果表達之進階能力養成，期讓學生在國內外設計競賽舞台上展現光芒。因本所結合設計、藝術、人文、木工等各領域的學生，整合培育創新設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具各種專長的研究生，協同完成生活環境設計的專案設計研究，或是透過生活環境設計專案執行的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專案執行為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: The objective of this course is to accumulate practical skills through professional development,to be able to demonstrate the practical operation ability of interior decoration design and material technology,to demonstrate the practical operation ability of living environment design.Through the theme of design competitions and various industry-university cooperation design projects,practical exercises are carried out,focusing on data collection,demand analysis,innovative ideas and achievement expression advanced ability cultivation,hoping to let students show their brilliance on the stage of design competitions.Another objective is to construct a multi-field interactive learning environment,which is a project-oriented learning mode,and graduate students with various specialties can be combined to collaborate on the project design research of living environment design,or through the implementation of living environment design projects.

syllabi.materials:
（一）一般教材
1. 各類教材優劣分析
（1）室內設計：一般室內設計介紹圖書
此多為針對室內設計科系學生所編教材，深入淺出，著重全盤整合式學習，學生學習易掌握狀況，且易了解，適合初學者使用。然室內設計尚無設計題目之相關教材出版，故可以此上述教材作為參考。

◎其他教材之缺點：
(1)教授重點，內容不夠詳實。
(2)部分單元、章節與其他課程有所重疊。
(3)內容過於繁多，若依上課週數安排，無法於一年內上完全部內容。

syllabi.notes:
SDG11：建構具包容、安全、韌性及永續特質的城市與鄉村
「永續城市」目標，在於透過住居、運輸、防災、環保、資訊建設、社會安全、民眾參與、文化傳承等不同面向，建構具包容、安全、韌性及永續特質的城市與鄉村。
本課程透過理解設計史上的精彩作品，透過政治、宗教、技術、文化、氣候和地理因素影響下的背景梳理，利用設計思維的文化傳承，進而達到建構具包容、安全、韌性及永續特質的城市與鄉村的目標。
