syllabi.schedule:
1. This course covers object-oriented modeling for software development. Materials covered include class models, state models, and interaction models in UML, a reference process model based on Unified process, implementation issues, and software engineering principles. This course is thinking and programming-intensive.
2. Students are required to complete a non-trivial software project. Only object-oriented languages such as C++/Java/C# are allowed. A project team may have 1-4 students. A single person team is allowed but is not encouraged.
3. There will be no exams; instead, there are 7 homework assignments, several in-class exercises, and two project reviews. All assignments turned in must be typed (handwriting will not be accepted).

syllabi.outline:
This course will introduce Google Cloud Computing related technologies and provide students with a comprehensive understanding of Google Cloud platform, architecture, services, and programming through the application of machine learning and IoT in railway systems. The course content includes: 1. Google cloud system architecture, storage network and virtualization technology, 2. Google cloud storage technology, 3. Google cloud scheduling technology, performance and security, 4. Google virtualized data center construction, 5. Google cloud services and enterprise applications, 6. Introduction to IoT technology 7. IoT standards and applications 8. Introduction to Industrial IoT network 9. IoT security and privacy protection 10. IoT internship courses and special projects. Therefore, before the midterm exam, we will mainly introduce the Google cloud system architecture. After the midterm exam, we will start to introduce the Internet of Things and its development trends. In the 11th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security issues and trends. In the 12th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology. In the 13th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 14th week. In the 15th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 16th week. In the 17th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology and practice. In the 18th week, we will make a special topic report at the end.

description.zh: 區塊鏈技術(作為比特幣等數位貨幣的核心)已重塑了金融交易與分散式交互方式之未來。同時它也被期待帶給我們一個更自組與可提供事實證明的數位化世界。抽象化區塊鏈構造是非常精巧的，它倚賴輕量化密碼學工具搭配分散式系統概念，完成了開放、安全且有效率的系統(如比特幣)。本課程為區塊鏈技術與應用上之概念介紹，包含：比特幣與區塊鏈設計、相關基礎密碼學工具、分散式網路與共識、區塊鏈應用。
description.en: Blockchain techniques (the core of cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin) have reshaped the future of financial transactions and decentralized interactions. They are also expected to bring us a more self-organizing and dependent digital world. The abstraction of blockchain is very delicate. It relies on cryptography tools and decentralized system concepts to achieve an open, secure, and efficient system (such as Bitcoin). This course aims to introduce the concepts of blockchain techniques and applications, including Bitcoin and blockchain design, basic cryptography tools, decentralized networks and consensus, and blockchain applications.

description.zh: 實現計算已從傳統地本地端機器獨立完成，進而委託上雲端等服務提供者協力完成。然而隨著資料或應用的授權，相關的計算安全性必須重新被探討。本課程將會從資料的隱密性出發，探討如何使用同態加密法輕鬆完成一個安全的授權計算，進而利用其他輕量化元件(混淆電路、私密分享)來取代同態加密並重新設計授權計算協定。接著會轉往定義資料的隱私性，並介紹k匿名等去識別化技術，最終帶入現今最嚴謹的差分隱私。透過上述之保有隱私與安全方法，將著名的人工智慧與機器學習演算法導入授權計算之中，重構不同情境的新型態安全計算框架。
description.en: The implementation of computation has been completed independently from the local machine, and then outsourced to the cloud (or some service providers) to complete it. However, with the delegation of data or applications, accordingly the security of such computation must be revisited. This course will start from the data confidentiality, discuss how to use homomorphic encryption to easily complete a secure outsourced computation, and then use other lightweight components (garbled circuit, secret sharing) to replace homomorphic encryption and redesign the secure protocols. Then it will move to define the privacy of data, introduce de-identification techniques such as k-anonymity, and finally bring the most rigorous notion of differential privacy. Through the above-mentioned methods of preserving privacy and security, artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms are introduced into the outsourced computation to reconstruct a new type of the framework for different scenarios.

name.zh: 資料科學原理與教育數據應用
name.en: Data Science Principles with Applications on Educational Data

description.zh: 資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
description.en: Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce the valuable knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The topics include data processing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. The course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with fundamental related knowledge and the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation-collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The course training is toward equipping students with the mindset and the ability to solve problems with the learned techniques on educational data. In addition, students need to practice the presentation for the findings of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually.

資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce or create the valuable information and knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The related topics include data processing and computing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. This course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with the fundamental related knowledge as well as the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation- collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The training of this course is toward equipping students with the general mindset and the ability to solve problems practically with the learned techniques on educational data with project groups. In addition, the students also need to practice the presentation for the findings and results of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually. The major objective of this course is to cultivate talents in data science.

description.zh:
安全程式設計是資訊安全領域中的關鍵技術。不良的「程式設計習慣」和「不考慮安全保護的程式設計」很容易導致可有心人士所利用。
本課程除了建立安全程式設計的基礎知識外，特別著重於同學的實務能力、漏洞測試、與安全程式開發能力。同時，透過分享最新的論文研究與相關技術報告，協助研究生在研究階段獲取最新的領域知識。
description.en:
Security programming is a key technology in the field of information security. “Bad programming habits” and “programming without security consideration” can easily lead to the use of malicious people. Four major themes will be explored.
In addition to establishing the basic knowledge of security programming, this course focuses on student's practical ability, vulnerability testing, and security programming development ability. At the same time, by sharing novel research papers and related technical reports, the students can obtain the newest and complete domain knowledge in their research stage.

description.zh: 能源在日常生活中以很多型態呈現，大量的能源使用於汽車動力、食物與用水加熱、產品製造、發電及其他不同事務。使用傳統能源會排放空氣污染物，因而引起鄰近地區、區域、跨國境空氣污染問題，甚至是全球的環境衝擊效應。本課程將檢視能源使用現況及其衍生的環境議題，並且探討能源使用之趨勢。傳統能源(如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等)、及再生能源(如太陽能、水力、風能、地熱能等)及能源效率等內容，都將於課程中介紹

description.zh:
氣候變遷儼然已為全球邁入21世紀所面對最嚴峻國際環保課題，對非聯合國氣候變化綱要公約締約國及屬於外銷型新興工業國家的台灣，正處在發展轉捩點上，為維持國家競爭力，國內應擬訂更積極之節能減碳政策，並著手研擬調適衝擊方案，同時加強與國際間合作，進行減碳政策、技術與經驗交流，以推動碳市場之國際接軌，並確保環境、經濟、社會之永續發展。
本課程將介紹溫室氣體與氣候變遷之關連性、國際溫室氣體管制相關公約、我國溫室氣體管理現況、溫室氣體減量政策與經濟工具、及溫室氣體衝擊調適與節能新技術等，期藉由本課程使之瞭解全球暖化成因與後果與國內外溫室氣體管理現況與法規要求，以提升我國於氣候變遷因應之認知。
description.en: This class introduces scientific, economic, and ecological issues about the threat of global climate change, and the Policy Instruments of greenhouse gas management.  This course examines the interconnections of international politics and climate change.  It includes Green House Gas inventory, carbon tax and emission trading, Voluntary approach and other greenhouse gas management policy tools.  It explores an integrated approach to analysis the benefits of greenhouse gas and air pollution reduction measures, and related model development.

description.en: The course of computerized motion control includes the following topics:  (1) Command generator design (2) Introduction of motion control plant and feedback system (3) Feedback control loop design (4) Feedforward control loop design (5) Observer design (6) Multi-axis contouring control (7) Case study: semiconductor/LCD equipment。 The student will understand how to develop a PC_based motion control system by this course.

This course is a graduate-level introductory course to the fundamentals of computerized motion control. The topics of this course include: (1) command generation, (2) devices of motion control , (3) feedback control, (4) feedforward control, (5) observer design, (6) multi-axis control, (7) case study. Students can understand the techniques used in the field of computerized motion control. In addition, students will be using the above techniques to implement a real motion control system.

description.zh: 本課程將會介紹「非限制最佳化問題、線性規劃、非線性限制最佳化問題」。這些問題將會由數學推導與MATLAB模擬得到解決。對於解決非限制最佳化問題，一維搜尋法、梯度法、牛頓共軛方向法、擬牛頓法會將在本課程介紹及使用；線性規劃問題會利用單形法來解決；拉格朗日及KKT乘數則用來解決非線性限制最佳化問題。
description.en: Course Description：In this course, unconstrained optimization problems, linear programming, and nonlinear constrained optimization problems are presented. Mathematical derivations and MATLAB simulations are used to analyze and obtain the solutions to these problems.  For unconstrained optimization problems, one-dimensional search, gradient, Newton's, conjugate direction, quasi-Newton methods are presented. For linear programming problems, simplex method is introduced. Last, Lagrange and Karush-Kuhn-Tucker multipliers are presented for solving nonlinear constrained optimization problems.

syllabi.outline: This semester's Deep Learning (DL) course will focus on Machine Learning (ML), DL, and Generative AI in data science analytics. We will look at supervised, unsupervised and structured learning methods, which will include classic Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) as a shallow or Deep Neural Network (DNN), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), k-Means clustering, and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). This course is designed for graduate students who are interested in AI and its applications in data science analytics. Students who take this course should have mathematical maturity of undergraduate curricula in science and engineering, including Calculus, Discrete Mathematics, Linear Algebra and programming language such as C/C++/MATLAB/Python. Teaching approaches conducted in this course emphasize analysis, modeling and design principles of AI methodology. Case studies, engineering applications of AI in data science analytics, will also be covered in this course. Collaboration Policy: You are free to form study groups and discuss programming assignments and projects. However, you must write up assignments and code independently, and you must acknowledge in your submission all the students you discussed with.

description.zh:
繞射光學元件是基於光波繞射的原理，以VLSI技術為加工方法，研究如何利用繞射現象設計光學元件來實現各種光學功能。繞射光學元件可以應用在改良光學系統的像差，為特定的波長實現聚光、分光等功能以取代傳統的光學透鏡、分光鏡等，此外利用傅光原理製作出傳統的光學元件無法實現的功能，在近代的光學系統、尤其是微光學系統佔有極重要的地位。本課程中，我們將討論其基本原理、設計方法、以及應用。主要課程內容為：
(1)光學繞射原理(2)傅式光學概論(3)繞射光學元件介紹(4)性能分析方法(5)繞射光學元件之設計方法(6)繞射光學元件之應用(7)繞射光學元件之製作
description.en:
Diffractive optical element (DOE) is based on optical wavefront diffraction on a phase profile that is commonly generated by VLSI techniques. DOE's can be applied on conventional optical systems as well as advanced opto-electronic systems. In this course, we will discuss in detail the basic pricioples, design methods, and others about DOE's. The following topics will be introduced:
(1)Introduction to Diffraction theory
(2)Overview of Fourier optics
(3)Diffractive optical elements (DOE's)
(4)Performance evaluation of DOE's
(5)Design methods for DOE's
(6)Applications of DOE's
(7)Fabrication tecjniqies of DOE's

syllabi.outline:
This course is designed to introduce the principle of diffraction of optical wave and study the means of using the diffraction to perform optical setups in modern optical systems. Diffractive optical element (DOE) can be applied to correct aberrations, light focusing, light splitting, and other novel functions that traditional optical components difficultly or impossibly perform. DOE plays an important role in modern optical technology. The content of this course includes: 
1. Principle of optical diffraction, 
2. Fourier optics, 
3. Design methods of DOE, 
4. Applications of DOEs, and 
5. Implementation of DOEs.

繞射光學是基於光波繞射的原理，研究如何利用繞射現象設計光學元件來實現各種光學功能。繞射光學元件可以應用在改良光學系統的像差，為特定的波長實現聚光、分光等功能以取代傳統的光學透鏡、分光鏡等，此外利用傅光原理製作出傳統的光學元件無法實現的功能，在近代的光學系統、此類的微光學系統佔有極重要的地位。本課程中，我們將討論其基本原理、設計方法、以及應用。主要課程內容為：
1.光學繞射原理
2.傅式光學
3.繞射光學元件之設計方法
4.繞射光學元件之應用
5.繞射光學元件之實現與製作

description.zh:
精準醫療(Precision Medicine)又稱為個人化醫療，該詞最早於2011年由美國國家研究委員會所提出，意指除了藉由傳統診斷方法如病患症狀描述及常規生化、影像檢查之外，加上新式生物醫學檢測如基因檢測等，並整合個人資料，如性別、身高、體重、種族、基因特異性、過去病史、家族病史等完整綜合信息，透過人體基因資料庫進行比對及分析，進而藉以選出最適合病患的治療方法及藥物治 療，如細胞治療、基因治療和標靶治療等。精準醫療最終的目的是希望透過個體差異性的深入診斷，來找出治療效果最大化及副作用最小化的最佳個人化醫療方案。2015年美國前總統歐巴馬在國情咨文演講中提出「精準醫學計畫(Precision Medicine Initiative)」， 率先投入二億美元以建立百萬人次的醫療記錄、基因、生活習慣等數據資料庫，並找尋誘發癌症的基因及相應新藥開發，訂定相關法規並 研究如何保護隱私與個資安全。此後各國無不競相投入精準醫療之發展，精準醫療也是當前台灣生技重點產業之一。

description.en: Precision Medicine is also known as Personalized Medicine. This term was first proposed by the National Research Council in November 2011. In addition to traditional diagnostic methods such as patient symptoms and imaging examinations, it also integrates with new biomedical tests such as genetic testing and comprehensive personal information like gender, height, weight, race, gene specificity, past medical history, family medical history, etc. The genetic and personal information is analyzed through searching known human gene database and used to select the most suitable treatments and medicines for patients, for example, cell therapy, gene therapy, and targeted therapy. The ultimate goal of precision medicine is to find out a personalized medical plan with maximum therapeutic benefits and minimum side effects through in-depth diagnosis of individual differences. description.en: This course aims to educate students in Information Technology English and prepare students for their career advancement. This course focuses on IT science and technology English reading, listening, speaking, writing, comprehension, grammar rules, vocabulary, pronunciation, conversation, communication, and professional presentation skills. This course also covers soft skills such as interview tips, communication, business etiquette, travel English, email English, decision making, understanding international business, global working environment, project management planning and execution. In addition, this course offers personal development for students to discover their personal advantage and perform their career planning for achieving career goals.

description.zh: 介紹化工廠廢棄物對安全、健康、環境之影嚮及化工產品之生命週期評估。舊程序之製程改善及建立完整的廢棄物管理體系，以達廢棄物最少化之目的，新程序之設計則對反應器、分離程序、熱交換器之程序整合及公用設施等，實施源頭減廢及回收，以達潔淨生產之目的。
description.en:
Introduction to the safety, health and environmental impact of wastes of chemical process industries and life cycle assessment of chemical engineering products. Waste minimization of existing process through changes in industrial process and setup of waste management hiarachy. 
For the new process, focus are on the source reduction and recycle of reactors, separators, heat exchange networks and utilities, etc.

name.zh: 光電化學與太陽能電池

description.zh: 光電化學即利用太陽光能源或其他光源驅使一個完整的電化學氧化還原反應，並充分使用光電催化反應後產生的電子轉換為電力，即為太陽能電池，其中有機材料、無機材料與電解質為太陽光電池反應時主要的影響因素。本課程將會介紹光電化學原理與測定, 光電催化, 光電化學能轉移及儲存,不同材料發展出不同型態的太陽能電池，進而介紹光電化學如何應用於染料敏化太陽能電池。
description.en: The concept of photoelectrochemistry is to utilize the solar energy and other light sources to drive a complete electrochemical oxidation-reduction reaction where the photocatalytic electron reaction has been converted into electrical energy. Photovoltaic cells which also known as solar cells composed of organic and inorganic materials and electrolytes are the great example for the photoelectrochemical reactions. Here the proposed course is constructed to introduce and implement the basic photoelectrochemical principles, measurements, photoelectrocatalysis, photoelectrical charge transfer and the storage of chemical energy. Further the remaining section of this course will be focused on the detailed studies about the development of different inorganic, organic materials for the fabrication of dye-sensitized solar cells.

ntroduction to Advanced Materials :including composite materials
The study of advanced materials encompasses fundamental knowledge such as material properties and processes, composite structures and microstructures, and mechanical properties. It includes an introduction to various composite materials like carbon fiber-reinforced composites, metal composites, and others, focusing on their principles and applications in cutting-edge technology fields. Composite materials can be categorized into polymer-based, metal-based, ceramic-based, and fiber composites, with fiber composites utilizing reinforcement components such as glass fibers, boron fibers, carbon fibers, organic fibers, ceramic fibers, and metal fibers, depending on requirements for strength, toughness, and cost. Key discussion topics cover manufacturing methods, interfacial structures, mechanical properties, applications, micromechanics, macromechanics, strength, fracture, fatigue, and design aspects.

description.zh:
本課程之目的在於介紹一些廣泛、基本及實際的微電子材料（其中最主要者為積體電路之材料）。首先說明製造方法上之三個主要部分：擴散（diffusion）、平版照相術（lithography）及薄膜沉積（thin-film deposition）然後再介紹這些方法如何應用在各種元件所需之物理特性及元件設計有關之訊息後者則需要了解各種製造策略之目的及限制時再隨時給予介紹。
1 .半導體物理特性基本概念，2.半導體製程初論，3 .薄膜製程原理，4 .擴散原理，5 .黃光製 程原理，6 .蝕刻製程原理，7 .晶片封裝，8 積體電路製程整合。

description.zh: 本課程目的在了解「為何」與「如何」以電腦模擬方式進行材料科學研究。課程內容提及量子化學、固態物理與密度泛函理論(DFT)。而後將實際演練基本的材料模擬計算，內容包括結構最佳化、電子性質、光學性質、機械性質等，並將透過Python進行資料處理。學生可透過此課程學到材料模擬的基本原理、工作流程與實際操作，得以以理論觀點/微觀尺度評估材料議題。
description.en: The main purpose of the course is to understand “why to do” and “how to do” researches in materials science by using computer simulations. The background theory of quantum chemistry, solid-state physics and density functional theory (DFT) will be briefly introduced. The common tasks of materials simulations, including structural optimizations, electronic properties, optical properties, mechanical properties, etc., will be then demonstrated and employed. Basic commands of Python will also be introduced in doing data processing for analyses. Students will learn about basic principles, workflows and practices of materials simulations, being capable to evaluate materials’ issues from theoretical and microscopic viewpoints.

description.zh: 此課程將介紹各種近代材料分析技術，特別著重於表面分析上。修課後，學生將了解各種技術的基本原理並可選擇適當的方法去作樣品影像表面以及材料分析，同時可比較各方法優缺以及其限制。課程討論之技術主要基於樣品與光子或電子之間的交互作用。
description.en: The aim of the course is to introduce modern techniques for materials characterization, especially on surface characterization. After completing the course, the students would be able to understand and choose appropriate instrumentation for imaging and materials analysis by comparing the performance and limitation of different methods for a given situation. Techniques involved in photon and electron interactions with matter would be discussed in this course.

description.en: The objective of this class is to teach student how to design a process plant to conduct industrial waste recycling and reutilization.  The process unit selection and computer modeling and simulation will also be included in the design process.

syllabi.outline: 本課程先介紹建構循環經濟之資源再生管理策略與法令規範，進而介紹資源再生相關應用技術原理、產品品質規範與程序組合設計，並藉由資源再生實廠案例的介紹與研討，以期對資源再生之法令規範、技術原理、流程設備及整廠設計有完整的瞭解。

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

In the era of technological & social growth at an exponential speed, more than ever, business leaders across the globe are facing even more challenging issues, not just economic aspects but also legal and ethical aspects.  In this elite IMBA program of NTUT, this course is specifically designed for developing future leaders for corporations & organizations in various business domains.  
How to simultaneously achieve the corporate objectives and fulfill the ethical responsibilities without compromising fundamental principles and standards of conduct when facing dilemma is imperative for us to learn and ponder upon. 
With this vision and mission in mind, the lecturer is committed to inspire the students’ talent within as in all the other executive management programs.  
This IMBA course will equip all participating international students with multiple pillars of those grounds in being great leaders in the future, including building fundamental mindset and value system for managing challenging issues both economically and ethically, framework of strategic thinking and organizational structuring, and practical cross-cultural business cases and simulations. 
All IMBA students who participate in this course will be expected to be well-prepared with passionate learning attitude to JOIN proactively group discussions, cross-cultural idea brainstorming, business scenario simulation, deductive-and-inductive reasoning practice, individual and team projects, and business case studies. 
It Is My Since Wish and Mission to develop You, to become great leaders of the future for bettering our world humanity advancement!  This course is specifically designed to develop and enhance all the wonderful qualities essential for You.

description.en: This course deals with management accounting and control both within a micro-behavioural and within an organisational theory perspective. The aim is to provide an understanding of the developments in management accounting and control theory and practice and the implications of critical variables that affect the design, development and operation of management accounting and control systems. Practical aspects of management accounting are mainly examined through computer assisted learning (CAL). Students are expected to cover the prescribed reading on their own, and to perceive the taught seminars as the opportunity to ask questions and to offer their views at any time.

description.zh: 本課程的目的是幫助學生在 21 世紀準備行銷業務並為之做出貢獻。無論是打算在企業、政府還是非營利組織工作，有效營銷的概念、策略和技術都是相關的。本課程是：從基本概念到與營銷相關，再到營銷在組織中的策略運用；儘早關注營銷的全球性。強調消費者營銷和企業營銷之間的相同點和不同點。將需求預測與其市場區隔、目標定位和市場定位相結合，在接觸消費者和商業市場以及市場區格之後，涵蓋市場營銷研究。在學生掌握市場營銷的含義後，整合規劃、實施和評估以提供眾向的行銷策略。
description.en:
The purpose of this course is try to help students prepare to operate in and contribute to the 21st century. Regardless of whether a person intends to work in a business, for the government, or in a nonprofit organization, the concepts, strategies, and techniques of effective marketing are relevant. This course is:
Providing from fundamental concepts through the major tasks associated with marketing to the strategic role of marketing in an organization.
Bringing early attention to the global nature of marketing.
Emphasizing the similarities as well as the differences between consumer and business marketing.
Combining demand forecasting with its logical antecedents-segmentation, targeting, and position.
Covering marketing research, after students have been exposed to consumer and business markets and segmentation.
Integrating planning, implementation, and evaluation to provide a broad strategic context after students have a grasp of what marketing entails.

description.zh: 一個數據模式是可以用來解釋結構性資料在商業環境下所代表的意義，而數據模組的建立，則是現實世界知訊管理系統中的自然而然產生的普遍結果。上述共同構成了我們當今被稱為數據分析系統，此系統是一種管理工具，提供用於評估及製定決策。本課程旨在介紹基礎數據模組的工具和使用方法以及相關主題，並會包含與強調在商業上的應用，其重點在不確定性模組建立與評估，理解決策的本質，有效利用數據和有限的信息來模擬複雜系統以及優化分配資源。
description.en: A data model describes how structured data is represented in a business environment. Data modeling is a natural consequence of the prevalence of management information systems in the real world. Together they form what in our days has become known as a Data Analytics system that provides management tools to evaluate performance and make decisions. The course aims to introduce the fundamentals of data models tools and methods and related topics. Business applications of the topics covered will be highlighted. The emphasis will be on modeling and evaluating uncertainty, understanding the nature of decision-making, using data and limited information efficiently simulating complex systems, and optimally allocating resources.

syllabi.outline: This course is an introduction to statistical computing and will be taught in Python. Python is widely used not only in the engineering but also in natural science, medicine, biology, physics, and business. This course will introduce you to a vibrant and growing community of open source data analysts that is pushing the state of the art in data analysis and presentation. (Another benefit to you as students is that open source software is free!) This course’s main objective is to: learn how to take raw data, explore it, and present the results in a useful way. Thus, in this course, you will learn all of the basic skills needed to do each of these steps with the statistical language Python.

description.en: Primary contents of this course are focused on case analyses, and its teaching method is trademark legal theories analyses in order to further introduce significant disputes about Taiwan trademark practices. Thus, students could understand how to concretely apply laws, precedents, or theories to judicial practices. In addition, this course will also introduce relevant foreign theories and well-known judicial cases to develop students’ abilities of examining and analyzing domestic/foreign trademark cases when students take this course.

syllabi.outline:
商標法係為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展所制定之法律。商標得以文字、圖形、記號、顏色、聲音、 立體形狀或其聯合式所組成，並應足以使商品或服務之相關消費者認識其為表彰商品或服務之標識，藉以與他人之商品或服務相區別。凡因表 彰自己之商品或服務，欲取得商標權者，應依該法申請註冊。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於商標法的瞭解。事實上，本課程之進行，30%以英文講授、70%以中文講授，而且課堂教材以中文為主。
Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and consumers' interest, maintain fair competitions of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce. A trademark may be composed of a word, design, symbol, color, sound, three-dimensional shape or a combination thereof. A trademark as defined above shall be distinctive enough for relevant consumers of the goods or services to recognize it as identification to those goods or services and to differentiate such goods or services from those offered by others. A person who wishes to obtain trademark rights in order to distinguish its goods or services shall apply for trademark registration as provided under this Act. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples to enhance a deeper understanding of Trademark Act for the students. In fact, the class lectures will be in English 30% and in Chinese 70%, and the class materials are in Chinese.

syllabi.outline: Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and consumers' interest, maintain fair competitions of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce. A trademark may be composed of a word, design, symbol, color, sound, three-dimensional shape or a combination thereof. A trademark as defined above shall be distinctive enough for relevant consumers of the goods or services to recognize it as identification to those goods or services and to differentiate such goods or services from those offered by others. A person who wishes to obtain trademark rights in order to distinguish its goods or services shall apply for trademark registration as provided under this Act. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples to enhance a deeper understanding of Trademark Act for the students.

description.en:
This is a research-based course. The course covers international IP treaties, IP-related provisions in some free trade agreements, and judicial decisions related to those international IP treaties. Eight research topics will be assigned to the participating students. The research-based course includes:
--Module One: International law 101
--Module Two: IP treaties; IP provisions in FTAs
--Module Three: Case law
--Module Four: In-depth studies
請參閱英文說明。

syllabi.outline:
本課程最主要之目的，乃是讓修課之學生瞭解國際智財權重要的組織與條約文件，藉由課程之教授，使得學生能夠確實掌握這些基本之概念與議題。透過本課程之教授不僅使學生瞭解國際智財法之最新發展趨勢外，更從國際智財法與我國智財法之比較及鑑鏡，來瞭解未來現行法所需修改之方向。其實，本課程之進行，30%以英文講授、70%以中文講授，而且課堂教材以中文為主。
Main proposes of this course are to let enrolled students understand international intellectual property organizations and treaties and make them understand these basic concepts and issues. Students will know new trends of international intellectual property law through teaching of this course and understand amendments of future Taiwan intellectual property legislation compared with international intellectual property laws and Taiwan intellectual property laws. In fact, the class lectures will be in English 30% and in Chinese 70%, and the class materials are in Chinese.

description.zh: 本課程下學期亦以智慧財產局頒布之「專利審查基準」為藍本，先介紹專利申請之特殊分割程序與改請程序，再就專利申請之「實體審查」部分依序說明先申請原則、發明單一性、優先權、說明書及圖式之補充與修正、更正、以及分割改請。
description.en: This course will be based on the "Patent Examination Guidelines" issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office, and introduces the special procedure for patent division application and patent conversion application according to the principle of "formality before substantive examination". Then, in the "substantive examination" section, topics such as the first-to-file rule, unity of invention, the priority of a patent application, amendments of description, claims and drawings,  division of a patent and conversion of a patent will be sequentially discussed.

name.en: Practice of Electrical Engineering Technology Patent Application

description.zh: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，準備實際電機技術(元件、電路、方法)之專利申請案，讓同學模擬實際申請專利的過程，首先是進行專利檢索與分析，討論專利佈局的策略；接著讓同學進行專利說明書(含申請專利範圍)撰寫實習，模擬實際上申請各國專利之程序，然後討論之後專利答辯、領證繳費及後續維護事宜。
description.en: In this course, we will focus on the practices of the patent application in   electrical engineering technology. Students will learn how to do patent search and analysis, write specification/drawings/claims, and reply office action responses. In addition, the practical aspects of international patent application are presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies will be also discussed in class.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，以實際電子電機產品或相關技術，讓同學以產業發展觀點模擬實際申請專利的過程，課程內容包含相關電機相關產品與技術服務發展需考量的相關法規、專利檢索、分析及佈局策略、專利說明書撰寫實習、專利申請程序探討、專利答辯、領證繳費及維護事宜。

name.zh: 創新、競爭與公平交易法
name.en: Innovation, Competition and Fair Trade Act

description.zh: 公平交易法是經濟憲法，也是維持市場交易秩序的根本大法。當現代企業與市場的結構愈趨複雜，公平交易法的角色也愈顯重要。本課程將以案例分析，帶領學生了解公平交易法的基本原則。最後，本課程將規劃呈現科技發展下的新興議題，特別偏重科技產業的創新與競爭、數位經濟所帶來的新挑戰，帶領學生一起探討。
description.en: The Fair Trade Act is often considered as the economic constitution also a set of fundamental rules to maintain the order of market. This Act is getting more and more important in the modern economy while the market is getting more and more chaotic and complicated due to the technology advancement. This course is designed for students who intend to understand the principles of the Fair Trade Act both in books and in action, and who are interested to learn about the interplay of innovation and competition with particular emphasis on technology industries and digital economy.

syllabi.outline:
公平交易法是經濟憲法，也是維持市場交易秩序的根本大法。當現代企業與市場的結構愈趨複雜，公平交易法的角色也愈顯重要。本課程將以案例分析，帶領學生了解公平交易法的基本原則。最後，本課程將規劃呈現不正競爭部分及科技發展下的新興議題。
The Fair Trade Act is often considered as the economic constitution also a set of fundamental rules to maintain the order of market. This Act is getting more and more important in the modern economy while the market is getting more and more chaotic and complicated due to the technology advancement. This course is designed for students who intend to understand the principles of the Fair Trade Act both in books and in action, and who are interested to learn about the interplay of innovation and competition with particular emphasis on technology industries and digital economy.

name.en: The Theory and Practice of the Mind

description.zh: 「心靈的理論與實踐」(The Theory and Practice of the Mind)旨在對人的心理各個層面，從不同的角度進行探討。課程將以理論講授與實際操作交替進行:我們將借重當代學術研究成果，如腦神經科學、心理學、哲學、神經生物學、社會學等等，以增進我們對人自身重要議題的認識。這些議題至少包括:心靈(Mind)、心流(Mental Flow)、情緒(Emotion)、選擇(Choice)、決定(Decision)、感官(Sensations)、直覺(Intuition)、自我分析( Self-Analysis)、單純性(Simplicity)、潛意識(Subconscious)、創新(Novelty)、洞察力(Insight)與意志力 (Willpower)等等。若時間允許，我們將在課上播放相關的科學影片與電影。
description.en: The course investigates several key aspects of human mind from different angles.  To achieve the goal, we shall discuss current topics and issues on the following subjects: Neuroscience, Psychology, Philosophy, Neurobiology, Sociology, etc.  The lecturing shall proceed from reading texts to practicing subjects and methods.  And the topics and issues will include at least: Mind, Mental flow, Emotion, Choice, Decision, Sensations, Intuition, Self-Analysis, Simplicity, Subconscious, Novelty, Insight, and Willpower, etc.  We may watch some relevant scientific films and movies in the class if time allows.

description.zh: 本課程探究文化保存的各項議題，包含有形無形文化保存的真實性、文化價值的差異與認定、詮釋與再現；同時透過國內外文化保存的實踐案例的分析與討論，思考未來文化保存的多元發展可能性。
description.en: This course aims to understand the concept of cultural preservation, and the methods of doing cultural preservation by examining different case studies in the world. Different issues related to cultural preservation are also discussed in this course, include the value and authenticity of cultural heritage, the representation and interpretation of culture, and reuse and management of cultural spaces. A creative practice of cultural preservation will be conducted in this course.

name.en: Theory and Praxis in Moving Images

description.zh: 本課程是動態影像的進階課程，不以歷史性發展為課程目的，旨在探究各類影像涉及的感官經驗以及所屬的文化意義，包含藝術電影、紀錄片、實驗電影與數位影像等，進而說明以動態經驗為基礎的混合現象，其涉及的美學、文化、技術與當代性。閱讀文本涵蓋電影、媒體與視覺文化評論。
description.en: This advanced moving images course aims to exam sensory experiences and cultural significances of various cinematic forms from art cinema, documentaries, and experimental images to the digital turn of VR films and beyond. However, the goal of the course is not to be a historical survey but instead an investigation of this hybrid moment and its relationship to aesthetics, culture, technology, and modernity. Readings cover topics in film theory, media theory, and visual cultural critical theory.

name.en: Paper’s Fiber Culture and Its Application

description.zh: 透過認識紙質、纖維實驗與材質研發的單元設計貫穿、活化課程，也由此串聯課程理念。達到培育美學素養、認識材質特性、應用紙藝與纖維文化。學生可透過選修這門課，養成美學素養、材質特色認識、紙藝與纖維文化應用。課程為理論與實務之結合，包含 : 1. 文化藝術與自然科學知識之傳授。2. 創意設計實作。後者(2)可做為檢視學生對前者(1)的學習與吸收狀況。作業訓練達到二項目標 : 1. 加強產學合作，強化實務教學。2. 培育紙質與纖維創意設計人才。
description.en: With the help of curricular components of paper qualities, fiber experiments as well as R&D on raw materials, the course essentials can thus be unified and the theme vitalized. WE aim to provide the course with aesthetical principles, knowledge of the raw materials, applied paper craftsmanship and fiber civilization—which will be comprehensively instilled into the course so that the students who take the course will be equipped with a good command on them. The course is made up of both aesthetical theory and practice, including a) knowledge on culture, arts and natural science and b) innovative & creative practice, with the later utilized as criteria to evaluate to what extent the students are successfully trained. The assigned homework is set so as to: 1. Enforce cooperation between industry and academics and strengthen course materials into practice; 2. Train and discipline more design talents in paper qualities and innovation in fiber.

syllabi.outline:
為了讓技職教育回歸「務實致用」的根本，導入產業能量，強化產學合作與實務教學，提高實作與實驗課程，加強基礎學科能力與人文素養。「紙質文化與應用課群」以「紙質文化」為主軸，分支三項課程核心理念，整合產業資源與專業師資，共同規劃課程內容，培育紙質專才。

  本課程的核心理念為「材質特性」，以加強技職生，尤其是設計學院和人文社會學院修課學生之基礎學科能力，奠定技職學生專業能力為要點。並由纖維、紙漿與化學變化為始，探討造紙原料的差異，進而分辨紙質種類的差異與特性，再讓學生創意發想，設計紙質特性實驗。課程邀請臺灣植物纖維專家、化學專家、紙漿研發專家、故宮博物院紙質修復師和紙質研究專家、纖維工藝與長春棉紙廠等業界權威共同授課，以多方專業聚焦紙質與纖維的基礎學科能力，最終透過實作，讓學生以材質知識為基底，體驗纖維與紙藝的無限可能。

本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。

description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to introduce the concept of corporate ethics and its differences from general ethics, as well as to explore ethical issues and cases related to Taiwan and the international community in depth. Through discussions and interactive exchanges, students will develop moral judgment skills and an international perspective to address the challenges faced by corporate ethics.
1. Introduction
Understand the basic concepts of ethics, morality, corporate ethics, and general ethics.
Explore the importance of corporate ethics in modern society.
2. Ethics Education and Moral Development
Investigate the implementation of corporate ethics education and the process of moral development.
Discuss related issues such as campus ethics education, ethical awareness, decision-making, and judgment.
3. Ethical Judgment and Teaching Practices
Explore teaching methods and practices for ethical judgment.
Analyze related issues such as administrative ethics, non-governmental ethics, and workplace ethics.
4. Corporate Social Responsibility and Environmental Protection
Understand the concept and practice of corporate social responsibility.
Explore the ethical issues of environmental protection and the importance of corporate citizenship responsibilities.
5. Ethical Challenges for Multinational Corporations
Analyze the ethical issues and challenges faced by multinational corporations.
Discuss related topics such as sustainable development and socially responsible investing.
The course structure corresponds to the chapters outlined in the syllabus, with relevant ethical cases and discussion questions arranged in each chapter to promote student learning and critical thinking. Additionally, the course concludes with multiple-choice questions and discussion topics for students to conduct self-assessments and engage in Q&A sessions to reinforce their knowledge.

description.zh:
本課程將由個人資料保護原則開始對個人資料保護作全面性的介紹，並說明《個人資料保護法》與《個人資料保護法施行細則》如何與個資保護原則互相呼應，期使學生瞭解目前個人資料保護的管理議題與實務考量，並且說明可參考的標準與指引，以強化學生對於個人資料保護的基礎概念。
藉由《個人資料保護法》及《個人資料保護法施行細則》的介紹帶入ISO/IEC 29100的個資保護框架、隱私衝擊評鑑(PIA)，接下介紹ISO/IEC 27701個資保護實作指引等相關國際標準，本課程以實際的案例以及國際標準讓學生這對於個人資料保護有更進一步的概念與瞭解。
description.en: This course will begin with a comprehensive introduction to personal data protection principles and explain in detail the "Personal Data Protection Act" and the "Enforcement Rules of the Personal Data Protection Act". Student will learn managerial and practical considerations of personal data protection. Relevant standards and guidelines, such as ISO/IEC 29100, ISO/IEC 27701, will be discussed to strengthen students' understanding of fundamental concepts of personal information management systems (PIMS). In addition, the process of a privacy impact assessment (PIA) and its related standard ISO/IEC 29134 will also be introduced in this course. All in all, this course aims to give students a solid understanding of personal data protection through cases studies and international standards.

description.zh: 本課程介紹資金管理的理論與實務應用。如何判斷一個交易系統好壞，使其不斷產生利潤? 我們將從理論出發，套用在實務交易模擬上，包含單一策略、多商品、多市場、多策略的運用。本課程將以R語言搭配模擬。
description.en: This course introduces the theory and practice of money management. How to determine a trading system is good or bad, how to continues to generate profits in a trading system? We will start from the theory, applied to the simulation of real trading market, including single strategy, multi-commodities, multi-markets, multi-strategies. This course will be run with R language.

This course is divided into two semesters. It introduces how to use financial operations to define and describe clearly the algorithm, and then uses R language to execute. Contents include: Introduction to program trading, trading strategy development, back-testing, and fund management.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於從科學哲學層次、研究方法層次、與實際操作層次探討設計研究的本質，內容包括界定設計研究問題、選用適當的量化或質性研究方法與特定工具、研究結果詮釋、案例解析、以及論文寫作等，俾使同學具備研究之基礎觀念以及進行創作或論文寫作之能力。研究方法二強調質性研究，例如：以深度訪談以及參與式觀察法探究互動行為脈絡，課程內容包含質性研究導論、質性研究過程與步驟、質性研究設計、質性研究方法、譯碼的程序、質性資料蒐集與分析、質性研究報告撰寫、質性研究在創新設計研究上的應用。教學以課堂講授與論文研討與發表為主要方式，並以隨堂測驗、報告與分組討論與發表為評量依據。
description.en:
The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at the three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and practical execution. The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis.
This course provides graduate students with the ability of fundamental concept and design creation or research thesis. These research methods two focus on qualitative research with the exploration of in-depth interview and participant observation. The details of content includes introduction, research process and approaches, research design, research methods, coding scheme, data collection and analysis, writing up and implication of innovation and design. The teaching methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discuss

name.en: Special Topics on Interactive Media Design (II)

description.zh: 本課程為一延續性的專題研究，其目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: This special topic is a continuous course within two semesters. This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, interactive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and practice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct a multi-disciplines learning environment which performs a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate a interactive media design project. name.zh: 使用者經驗設計與評量

description.zh: 本課程將包含使用者經驗設計的基礎，以及使用者研究量測的內涵及方法。本課程中，將透過課堂上課、討論、以及實習的方式，介紹使用者研究的實際案例、評估模式、團隊合作方法、設計與評估工具、實踐思維、挑戰、以及實際執行的程序。預期學生將於本課程中，透過分組獲得使用者經驗在互動設計、空間設計以及產品設計上，有關使用者研究的設計、評估、施行、以及質化與量化分析量測評估的知識與方法。
description.en: This course will cover the fundamentals of user experience design and provide the students with insights into the measurement of user research. The real-life processes, challenges, considerations, tools, team works, models and case studies of user research are introduced in this course by lecturing, discussing and practicing methods. Students are expecting to learn user experience principles, to designing, evaluating, implementing and measuring user experience in both qualitative and quantitative methods in the aspect of interaction design, space design and product design individually.

syllabi.outline:
As the internet has grown and become pervasive in our lives, the world has gotten smaller. More and more, as consumers, we can share our experiences. For a company, great experiences can be a competitive advantage. They can keep your customers loyal and turn them into your biggest cheerleaders. On the flip side, terrible experiences can stop you in your tracks very quickly. No one wants to be that company being talked about for all the wrong reasons. Building great user experiences requires listening and empathy. In this course, you’ll learn the tools and techniques to make your design/products delightful for users.
This course is an introduction to User Experience with a focus on Space, Product, and Interaction Design. Students create a complete UX brief, from ideation to annotated wireframes that could be handed off to a developer to be built. They will also learn to conduct the research necessary and create all the supporting documentation required to defend their design decisions. There is a large focus on how to dissect and analyze common design patterns.
This class is an interdisciplinary integration course. The majority of students are design college students looking to transition their skills into digital, or product managers looking to improve their design skills. Other students often include engineers who want to learn how to make their design/products more usable and entrepreneurs looking to build out the user experience for their idea.
Overall, this course will cover the fundamentals of user experience design and provide the students with insights into the measurement of user research. The real-life processes, challenges, considerations, tools, team works, models, and case studies of user research are introduced in this course by lecturing, discussing, and practicing methods. Students are expecting to learn user experience principles, to designing, evaluating, implementing, and measuring user experience in both qualitative and quantitative methods in the aspect of interaction design, space design, and product design individually
本課程主要將由設計學院互動設計王聖銘老師授課，並將邀請國內使用者經驗研究與服務設計的研究學者與業界專家，透過專題演講的方式協同授課。王聖銘老師兼具建築與城鄉規劃、互動技術及資訊科學跨領域的背景，目前研究的主軸為人機互動、服務設計以及使用者經驗科學性驗證。課程中將包含使用者經驗設計的基礎，以及使用者研究量測的內涵及方法。本課程中，將透過課堂上課、討論、以及實習的方式，介紹使用者研究的實際案例、評估模式、團隊合作方法、設計與評估工具、實踐思維、挑戰、以及實際執行的程序。預期學生將於本課程中，透過分組獲得使用者經驗在互動設計、空間設計以及產品設計上，有關使用者研究的設計、評估、施行、以及質化與量化分析量測評估的知識與方法。本課程也將協助修課之博碩士班學生，組織、整理並撰寫可投稿研討會或期刊之論文。
syllabi.schedule:
Unit 1: Principles and Process（第一單元：原理與步驟）
Introduction to UX（使用者經驗概論）
	Describe the field of UX and how it relates to other disciplines
	Outline the stages in the UX process
	Identify the structure and purpose of various design deliverables
User Research and Personas（使用者研究與人物誌整理）
	Write a questionnaire
	Interview users in context
	Identify User Centered Design techniques
	Create effective personas to define the users one is trying to reach
UX Analysis（使用者經驗分析）
	Ask questions that discover key business needs
	Describe the benefits to an MVP approach
	Given a goal, identify the tasks for a user to complete that goal and draw the user flow
	Given a problem and a determined feature set, use a competitive audit to determine if there are different ways to implement the feature
	Prioritize features based on essentialness and level of effort
Unit 2: UX Toolkit and Measurement（第二單元：使用者經驗分析與量測工具）
Creating Wireframes and Prototypes（架構與雛型的建構）
	Identify and describe tools for wireframing, prototyping, advanced drawing, and creating clickable drawings
	Create wireframes, clickable drawings, and prototypes
Usability Principles and Testing（易用性評估原理與測試）
	Evaluate user experience of given websites and products, using Jakob Nielsen's 5 Principles of Usability（易用性的五大原則）
	Define each type of usability test and determine when to use each
	Run a usability test using best practices
User Experience Measurement（使用者經驗量測）
	Measuring user experience by participant observation
	Eye tracking basic, applications and implementation on user experience analysis
	Using Electroencephalography (EEG) in a usability test of a survey
	Scientific data analysis and big data analysis
Unit 3: Practices for Design Patterns（第三單元：設計實務）註：依修課學生之研究領域選擇
Interaction Design in Spatial Planning（空間規劃之互動設計）
Product Service System User Survey（產品設計系統使用者調查）
Service Design of Interaction Technology（互動技術之服務設計）
Social Network Experiences Design and Evaluation（社群網絡之經驗設計與評估）

description.en: This course mainly introduces sound design and electronic music production tools and skills. Through the introduction of audio editing technology and the use of related sound design tools, students can learn creative sound design. In the course, students are taught to use the Ableton Live sequencer software, combined with its sound design tools in Max for Live, to design their own software synthesizers and digital effects to be used in the sequencer. These skills may be used in multimedia design, game audio, new media performances, and etc.

syllabi.outline:
This course mainly introduces sound design and electronic music production tools and skills. Through the introduction of audio editing technology and the use of related sound design tools, students can learn creative sound design. In the course, students are taught to use the Ableton Live sequencer software, combined with its sound design tools in Max for Live, to design their own software synthesizers and digital effects to be used in the sequencer. These skills may be used in multimedia design, game audio, new media performances, and etc. In addition, this course will also cover the concept and technology of "adaptive music", integrating the middleware FMOD into the game engine Unity to establish a prototype framework of adaptive music for interactive design.

本課程提供給對於電子音樂、聲音藝術、數位音樂、遊戲配樂、以及聲音相關研究等有興趣的學習者們一系列有效工具的介紹與實務練習，並為學習者建立數位音樂、遊戲配樂、聲音設計的基本概念。本課程透過介紹音訊編輯的技術、相關聲音設計工具的使用，學習創意的聲音設計與電子音樂製作。課程當中，除了聲音設計的工具介紹之外，並教導學生使用 Ableton Live 序列器軟體，搭配 Max for Live 的聲音設計工具，讓使用者可以在序列器中使用自己所設計的軟體合成器與數位位效果器，進而可延伸至多媒體、遊戲、新媒體展演等之音樂與音效應用。此外，本課程亦將結合「自適性音樂」的技術，透過中介軟體 FMOD 與遊戲引擎 Unity 進行結合，建立自適音樂的雛形架構，作為互動設計的音樂設計依據。

description.en: The main objective of the program is taking from the application and design perspective, cutting into the possibilities of the virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

syllabi.outline:
Virtual reality (VR) is a fusion of art and technology, widely applied across various fields, including transportation simulators (driver training), BIM-integrated applications (building maintenance training), immersive gaming (next-generation sports, rehabilitation), immersive storytelling (film, animation), factory simulation, museums, and product previews. This course on VR applications focuses on the impact of VR on future technology and daily life, while also exploring the interplay between immersion, imagination, interaction, and human cognitive perception. The course covers the concepts, principles, and implementation methods of VR/AR and interactive haptic technologies, including an introduction to computer vision techniques, to help students understand sensory perception and interaction mechanisms in virtual environments. To enhance practical VR applications, students will be guided in developing innovative and practical multimedia human-computer interaction systems, exploring and evaluating immersive interaction models. Through a combination of theoretical instruction and hands-on practice, this course aims to equip students with core VR/AR technologies, fostering innovation, cross-disciplinary integration, and creative applications, enabling them to contribute to the future development and advancement of immersive technology.

虛擬實境是一種藝術與科技的整合，廣泛運用在不同屬性的領域，如交通模擬器(司機員訓練)、BIM整合應用(建築養護訓練)、沈浸式遊戲(新型態科技運動、復健)、沈浸式敘事(電影、動畫)、工廠模擬、博物館、成品預覽等。本虛擬實境應用之課程內容，將專注於虛擬實境應用對於未來科技、生活等不同層面的影響，同時探討沈浸、想像、互動與人類心理認知的相互關係。課程內容涵蓋VR/AR 及其互動體感技術的概念、原理與實現方法(電腦視覺技術簡介)，幫助學生理解虛擬環境中的感知與互動機制。為強化 VR 技術的實務應用，本課程將帶領學生開發創新且實用的多媒體人機互動系統，探索與評估沉浸式的操作模式。透過理論講解與實作練習，本課程將培養學生掌握 VR/AR 核心技術，並培育其創新應用與跨領域整合能力，使其在未來科技發展中發揮創造力與影響力。

description.zh: 本課程為一延續性的專題研究，其目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。

syllabi.outline:
This course is a continuation of a specialized research project, aimed at exploring topics related to interactive design, interactive media, and interactive art. The focus is on literature review, paper discussions, and case studies. Through intensive discussions, written reports, and the research and implementation of design projects, students can efficiently exchange ideas, gain deeper and broader experiences, and develop skills in research, analysis, and implementation.

The course integrates students from various fields, including electronics, mechatronics, humanities, design, and the arts, to cultivate professionals in interactive media design. Another primary learning objective of this course is to create a multidisciplinary learning environment. Following a project-oriented learning model, graduate students with expertise in design, art, information technology, and mechatronics can form teams to collaboratively conduct research on interactive media design projects or engage in case studies and creative projects in interactive media design.

The teaching methodology focuses on lectures, paper discussions and presentations, as well as project implementation. Assessment is based on reports, group discussions and presentations, and the practical implementation of projects.


本課程為一延續性的專題研究，其目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。

description.zh: 本課程專注於太空系統設計、驗證和確認的基本概念與技術。本課程涵蓋了任務要求、系統架構、系統貿易研究、設計優化以及驗證和確認方法等主題。學生將學習如何設計符合特定任務要求的太空系統，同時確保系統具有可靠、安全和高效的特性。本課程還將向學生介紹各種驗證和確認性能的技術，包括模擬、測試和分析。
description.en: Mission and System Design, Verification and Validation is a course that focuses on the fundamental concepts and techniques used in the design, verification, and validation of aerospace systems. This course covers topics such as mission requirements, system architectures, system trade studies, design optimization, and verification and validation methods. Students will learn how to design aerospace systems that meet specific mission requirements while also ensuring the system is reliable, safe, and efficient. The course will also introduce students to various techniques for verifying and validating the performance of aerospace systems, including simulation, testing, and analysis. By the end of this course, students will have a deep understanding of the process of designing, verifying, and validating aerospace systems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程專注於航太系統設計、驗證和確認的核心概念與進階技術。課程內容涵蓋任務需求分析、系統架構設計、系統貿易研究、設計優化，以及驗證與確認的理論和實踐方法。學生將學習如何設計滿足特定任務需求的航太系統，並確保系統在可靠性、安全性和效能方面表現卓越。本課程還將深入介紹多種驗證與確認技術，包括模擬、測試、數據分析及建模工具。通過理論與實踐相結合，學生將全面掌握航太系統設計、驗證與確認的完整流程，為未來實際工程應用奠定堅實基礎。

This course focuses on the core concepts and advanced techniques involved in the design, verification, and validation of aerospace systems. Topics include mission requirements analysis, system architecture design, system trade studies, design optimization, and the theoretical and practical aspects of verification and validation. Students will learn to design aerospace systems that meet specific mission requirements while ensuring exceptional reliability, safety, and performance. The course also delves into various techniques for verifying and validating aerospace system performance, such as simulation, testing, data analysis, and modeling tools. Combining theory with hands-on practice, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end process of aerospace system design, verification, and validation, preparing them for real-world engineering challenges.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Course Introduction - Overview of aerospace Verification and Validation (V&V) challenges
Week 2: Systems Engineering Basics - Aerospace-specific systems engineering
Week 3: Requirements Analysis - Functional and performance requirement derivation
Week 4: System Design - Aerospace system modeling and design
Week 5-6: Verification Techniques - Simulation and testing methods
Week 7-8: Validation Techniques - Aerospace-specific validation methods
Week 9: Midterm Exam: Theoretical and practical assessment
Week 10: Case Study Practice - Practical application and team project
Week 11: Group Project Discussion - Focus on System Design, Verification, and Validation
Week 12-13: Risk and Failure Analysis - FMEA and FTA applied to aerospace systems
Week 14: Case Study Practice - Practical application and real-world project analysis
Week 15-16: Advanced Topics - Exploration of recent aerospace V&V trends
Week 17-18: Project Presentation - Group project final presentation

5-6 assignments focused on aerospace Verification and Validation (V&V) challenges to reinforce theoretical and practical understanding.

A comprehensive assessment covering the theory and practical applications of V&V in aerospace systems.

- Final Report and Presentation: 60%
A detailed analysis and presentation of the group project findings, incorporating system design, verification, validation methods, and recommendations for improvement.

description.zh: 複雜系統專案管理是一種專門用於複雜項目的管理技巧。它使用分項管理方法，來預測和了解不斷變化的應用環境，確保複雜的工程項目的品質和成本，以及確保計劃準時完成。它由深入的規劃、品質管理、問題解決、進度及準確的檢測和調整所組成，並從團隊中運用整合協調和溝通管理，確保具備競爭優勢的項目順利達成。課程中包含，複雜系統專案概念，管理能力、架構、流程、方法等。
description.en: Project management of complex systems is a management technique specifically designed for complex projects. It uses an itemized management approach to predict and understand the different application environments, ensure the quality and cost of complex projects, and ensure that programs are completed on time. This course includes complex systems project concepts, management capabilities, structures, processes, and methodologies.

syllabi.outline:
本課程為複雜系統專案管理，主要探討管理複雜系統使用的管理方法，確保工程項目的品質和成本，以期計畫準時完成，期間必須進行有效溝通、計畫管理、品質管理、問題解決、進度。
太空計畫為一種典型的複雜系統，在有限的時間與經費下，必須要完成所設定的太空任務目標，因此本課程的授課內容將集中於太空系統工程及實務專案管理，包括太空任務專案概念，管理架構、流程、設計、方法等，並考量一個衛星系統於規格設計、材料選用、次系統製造、系統測試等各種不同階段的運作，並以立方衛星之介紹為範例。

This course is about complex system project management. It mainly discusses the management methods used to manage complex systems to ensure the quality and cost of engineering projects so that the plans can be completed on time. During this period, effective communication, project management, quality management, problem solving, and progress must be carried out. 
Space programs are typical complex systems that must complete the set space mission goals within limited time and funds. The course content will focus on space system engineering and practical project management, including space missions. Project concepts, management structure, processes, design, methods, etc. We consider the operation of a satellite system in various stages such as specification design, material selection, subsystem manufacturing, system testing, etc., A cubic satellite project will be as an example for further introduction.

description.zh: 本課程探討衛星通訊系統收發機設計，介紹衛星端與地球站通訊收發資料流。課程涵蓋的主題包括：通訊協定、通道編碼演算法、調變技術、多天線設計、軟體無線電技術、通訊數據機實現。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解衛星通訊收發機設計的技巧，並學習以軟體無線電實現通訊數據機。
description.en: This course discusses the design of transceivers for satellite communication systems and introduces the flow of data sent and received in communications between satellites and earth stations. Topics covered in the course include communication protocols, channel coding algorithms, modulation technology, multi-antenna design, software-defined radio technology, and the implementation of communication modem. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the techniques of satellite communication transceiver design and learn to implement communication modems using software-defined radios.

syllabi.outline:

description.zh: 本課程是研究所程度進階的巨量資料探勘與應用課程，主要介紹巨量資料探勘概念和原理、分散式計算基本架構、及各種應用包括: Link Analysis、Social Network Graph Mining、推薦系統等, 並且將介紹在處理巨量資料時常用的機器學習方法, 如: 類神經網路、SVM等，除了觀念的介紹外，透過平行化程式設計的練習以及期末專題，能讓學生認識實際巨量資料探勘的程式設計以及機器學習等工具的應用方式。
description.en: This course introduces the concepts in big data mining and advanced applications in machine learning. Topics include big data concepts, distributed computing infrastructure, and machine learning methods commonly used in processing big data, such as neural networks, support vector machines. In addition to concept introduction, parallel programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the processing steps and practical tools in big data anlaytics.

syllabi.outline:
本課程是研究所程度的進階課程，聚焦於巨量資料探勘與應用，涵蓋資料探勘理論及發展趨勢、技術與其在人工智慧及大數據領域中的創新應用。課程主要內容包括：資料科學的核心基礎(如資料倉儲與線上分析處理)、資料清理與前處理技術、頻繁樣式與關聯性分析、分類方法、群集分析及離群值偵測，並探討資料探勘中的前沿議題(如暗資料)。

本課程也將會深入介紹機器學習中常用的方法原理及分散式計算的基本架構，幫助學生掌握巨量資料處理技術。為加深學生的實作能力，課程安排了Python程式練習，結合資料科學模組（如NumPy、Pandas、Scikit-learn）進行資料探勘應用程式開發，並透過期中報告與期末專題的形式，培養學生分析資料、解決問題及團隊合作的能力。

透過本課程，預期同學將能夠學習到：
    1. 理解巨量資料探勘的基本概念、技術與應用場景(如鐵道系統應用)。
    2. 掌握資料清理、前處理、模型建立與評估等關鍵技能。
    3. 使用Python與相關工具進行資料分析與應用開發。
    4. 探索資料探勘在大數據與AI創新中的潛在發展方向，並培養研究與實踐能力。

This advanced graduate-level course focuses on big data mining and its applications, covering theories and developmental trends, as well as techniques and novel applications in the artificial intelligence and big data domains. The course covers fundamental topics like core foundations of data science (e.g., data warehousing and online analytical processing), data cleaning and preprocessing techniques, frequent patterns and association analysis, classification methods, cluster analysis, and anomaly detection. The course also covers cutting-edge topics in data mining, such as dark data.

This course also delves deeply into the principles of commonly used machine learning methods and the fundamental architecture of distributed computing, providing students with critical skills for handling big data. To improve hands-on skills, the course includes Python programming exercises that incorporate data science modules (such as NumPy, Pandas, and Scikit-learn) for developing data mining applications. Mid-term reports and final projects will encourage students to analyze data, solve problems, and develop teamwork skills.

By finishing this course, students are expected to:
    1) Understand the fundamental concepts, techniques, and use cases for big data mining (e.g., railway system applications).
    2) Develop critical skills in data cleaning, preprocessing, model building, and evaluation.
    3) Use Python and related tools for data analysis and application development.
    4) Investigate potential developments in data mining for big data and AI innovations, while also developing research and practical skills.

description.zh: 當代都市議題經常為跨領域、開放性的複雜問題，在資料蒐集與分析上，需要整合地理空間、時間的維度；在分析與對策上，須平衡公部門、私部門、民眾等多重利害關係者的，是一門相當複雜但重要的學問。本課程從真實的都市議題出發，教導學生掌握地理空間資訊、資料分析、資料建模、資訊視覺化、策略論述等綜合能力，培養學生對於都市複雜議題的觀察與剖析，進而對真實環境提出洞見與創意。
description.en: Contemporary urban issues are complex, requiring the integration of geographical, and temporal dimensions in data collection and analysis. Balancing the interests of stakeholders like the public, and private sectors is crucial. This course focuses on real urban issues, teaching skills in geographical information, data analysis, modeling, visualization, and strategic discourse. It aims to cultivate students' ability to observe, analyze urban issues, and propose insights for real environments. It's an advanced course, requiring basic programming and GIS concepts. Through group projects, students learn API usage, geographic computation, model building, and data visualization. The course includes one midterm report and one final project report.

description.zh: 數理邏輯是理論計算機科學各領域重要的基礎。在本課程中，重點關注於數理邏輯在軟體程式驗證與機器可檢驗之證明等的應用。透過各種如SAT/SMT求解器與輔助證明工具Coq等，本課程將涵蓋以下主題：比例邏輯、一階邏輯、可滿足性模組理論、模型檢查與程式驗證。
description.en: Mathematical logic is an important foundation of various fields in theoretical computer science. This course focuses on its applications from software/program verification to machine-checkable proofs. Through various tools like SAT/SMT solvers and proof-assistant Coq, this course will cover the following topics: proportional logic, first-order logic, satisfiability module theory, model checking and program verification.

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供所有博士生共同參與研究討論的園地。將進行設計專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。論文撰寫、投稿及專題報告
1.人數：全部博士生參與，與授課老師協商指導，需於本學期末之前投稿，提交投出證明，方才取得學分。
2.論文投稿範圍：以最近5年內與論文相關之SCI、SSCI、EI、A＆HCI、TSSCI（如科技部2014年通過之相關TSSCI名單：戶外遊憩研究、地理學報、住宅學報、建築學報、都市與計劃、運輸計劃季刊、運輸學刊、台灣土地研究、歐美研究、藝術教育研究…）或該領域經審查後出版之學術性期刊文章；或國內外研討會。
3.語文：中英文皆可，需於本學期末之前投稿，提出證明，方才取得學分；並請準備演講或報告摘要給同學參考。
4.時間：論文進行定期全班報告，由授課老師共同排定時間；其餘週次，各組帶開，由授課教師進行論文討論。
5.作業討論繳交：論文題目確定、撰寫過程與分組授課老師討論。論文投出後學期結束前，以E-mail繳交全文及投稿證明給所長，由全體授課老師評分。未完成繳交視同期末考缺考，不得補交，成績不及格論。

3.語文：中英文皆可，需於本學期末之前投稿，提出證明，方才取得學分；並請準備演講或報告摘要給同學參考。

syllabi.outline:
本課程透過創新科技之電腦，心理學，人機互動應用多學科類期刊文導讀，來建構學生對設計研究者在投稿專業期刊時所應具備的專業背景理論知識的探索，透過廣泛閱讀與師生討論的形式引導學生能夠對其感興趣的研究進行論文撰寫與期刊投稿。建構學生基本概念與專業技能，並引導其發展具有創意潛力的研究題目，訂立，與主題發展，最終引導到資料分析與評估，並讓學生能夠藉由對該研究主題的瞭解與實際操作進而具有撰寫國際頂尖一流期刊的專業能力。

1. 給予修課同學在收集、閱讀及分析學術期刊文獻上的訓練。 
2. 透過現場討論的方式培養積極參與學術活動的動機與辯證態度。 
3. 了解其他學術單位的成就及最新學術發展方向。

description.zh: 本課程目的在介紹微觀之固體表面結構與現象。課程內容包括微觀之固體表面結構，固體表面之吸附、擴散、脫附現象，表面偏析現象，分子和表面間之鍵結，表面反應的熱力學與動力學，以及各種表面分析的技術。
description.en: This course is designated to acquaint the student with atomic-level understanding of surface structure and surface phenomena. The course focuses on the surproperties of the solid-gas and solid-vacuum interfaces because most of the results of modern surface-science studies on the atomic level come from the scrutiny of these interfaces. It contains the following topics: the atomic-level structure of clean and adsorbate-covered surfaces, adsorption and desorption, surface diffusion, surface segregation, the nature of the surface bonding, the adsorbate-adsorbate interaction, energy transfer during gas-surface interactions and surface reaction; surface analysis techniques.

syllabi.outline: The purpose of this course is to elucidate the gas-solid interfacial phenomena, principles and techniques of surface science and its application to meet the increasing demand for analysis of solid surfaces in both the “academic” and “technological” fields.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

syllabi.outline:
課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

name.en: Analysis and Simulation of Integrated Circuits

description.zh:
本課程在訓練學生如何使用電腦輔助設計軟体來分析與模擬類比及數位積体電路,進而能培養學生具有設計積体電路的能力,課程內容包念：
1. 電腦輔助設計積体電路介紹
2. 類比積体電路設計軟体之介紹及使用 ( SPICE Design center )
3. 數位積体電路設計軟体之介紹及使用 ( Viewlogic )
4. PLD的認識與介紹
5. FPGA ( Xilinx )的設計
6. 專題設計
description.en:
This course is trained the student to use computer-aided design tools for the analysis and simulation of integrated 
circuits(digital & analysis) .Therefore,the student have the design capability of integrated.The contents of this 
course :
1.introduction to the Computer-aided IC design 
2.Introduction to the computer-aided deaign of analysis  
  integrated circuits(SPICE ,Deaign Center)and computer-
  exercise
3.Introduction to the computer-aided design of digital integrated circuits(Viewlogic)and computer-exercise
4.Introduction to the PLD
5.FPGA(XILINX)design and computer-exercise
6.Project.

syllabi.outline:
本課程在訓練學生如何使用開源服務軟體來分析與模擬數位IC的設計,進而能培養學生具有設計積体電路的能力,課程內容包念：
1. 數位邏輯系統
2. 數位積体電路設計軟体之介紹及使用EDA Playground
3..FPGA的原理
4. 專題設計
syllabi.schedule:
This course trains students how to use open source service software to analyze and simulate the design of digital ICs, thereby cultivating students' ability to design integrated circuits. The course content includes:
1. Digital logic system
2. Introduction to digital integrated circuit design software and use of EDA Playground
3..Principles of FPGA
4. Thematic design

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討供應鏈管理相關之基本議題。供應鏈管理係從供應商、製造商到最終顧客，對整個製造與配銷通路的整合性管理策略。本課程內容包含供應鏈管理之策略發展、供應鏈管理之相關功能、及供應鏈管理之主要困難點。本課程將同時探討與供應鏈管理相關之議題，如存貨理論、資訊系統整合、及供應契約等。本課程理論與實務並重、案例研討也將為本課程重要之一環。
description.en: This course intends to introduce fundamental issues regarding supply chain management. Supply chain management is an integrated approach to manage the total flow of manufacturing and distribution channel from supplier to ultimate customer. The contents of this course include the development of supply chain management strategies, supply chain management functions, and major challenges of supply chain management. Certain topics related to supply chain management, such as inventory policy, information system integration, and supply contract will also be addresses. This course focuses on both theoretical and practical issues. Real world case study will be an important part of this course.

description.zh: 為加強學生設計實務能力，本課程規劃學生赴家具相關產業，至少為期4.5個月之校外實習，並於期滿後須由接受實習單位提具實習證明及成績考核。次一學期開學後，學生必須繳交書面或經口頭實習成果發表，由指導教師檢核實習單位成績考核，以給予實習學生最後評量成績。
description.en: For the purpose of enhance senior students' practical skill in design, the course is established to encourage students to intern in the industry for no less than 4.5 months. The student will then be evaluated by the industry, and by the lecturer through the examination of a written report and/or an oral presentation to demonstrate his/her effort.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。學生需每週40小時於企業實習，並於期末繳交實習報告。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生實務能力，學生利用整學期至各相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: This course, off-campus practice, aims to provide practical training for undergraduate students through working in enterprise environments. During one semester, students go to enterprises or organization related to energy, air-conditioning and refrigerating industries and learn application-oriented skills. After completing the course, the organization for internship will provide training certifications and evaluate the score of students. The intern should write internship report and send the report to department office.

description.zh:
本課程使學生對燃料電池的基本原理、關鍵技術、以及商品化發展與應用過程，有所瞭解並加以分析及探討。
燃料電池是一種電化學的發電裝置，其運作原理係利用電化學反應將燃料內之化學能直接轉換為電能，因其在能量轉換過程中並不經過熱機過程，因此能量轉換效率較高。本課程之授課綱要可分為以下幾項：
燃料電池簡介、燃料電池之效率、質子交換膜燃料電池、磷酸燃料電池、鹼性燃料電池、直接甲醇燃料電池、固態氧化物燃料電池、燃料電池的燃料供應、燃料電池之計算實例。
description.en:
This course enables students to fully understand the basic principles of the fuel cell, key technologies, and the commercialization of the development and the application process, and to analyze and discuss the design of fuel cell system.
Fuel cell is an electrochemical power generating device. It can directly convert the chemical energy of fuel into the electrical energy via the electrochemical reaction. Because it does not go through the process of thermal engine in the energy conversion process, and therefore a higher energy conversion efficiency. Teaching outlines of the course can be divided into the followings:
Introduction to fuel cell, Fuel cell efficiency, Proton exchange membrane fuel cell, Phosphoric acid fuel cell, Alkaline fuel cell, Direct methanol fuel cell, Solid oxide fuel cell, Fueling fuel cell, Calculation example of fuel cell.

description.zh: 近年來由於台灣在半導體、平面顯示器、光電、薄膜、低溫冷凍、生物科技及微奈米技術等產業的蓬勃發展，因而帶動了真空設備相關產業，進而對真空科技及其專業人才需求日殷。本課程將針對上述產業所使用的相關真空設備進行講解及討論，包含有真空蒸鍍系統、真空濺鍍系統、真空冷凍乾燥系統、電漿蝕刻真空系統、真空熱處理系統、表面分析技術等，將使學生具備真空設備理論及實務的相關知識與技能。
description.en: The vacuum industry is growing fast in the past two decades because of the highly growing of the high-tech industries including semiconductor, optics-electrics, communication, MEMS, and nano-technology. Therefore, a lot of students need to know the vacuum system described previously. This program will introduce vacuum systems including vacuum evaporating system, vacuum sputtering system, vacuum drying system, vacuum plasma etching system, surface analysis.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces students to probability, random variables and fundamental statistics. Topics include fundamental probability theory, random variables, distribution functions, Bernoulli, binomial, negative binomial, geometric, hypergeometric, and Poisson distributions. The other continuous topics covered are uniform, exponential, normal, gamma and beta distributions; joint distributions; properties of expectation, central limit theorem, Chebyshev inequality, and law of large numbers; fundamental statistics.

description.zh: 任何計畫、產品或服務之壽命週期起始自需要分析，其次為決定需求和規格，接著為設計和執行，最後經由使用階段，在支援和維護下完成此計畫。而在進行經濟分析，應對貨幣之時間價值、投資報酬率、損益平衡、公司債券、現金流量、有效利率、最小成本壽命、通貨膨脹、成本估計、折舊、所得稅、資金成本、更新分析、敏感性分析和風險決策分析等要點，以求估計值之準確性、方案抉擇決策之正確性。

description.en: Human factors is dedicated to discover and survey human beings' capability, limit, behavior and other futures.  And then apply it to the design of tools, facilities, systems, works and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity.  The course includes research approaches, physical design, human being's feeling process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.

syllabi.outline:
Human factors and ergonomics is dedicated to discover and survey human beings’ capability, limit, behavior and other features. And then apply it to the design of tools, facilities, systems, works and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity. This course includes research and scientific approaches, physical design, human beings' sensory process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.
The aim of this course is to inspire students for human factors science through evidence-based approaches in improving products and systems by considering human capabilities and needs (also socio-technical factors) when interacting with products & systems. In this course we step from theory to practical implementation.

description.en: Students will practice the following subjects: Using body working equipment, Collision repair, Body alignment, Body panel replacement and sectioning, and Sealer, adhesive, and anti-rust treatment.
