95學年度前入學者適用下列實習內容: 車輛電系和可程式控制器，包括：引擎電系，充電系檢測，點火系檢測，電池之檢測與換裝，電腦控制系檢測，電腦診斷系統檢測，其他電控系統檢測；可程式控制器系統規劃，可程式控制器之整合與評估，可程式控制器應用。
description.en:
Automobile Drive Trains , Body Refinishing and Painting Service Shop Practice , Include the Repair, Overhaul and Trouble-Shooting of Automobile Transmission and Chassis, Automobile Body and Motorcycle Frame Assembly, Basic Dimensional Measurements, Inspection and Adjustments. The practice of automobile body sanding, welding and hydraulic straightening equipment; repairing of the sheet-metal panels; frame and body alignment; door trim, headlinings, glass and weatherstripping replacement; repairing of the collision damages ; Automobile refinishing and painting equipment, refinishing and painting materials , color matching, the practice of refinishing and painting of the vehicle , painting quality testing .
For those students who enter the school before 2006 Fall Semester , the practice contents are :
Electrical and Electronic System, Battery, Starting System, Charging System, Ignition System, Computer Control System, Computer Diagnostic System. Programmable logic controller (PLC) combi

description.zh: 柴油引擎-四行程柴油引擎、燃燒與燃燒室、燃料系統、預熱起動系統、電腦控制燃油噴射系統，汽車空調-冷氣基本作用原理、相關基礎熱力學、冷媒及冷凍油、汽車冷氣系統構造、汽車冷氣電路、汽車自動空調系統，汽車專業英文。
description.en: Diesel Engines include Four-Stroke Diesel engine, Combustion and combustion chamber, Fuel systems, Pre-Heat starting systems and Computer control fuel injection systems; Auto Air Condition Systems include Fundamental theory, Basic thermodynamics, Refrigerant and refrigerant oil, Construction, Electrical circuits and automatic air condition systems; Basic English for automotive service .

name.en: Auto Body Repair and Refinishing Technology (II)

description.zh: 課程包含識圖與製圖，電腦輔助製圖，量具、畫線、切斷，彎曲，車身板金接縫與邊緣，車身材料，塗料組成、溶劑、稀釋液，塗料樹脂種類與乾燥、硬化原理，塗裝研磨材料，塗裝遮蔽用材料，拋光用研磨膏及保護臘，以及汽車塗裝美容用材料之介紹。
description.en: The course includes the following topics: Learning to read and make design drawings, Computer-aided drafting, Measurement systems, line drawing, and cutting, Bending, Body sheet metal seaming and hemming, Body materials, Paints, solvents, and thinners, Paint resin and curing, Paint abrasives, Masking materials, Polishing paste and protection wax, and Vehicle cosmetic materials.

description.zh: 汽車材料的構成，金屬、非金屬、非鐵金屬、燒結合金及複合材料等在汽車分野上的應用，汽車材料的動向。
description.en: Compositions of Automotive Material，Applications of Metal、Nonmetal、Nonferrous Metal、Sintered Alloy、Composite materials for Automotive、Automotive Materia

description.zh:
先修課程:4402014或負責教授同意
柴油引擎概說，柴油之類別，特性與燃燒分析，柴油引擎與汽油引擎之比較，柴油引擎之類別與用途，柴油引擎之循環理論與工作分析，柴油引擎系統之主要構件、類別與特性分析，柴油引擎進排氣系統與環保控制裝置，柴油引擎之啟動設備，柴油引擎之其他配件與自動化，柴油引擎之特性數據與性能分析，柴油引擎之未來發展。
description.en: Diesel Engine Models, Combustion Analysis, Working Cycles Analysis, Major Components, Exhaust and Emission Control, Starting System, Performance Test and Analysis, Future Development.

description.zh: 底盤系統定期保養，輪胎平衡，四輪定位，變速箱分解檢查及故障排除。汽油及柴油引擎拆裝，引擎量測與調整，引擎啟動、點火、燃油、冷卻及潤滑系統之定期保養檢測及故障排除。
description.en: Experiments on vehicle chassis, and transmission. Inspection, adjustment and repair of chassis system, tire balance, wheel alignment, overhaul and trouble-shooting of transmission. Gasoline & diesel engine assembly, engine test, engine tune-up and repair, trouble-shooting and instrument adjustment on: ignition system, fuel system, cooling system, lubrication system, and starting system.

description.zh: 車身研磨、焊接及液壓施力設備之操作，金屬鈑金件之維修，車架及車身之校正及調整，門緣、車頭、玻璃及防潮條之更換，碰撞損壞之維修；塗裝及噴漆設備，塗裝及噴漆材料，配色技巧，車輛之塗裝及噴漆實際操作，完成品之品質檢驗。
description.en: The practice of automobile body sanding, welding and hydraulic straightening equipment; repairing of the sheet-metal panels; frame and body alignment; door trim, headlinings, glass and weatherstripping replacement; repairing of the collision damages ; Automobile refinishing and painting equipment, refinishing and painting materials , color matching, the practice of refinishing and painting of the vehicle , painting quality testing .

description.zh: 實習素色調色(色相、明度、彩度)，珍珠銀粉色調色，三層珍珠色調色，小美容、以及全車大美容。
description.en: Students will practice the following subjects: Plain paint blending (including hue, lightness, and saturation), Pearl silver-color blending, Pearl color paint mixing, Vehicle salon, and Full vehicle spa.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

After completing the course, the organization for internship will provide training certifications and evaluate the score of students. The intern should write internship report and send the report to department office.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹期貨、選擇權與相關衍生性金融商品的理論基礎與實務概念，了解衍生性金融商品在套利、避險與投機策略上的應用。課程內容包含期貨與選擇權兩個部分：在期貨議題方面，主要介紹期貨市場的組織結構、期貨契約的理論價格、以及避險策略；在選擇權議題方面，則是涵蓋選擇權市場的介紹、選擇權的理論價格、交易策略、與市場資訊分析。藉由對期貨與選擇權理論基礎的建構，期望能強化同學對於衍生性金融商品的實務應用能力。
description.en: This course is designed to introduce students to the theoretical and practical aspects of financial futures, options, and other derivatives. Derivatives have become one of the most important tools of modern finance, from both the academic and the practical standpoint. They are used for compensation, speculation, yield enhancements of investments, and, most importantly, for risk management. This course consists of two parts. The first part of the course deals with futures issues including the structure of futures markets, pricing of futures contracts, and hedging with such contracts. The second part of the course deals with options issues including options markets, strategies, pricing, and hedging analysis. Students will learn about the theoretical underpinnings and the practical applications in real world of derivative securities.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

syllabi.outline:
課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至相關機構連續實習18週，每週不得低於2.5天。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。

This requirement applies to Freshman Sophomore and Junior students while it is an elective for senior students.  For Freshman level, Classes focus on basic physical strength training. description.zh: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to train the students who can be familiar with the statistics approaches and theories. Besides, they will be able to employ the collected data to analyze the unknown environments. The course includes probability theory, testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.

description.zh: 本課程介紹作業研究中非線性模式之各項基本概念及應用，包含整數規劃、動態規劃、賽局原理、馬可夫鏈、等候原理、存貨模式、專案管理、模擬等。
description.en: In this course, the basic concepts and applications of Nonlinear Programming Models in Operations Research. It includes Integer Programming、Dynamic Programming、Game Theory、Markovian Chains、Queueing Theory、Inventory Theory、Project Management and Simulation Modeling﹒

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹作業研究中非線性模式之各項基本概念及應用，包含整數規劃、動態規劃、賽局原理、馬可夫鏈、等候原理、存貨模式、專案管理、模擬等。
In this course, the basic concepts and applications of Nonlinear Programming Models in Operations Research. It includes Integer Programming、Dynamic Programming、Game Theory、Markovian Chains、Queueing Theory、Inventory Theory、Project Management and Simulation Modeling﹒

description.zh: 其主要是建立系統化的服務系統設計與服務作業管理方式，其內容：服務業本質的瞭解、服務設計、服務系統規劃、服務廠址選擇、服務場所佈置、服務程序設計、服務自動化及電腦化、服務作業管理人員管理、儀器設備管理、服務存貨管理、服務等候線管理、服務績效管理等。
description.en: This course mainly introduces the development, design and management of service systems.  The contents include introduction of service industry, service design, service systems planning, site selection, layout, service process design, service automation, service process management, facility management, inventory control, queuing, performance management.

syllabi.outline:
本課程針對服務業之管理暨實地參與學習服務作探討，課程包含服務業的本質與定義、 顧客需求、服務系統設計與作業管理、服務地點與佈置、服務業人力資源與行銷管理、服務等候線管理及服務品 質管理與顧客滿意等。經此課程的學習可使同學真正瞭解服務業管理的內容。
 1.建立服務業管理之理論與實務的整體觀念。
 2.培養學生具備規劃與管理服務業之能力，並能洞悉消費者行為與掌握服務管理的核心。

Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.zh: 課程講授家具結構之專業知識與應用技術，理論與實務並重。內容包括開發流程、產品工程、基本力學、木材特性、複合板特性、木材接合、機械扣件、框類家具結構特性、板類家具結構特性、殼類家具結構特性等。
description.en: This course is introducing the knowledge and technique of furniture construction, both theory and practicing. The contents include R&D procedure, product engineering, basic mechanics, characteristics of wood, characteristics of composite board,, wood joints, mechanical fasteners, characteristics of frame type furniture, characteristics of panel type furniture, characteristics of shell type furniture etc.

description.zh: 讓學生瞭解木材機器加工原理及最新工業用木工機器之種類，並使學生熟悉家具製造技術，特別是製造家具需要用到的各種設備之加工能力，及其作業特性和刀具要件等方面之知識與實務。 介紹家具製造過程中所需之各種機器設備之種類及其加工性能。不論及機器本身之設計問題，而側重於機械之應用；不研究一種機器所能做出之各種巧妙的加工方法，而在討論量產作業時，如何利用最合適之機器及加工方法所應採用之標準操作方式。
description.en: Survey of furniture manufacturing technology emphasizing mass production equipment and its relationship to furniture product engineering. The course is directed toward the efficient use of equipment in the production of large lots. In addition, the course does not concern itself with ingenious ways to do a maximum variety of operations on one machine; however, it is interested in presenting the best machine and method for standard production operations.

description.zh: 本課程係提供學生有關家具的成本觀念，如何估算、分析和控制家具製品之成本。其講授內容有：成本結構、成本估算、材料成本、人工成本、製造費用、銷售費用、總成本及單位成本與產品報價等。
description.en: This course is to provide students with the concept of cost of furniture, how to estimate, analyze and control the cost of furniture products. Its teaching content includes: cost structure, cost estimation, material cost, labor cost, manufacturing cost, sales expense, total cost, unit cost and product quotation.

description.zh: 本課程之主旨為探討木質材料在生活產品上的設計應用，著重在傳統木工技藝、機械加工上的技能訓練，並培養學生在創新設計上的思維。更積極培養訓練學生以生活需求的觀點來創作木質材料產品，使學生能靈活運用各項木工基本機具設備製做各項木器產品。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to explore the design and application of wood materials in life products, focusing on traditional woodworking techniques, skills training on mechanical processing, and training students' thinking on innovative design. More active training and training students to create wooden materials from the perspective of living needs, so that students can use all kinds of woodworking basic machine equipment to make all kinds of wood products.

description.zh: 本課程教導學生了解木材塗裝專業知識與應用，主要包括: 1. 木材塗料的種類。 2. 木材塗裝方式的選擇，如何依照木材特性選用合適之塗裝方式。 3. 塗裝作業方式，塗料乾燥、固化及硬化方法。 4. 不同塗裝方式在木材外觀與維護上之影響。 5. 塗膜缺陷與對策。
description.en: This course will help students to understand what is wood coating and application, include : 1. Wood coatings category. 2. How to choose best way of wood coating process. 3. Coating process, curing, drying and hardening of paint. 4. The appearance and maintain in different finish. 5. Coating defects and solution.

description.zh: 探討木材之物理及機械性質對於家具構造與製造品質之影響，並讓學生瞭解材料之組織構造以熟識家具用材之鑑定。終其目標在使學生認識材料進而善用材料。 介紹以木質材料為主之家具材料。內容含蓋木材之外觀特徵，組織構造，材料鑑識及其物理與機械性質對於家具構造和製造品質其間之關係等。
description.en: The macrostructure and microstructure of wood. Identification and uses of common Softwoods and Hardwoods. Physical and mechanical properties in relation to wood processing. Properties of other wood based materials such as particleboard, fiberboard, plywood, laminated wood related to their use in furniture manufacture also included.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh:
先修課程:4401011或負責教授同意
介紹結構體在受到張力、壓力、剪力、扭力及彎曲等外力狀態下之變形，分析應力，應變及變形，莫耳圓，壓力容器，樑，柱。
description.en: Introduction of the deformation, Strain and stress of structure (Beam, Column, Pressure vessel) under several different loading condition equations, Compression, Shear force, Torsion and Bending moment.

syllabi.outline:
先修課程:4401011或負責教授同意
1. 固體結構體在受到張力、壓力、剪力、扭力及彎曲等外力狀態下之變形；(2) 分析各不同受力下結構之應力、應變及變形；(3) 材料之應力應變關係；(4) 利用莫耳圓計算主應力、主應變及其轉換；(5) 介紹柱、樑、及軸等結構之設計原理。

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。學生需每週40小時於企業實習，並於期末繳交實習報告。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh:
本課程引入程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以 C 語言為基礎，於熟習基本

念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
description.en:
This course introduces to the students the basic computer programming concepts.
Syntax and semantics of the C and C++ programming languages will be introduced.
Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer
solutions, effective methods of program design using structured programming notions
of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.zh: 本門課藉由濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程，分析人體舒適與空氣品質之需求，及各種空調設備系統之設計。本門課在空調負荷計算原理與方法涵蓋輻射熱、熱傳導及熱儲存效應等之分析，系統設計包括送風與送水系統之計算與設計，及室內送風分佈之理論與設計。
description.en: Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. Design of air-conditioning equipment and systems are introduced. Air-conditioning load analysis includes radiation, transfer, and heat storage effects. System design includes design and calculation air and water moving systems. Air distribution principles and design are also covered.

syllabi.outline:

Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. Design of air-conditioning equipment and systems are introduced. Air-conditioning load analysis includes radiation, transfer, and heat storage effects. System design includes design and calculation air and water moving systems. Air distribution principles and design are also covered.

description.zh: 本科目將由不可壓縮流體在各種流動環境所產生之流體分子流動現象之認識，進而利用各種有關因次群，熟習包含可壓縮流體在內之實際應用上所必須具備之基礎方法；如雷諾數．伯努力方程式等。利用流利基礎分析，流體機械之流場與動力，及管路內流場與壓力之變化。
description.en: Introduction to flow phenomena of incompressible flow, discussion on the dimensionless groups and their applicants, derive the conservation equations such as the Bernoulli equation, using fluid mechanics to analyze the field and the dynamics of fluid machinery, pipe and duct flow are also discuss.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生實務能力，學生利用整學期至各相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: This course, off-campus practice, aims to provide practical training for undergraduate students through working in enterprise environments. During one semester, students go to enterprises or organization related to energy, air-conditioning and refrigerating industries and learn application-oriented skills. After completing the course, the organization for internship will provide training certifications and evaluate the score of students. The intern should write internship report and send the report to department office.

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class.  This requirement applies to Freshman Sophomore and Junior students while it is an elective for senior students.  For Freshman level, Classes focus on basic physical strength training.  For Sophomore and Junior students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 教導學生閱讀囊括全球議題的文章，並藉由文章的內容作技巧的訓練，字彙的建構，語言的解析，及思維的啟發。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to train the students who can be familiar with the statistics approaches and theories. Besides, they will be able to employ the collected data to analyze the unknown environments. The course includes probability theory, testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.

syllabi.outline: The purpose of this course is to familiarize students with frequently used statistical methods and theories. Students will be able to draw appropriate conclusions through problem identification, data collection, and appropriate statistical analysis methods. The course includes: descriptive statistics, probability concepts, probability distribution, interval estimation, hypothesis test, variance analysis, and regression analysis.

description.zh: 本課程介紹國際金融市場以及金融系統。本課程涵蓋範圍包含: 股票市場、貨幣市場、債券市場、外匯市場、房貸市場、投資銀行、保險產業、基金市場…等。主要目的在讓學生了解整個金融市場是如何運作。同時以個案討論方式讓學生對整體的金融市場與機構有通盤的了解。
description.en: This course introduces the international financial markets (i.e. money market, bond market, stock market, mortgage market, foreign exchange market, investment banks, commercial banks…etc). The objectives of this course are to develop a fundamental understanding of (i) how financial markets work; (ii) how financial systems affect people and daily life.

Further training students to obtain international and domestic financial professional certification exams in order to achieve the goal of seamless integration of theory and practice.

description.zh: 資訊安全其主要目的是讓初接觸資訊安全領域的學生能夠瞭解什麼是資訊安全，並且能夠對於資訊安全有更正確認知。課程規劃如下：資訊安全介紹、基礎密碼學介紹、電腦病毒與惡意程式、網路安全與攻擊、網路安全防護,應用層安全、網頁安全、雲端安全、物聯網安全、個人資料保護。

description.zh:
由於雲端運算的快速發展，大量資料收集與儲存技術已成瓶頸，大數據技術與管理提供一套具延展性與容錯能力的分散儲存與計算架構, 能有效處理大量複雜數據資料的儲存與運算。
本課程除介紹現有的大數據生態與趨勢，並針對目前軟硬體架構的處理瓶頸，提供系統組態與部署、服務層級協定、監控與管理等系統性規劃的解決方案，並導入跨領域的工程管理科學知識。課程簡扼論述大數據技術與管理的重要，並在Hadoop生態系統中，以Cloudera Hadoop為應用範例，實作說明其重要性。
課程內容包括：大數據的概念、應用生態與趨勢、Hadoop硬體規格與基礎架構規劃、叢集組態與部署、叢集服務層級協定、叢集監控與管理、相關生態技術、及概略介紹Hadoop認證與準備。
description.en: The course will introduce Apache Hadoop core technologies and administration with its major including: Big Data (BD) in demand and its application trend, Core technologies of Hadoop for BD management, Hadoop Administration and management tool, Hadoop cluster deployment,YARN applications plus MapReduce, Hadoop cluster hardware and software, Introduction of Hadoop ecosystem projects, HDFS configuration for high availability (HA), Hadoop security, Cluster resource scheduling and configuration, and Hadoop certification program, etc.

syllabi.outline:
先修課程：負責教授同意。
本課程經由研究、分享、討論，瞭解科技創新轉型發展之趨勢，進行科技創新之思維與實例教學，使學生能瞭解創新之模式及相關理論，以啟發學生之創意，促進學術與產業之互動與交流。內容包含科技未來趨勢和創新挑戰，企業核心技術、來源和取得，科技管理與風險，國家科技政策之影響，企業發展生存之道，全球創新產品之開發與技術戰略與戰術。
Through research, sharing, and discussion, this course aims to understand the trend of technological innovation, its transformation and development, to tell technological innovation, thought and examples, to enable students to understand the mode of innovation and related theories. The course will inspire students' creativity, and will promote the interaction between academia and industry. The course content includes the future trend of science, technology and innovation challenges, enterprise core technology with its source and acquisition. It also includes the science and technology management and risk which impact the national science and technology policy for enterprise development and survival, and the development of global innovative products and technology strategies and tactics.
syllabi.schedule:
科技創新與管理總論 / 課程介紹與說明(一週)

2.     科技創新轉型的機會與挑戰(二.三週) 
2.1	全球再生能源發展大轉彎闡述與案例分享。
2.2	汙染疾病挑戰闡述與案例分享。

2.4	經濟產業價值創新闡述與案例分享。
2.5	製造者轉為使用者需求導向服務闡述與案例分享。
2.6	勞動力/少子高齡化日趨嚴重趨勢分析。
2.7	傳染疾病挑戰全球秩序闡述與案例分享。

3.	創新轉型案例分析(四.五週)
3.1	柯達-失敗商業轉型與戰略失敗分析。
3.2	諾基亞-失敗商業轉型與戰略失敗分析。

3.6	科技業與金融業合作發展之案例與分析。
3.7	科技創新轉型示範的挑戰與風險。
3.8	舊物種轉型新物種之挑戰闡述。

4.	創新轉型機會與挑戰分析(六.七.八週)

name.en: Non-Destructive Testing of Materials and Structures

description.zh: 課程內容包括：原理探討:超音波,磁場與磁性,電磁感應與渦電流,輻射線,液體表面現象,材料微結構；方法介紹:磁場檢測法,超音波檢測法,渦電流檢測法,X光檢測法,液滲法,微奈米檢測(各種顯微鏡)等；材料非破壞檢測實驗:導電性材料、磁性材料、陶瓷材料、複合材料之缺陷檢測；結構非破壞檢測實驗：機械零件、以及特定結構之檢測；非破壞檢測影像：電腦數據擷取、數據分析、與影像處理
description.en: Introduce the concepts of following topics, Fundamentals: ultrasonic waves, magnetic field and magnetism, electromagnetic induction and eddy currents, X-rays, penetrants. NDT methods: ultrasonic testing, magnetoscopic inspections, eddy current testing, radiographic technique, penetrants method. NDT of materials: conductive materials, magnetic materials, ceramics, composite materials. NDT of structures: mechanical components, specific structures. NDT images: PC-based data acquisition, data analysis and image process.

name.zh: 建築資訊模型與防救災及工程管理
name.en: Applications of Building Information Modeling for Disaster Prevention and Engineering Management

description.zh: 本課程將以BIM之觀點，介紹國內外建築資訊模型及建築資訊模型案例，包含建築資訊模型及探討BIM之設計與實作，希望學生能夠經由防救災或工程管理之需求分析開始，瞭解BIM建築資訊系統之架構與應用，進而設計一個BIM在防救災與管理之實務應用，其內容包括：BIM自動化防救災應用，BIM實務應用，國內外BIM案例探討，BIM應用之分析與設計，BIM系統設計與開發，BIM系統在防救災與工程管理之應用等內容。
description.en: Building Information Modeling (BIM) is increasingly important for applications disaster prevention and management recently. The course introduces the BIM use, modeling, design, development, and related applications for disaster prevention and engineering management. The course is a combination of lectures, readings, hands-on exercises, homework assignments, a midterm report and a final project. The course allows students to develop a BIM-related applications suitable to their own researches to meet disaster prevention or engineering management requirement.

name.zh: 土木與防災之低碳管理
name.en: Low Carbon Management of Civil Engineering and Disaster Prevention

description.zh:
為使土木營建背景的學生具備跨域學習與創用能力，本課程扣合當前重要時趨(如SDGs, ESG, LCA, ESDG/USR等)於土木與防災之低碳管理。擇採綠色與數位雙軸科技(如數位碳盤查與減碳之智化物聯網AIoT)作為課程雙核心編排，介紹內容如碳-水-環境足跡之盤查與減碳策略、綠-智-健康之數位雲平台、無線感測與低工耗遠域網路等專案開發的理與例，以符綠智營建之踐履，以臻永續經管之倡議。
為求哲科合一，課程亦將思與學之認識與方法作簡扼介紹(系統思考與問題導向學習)。
description.en:
To achieve interdisciplinary learning and innovative creativity for civil engineering students, this course presents the Carbon-Water-Environmental inventory associated with Artificial Intelligent/Internet of Things (AIoT) to meet sustainable development of civil engineering and disaster adaptation/mitigation. The contents in this class include sustainable development goals such as SDGs, ESG, LCA, ESDG/USR briefly, green-intelligent-healthy construction/maintenance and resilient projects, WSN (Wireless Network), LPWAN (Low Power Wide-Area Network), e-Cloud Management.
Meanwhile, Systems Thinking (ST) and Problem-based Learning (PBL) , which are crucial for philosophy of science, would be introduced for this holistic approach.

name.en: Energy-saving vehicle simulation and embedded system

description.zh: 建立節能車輛模擬平台，用以評估主系統與次系統之性能與響應關係，並以行車型態為例，分析能量管理系統、引擎、馬達、燃料電池、變速箱與不同儲能電池彼此之特性影響，進一步完成整車調校與控制策略之修正；介紹節能車輛中所使用數學模型與相關理論，進一步連結到學生在實務時會遇到的實際案例，解釋所觀察到的物理反應現象。
description.en: Establish the energy-saving vehicle simulation platforms are developed in this study to evaluate performance and response between main system and subsystems. The driving cycles are adopted as an example and characteristics among energy management system (EMS), engine, motor, fuel cell, automated manual transmission (AMT) and Energy storage batteries are analyzed for further calibration and modification of control strategy. This course aims at teaching key mathematical models and related theories used in energy-saving vehicles, further links to actual cases that students will encounter on the scene, and explains the physical reaction phenomena observed.

description.zh: 本課程針對目前通用之真空系統原理、設計及實務組裝等議題進行說明與分析。將先針對真空系統進行分類說明，並陳述真空系統實務組裝時所要考慮的事項，以及說明真空系統的抽氣概念與設計。真空腔體的設計原理將會詳細說明，並介紹中低真空、高真空及超高真空的系統設計。
description.en: This class explains and analyzes issues concerning the principle, design, and assembly of vacuum systems that are commonly used today. We will begin with the classification of the vacuum system, then goes into the cautions regarding the assembly of the vacuum systems, as well as the concept and design of the air extraction of the vacuum system. We will also discuss the design principles for the vacuum cavity, and the system design for medium-low, high, and super-high vacuum systems.

description.zh: 實驗是進行科學與工程研究不可或缺的工具，實驗方法的設計與實驗數據的分析更是決定實驗結果品質優劣的關鍵，本課程將介紹實驗過程所必須具備的各項知識，以數據的量測與分析為開始，並介紹量測各類物理量的感測元件，如壓力、溫度、流量及聲波等，以建立學生具備實驗量測的基礎。課程主要內容包含有基本量測、量測標準、量測單位、訊號讀取、資料簡報、數據的準確性與變異性、類比訊號量測、數位訊號量測、系統響應、感測器。
description.en:
Introduction of Experiment and Measurement Method
Experiment is the essential tool for the research of science and engineering. The design of experiment and the analysis of data are the keys of the high quality of experiment. The course will introduce the materials of experiment and measurement. The procedures of measurement and the analysis method of data will be detailed investigated. And then the sensors to measure the interested physical parameters of pressure, temperature, flow rate and acoustic will be introduced. The technology of measurement and analysis of experiment will be built up in the course. The contents of the course are basic measurement, standards of measurement, dimension of measurement, access data, data presentation, accuracy and uncertainty of data, analog signal measurement, digital signal measurement, system response, and sensors.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹化學儲能裝置和儲冷系統之基礎與實務。課程內容包括：(一)儲能裝置理論與技術：電池儲能系統與模組、轉換器，各式燃料電池，如燐酸電池，質子交換電池等。(二)儲冷系統理論與技術：儲冰水式系統，各式儲冰系統如全凍結式、冰盤管式、冰泥式、動態製冰式、優態鹽及冰球式等。

name.en: The technology and application of solar thermal energy system

description.zh: 本課程目的為訓練學生獲得在太陽熱能系統與製程應用領域上高階智識理論。課程教材含蓋數種太陽熱能轉換系統用以產生電能、熱水、冷暖氣與照明等用途，主要內容包括太陽輻射幾何學、追日型太陽能聚光器、太陽能史特靈發電系統、太陽能熱水器、太陽能冷暖氣系統、太陽能海水淡化、太陽能照明系統等等章節。期使學生未來能實際應用於各種不同太陽熱能轉換系統之規劃與設計。
description.en: This course aims to give graduate student a resource on the advanced principles and application of solar thermal energy system and processes. The material presented in the course covers several technologies for the conversion of solar thermal energy to provide electricity, hot water, heating, and desalination. The course outline mainly includes analysis of solar geometry and radiation, performance of sun-tracking solar concentrating collectors, solar stirling power system, solar water heating system, solar space heating and cooling system, solar optical lighting system. It hops that the student can apply the learned knowledge to the plan and design of many types of variable solar thermal energy system in year to come.

syllabi.outline:
太陽能熱能工程應用，是一門利用太陽能之能量來提供人類能源之科學，太陽能為取之不盡用之不絕，且為乾淨又穩定之來源，在油價高漲且地球環境保護需求日益殷切的今日，太陽能之能源應用，已成為今日最熱門之學科。本學科之教學目標，在使學生了解基本之太陽能轉換為熱能、電能及照明之基本原理，並且經實際之能量轉換過程,以及熱力學之運用, 使學生對以太陽能為熱源之機械設備,如太陽能熱水器、太陽能冷凍空調設備、太陽能發電機、太陽能電池、太陽能照明設備等之應用，作深入之瞭解與認識，並可對相關產品做能量之計算及規劃設計,以使學生日後能為相關產業提供基礎人才。
本科目將由認識太陽、地球與太陽互動關係、地球上太陽能之基本熱輻射理論，結合各種不同形式之利用太陽能源有效裝置，討論太陽能之有效利用方式及相關系統技術。以期在既有太陽能利用技術上，發揮更有效率的太陽能源工程系統設計，奠定未來21世紀太陽能源利用之高效率化基礎。本門課主要為太陽能應用的原理分析及系統設計，課程內容包括太陽熱能系統的熱力熱傳及流體力學分析與系統設計、成本分析(為主)；太陽能光電系統的組成與設計分析(為輔)。

The application of solar thermal energy engineering is a science of using solar energy to provide human energy. Solar energy is inexhaustible, and it is a clean and stable source. Today, when oil prices are rising and the demand for environmental protection is increasing, The energy application of solar energy has become the most popular subject today. The teaching goal of this subject is to enable students to understand the basic principles of the conversion of solar energy into heat, electrical energy and lighting, and through the actual energy conversion process and the application of thermodynamics, to enable students to understand mechanical equipment that uses solar energy as a heat source, such as solar energy. In-depth understanding and understanding of the application of water heaters, solar refrigeration and air conditioning equipment, solar generators, solar cells, solar lighting equipment, etc., and energy calculation and planning and design of related products, so that students can provide for related industries in the future Basic talents.
This subject will discuss the effective use of solar energy and related system technologies by understanding the sun, the interaction between the earth and the sun, and the basic thermal radiation theory of solar energy on the earth, combining various effective devices for using solar energy sources. It is hoped that in the existing solar energy utilization technology, more efficient solar energy source engineering system design will be used to lay the foundation for the high efficiency of solar energy source utilization in the future 21st century. This course is mainly for the principle analysis and system design of solar energy applications. The content of the course includes thermal heat transfer and fluid mechanics analysis of solar thermal energy system and system design, cost analysis (mainly); composition and design analysis of solar photovoltaic system (secondary)

name.en: Philosophy of Technological and Vocational Education

description.zh: 本課程在探究技職教育的本質、目標、歷史發展及相關哲學思潮，期培養學生發展批判思考能力分析技職教育相關議題。
description.en: This course is designed to investigate the purpose, essence, history,    and related philosophical thinking of Vocational and Technological Technical Education (VTE)；to develop students forming critical thinking to analyze the current issues in VTE.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹技職教育之歷史發展與相關哲學思潮，綜採行歷史學、社會學、哲學與比較教育學的觀點，以專題討論的方式進行。期達成以下目標-
一、使學生瞭解技職教育的歷史發展與哲學理念
二、使學生瞭解台灣技職教育的變遷
三、使學生能比較及分析國內外技職教育之差異
四、使學生能以宏觀的視野與脈絡來透視技職教育問題並提出改革建議。
syllabi.schedule:
1.課程介紹
2..技職教育的理念
3.技術在歷史中的演化
4.技職教育哲學(一)
5.技職教育哲學(二)
6.Edgerton的技術史觀
7.中國古代科技思想對技職教育的啟示
8.戰後台灣的技職教育發展（一）1945-1965
9..戰後台灣的技職教育發展（二）1966-1987
10.戰後台灣的技職教育發展（三）1988-迄今
11.全球化對技職教育研究的啟示
12.其他技職教育史哲相關文獻評論
syllabi.assessment:
一、平時成績：每週指定文獻閱讀及討論40%
二、專題口頭報告30％

2.針對該主題對「技職教育」影響主持討論活動。
三、期末書面報告30%，依據期中口頭報告增刪，將修正後將電子檔寄給老師

name.zh: 教育訓練需求評估與規劃

description.zh: 教育訓練是人力資源的一環，本課程探討教育訓練的種類及評估訓練需求的方法與程序，並了解人力部門在規劃員工訓練計劃之前，如何對員工進行調查以確實地掌握員工的需求及意願，同時亦能掌握企業之發展目標。
description.en: Educational training is part of the human resources. This curriculum will discuss the categories of educational training and evaluate the methods and procedures of the training needs, and understand how the human resource department investigates the employee's needs and will, and know the development aim of the enterprise as well before the planning of the employee educational training program.

name.en: Career Planning and Management for Employees

description.zh: （一）瞭解生涯規劃與經營的理論及實務；（二）探討生涯規劃與經營模式；（三）應用生涯規劃與經營模式。課程內容包括：生涯規劃與生涯管理的定義、內涵與功能、生涯探究指引、生涯目標設定、生涯策略、生涯評估、生涯管理議題、人力資源支持系統及組織生涯管理系統。
description.en: The course arms to (1) Understand the theory and application Of career planning and management. (2) Explore the model of career planning and management. (3) Apply the career planning and management model. It covers the definition, essence, and function of career planning and management, a guide to career exploration, career goal setting, career strategies, career appraisal, and contemporary issues in career management, human resource support system, and organizational career management system.

description.zh:

(I) 高分子加工學之基礎(a)輸送現象(b)高分子黏彈學(c)高分子混煉。

description.en:
The course focuses on the "trouble shooting" in the polymer processing . Both theoretical and practical topics will be included. The main contents are devided into the following units :
(I)Fundamental Studies:(a)Transport Phenomena (b)Viscoelastic Properties of  Polymer Melt (c)Polymer Compounding and Blending.
(II)Practical Studies:(a)Compression Molding (b)Injection Molding (c)Reaction Injection Molding (d)Fiber Formation (e)Membrane
      Formation.

description.en: Two major goals of this course are spectroscopy and separation methods. Spectroscopy methods include ultraviolet, visible, infrared, nuclear magnetic, and x-ray spectroscopies.Election and mass spectrometry are also included. Separation methods are: gas, liquid, and gel chromatographies. In addition, GC-MS,LC-MS, GC-IR, etc. will be studied.

description.en: This course explores the principles of sustainable development in green chemistry technologies, including renewable resources, minimizing waste, and employing eco-friendly processes. name.en: Special Topics on Sustainable and Resilient Cities

description.zh: 該課程將研究在全球化與氣候變化下的永續與韌性城市發展策略；內容包括永續城市、創意城市、智慧城市、宜居城市、全球城市和後工業城市的各種概念。課程將引導學生參與學術性討論和永續與韌性的城市發展實務理解；提供在不同經濟、體制和文化環境下，探索其規劃政策和設計概念，並以實際案例借鑒不同城市之韌性的回復力規劃，以及說明如何促進城市韌性回復能力，減少社會失序和提高當地應變災害能力的積極策略，因此課程的目標包括讓學生參與永續城市發展的學術討論和韌性城市實踐方法，發展相關知識與了解促進韌性城市和永續性的國際實踐案例，期能將這些概念和經驗應用於規劃設計所需的研究和技能。
description.en: The course will examine strategies for sustainable and resilient urban development in the globalization and climate change. It will engage students in academic discussions and the practice of sustainable and resilient development. Planning policies and design concepts will be explored in different economic, institutional and cultural environments. Case studies draw on best practices in urban resilience planning in different cities, and will illustrate positive strategies to promote urban resilience, reduce social disruption, and improve local ability to deal with pressure. The objectives are to engage students in sustainable urban development, develop knowledge and understand good international practices that promote urban resilience and sustainability, and develop the research and skills necessary to apply these concepts and ideas to actual planning projects.

syllabi.outline:
韌性城市是回應環境變化以尋求新穩定狀態的住宅建築與聚落。由於氣候變遷逐漸影響居住環境，加以城市發展，消耗的能源與資源，促使碳排放增加，破壞自然界的循環，加劇氣候變遷；台灣位處自然災害脆弱帶，將近3/4面積與人口處於地震、颱風與洪患之複合性災害地區，宜積極強化住宅建築與都市設計之減緩與調適作為。研究顯示藉由建構永續與韌性機制，有助於建築及都市基盤設施系統，有效因應環境變化。
本課程將研究在全球化與氣候變化下的永續與韌性城市發展策略與行動方案；內容包括永續宜居與韌性調適的理論與實務；以實際案例借鑒不同住宅、社區與城市之韌性規劃，減少社會失序和提高應變災害能力的積極策略和實踐方法。

description.zh: 本課程以都市再生理念為中心，講述推動都市再生過程中面對相關文化資產保存議題之理論與實際操作架構。第一部份探討歷史文化保存相關理念手法。第二部份探討各國文化保存再生案例實踐之相關課題與借鏡，第三部份針對台灣本土都市更新過程中面臨歷史文化保存議題深入研討。
description.en:
This course regards urban revitalization as the central concept to discuss about the theory & implementation of history & culture conservation issues of urban revitalization. This course consisted of three parts. 
The first part is considered of relevant concepts & strategies of history and culture conservation. The second part is to survey different implemented examples of history and culture conservation of different country. The third part involves the regional issues by local-oriented issues of Taiwan. A few of cultural conservation topics are introduced to be further interpreted.

description.zh:
為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。本課程為第二階段之系列課程，其內容包括：
一.疫學：探討關於病態建築症候群的因素與特定外來的致病物質與疫之關聯。
二.家政事務：探討生活習慣、飲食生活的變化對環境、人體健康之影響。
三.醫療領域：探討病態建築症候群與化學物質過敏症的差異與因應對策。
四.日常領域：探討日常生活用品、居住行為對環境、人體健康之影響。
description.en: The main goal of this class is to pursue sustainable development and human health. In order to enhance the quality of residential and living environment in both existing and new-build dwellings, the course will cover important principles and topics in sick building environment, including medical, regulation, and architecture, chemical and biological. Specific contents include:(1)Immunology: to introduce the interactions between the immune system and the factors of sick building syndrome (SBS) and some specific pathogens.(2)Behavioral science: to investigate the influence of dietary and habit changes on environmental and human health.(3)Medical care: to introduce the difference and the response strategies between sick building syndrome (SBS) and Multiple Chemical Sensitivity (MCS)(4)Daily life: to investigate the influence of daily articles and resident behavior on environmental and human health.

Grading Policy
1. Research Ideas (25%): 
Originality: Are the ideas innovative or bringing fresh perspectives?
Relevance: Are the ideas aligned with the field of study and research objectives?
Feasibility: Are the ideas realistic and achievable within the scope of the research?

2. Critical Thinking (25%)
Depth of Analysis: Does the student critically engage with existing literature or problems?
Argumentation: Are arguments well-structured, logical, and supported by evidence?
Problem-Solving: Does the student demonstrate the ability to critically address challenges?

3. Research Tools (25%)
Proficiency: Is the student skilled in using appropriate research tools (e.g., statistical software, databases)?
Selection: Are the tools chosen suitable for the research questions and methodology?
Application: Is the student able to effectively apply the tools to gather and analyze data?

4. Research Motivation (25%)
Commitment: Does the student exhibit consistent effort and enthusiasm throughout the research process?
Curiosity: Is there a demonstrated eagerness to explore and learn?
Independence: How well does the student take initiative and responsibility for their research?

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 本課程提供關於語料庫應用的介紹，包含語料庫分析工具、分析方法、語料庫設計與建構，及語料庫為本的研究方法等；同時，本課程亦探討其在英語教學上的應用。主要的主題涵蓋字彙教學與學習、詞組分析、中介語分析、教材分析、言談分析，及電腦輔助語言學習等。修課學生將學習如何針對不同研究主題，收集語料、構建小型語料庫，並運用所學之語料庫軟體進行語料分析等。
description.en: This course offers an introduction to corpus linguistics, including the corpus analytical tools, techniques, corpus design and construction, and methodologies for doing corpus-based studies. We will also discuss its applications in English language teaching and learning. Major topics include vocabulary teaching and learning, analysis of chunks, teaching materials analysis, interlanguage analysis, discourse analysis, and computer-assisted language learning. Students are expected to learn to collect corpora data, create a small corpus, run and analyze corpora data according to different research topics.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to introduce to students the basic concepts, issues and skills of corpus linguistics, including types of corpora, corpus design and construction, corpus analytical tools and techniques, and methodologies for corpus-based studies. It will discuss the major uses of corpora and the applications of corpus linguistics in English language teaching and learning. In the class, students will read and discuss previous studies, and will be given hands-on activities to use corpora and corpus tools.

description.zh: 本課程將對英語文教學之趨勢與議題進行深入探討與分析，課程內容包含一般英語文(EGP)及專業英語文(ESP)之教學法、課程設計與英語教學實踐研究、全英語授課(EMI)、學科內容與語言整合教學(CLIL)、雙語教育及師資培育等相關議題。本課程在培養學生具有英語文教學與研究之理論基礎、研究設計及創新課程推動之應用能力。
description.en: This course is designed to engage students in intensive study and analysis of current and emerging issues and trends in English as a foreign language (EFL) teaching and research. Both teaching English for general purposes (EGP) and specific purposes (ESP) will be addressed regarding methods and techniques in implementing courses and teaching practice research. The issues related to bilingual education will also be discussed, including English as a medium of instruction (EMI), content and language integrated learning (CLIL), and bilingual teacher development. The course will provide theoretical foundations and applications in respect to research and innovations in teaching EFL across different education levels.

The subject's purpose is to provide an introduction of Nanoscience, Nanoengineering
and Nanotechnology; Physics and Chemistry and mechanical properties and applications 
of Nanomaterials; Nanofabrication of Nanopowder, Nanopartical, Nanofluid,

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

syllabi.outline:
課程目標：
本課程旨在全面探討企業倫理與永續經營的重要性，使學生了解企業在當今社會中應承擔的責任與角色。學生將學習企業社會責任（CSR）、利害關係人的倫理、以及企業對消費者、員工、股東和環境的倫理義務。本課程還將涵蓋ESG（環境、社會及公司治理）、公司治理標準，以及企業永續經營的各項指標與戰略，包括淨零排放、碳中和等主題。課程結束時，學生將能夠瞭解企業如何有效地實施倫理與永續經營的策略，並且能評估企業在這些領域的績效。

課程描述：
這是一門專注於企業倫理與永續經營的課程。課程從探討企業倫理的必要性開始，逐步深入到企業社會責任、對各利害關係人的倫理義務，以及ESG指標的理解與應用。學生將學習如何分析企業的社會與環境影響，並了解公司治理的不同階段。透過研究永續報告書的撰寫標準，學生將獲得實際操作企業永續經營報告的能力。此外，課程還涵蓋了Net Zero、碳中和、以及與氣候相關的金融風險管理。最終，學生將能夠綜合運用所學知識，評估和提出企業在永續經營方面的改進方案。
Course Objectives:
This course aims to comprehensively explore the importance of corporate ethics and sustainable management, enabling students to understand the responsibilities and roles that corporations should assume in today's society. Students will learn about Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), ethics in relation to various stakeholders, and the ethical obligations of corporations towards consumers, employees, shareholders, and the environment. The course will also cover Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) standards, corporate governance standards, and various indicators and strategies for sustainable corporate management, including topics like Net Zero emissions and carbon neutrality. By the end of the course, students will be able to understand how corporations can effectively implement strategies for ethics and sustainable management, and evaluate corporate performance in these areas.

description.en: Corporate governance is the combination of legal and political governance mechanisms external to the firm, along with monitoring and incentive governance mechanisms internal to the firm, linked and driven by the forces of investment markets, to produce value-increasing outcomes for firms' owners and, ultimately, society at large. In this course, we will survey corporate governance, taking the investor's point of view. By the end of the course, you should have a well-informed understanding of the basic corporate governance problem and the major issues in corporate governance, prominent proposed solutions to the corporate governance problem, the way the problem is actually addressed in a variety of companies and countries, and evidence on the prospects for and drawbacks of the various solutions. This course is therefore comprised of distinct intellectual components-the practice and the science-which are intertwined throughout the semester's activities.

description.zh: 本課程是針對高科技產業行銷管理的進階課程，目的是以行銷管理理論及案例討論方式，幫助學生熟悉高科技產業分析與行銷管理策略。關鍵概念包括傳統的行銷管理、高新技術產業B2B行銷管理、高科技導論、高科技企業之策略與企業文化、關係行銷、高科技企業之市場導向及研發與行銷的互動、高科技市場的行銷研究、了解高科技市場之顧客、高科技市場之後配銷通路與供應鏈管理、高科技市場之定價考量、高科技市場之廣告及促銷、及電子化企業及電子商務等研討。
description.en: This is an advanced course in marketing management for high-tech firms. The objective is to help students become familiar with industrial analysis and marketing management through marketing theories and cases. The key concepts include traditional marketing management, B2B Marketing Management, the introduction of high-tech Industry marketing, high-tech company's strategy and culture, relation marketing, marketing-R&D interaction, marketing research in high-tech markets, understanding high-tech customers, distribution channels and supply chain management, pricing consideration on high-tech marketing, advertising and promotion, E-business, case study, and term project.

syllabi.outline:
本課程探討當今新科技產業發展趨勢與國家政策推動，觀察科技政策與國家競爭力的影響，並以全球化的產業觀點、現今前瞻新科技的運用發展及各國案例討論方式，幫助同學了解高科技產業發展與國家推動策略，進而培養國際觀及全球化視野。課程內容注重理論與實務，會以演練及個案研究為主要教學內容。
This course discusses the development trend of today's new technology industry and the promotion of national policies, observes the impact of technology policies and national competitiveness, and helps students understand high technology with a global industrial perspective, the application and development of new technologies and case discussions in various countries Industrial development and national promotion strategies, and then cultivate an international outlook and a global perspective. The course content focuses on theory and practice, with drills and case studies as the main teaching content.

description.zh: 本課程探討的主題包括：電子商務的定義與架構、市場商機分析與風險評估、電子商務的經營模式及其對傳統經營模式造成的衝擊、顧客界面規劃設計、網路行銷與品牌塑造、實作導入、線上交易機制與資訊安全以及電子商務發展趨勢等相關議題，作深入淺出的探討。並以案例研討方式，加強學生理解，以達到最佳的學習效果。
description.en: This course mainly includes the following topics: 1.Overview of EC; 2.The opportunity and risk evaluation; 3.The business models of EC and impact on traditional businesses. 4. User interface planning; 5.The marketing strategies of EC; 6.How to install an EC; 7.Online transaction mechanisms and information security etc. Some real-world cases will also be discussed to enhance students' understanding and obtain the best learning effects.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將盡量從實務的角度來講解電子商務。

內容將採用理論與實作並行的方式。

課程理論部分將介紹電子商務的定義與發展歷史，涵蓋B2B、B2C、C2C、O2O等主要類型，並探討台灣電商業者發展平台的常見路徑。學生將學習經營電子商務的七種主要方式，包括自建平台、第三方平台銷售、微商、社交電商等，同時了解SEO-SEM、社群行銷、Email行銷和內容行銷等關鍵的網路行銷策略。後半部分課程還將結合案例探討供應鏈管理、社交媒體平台與網紅/KOL合作的經營模式、及跨境電商的趨勢。

課程實作部分將帶領學生開發電子商務網站，從前端技術（Html+CSS）到後端技術（PHP+MySQL）進行實際操作。此外，學生將學習如何使用JavaScript追蹤客戶行為，應用SEO技巧和響應性網頁設計（RWD）來提升網站在搜尋引擎的排名，並通過Google Analytics進行流量分析，以理論結合實作，提升學生的實務操作能力。

This course will approach e-commerce from a practical perspective.

The content will combine both theory and practical exercises.

The theoretical part of the course will introduce the definition and development history of e-commerce, covering major types such as B2B, B2C, and C2C, and exploring common pathways for developing e-commerce platforms by Taiwanese companies. Students will learn seven major ways to operate e-commerce, including self-built platforms, third-party platform sales, micronet, social e-commerce, and more. They will also gain an understanding of essential online marketing strategies such as SEO-SEM, social media marketing, email marketing, and content marketing. The latter part of the course will include case studies to explore supply chain management, business models involving social media platforms and influencer/KOL collaborations, and trends in cross-border e-commerce.

The practical part of the course will guide students in developing an e-commerce website, with hands-on practice in front-end technologies (Html+CSS) and back-end technologies (PHP+MySQL). Additionally, students will learn how to use JavaScript for customer behavior tracking, apply SEO techniques and responsive web design (RWD) to improve search engine rankings, and utilize Google Analytics for traffic analysis. This combination of theory and practice aims to enhance students' practical skills in e-commerce.

description.zh:
設計科學研究重視創造與解決現實世界問題相關且實用的成品或服務。目標是開發具有實用價值並可在實務中實施的解決方案或進一步進行設計驗證。課堂進行方式，除了方法講解，將於課堂採用方法卡與結構化的課堂互動模式，深化學生對設計學在學術研究方法的認識與應用。學生將學會：
1.理解設計學的範疇與趨勢
2.理解如何擬定研究命題與設計研究方法
3.理解量化與質性研究方法
4.理解研究結果的詮釋與視覺化
5.擬定研究命題、研究框架、研究流程與方法
description.en:
Design science research values the creation of finished products or service that are relevant and useful in solving real-world problems. The goal is to develop solutions that have practical value and can be implemented in practice or for further design verification. In addition to method explanations, method cards and a structured classroom interaction mode will be used in class to deepen students' understanding and application of design methods in academic research. Students will learn:
1.Understand the scope and trends of design
2.Understand how to formulate research propositions and design research methods
3.Understand quantitative and qualitative research methods
4.Understand the interpretation and visualization of research results
5.Formulate research propositions, research framework, research processes and methods

syllabi.outline:
設計科學研究重視創造與解決現實世界問題相關且實用的成品或服務。目標是開發具有實用價值並可在實務中實施的解決方案或進一步進行設計驗證。課堂進行方式，除了方法講解，將於課堂採用方法卡與結構化的課堂互動模式，深化學生對設計學在學術研究方法的認識與應用。學生將學會：
1.理解設計學的範疇與趨勢
2.理解如何擬定研究命題與設計研究方法
3.理解量化與質性研究方法
4.理解研究結果的詮釋與視覺化
5.擬定研究命題、研究框架、研究流程與方法
Design science research values the creation of finished products or service that are relevant and useful in solving real-world problems. The goal is to develop solutions that have practical value and can be implemented in practice or for further design verification. In addition to method explanations, method cards and a structured classroom interaction mode will be used in class to deepen students' understanding and application of design methods in academic research. Students will learn:
1.Understand the scope and trends of design
2.Understand how to formulate research propositions and design research methods
3.Understand quantitative and qualitative research methods
4.Understand the interpretation and visualization of research results
5.Formulate research propositions, research framework, research processes and methods

description.zh: 21世紀國際為確保環境、經濟、社會之永續發展，國際紛紛採取氣候變遷相關因應措施，低碳與淨零已成為全球之共同趨勢。本課程將介紹能源轉型/節能減碳與低碳經濟及社會之國際趨勢、國際溫室氣體減量與能源安全相關法規、我國溫室氣體減量與節能相關法規等，並介紹碳足跡、碳中和等概念，由國際相關案例看我國邁向低碳經濟與社會挑戰與機會。
description.en: To ensure the sustainable development of environment, economy and society, effective measures are gradually adopted by internationals. Low-Carbonization and Net-Zero Emission obviously becomes a global common tendency. This course will be introduced the international tendencies of “energy saving & carbon reduction” and “low-carbon society”. It will also be introduced with related regulations of international greenhouse gases reduction, energy security, Taiwan GHG reduction, energy saving. The above concepts and latter concepts of carbon footprints and carbon neutral will be introduced with international practical cases to refer to challenges as well as chances toward a low-carbon Economy and society in Taiwan.

syllabi.outline:
聯合國政府間氣候變化專門委員會(Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, IPCC) 2022年2月公布第六次評估報告(IPCC AR6)指出，全球暖化將在近20年內升溫至攝氏1.5度，多種氣候危害的增加，如極端氣候災難、熱浪、生物多樣性喪失等，全球皆無法倖。這些危害衝擊到了能源、水資源與糧食安全，並造成許多居住地與生物棲地的喪失。

科學證實，氣候變遷的負面影響十分危急，引起了國際社會、跨國企業及在地團體的高度關注。各國積極提出「2050淨零排放」的宣示與行動，顯示出全球共同應對氣候變遷的決心。

根據數據，臺灣的溫室氣體排放總量已逐步減緩並與經濟成長脫鉤，且2019年，溫室氣體淨排放量為265.62百萬公噸二氧化碳當量，已降至2005年基準年水準以下。同時，碳排放密集度（即每單位GDP的二氧化碳排放量）較基準年減少了約34%，顯示臺灣的溫室氣體排放已經與經濟成長脫鉤。

為了共同承擔全球減碳目標我國已將2050淨零排放納入法律框架，引領未來中長期因應氣候衝擊的行動。此舉必須透過跨世代、跨領域、跨國際的轉型工程，方可達標。
在實現2050淨零排放的目標上，臺灣已推動能源、產業、生活、社會等四大轉型策略。這些策略將幫助臺灣逐步邁向永續社會。國際為確保環境、經濟、社會之永續發展，更積極落實在因應氣候變遷對環境、人類生存和國家安全的威脅轉型路徑策略上，巴黎協定後全球已有130多國提出「2050淨零排放」的宣示與行動。為國際接軌此一全球趨勢，各國紛紛採取氣候變遷綠色新政，低碳與淨零已成為全球之共同時尚趨勢。本課程將介紹能源轉型/節能減碳與低碳經濟及社會之國際趨勢、國際落實淨零之路徑與溫室氣體減量與能源安全相關法規、我國氣候與能源相關法規等，並介紹碳足跡、碳中和等概念，由國際相關案例看我國邁向低碳經濟與社會挑戰與機會。

Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) Sixth Assessment Report (AR6) February 2022 The IPCC AR6 report indicates that global warming will raise temperatures to 1.5°C within the next 20 years. This will lead to increased climate hazards such as extreme weather events, heatwaves, and biodiversity loss, affecting all parts of the world. These impacts threaten energy, water, and food security, leading to the loss of both habitats and living spaces.

Scientific evidence highlights the urgent negative effects of climate change, which have drawn significant attention from the international community, multinational corporations, and local groups. Countries worldwide have committed to "Net Zero Emissions by 2050," demonstrating a collective determination to address climate change.

Taiwan's Greenhouse Gas Emissions Data shows that Taiwan's total greenhouse gas emissions have gradually decoupled from economic growth. In 2019, Taiwan's net greenhouse gas emissions were 265.62 million metric tons of CO2 equivalents, below the baseline year of 2005. Furthermore, the carbon emission intensity (emissions per unit of GDP) has decreased by about 34% compared to the baseline year, indicating that Taiwan's emissions have been decoupled from its economic growth.

Net Zero Emissions by 2050 Taiwan has incorporated the goal of net zero emissions by 2050 into its legal framework, guiding future medium- and long-term actions to mitigate climate impacts. Achieving this goal requires a cross-generational, cross-sectoral, and cross-national transformation effort.

Four Major Transformation Strategies To achieve the 2050 net zero emissions target, Taiwan has promoted four major transformation strategies: energy, industry, lifestyle, and society. These strategies will help Taiwan gradually move towards a sustainable society. Internationally, to ensure sustainable development of the environment, economy, and society, more active implementation of climate change mitigation pathways is necessary. Since the Paris Agreement, over 130 countries have declared actions toward "Net Zero Emissions by 2050." Low-carbon and net zero have become global trends.

Course Overview This course will introduce international trends and implementations of energy transition, energy conservation, carbon reduction, low-carbon economy, and society. It will cover regulations related to greenhouse gas reduction and energy security, as well as Taiwan's climate and energy laws. Additionally, it will discuss concepts like carbon footprint and carbon neu

syllabi.outline:
類神經網路具有universal approximation的特性（非線性函數近似器）；因此，其可被應用於控制器設計。另外，其也可被應用於解決分類/迴歸（函數近似）（時間序列建模與預測）問題。本課程內容包含：(1) 介紹，(2) 類神經網路，(3) 類神經網路應用於分類問題，(4) 類神經網路應用於迴歸（函數近似）問題以及(5) 應用。
This course covers important concepts and topics of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) that can be developed and used to solve classification or function approximation problems. The outline of this course is given as follows. (1) Introduction, (2) ANN, (3) ANN applied in classification, (4) ANN applied in function approximation, and (5) Applications.

name.zh: 綠能產業政策與經濟分析
name.en: Industrial Policy of Green Energy and Economic Analysis

description.zh:
在推動國家經濟發展，提升環境保護和創造國家競爭力，政府對於科技政策之擬定，及科技經費之持續支持十分重要，並以此培植科技人才、將科技研發成果加以推廣。為確保有限之科技資源能夠發揮其最高之效用，建立客觀及公正之績效評估制度實屬必要。本課程擬以最近影響人類生活環境甚巨之全球暖化現象( Global Warming )，及其引發之綠能科技投資為例，探討綠能科技政策之擬訂，以及綠能產業經濟分析。
綠色能源包括風能、太陽能、生質能、氫能與燃料電池、地熱能、海洋能與淨煤技術，發展綠能產業即具備「3E」平衡發展之功效，已成各國追求之目標。
本課程預計將涵蓋以下主題：
替代能源介紹（包括生質能源，如生質柴油與酒精汽油，以及氫能與燃料電池等）
再生能源介紹（包括太陽能、風能、水力發電、地熱及海洋能等）
二氧化碳捕捉與封存、淨煤專題
LED專題等
description.en:
Many scientists conclude that the increased greenhouse effect is already accelerating global warming and leading to the climate change. Worldwide government are taking measures to tackle this issue and outlining strategies to bring the greenhouse effect under control.
Greenhouse gas emissions in Taiwan are mainly from burning fossil fuels such as crude oil, coal and LPG and the energy imports have reached 99.22%. Therefore, the sustainable development in any country is to increase the proportion of self-generation of energy, reduce the emission of GHGs, and balance among Economic Growth, Environment Protection and Energy Supply.
Green energy (Renewable energy) covers the fields of solar and wind energy, biofuels which includes biodiesel and bioethanol, hydrogen energy and fuel cell, geothermal and ocean energy as well as clean coal combustion technologies (IGCC). Balancing development of '3E' can be achieved by developing green energy industries and which is also the goal every count

description.zh: 本課程主要以實務案例之解析為內容，並結合商標法理論剖析之教學方式，來深入介紹我國商標實務上之重要爭議，讓同學了解司法實務中，如何具體適用法律、判決或學說等。此外，本課程亦將分別介紹國外相關學說理論及著名司法案例，期望同學透過本課程之修習，來培養對國內外商標法案例思辨及評析之能力。
description.en: Primary contents of this course are focused on case analyses, and its teaching method is trademark legal theories analyses in order to further introduce significant disputes about Taiwan trademark practices. Thus, students could understand how to concretely apply laws, precedents, or theories to judicial practices. In addition, this course will also introduce relevant foreign theories and well-known judicial cases to develop students’ abilities of examining and analyzing domestic/foreign trademark cases when students take this course.

syllabi.outline: 商標法係為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展所制定之法律。商標得以文字、圖形、記號、顏色、聲音、立體形狀或其聯合式所組成，並應足以使商品或服務之相關消費者認識其為表彰商品或服務之標識，藉以與他人之商品或服務相區別。凡因表彰自己之商品或服務，欲取得商標權者，應依該法申請註冊。本課程將兼顧實例與理論之探討，讓同學能夠深入對商標法之瞭解。

description.zh: 本課程為一延續性的專題研究，其目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: This special topic is a continuous course within two semesters. This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, interactive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and practice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct a multi-disciplines learning environment which performs a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate a interactive media design project.

description.zh: 課程分為兩主軸，技術成面以感知真實的角度循序討論數位呈現的相關技術。在研究理論方面則介紹相關之現有研究、研究工具、與研究方法，並討論與人互動之感知研究的理論與操作，心理物理學的實驗設計與受試者保護規範之實驗計畫書撰寫。
description.en: This course introduces research methods applicable in the field of design with particular emphasize on the human interaction. Topics including Psychophysics, perceptual study, HCI experiment design, hypothesis testing, and statistical analysis. The aim of this course is to help students in identifying a research topic in the field of interaction design, designing an experiment, and preparing the necessary documents including research proposal and consent form to recruit human subjects to participate in the experiment.

Technologically, this course reviews the recent developments on research-based interaction design. Theoretically, this course introduces the theories and methodologies of the research applications in the field of human-computer interaction and teaches how to design a HCI experiment.

description.zh:
希望朝著技術訓練、實際運用與實驗性創作，三個層面進行課程上的交織鋪陳。在虛擬成像的關鍵技術上給予學生3D物件創作及影像合成的知識，並獲得自行研發與創造視覺效果的能力。
在熟悉3d創作工具的同時，利用軟體本身多元並高度的掌控性，重組物理世界的運行法則，利用像是重力、碰撞、光影、質感等，並企圖創造出各種感知進化的契機。
description.en:
By utilizing technical training, practical application and experimental creations as three aspects for intertwining in this courses. To offer the 3D object creation and image synthesis as the key techniques of virtual imaging for students knowledge development, and access to the ability of self researching and development for creating visual effects.
While familiar this creative methods, using software itself as highly diverse controlling tools to reorganizing the rules of the physical world , such as gravity, collision, light, texture, etc., and attempting to create a variety of perceptual evolutionary opportunity.

description.zh: 課程主要為介紹學術界最新的深度學習研究成果，教導學員使用Python深度學習套件，讓學員能將深度學習技術應用於各個不同的領域。課程內容包括：●車牌與門牌數字辨識 ●人臉辨識 ●1000種影像分類 ●辨識9000種物件 ●自動駕駛模擬 ●嵌入式深度學習演算法 空虛，寂寞，覺得冷？讓深度學習來幫助你 ●遞迴式神經網路 (RNN)：找不到人聊天？訓練自己的聊天機器人 ●對抗生成網路(GAN)：用 GAN 產生自己的夢中情人 ●深度強化學習(DRL)：訓練AI跟你一起玩遊戲
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce latest deep learning researches and allow students to develop deep learning applications using Python library (TensorFlow & Keras). The content includes: ●Number recognition of License plate and Doorplate ●Face Recognition ●1000 Image Classification ●9000 Object Detection ●Autopilot simulation ●Embedded Deep Learning Algorithms ●Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) ●Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) ●Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) ●Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) ●Deep Reinforcement Learning

name.zh: 人工智慧跨領域專題實作
name.en: Interdisciplinary Project in Artificial Intelligence Applications

description.zh: 本課程運用問題分析能力，以企業實際問題為基礎，採用問題導向學習（PBL）模式，進行人工智慧跨域專題實作。課程的目的是幫助學生理解如何運用人工智慧技術來解決現實世界中的問題。透過學習機器學習、光學檢測、影像辨識、生成式AI、自然語言處理等AI技術，學生將能跨域應用這些知識於數據分析、高速通訊、資訊安全、專案管理、企業管理與決策、金融商業服務、智慧製造、無人載具、國防太空、智慧農業、醫療、法律、半導體、藝術創作、環境監測等領域。本課程將培養學生實際操作人工智慧的能力，提升其問題解決和創新思維，並培育具有創業和創新精神的人才，讓學生了解在AI轉型和導入過程中產業所面臨的挑戰與困難。
description.en:
This course uses a problem-based learning (PBL) approach to tackle real-
world business issues, guiding students through interdisciplinary AI projects. It
aims to teach students how to apply AI technologies such as machine learning,
image recognition, and natural language processing across various domains
like data analysis, healthcare, and smart manufacturing. Students will gain
practical skills, enhance problem-solving abilities, and develop innovative
thinking. The course prepares students to handle AI projects, understand
industry challenges, and cultivate entrepreneurial and innovative spirits.

name.en: Measurement and Analysis for Business Decision Making

description.zh: 本課程為學生提供商業決策背景下財務報告、分析和衡量問題的全面概述。學生將了解財務報表及其基本衡量標準。然後，他們將利用這種理解來使用財務比率進行分析。然後，學生將探索成本衡量、分配等在確定組織各部分的績效衡量方面的作用，以及它們與在各種商業環境中選擇和評估戰略的相互關係。他們將涵蓋諸如匹配策略與績效衡量、選擇和評估關鍵績效指標和平衡計分卡等問題。
description.en: This course provides students with a comprehensive overview of financial reporting, analysis and measurement issues in the context of business decision making. Student will gain an understanding of financial statements and their underlying measurements. They will then use this understanding to conduct analyses using financial ratios. Students will then explore the role of cost measurements, allocations, etc. in determining the performance measures of parts of the organization and their inter-relationship with both choosing and evaluating strategies in various business contexts. They will cover issues such as matching strategies to performance measures, choosing and evaluating key performance indicators and balanced scorecards, etc.

name.zh: 海外管理實務觀摩與跨境研習
name.en: Overseas Management Practice and Cross-border Studies

description.zh: 本課程將安排學生組團由學院教授帶領到境外EMBA專班或國外（含中國大陸）大學交流學習，瞭解該國地域性的產業型態與國家經濟政策，另安排到當地企業廠商做實地觀摩與考察。返校後由領隊教授引導主持，進行綜合討論，學生必須在返台灣後一個月內提交心得報告及建議。
description.en: The course will arrange the student group led by the college professor to the overseas EMBA class or foreign (including mainland China) universities to study and learn about the country's regional industrial type and national economic policy. They will then conduct the tours of local businesses. Upon returning, a seminar, facilitated by the professors, will be held to exchange views and opinions. Students are required to submit a final report with recommendations within one month after their return to Taiwan.

公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。

description.zh: 金融科技是近年來新興的產業趨勢，影響的層面非常廣泛，不只是金融方面，更牽涉到新興科技與物聯網。本課程將從不同的角度分析金融科技的技術內容、應用領域及商業模式，並藉由國內外重要金融科技公司發展的經驗做一介紹，希望達到了解並運用此新興科技的目的。本課程內容包括:金融科技概論、金融科技商業模式、金融大數據、P2P 借貸、虛擬貨幣、雲端服務、第三方支付、群眾募資、區塊鏈、跨境電商、程式交易、機器人理財等主題。
description.en: FinTech includes two words: Finance and Technology. It is a new trend of industrial field. It has influences on lots of technical fields, not only finance, but also emerging technologies and IoT. This course will analyze FinTech from different angles, such as technology contents, application fields and business models. It also will utilize experiences of leading companies with FinTech to obtain decent knowledge of this new field. The contents of this course include introduction to financial technology, business models of financial technology, finance big data, P2P lending, virtual money, cloud services, third-party payment, crowd funding, blockchain, cross-border e-commerce, program trading, and robotic financial advisory etc.

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上建立足夠的知識與技能。課程內容主要分為兩部分，第一部分將介紹論文架構，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided into two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin with the introduction of different quantitative methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussions, assignments, term-projects, and in-class practices. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, and some basic multivariate

name.en: Overseas Management Practice and Cross-border Studies

description.zh: 本課程將安排學生組團由學院教授帶領到境外EMBA專班或國外（含中國大陸）大學交流學習，瞭解該國地域性的產業型態與國家經濟政策，另安排到當地企業廠商做實地觀摩與考察。返校後由領隊教授引導主持，進行綜合討論，學生必須在返台灣後一個月內提交心得報告及建議。
description.en: The course will arrange the student group led by the college professor to the overseas EMBA class or foreign (including mainland China) universities to study and learn about the country's regional industrial type and national economic policy. They will then conduct the tours of local businesses. Upon returning, a seminar, facilitated by the professors, will be held to exchange views and opinions. Students are required to submit a final report with recommendations within one month after their return to Taiwan.

name.en: Management Case Writing and Research Methods

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹管理個案的寫作與研究方法，藉由各種量化和質性的方法，如EXCEL及SPSS程式語言等分析個案資料，結合理論與實務，發掘、陳述、分析個案，以設計和實施單一個案研究和撰寫管理個案。
description.en: This course introduces the writing and research methods of management cases. It analyzes case data through various quantitative and qualitative methods, such as EXCEL and SPSS programming language. The course combines theory and practice, and discovers, presents and analyzes cases to design and implement a single case study and writing a management case.

Week 09  : 個案進度報告與討論(耿慶瑞)。每組報告13分鐘。教學手冊範例: 匯豐汽車－開啟電子化的eMentor系統
Week 10  : 個案進度報告與討論(耿慶瑞)。每組報告13分鐘。
Week 11  : 個案進度報告與討論(耿慶瑞)。每組報告13分鐘。
Week 12  : 完整個案發表，包括個案本文與教學手冊(耿慶瑞)。

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上建立足夠的知識與技能。課程內容主要分為兩部分，第一部分將介紹論文架構，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided into two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin with the introduction of different quantitative methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussions, assignments, term-projects, and in-class practices. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, and some basic multivariate

syllabi.outline:
本課程目的在如何維繫顧客忠誠？透過CRM 的機制，不斷獲得客戶的進店造訪、不斷消費、繼續的與店家維繫關係，重複消費和推薦客人的機制，便是成功的運用CRM 機制。
忠誠的顧客對企業來說就是一種年金收入— 亦即數年間營收的持續來源。
顧客與業者往來的時間愈長，企業獲得的利潤愈高，每位顧客的年獲利是逐年增加的。獲利成長的因素：
來自消費增加的獲利 （Top Line)
來自服務成本降低的獲利(利潤高Bottom Line）
顧客推薦帶來的獲利
價格敏感度低，業者可以收取溢價(price premium)，進而提高獲利
取得顧客的成本可以在較長的時間內攤銷

description.zh:
本行為經濟專題課程: 
1.	介紹全球總體經濟以及政經情勢探討: 從消費、投資、政府支出、進口、出口、外匯、利率、失業率、政府政策、地理位置等方面來分析經濟行為以及決策行為。
2.	介紹管理者或一般大眾在作決策時，會產生的心理偏誤。另外，也提供管理者或一般大眾如何避心理偏誤，並改善其決策程序，以心理學的角度來探討。
3.	從總體經濟數據中，找出可行投資方向。
4.	運用幾位諾貝爾經濟學獎得主之文章，來介紹公司(個人)行為決策
5.	公司或個人如何利用期貨選擇權來進行公司(個人)理財投資行為之介紹
description.en: The empirical and theoretical evidence for the efficient market hypothesis (EMH) has been challenged over the past two decades. Behavioural Economics starts from the premise that, in the real world, investors do not follow the rational assumptions which underlie the EMH. Behavioural Economics has developed to try to explain financial market anomalies which could effect the functioning of these markets.

2.	介紹管理者或一般大眾在作決策時，會產生的心理偏誤。另外，也提供管理者或一般大眾如何避心理偏誤，並改善其決策程序，以心理學的角度來探討。
3.	從總體經濟數據中，找出可行投資方向。
4.	運用幾位諾貝爾經濟學獎得主之文章，來介紹公司(個人)行為決策
5.	公司或個人如何利用期貨選擇權來進行公司(個人)理財投資行為之介紹
The empirical and theoretical evidence for the efficient market hypothesis (EMH) has been challenged over the past two decades. Behavioural Economics starts from the premise that, in the real world, investors do not follow the rational assumptions which underlie the EMH. Behavioural Economics has developed to try to explain financial market anomalies which could effect the functioning of these markets.

description.zh: 本課程從品牌在公司經營中所應扮演的策略性角色，課程中以品牌理論來探討品牌行銷策略的重要關鍵議題。課程內容包含品牌特性、品牌權益、品牌行銷、品牌競爭、品牌策略。身為公司品牌經營者，面對國際化與多變化的行銷環境中，能做出最佳的品牌行銷決策。
description.en: This program is designed to help students learn about and apply the concepts and practices of branding as they are used in a wide variety of settings in product and service firms, consumer and business markets, organizations, business. The topics covered in this class include: The nature of brand, brand marketing, brand competition, brand strategy. After taking the course, the students should be able to make the best brand decisions under the internationalized and changeable marketing environment.

syllabi.schedule:
次(日期)	主題	內容與個案
 13
	品牌行銷補充資料	廣告影片分析
 
 
14	行銷個案：內容角色品牌管理
 	哈佛商學院HBS: Case 1: Marvel
1.請問Marvel 的Vice Chairman Peter Cuneo應該要追求何種的策略方向？
2.為何Marvel 的轉型是成功的？你認為這個成功只是暫時的？還是會持續的？
3.請說明Marvel漫畫（comic books），玩具(toys)與授權(licensing)三個事業部的重要性？以及三者有何綜效？
4.你是否認為Marvel的成功只靠著蜘蛛人一個角色？Marvel是否該發展一些較不知名的角色？要如何做？
 
15
	行銷個案：平台式品牌
 	哈佛商學院HBS Case2: Uber
1.	請分析消費者在搭乘汽車的消費行為，並與Uber及其競爭者比較。
2.	請評估Uber之APP有何優缺點
3.	你對Uber的服務行銷有何建議?台灣與大陸市場有何建議?
4.	共享經濟的營運模式成功要素為何?
 
 
16	品牌行銷與廣告創意
  	哈佛商學院HBS: Case3: Mountain Dew
1.請分析Mountain Dew與其他競爭者的差異，定位有何不同?
2.你建議選擇最後五個中的哪些創意?
3.對投放在Super Bowl的廣告有何建議?
4.2000年非碳酸飲料崛起，你對Mountain Dew有何建議?
 
17	行銷個案：品牌與通路	哈佛商學院HBS: Case4: Longchamp
1.	Le Piage為何如此成功?它在Longchamp的角色為何?
2.你覺得要如何管理Le Piage的產品線?
3.你認為Lonchamp品牌定位如何?
4.你建議Longchamp的通路策略為何?

18	行銷個案：品牌全球化
	哈佛商學院HBS: Case3: AKB48:Going Global
1.	AKB48的品牌定位為何?
2.	AKB48目前遇到的問題為何?
3.	AKB48要如何往海外發展?

name.en: The Leadership Philosophy of Senior Manager

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹高階主管的領導理論與實務。課程目的有三個：(1)了解高階主管的領導與管理；(2)討論領導與組織管理的理論與實證發現之間的差異；(3)對實務界高階主管提供具體建議。
description.en: This course focuses on the theory and practice of senior manager’s leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is (especially for the senior managers); (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for senior managers’ leadership.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.
