description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.outline:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。
本國語文課程以《世說新語》為主要文本，這部由南朝劉義慶編撰的經典筆記小說，內容涵蓋魏晉南北朝時期的逸聞軼事與人物風貌。通過閱讀、分析和討論，學生將深入了解魏晉風度、清談文化以及個人與社會價值觀的演變，並認識《世說新語》的文學價值及其對後世的影響。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline:
ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。

description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

包括製作模型所需用之各種機械設備操作、使用工具、紙模型、工業油土等之加工技術
Training students to operate some basically equipment such as bench work, sheet metal, machining, and welding machines safely and correctly, giving them the primary skills in model making.
syllabi.schedule:
第一階段 （1-5週）
1. 學生進行家具試作預備課程與木工基礎訓練。
2. 實際在教學現場（實習工廠）製作手工木工產品，經由老師現場講解，並經由操作示範後，學生自行操作木工機械：包括鋸切、鉋削、鑽孔與砂光等進行家具製作程序。


第二階段 （6-9週）
藉由口授、講義之影片、圖像與文字等詳述木製家具製程與實務，培養訓練學生對家具製造之程序、生產速度及各種工廠設備與製造系統之整合觀念，並配合教學進度至工廠實務操作與流程走位的方式進行理解加工生產線的環境狀況。


第三階段 （10-18週）
分為兩項考核方式進行
一、以場域實作與測驗的方式進行加工知識面向之考核：
1. 透過家具加工操作任務去測驗學生是否能夠充分理解各生產線流程之加工方式與用途，請學生實際的操演與示範講解。
2. 請學生實際透過分組規劃與討論去對應不同家具類型安排出正確之生產加工步驟與程序。
3. 另出應用題類型之不同家具產品所需的生產加工方式安排為何，請同學規劃並詳述之。
4. 業師的評估與觀察搭配產業實習的經驗回饋。

二、以實際操作機具的方式進行實務操作面向之考核：
操作內容包括：平刨機、裁切機、鑽孔機、砂磨機等，以本系實作工廠之現有機台為主，測驗學生是否能熟練運用木工加工所需之機具與了解生產線之間的關係與相關注意事項。

description.zh: 傢俱塗裝為傢俱外觀重要的製程，本課程教導學生了解傢俱塗裝專業知識與生產規劃，主要包括: 1.傢俱塗料的種類。例如: 刷塗、噴塗、滾筒塗佈、簾幕式塗佈 2.傢俱塗裝方式的選擇。 3.傢俱塗裝作業方式，塗料乾燥、固化及硬化方法。 4.不同塗裝方式在外觀與維護上之影響。 5.塗膜缺陷與對策。 6.塗裝線規劃。
description.en: Furniture finish is an important part of appearance, This course will help students to understand furniture finishing and Manufacturing process, include 1. Furniture coatings category. ex: brushing、spraying、roller coating、curtain coating… 2. How to choose best way of coating process. 3. Coating process, curing, drying and hardening of paint. 4. The appearance and maintain in different finish. 5. Coating defects and solution. 6. Production planning.

description.zh: 本課程之目的為使學生瞭解生產計畫與管制的基本概念，訓練學生對於生產計畫與管制的各項方法，制度設計及改善等具有基本認識，並應用管理科學及作業研究於生產計畫與管制之研究發展。本課程包括下列主題：生產計畫與管制概論、產品設計與發展、預測、來源需求規畫、生產排程、總排程、存貨管理、豐田式管理、專案規畫與管理等。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to introduce the fundamental concepts of production planning and control. In addition, applications of management science and operations research in production control and planning are also provided. This course is consisted of the following subjects: introduction, product design and development, forecasting, resources requirement planning, production scheduling, total scheduling, inventory management, Toyota management, and project management.

description.en: Through the detailed explanations of multiple focusing adjustments and image correcting methods of the view camera (large format camera) to help students master the operation of the camera and many other photo taking techniques. The students shall be able to take picture of their own designing product (showing the right material quality, surface texture, the form, volume, weight and color).Furthermore, the students are requested to learn, to make full use of their knowledge as to show the character, function, value and uniqueness of their product in the picture for the purpose marketing promotion and exhibition.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh:
本課程引入程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以 C 語言為基礎，於熟習基本
程式語法後，再導入 C++程式語言。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，
同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概
念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
description.en:
This course introduces to the students the basic computer programming concepts.
Syntax and semantics of the C and C++ programming languages will be introduced.
Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer
solutions, effective methods of program design using structured programming notions
of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 能源在日常生活中以很多型態呈現，大量的能源使用於汽車動力、食物與用水加熱、產品製造、發電及其他不同事務。使用傳統能源會排放空氣污染物，因而引起鄰近地區、區域、跨國境空氣污染問題，甚至是全球的環境衝擊效應。本課程將檢視能源使用現況及其衍生的環境議題，並且探討能源使用之趨勢。傳統能源(如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等)、及再生能源(如太陽能、水力、風能、地熱能等)及能源效率等內容，都將於課程中介紹
description.en: Energy enters our everyday lives in many ways. Prodigious amounts of energy are used to power automobiles, heat food and water, manufacture products, generate electricity, and perform various other tasks. The use of traditional energy will emit air pollutants that may result in regional air pollution problem as well as global effects. In this course we will look at the current energy situation, its environmental implications, and try to determine the patterns of energy use. We will look at energy use as coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear energy, and renewable energy, such as solar energy, hydroelectric

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹各種再生能源的原理與發展現況，包括太陽能、風能、波浪能、潮汐能、海流能、海洋熱能、鹽差能、生物能、水力能、地熱能、氫與燃料電池等，其有關的主要技術和成本、對環境造成的衝擊、來源的規模潛力及其未來前景。並檢視各種傳統能源如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等之使用現況及其衍生的環境議題。
Knowing the principle and development of each renewable energy, including solar energy, wind energy, ocean energy (wave energy, tide energy, ocean thermal energy, ocean salinity gradient energy), hydro energy, geothermal energy, biomass energy, and fuel cell. Realizing their potential, impact on the environment, and future perspective.

1.Course introduction, 2.Energy overview, 3.Solar energy(1), 4.Solar energy(2), 5.Wine energy(1), 6.Wine energy(2), 7.Ocean energy(1), 8.Ocean energy(2), 9.Midterm report, 10.Hydro energy, 11.Geothermal rnergy, 12.Biomass energy(1), 13.Biomass energy(2), 14.Hydrogen/Fuel cell, 15.Energy storage and transportation(1), 16.Energy storage and transportation(2), 17.Fossil energy, 18.Final report

description.zh: 本課程旨在為學生奠定紮實的英語文法與句型結構基礎，幫助學生掌握不完整句、連寫句、誤置修飾語、不連結修飾語、錯誤平行結構等關鍵文法知識。於此基礎上，課程將進一步培養學生的段落寫作技巧，包括敘述、描述、闡釋和論證等，使學生能撰寫條理分明、結構嚴謹之段落。
description.en: This course provides a solid foundation in English grammar and sentence construction, helping students master key grammatical elements like sentence fragments, run-on sentences, misplaced modifiers, dangling modifiers, and faulty parallelism. Building upon this grammatical foundation, this course further develops students’ paragraph writing skills through techniques such as narration, description, exposition, and argumentation, enabling students to craft well-structured paragraphs.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to help students learn the correct usage of English grammar and master the paragraph-length writing. It will develop students’ writing skills from expressing an idea into a complete English sentence to organizing ideas into a structured paragraph. Students are expected to be able to use effective definition, description, illustration, argumentation and narration in their paragraph writing. Plenty of discussion will take place in class and active participation is highly required of students.

description.zh: 本課程目的在啟發學生英語聽力，分析及思辨能力。本課程自報紙，雜誌及電視選取豐富的新聞及媒體教材, 以訓練聽力及筆記的技巧。 此外，在課堂上將討論一些有爭議性的或者有趣的議題，以培養學生獨立思辨能力。
description.en: The course aims to develop the student's techniques of listening, analyzing and critical thinking in English. A variety of journalistic and media texts will be selected from newspapers, magazines and T.V. to reinforce listening training and note-taking skills. Besides, some controversial or interesting issues will be discussed in class to encourage the student's independent and critical thinking.

syllabi.outline: Through listening comprehension of world news, this course aims to engage students in understanding the current international  issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on listening, understanding, discussing and doing news report on selected topics and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

name.zh: 高階英文字彙習得與應用
name.en: The Acquisition and Application of Advanced English Lexical Use

description.zh:
此課程旨在協助學生建立相當於美國大學入學測驗的高階字彙，亦即相當於接受高等教育之英語系國家人士所具備的用字能力。此課程將通過故事方式介紹此類字彙，其中也包括字形學之解析。學生修習此課程後應能將高階字彙使用於正確的上下文中，因此可達成下列諸目的：
"	提昇高階字彙數量
"	加強英文閱讀能力
"	習得重要字源解析
"	避免上下文中的用字錯誤
"	提高英語表達能力
"	加強英文寫作能力
"	精進英語文溝通技巧
description.en:
This course aims to help students build a more powerful vocabulary on the SAT (the qualifying exam for US college admission) level, i.e. the level of proficiency of an educated native speaker's. Students will be introduced to the lexical use through story scenes. Morphological analysis of the words will be included in the course. At the exit of this course, students are expected to use them in their proper contexts and hence reach the following goals:
"	Develop a powerful vocabulary
"	Improve reading skills
"	Learn important word roots
"	Avoid word usage error in context
"	Become a better speaker
"	Strengthen his/her writing ability
"	Improve communication skills

description.zh: 課程之設計旨在教導學生使其具備科技產業所使用之語言能力、知識和觀點，以利學生未來職涯發展。藉由大量的閱讀及討論，使學生了解科技產業之發展，同時建立學生在實務界的真實情境中所需的高度英語文認知與溝通能力。課程包含科技發展、議題及趨勢的深入分析，以及職場上真實情境的演練。
description.en: This current course is geared to empower students with the language, knowledge and views of technology industry in order to carry out their career goals. Ample opportunities are provided to understand technological and industrial developments through reading and discussions while building high-level of awareness and proficiency of the English language in use to address realistic scenarios in field industries. The course adopts an integrative approach to accommodate in-depth analysis of technological advances, issues and trends as well as real-life workplace scenarios in technology fields of work.

description.zh: 以對流行事物，如電影，音樂，廣告，服裝，電視，通俗小說等，在當代文化思潮中的影響，及其所扮演角色探討為經，並對於英語在各範疇中展現之語彙，修辭，語法，技巧之賞析為緯，引領學生進入一個交織著現代語文與現代意涵的世界。
description.en: This course aims at giving an approach to the study of television, popular music, popular literature such as magazines and best sellers, fashion and movies, as well as an examination into the influence of all aspects of our daily lives on our basic beliefs and values. It involves the use of methodologies from both the humanities and the social sciences in the effort to interpret expressive cultural forms. Students are encouraged to participate in discussion over selected topics from contemporary issues.

syllabi.outline:
在 20 世紀末和 21 世紀初，另類藝術形式——電影、漫畫書、電子遊戲——在塑造我們的文化和日常生活方面變得越來越有影響力。
 
看看電影、電視和其他形式的流行文化，如流行音樂和漫畫書，我們將考慮西方和東方流行文化的本質和意義。  我們要問的問題包括：流行文化與學校通常學習的傳統或「高雅」文化有何不同？  評價此類作品的標準是什麼？  我們是否應該像重視經典作品一樣重視流行文化作品？  流行文化的好與壞有差別嗎：流行的東西一定是好的嗎？流行的一定是好的嗎？

In the late 20th and early 21st centuries, alternative forms of art – movies, comic books, video games – became increasingly influential in shaping our culture and our daily lives.
 
Looking at films, television, and other forms of pop culture like pop music and comic books, we will consider the nature and significance of pop culture in the West and in the East.  Among the questions we will ask:  How does pop culture differ from traditional or “high” culture normally studied in schools?  What are the standards for evaluating such works?  Should we value pop culture works in the same way as classic works?  Is there a difference between good and bad pop culture:   Can what is popular be good? Must what is popular be good?

description.zh: 此筆譯入門課程旨在使學生熟悉中英翻譯的基本概念、技巧與原則。課程中亦將介紹中英對比分析與翻譯之關聯，並協助學生將語言對比知識應用於翻譯實務中。學生將能於本課程中習得各類型翻譯所需之策略。
description.en: This is an introductory course aiming to familiarize students with basic concepts, skills and principles of Chinese-English translation. Moreover, the relevance of Chinese-English contrastive analysis to translation practices will be introduced, and students will learn how to apply the linguistic knowledge to practical work. By the end of the course, student will develop useful and appropriate translation strategies to deal with a range of translation tasks.

syllabi.outline: This is an introductory course aiming to familiarize students with basic concepts of translation, including qualifications of good translators, the procedure of translation, use of references & electronic tools and the idea of translation equivalence. Also, the relevance of contrastive studies between English and Chinese to translation will be introduced. A guided application of the linguistic knowledge to practical work will be provided, in the interest of assisting students in formulating suitable and appropriate translation strategies and techniques. This course is intended to prepare students for more specialized translation training.

description.en: This course aims to provide students with an overview of the spread of the English language around the world, the emergence of English varieties, and the development of the popularization of English as a lingua franca. Through readings and class discussion, students will have the opportunity to examine key issues arising from the spread of English as well as the development of Global Englishes.

description.zh: 在西方，「傳奇」不像其他的文類般受到認定和推崇，很難將它定位歸類，有點像是古典文類的小跟班。傳奇既沒有悲劇史詩的莊嚴崇高，也沒有抒情詩的優美，更沒有喜劇的逗趣嗆人。但是它卻以通俗文類一脈流傳，一直到二十一世紀。傳奇始於中古世紀，後來並沒有發展成自成一格的文類，反而在寫作和思想上超越了原本的形式，形成了特殊的風格。我們可以說，傳奇入侵其他傳統文類，與之結合，然後重新塑形，因而變化多端，成為現代西方文化中一股無所不在的強大力量。本課程將回顧傳奇的發展史，從中古時期獨樹一格的文類，到了現代發展成具有哲學和詮釋特質的一種形式。我們的重點將探討這之間的變化如何發生? 並研究為何傳奇在西方歷史中歷久不衰，甚至成為我們理解現代西方思想及特色的一扇重要窗口。
description.en: In the West, romance has often seemed to win less acclaim than other genres, a strange younger sister to the celebrated classical forms, not quite as sublime as epic tragedy, not as beautiful as lyric, not as provocative as comedy.  Yet it has nonetheless endured as a popular form into the 21st century.  Evolving since the Middle Ages to become less a genre in its own right than a transcendent mode of writing and of thought which invades, combines, and reshapes the other traditional genres, romance's protean nature has made it an omnipresent and influential force in modern Western culture.  This course will trace the development of romance as a genre and as a philosophical and interpretive mode from the Middle Ages to the present, as we ask how it has changed and why it has persisted throughout Western history, becoming essential to our understanding of thought and of character in the modern West.

The course content covers basic syntax for the programming languages, along with the fundamental concept theories of artificial intelligence. Through programming practices and AI tool manipulations, the students can gain a further understanding of the artificial intelligence application and the potential application via programming.

description.zh: 粉末冶金是工業先進國家積極發展的重點科技之一，其內容涵蓋粉末製造、粉末成形固結以及燒結體的後處理等範圍，本課程即安排包括粉末製造、粉末特性與其測定、粉末混合與造粒、成形、燒結理論與實務、燒結體性質與其測定、燒結體的後處理等基礎項目。另外，再講述利用粉末冶金技術製造的材料與產品的實務應用項目等，以期讓學生能對粉末冶金技術能有基本上的認識。
description.en: Powder metallurgy is one of the most important highlighted high-tech in the developed countries, its content includes powder making,powder formation and condensing,and the final treatment of sintered body,etc.Thus, this course includes the fundamental items such as powder manufacturing, powder characteristics and its test, powder mixing and granulation, formation, sintering theory and practice, the property of sintering body and its test, the post-treatment of sintering body. Besides, it also lectures practice method like using powder metallurgy to manufacture material and product, in order to let students have basic knowledge about powder metallurgy.

description.zh: 固態元件簡介,功能電子陶瓷(functional ceramics); 同時可對某些物理量如壓 ,力,音, 濕度, 溫度, 氣體等產生響應, 故其亦可稱為感測陶瓷(sensing ceramics). 精密電子陶瓷課程內容將對日常生活常見之介電陶瓷, 壓電陶瓷, 焦電陶瓷, 半導體陶瓷及磁性陶瓷等部分作深入淺出介紹.
description.en: It may also be called as Solid-state Devices and "functional ceramics" because of the special function applied in practical circuits; through the responses caused by pressure, force, sound, moisture, temperature and different gas, the fine electronic ceramics may also be called "sensing ceramics". In this course, the dielectric ceramics, piezoelectric ceramics, pyroelectric ceramics, semiconducting ceramics and magnetic ceramics will be introduced with their applications.

description.zh: 本課程內容目的在介紹電化學之原理與其應用.一、在原理方面包括離子之作用及其平衡,電解質之導電性質,界面現象,電極電位,電化學電池和電極動力程序等內容.二、在應用方面則涵蓋溶液化學參數測量,電化學分析技術,電鍍,表面處理,金屬腐蝕防治,電池應用,和電合成等
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to principles of electrochemistry and its applications. In the principles which includes ionic interaction, ionic equilibrium, the conducting properties of electrolytes, interfacial phenomena, electrode potentials, electrochemical cells and electrode kinetic process. For the application covers determination of physical parameters in the solutions, electroanalytical techniques, electroplating, electrochemical sensors, surface finishing, metal corrosion prevention, cells, electrodialysis, and electrosynthesis etc.

syllabi.outline:
電化學工程的領域眾多，舉凡腐蝕現象與電泳作用的探討，電分析感測器或電池元件的製作，以及電鍍、拋光或鋁和氯氣的生產技術等均為電化學工程的範疇。本課程除了介紹基本的電化學原理外，另將著重於電化學分析方法在能源與生醫系統研究上的應用。
Electrochemistry includes many different phenomena (e.g., corrosion and electrophoresis, electroanalytical sensors and batteries devices, the electroplating of metals, and the large-scale production of aluminum and chlorine technologies……). In addition to an overview of the basic principles of electrochemistry, the main emphasis here is on applying electro-analytical methods to the study of energy and biomedical systems.

description.zh: 隨著先進能源科技的快速進展，各種形態能源的生產、儲存、再生、與利用成為技術發展的重點。材料科技是提升能源效率的重要一環，本課程結合包括金屬、陶瓷、高分子、奈米等複合材料系統，討論材料在在包括儲氫合金、二次電池、燃料電池、太陽能電池、熱電、超電容等新型能源儲存或生產等裝置上的應用領域與其限制。
description.en: The demands for advanced energy requires the development of technologies for sustainable energy production, converting, and storage. Materials are key blocks to improved performance in new energy technologies. These new materials systems often combine the knowledge in the fields of metals, ceramics, polymer, and nano-materials. This course will discuss the applications and limits of materials in hydrogen storage, secondary batteries, fuel cells, solar cells, thermoelectric devices, and supercapacitors to give undergraduate students a basic understanding of energy-related materials.

description.zh: 本課程介紹移動應用程式的設計與開發，涵蓋移動端使用者介面和使用者體驗設計原則，並討論平台特定的挑戰和最佳實踐。課程包括注重疊待開發、前端設計和測試的實作專案，旨在幫助學生開發和部署功能完整的移動應用程式。
description.en: This course introduces the design and development of mobile applications, covering the principles of mobile user interface and user experience design, while discussing platform-specific challenges and best practices. description.zh: 本課程主要介紹薄膜製作有關的基礎理論與技術。講述內容包括真空技術，薄膜基礎，薄膜製作技術，蝕刻技術，薄膜評估方法以及薄膜技術的應用等。讓學生認識薄膜在高科技產業上的應用與其重要性，製作薄膜的方法與技術以及其未來的發展。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Thin films technology and Thin film materials science. 2. Vacuum science and technology 3. Thin film evaporation processes 4. Discharge, plasma, and ion-surface interaction 5. Plasma and ion beam processing of thin films 6. Chemical vapor deposition 7. Substrate surfaces and thin film nucleation 8. Film structure 9. Characterization of thin films and surface 10. Interdiffusion, reactions, and transformations in thin films 11. Mechanical properties of thin films.

syllabi.outline:
薄膜科技是當今各式高科技製造業最不可或缺的技術之一，相關技術影響範疇包含電子、光電、半導體製造業、表面工程、高硬度高強度、耐磨抗腐蝕、裝飾與保護等等。薄膜技術種類與相關配合技術繁多，隨產業發展各項技術亦不斷進化，本課程涵蓋相關薄膜成長概論與原理，並搭配實作課程，期望讓學生認識薄膜在科技產業上的應用，並了解其重要性及未來的發展。
本課程包含以下主題：
1.	薄膜沉積 (Thin film deposition)
2.	薄膜材料表面能、擴散行為、應力等介紹 (Review of surface energy, diffusion, and stress in thin films)
3.	薄膜的化學能與表面動態行為 (Chemical potentials and surface kinetic processes)
4.	同質磊晶與異質磊晶 (Homogenius epitaxy and heterogenius epitaxy growth)
5.	互擴散 (Interdiffusion)
6.	蕭基能障 (Schottky barrier)
7.	矽化物薄膜形成 (Silicide formation and thin film reaction)
8.	電遷移機制 (Electromigration)
9.     薄膜分析技術 (Thin film characterization)


Thin film science and technology have gone through a thorough development which results in numerous new materials and advanced applications. Thin film research shares the knowledge from multi-disciplines, such as materials science, chemistry, solid state physics, mechanics and etc.. This course is an introductory class for students who are interested in thin film technology. Lab or tour session(s) will be provided to promote teaching and learning.

The topics will cover:
1.	薄膜沉積 (Thin film deposition)
2.	薄膜材料表面能、擴散行為、應力等介紹 (Review of surface energy, diffusion, and stress in thin films)
3.	薄膜的化學能與表面動態行為 (Chemical potentials and surface kinetic processes)
4.	同質磊晶與異質磊晶 (Homogenius epitaxy and heterogenius epitaxy growth)
5.	互擴散 (Interdiffusion)
6.	蕭基能障 (Schottky barrier)
7.	矽化物薄膜形成 (Silicide formation and thin film reaction)
8.	電遷移機制 (Electromigration)
9.     薄膜分析技術 (Thin film characterization)

description.zh:
駭客是一門非常廣泛的學科，涵蓋了廣泛的主題。 本課程將提供駭客攻防的各種概念，並解釋如何在即時環境中使用它們。
本課程將包括駭客的類型，駭客的優勢/劣勢，駭客的目的，駭客的工具，駭客的技能，駭客的流程等。
description.en:
Hacking is a very broad discipline, which covers a wide range of topics. This course will provide the various concepts of Ethical Hacking and explain how you can use them in a real-time environment.
This course will include the type of hacking, advantage /disadvantage of hacking, the purpose of hacking, tools of hacking, skill of hacking, process of hacking, etc.

Material Chemistry
Allotropes of carbon-fullerene (C60), 1D, 2D, and 3D carbon nanostructure, and graphene. Boron materials: borophene, and borospherene, Metals alloys, delafossite material, zeolites, Microporous, and mesoporous materials: Structure, properties, and application. semiconductors, superconductors, insulators, ceramics, and glass. 
Electrochemistry
Voltammetry: Cyclic voltammetry, linear sweep voltammetry, differential pulse voltammetry, amperometry, chronopotentiometry, oxidations, and reductions. Types of electrode and electrode reactions: Standard Electrode Potentials, Standard Hydrogen Electrode, Calomel electrode, Carbon electrodes, Microelectrodes, Ultra-micro electrodes, Ion-selective electrodes, porous electrodes, Semiconductor electrodes, Hydrodynamic/Rotating disk electrodes. Electrolytes, classification of electrolytes, liquid, solid electrolytes. Reversible, quasi-reversible, and Irreversible electrode processes, Characteristics of commonly used working electrodes such as glassy carbon, pyrolytic graphite, platinum, and reference electrodes. Liquid junction potential, salt bridge, conductometric and potentiometric titrations (acid-base).
Modified electrodes and their application, Electrochemical sensor: Fundamentals of electrochemical sensors, Electrochemical sensor for food and water analysis, Electrochemical DNA sensors. Design of third-generation electrochemical sensors. Electroanalytical chemistry in neuroscience. Electrochemistry sensors of biological molecules like glucose, insulin, and cholesterol. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and their application. Electrochemical quartz crystal microbalance and its applications. Electrochemical cell-redox reaction, electrode potential, EMF. Corrosion: Basics, chemical, and electrochemical principles corrosion, and electrodeposition. Electrochemical CO2 reduction, Electrochemical detection of environmental pollutants.
Electrochemical devices and techniques: Fundamental concepts of electrochemical energy conversion and storage, irreversible systems. Supercapacitors and their working principle. Electrochemical energy systems, lithium batteries, photocathode.  Fuel cells: Electrode materials, fuel cell research. Batteries: Principles of operation of cells and batteries; Electrochemical principles and reactions; Factors affecting battery performance; Battery design; Fundamentals of Primary cells and batteries, secondary batteries, Advanced lead-acid, Ni-based and lithium-ion batteries, next-generation batteries, materials for batteries, batteries electrode preparation, cell assembly, electrochemical performance analysis. Fuel cells: Introduction to fuel cells: working principle, direct methanol fuel cells, proton exchange membrane fuel cells, alkaline fuel cells, phosphoric acid, solid oxide, molten carbonate Fuel cells. 
Debye - Huckel - Onsager Equation, Kinetics- over-potential, Butler Volmer equation, Tafel equation, Nernst equation. Electrochemical cells: Galvanic cell, Daniel cell, Half-cell, Overpotential, Oxidation potential, Reduction potential. The rate of charge transfer, Current density, Ionic equilibria, Electro Kinetic Phenomena, Electrical double layer potential, Zeta potential, electro-osmosis, and sedimentation potential.

description.zh: 速寫是最古老、最容易、最快速的溝通方式之一，也是充滿希望的設計師及藝術家必備的絕技。藉由大量的植物寫生，提昇觀察能力並把線條練活，進而建立起掌控「形」的基本信心。接下來的靜物寫生著重整體的構圖關係，利用黑白灰的構圖原理，著眼在傳其「神」而不是傳其「形」。將前階段的單線練習，改作分塊、分面的線群練習。再接下來是人物肖像寫生練習。到此，線條的特質、比例的嚴謹皆要掌控，肖像對象的性別、年齡、特徵以及由內在而外顯的神韻，是畫者所要表達的。
description.en:
Sketching is one of the oldest, easiest and quickest methods of communication 
and also one of the most important skills a hopeful designer and artist must master. 
The course begins with a lot of plants sketching that helps to enhance your observation and build up your confidence in mastering forms and shapes in order to make your sketches vivid. Next still life sketching focuses on the composition. You are encouraged to utilize the composition principle of black, white and gray, and emphasize more on the vividness than the form until you get rid of the habit of passive copying of the objects. Then you move from the previous linear sketching practice into facet sketching and then block sketching. At the end of the semester, you will practice human portrait sketching. Until now you should be able to handle not only the characteristics of the line and proportion, but also the gender, age, charm and expression of the model.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在培養學生在設計領域中的研究與實踐能力，涵蓋設計師角色定位、調查方法、以及永續設計等多方面議題。課程初期說明學習目標與評分方式，進而探討生活型態的研究與設計師必備的實地訪查、次級研究、脈絡訪查等技術，並透過實際案例與草圖練習深化理解。中期以使用者旅程地圖和同理心地圖為核心，幫助學生掌握使用者需求與目標。課程後半著重於永續發展，結合減碳生活型態與以生命為本的設計實踐。課程最後以小組形式進行設計溝通、裱板展示與口頭簡報，全面展現學習成果，為學生在未來設計領域的發展打下扎實基礎。

description.en:
This course aims to guide students understanding cloud environments and IoT systems and their corresponding security requirements. In addition to introducing basic concepts of cloud environment and IoT system, the course contents will focus on OWASP's cloud security and IoT security. All practical techniques will be explained. Students are able to analyze various potential security threats in the cloud and Internet of Things environments, and to learn security protection capabilities for cloud and IoT systems. Course contents including:

●Introduction to cloud technologies
●Introduction to cloud security
●Security standards for cloud services 
●Introduction to IoT technologies
●Potential threats of industrial IoT systems
●Industrial Cyber Security introduction
●IoT security detection
●IoT security standards
●Information security and privacy protection

syllabi.outline:
This course will introduce Google Cloud Computing related technologies and provide students with a comprehensive understanding of Google Cloud platform, architecture, services, and programming through the application of machine learning and IoT in railway systems. The course content includes: 1. Google cloud system architecture, storage network and virtualization technology, 2. Google cloud storage technology, 3. Google cloud scheduling technology, performance and security, 4. Google virtualized data center construction, 5. Google cloud services and enterprise applications, 6. Introduction to IoT technology 7. IoT standards and applications 8. Introduction to Industrial IoT network 9. IoT security and privacy protection 10. IoT internship courses and special projects. Therefore, before the midterm exam, we will mainly introduce the Google cloud system architecture. After the midterm exam, we will start to introduce the Internet of Things and its development trends. In the 11th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security issues and trends. In the 12th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology. In the 13th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 14th week. In the 15th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 16th week. In the 17th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology and practice. In the 18th week, we will make a special topic report at the end.

description.zh: 區塊鏈技術(作為比特幣等數位貨幣的核心)已重塑了金融交易與分散式交互方式之未來。同時它也被期待帶給我們一個更自組與可提供事實證明的數位化世界。抽象化區塊鏈構造是非常精巧的，它倚賴輕量化密碼學工具搭配分散式系統概念，完成了開放、安全且有效率的系統(如比特幣)。本課程為區塊鏈技術與應用上之概念介紹，包含：比特幣與區塊鏈設計、相關基礎密碼學工具、分散式網路與共識、區塊鏈應用。
description.en: Blockchain techniques (the core of cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin) have reshaped the future of financial transactions and decentralized interactions. They are also expected to bring us a more self-organizing and dependent digital world. The abstraction of blockchain is very delicate. It relies on cryptography tools and decentralized system concepts to achieve an open, secure, and efficient system (such as Bitcoin). This course aims to introduce the concepts of blockchain techniques and applications, including Bitcoin and blockchain design, basic cryptography tools, decentralized networks and consensus, and blockchain applications.

description.zh: 資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
description.en: Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce the valuable knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The topics include data processing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. The course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with fundamental related knowledge and the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation-collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The course training is toward equipping students with the mindset and the ability to solve problems with the learned techniques on educational data. In addition, students need to practice the presentation for the findings of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually.

syllabi.outline:
資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce or create the valuable information and knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The related topics include data processing and computing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. This course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with the fundamental related knowledge as well as the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation- collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The training of this course is toward equipping students with the general mindset and the ability to solve problems practically with the learned techniques on educational data with project groups. In addition, the students also need to practice the presentation for the findings and results of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually. The major objective of this course is to cultivate talents in data science.

description.zh:
本課程強調具知識內涵的設計過程，以知識的探討與研究為手段，豐富設計創意的發展。
透過工業設計的理論、方法及程序，以研究的手段形成設計決策，或以實證的方式將研究成果應用於設計實務。
本課程藉由設計主題或產學合作進行實際演練，應用新科技與新材料的發展，並探討生活型態與市場的需求，研發創新型態的產品或服務。其中應用的方法包括：問題分析，需求研究，方案評估，設計檢核，價值呈現及績效評價。
description.en:
This course provides an approach to Knowledge Embedded Design.
‘Creating’ is the ultimate stage for learning, critical thinking and combining all acquired knowledge to produce something new and unique. Advanced Product Design (III) educates students to identify and resolve design problems – innovatively. 
In order to identify, expand and test user’s requirement, research and design process will be carried out under the instruction, which includes Identify the Problem, Investigation Research, Identify Possible Solution, Choose Best Solution & Develop Detail, Implement Solution, and finally, Test & Evaluation.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在以個別與小組合作模式，訓練學生通曉設計開發流程，以執行設計專案。藉由實務案例的運作，及兼顧產業與組織之需求，以體現產業與社會文化面的問題與解決對策。本課程又以培育學生具備專業設計師之設計企劃提案與概念發想能力，以及學生使用設計工具之能力。

syllabi.outline: The course gives a broad introduction about the design and analysis of computer algorithms. General topics to be covered include: growth of functions, recurrences, sorting and order statistics, fundamental and advanced data structures, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, graph algorithms, and NP-completeness.

description.zh: 「數據啟發設計思考（Data-informed Design Thinking）」課程旨在結合數據分析與設計思考，通過實踐項目提升學生在現代設計環境中的問題解決能力。本課程將引導學生掌握如何從數據中提取關鍵洞察，並結合設計思考中的使用者需求、創意思考與解決方案原型的開發。學生將學習如何有效地應用數據，來支持設計決策與創新。課程以Project-Based Learning為教學模式，學生將在實際設計項目中探索如何將數據與設計思考相結合，最終交付一個完整的數據驅動設計解決方案與數據視覺化。這門課不僅培養學生的技術技能，還強調協作、反思與迭代改進的設計思考過程，幫助學生為未來數據密集型的設計環境做好準備。
description.en: The "Data-informed Design Thinking" course aims to combine data analysis and design thinking to improve students' problem-solving abilities in modern design environments through practical projects. This course will guide students in how to extract key insights from data, combining user needs, creative thinking and solution prototype development in design thinking. Students will learn how to effectively apply data to support design decisions and innovation. The course uses Project-Based Learning as the teaching model. Students will explore how to combine data with design thinking in actual design projects, and ultimately deliver a complete data-driven design solution and data visualization. This course not only cultivates students' technical skills, but also emphasizes the design thinking process of collaboration, reflection and iterative improvement, helping students prepare for the data-intensive design environment of the future.

syllabi.outline:
「數據啟發設計思考（Data-informed Design Thinking）」課程旨在結合數據分析與設計思考，通過實踐項目提升學生在現代設計環境中的問題解決能力。本課程將引導學生掌握如何從數據中提取關鍵洞察，並結合設計思考中的使用者需求、創意思考與解決方案原型的開發。學生將學習如何有效地應用數據，來支持設計決策與創新。課程以 Project-Based Learning 為教學模式，學生將在實際設計項目中探索如何將數據與設計思考相結合，最終交付一個完整的數據驅動設計解決方案與數據視覺化。課程將以臺北市選定的社區為研究場域，透過交通數據、人流分析、空間設計及環境相關數據，探索都市社區面臨的挑戰，並提出創新且實際的解決方案。學生將學習如何運用數據驅動的設計方法，發展出具未來性與可行性的設計概念，並與專家及業界代表交流。

The "Data-informed Design Thinking" course aims to combine data analysis and design thinking to improve students' problem-solving abilities in modern design environments through practical projects. This course will guide students in how to extract key insights from data, combining user needs, creative thinking and solution prototype development in design thinking. Students will learn how to effectively apply data to support design decisions and innovation. The course uses Project-Based Learning as the teaching model. Students will explore how to combine data with design thinking in actual design projects, and ultimately deliver a complete data-driven design solution and data visualization. The course will use selected communities in Taipei City as the research site. Through traffic data, people flow analysis, spatial design and environment-related data, it will explore the challenges faced by urban communities and propose innovative and practical solutions. Students will learn how to use data-driven design methods to develop futuristic and feasible design concepts, and communicate with experts and industry representatives.

name.zh: 數據驅動跨域設計專題研究

description.zh: 「數據驅動跨域設計專題研究」是一門結合學術研究與實務經驗的高階設計課程，專為日間部碩士生與在職進修碩士生共同學習與協作設計。本課程以數據驅動設計為核心，強調將數據分析與設計實踐相結合，旨在提升學生的跨領域思考能力與解決問題的實踐能力。通過全職研究生與在職研究生的密切合作，學生將有機會從不同視角出發，探索如何將數據驅動策略應用於設計實務中，進而達成具創新性與實用性的設計解決方案。課程將涵蓋數據分析、使用者需求研究、設計驗證與實驗等多個模組，並強調在真實世界中的應用。最終，學生將完成一個具備學術價值與實際應用潛力的設計專題研究，為未來的專業發展或進一步學術研究打下堅實基礎。
description.en: The course integrates academic research with practical experience, specifically designed for full-time master’s students and professionals in the master’s program. This course centers on data-driven design, emphasizing the combination of data analysis with design practice. It aims to enhance students' interdisciplinary thinking and practical problem-solving skills. Through close collaboration between full-time and part-time students, participants will have the opportunity to explore how data-driven strategies can be applied to design practice from different perspectives, ultimately creating innovative and practical design solutions. The course will cover various modules, including data analysis, user needs research, design validation, and experimentation. At the end, students will complete a design research project with both academic value and practical potential, laying a solid foundation for future professional development or further academic research.

syllabi.outline:
"Data-Driven Interdisciplinary Design Research Project" is an advanced design course that combines academic research and practical experience. This course takes data-driven design as its core, emphasizing the combination of data analysis and design practice, aiming to improve students' cross-field thinking abilities and practical problem-solving abilities. Through close collaboration with graduate students, students will have the opportunity to explore how to apply data-driven strategies to design practice from different perspectives, thereby achieving innovative and practical design solutions. The course will cover multiple modules such as data analysis, user needs research, design verification and experimentation, and emphasize application in the real world. Ultimately, students will complete a design research project with academic value and practical application potential, laying a solid foundation for future professional development or further academic research.
「數據驅動跨域設計專題研究」是一門結合學術研究與實務經驗的高階設計課程。本課程以數據驅動設計為核心，強調將數據分析與設計實踐相結合，旨在提升學生的跨領域思考能力與解決問題的實踐能力。透過研究生的密切合作，學生將有機會從不同視角出發，探索如何將數據驅動策略應用於設計實務中，進而達成具創新性與實用性的設計解決方案。課程將涵蓋數據分析、使用者需求研究、設計驗證與實驗等多個模組，並強調在真實世界中的應用。最終，學生將完成一個具備學術價值與實際應用潛力的設計專題研究，為未來的專業發展或進一步學術研究打下堅實基礎。

description.zh:
本課程屬於影像處理的進階課程，以遙測影像為主軸，聚焦於多光譜和高光譜影像分析與處理，並將涵蓋一般日常使用的彩色影像（多光譜影像的一種），分析各自不同的差異以及所需的影像處理技術。
課程內容將涵蓋多光譜和高光譜影像的基礎、各種影像於分析時所面臨的挑戰以及所需的影像處理技術，包括線性分解、資料降維與升維、光譜與空間上的特徵萃取、機器與深度學習演算法。 
選修本課程的學生需要具備基礎的信號處理、機率、線性代數和影像處理方面的背景。
description.en: This is an advanced course on image processing. The main focus of this course is the analysis and processing of multispectral and hyperspectral images. It will cover the general color images as a type of multispectral image based on remote sensing for analysis of their differences and corresponding image processing techniques. The scope of this course includes fundamentals of multispectral and hyperspectral imagery, challenges in image analysis, and corresponding image processing techniques, such as linear unmixing, dimensionality reduction, spectral and spatial feature extraction, and machine/deep learning algorithms. Students are expected to have a basic background in signal processing, probability, linear algebra, and image processing prior to taking this course.

syllabi.outline:
當高解析度的數位微波影像以成趨勢後，下一世代各國之間在遙測影像的競爭上已經不再局限於光學影像中。然而無論是光學或微波影像，都是以傳統的影像處理為基礎，然後再根據彼此間的數位訊號間的差異，而有不一樣的處理方法。在國際上，越來越多實務上的應用不再只局限於傳統的數位光學影像。利用更多輔助的數位影像資料，例如數位微波影像，能獲取更高效能、更高精度的結果。本課程會以數位微波影像發展趨勢與應用介紹起，並說明影像的特性、訊號模型與處理方法，並搭配實務上的操作，達到理論與實務兼具的目的。

When high resolution digital microwave image becomes the trend, the competition of remote sensing image among countries in the next generation is no longer limited to optical image. However, both optical and microwave images are based on the traditional image processing, and then have different processing methods according to the difference between digital signals. Internationally, more and more practical applications are no longer limited to traditional digital optical imaging. The use of more complementary digital image data, such as digital microwave images, can lead to more efficient and accurate results. This course will introduce the trends and applications of digital microwave imaging, explain the characteristics of the image, signal model and processing methods, and provide practical operation to achieve both theoretical and practical purposes.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目標為增進研究生之英文表達能力。包含:
1. 此課程主要分成三大部分：(1) 簡報前準備工作和簡報注意要點；(2) 簡報開場、結尾、內容表達技巧；(3) 個人簡歷報告和表達技巧。 2. 課堂中引導學生於課程中探討與分析簡報技巧，比較不同說法的優缺點，同時找出適合自己的表達方式。 3. 除了解說中規中矩的開場簡報說法外，同時分享吸引聽眾注意的開場簡報技巧。 4. 本課程強調「實用性」與「創造性」，為了加強學習過程和效率，將以引導方式讓學生在課堂中有充分練習機會，加深學習印象。

syllabi.outline: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論					  本課程架構為探討技術及職業教育相關領域之理論應用與研究方法，藉由「多元化」研究主題之專題課程初探之操作並結合技職教育相關學術研究的基本特質與科學方法的傳統等進行課程內容之整合、系統化及融合式教學；本課程旨在熟悉技職教育的重要理論與概念、培養熱心探究教學與研究問題的態度以及訓練閱讀、摘要、報告、展演技職教育專題文獻之能力，並探討各種研究方法的特質與限制，引導學生以策略性的思考進行文獻探討並架構適當的設計研究策略，進而得以研擬具可行性的研究計劃以提昇研究者自我獨立研究及撰寫論文之能力之目標。

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養研究生認識中英文期刊、研討會及學位論文的語法、文體、結構組織等特性，以及批判思維、閱讀分析、論述寫作及編修互評等相關技能。透過本課程的學習，學生能藉由學術論文表達對特定議題的態度與觀點，嘗試尋求解答以處理研究問題。
description.en: This course is designed to develop graduate students' understanding of the grammatical, stylistic, and structural organization characteristics of journals, conference papers, and dissertations in English and Chinese, as well as skills related to critical thinking, reading and analysis, essay writing, peer editing, and responding to peer feedback. Through the study of this course, students will be able to express their opinions and attitudes towards specific issues through academic paper, and attempt to seek ways to investigate/answer academic research questions.

syllabi.outline: This course helps the learners recognize the syntax, style, and organization as far as the papers on English writings are concerned.

description.en: The goal of English Technical Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

syllabi.schedule:
Instructions and procedures are documents that help either developers or end users operate or configure a device or program.
 
Proposals. Most projects begin with a proposal—a document that describes the purpose of a project, the tasks that will be performed in the project, the methods used to complete the project, and finally the cost of the project.

Emails, letters, and memoranda are some of the most frequently written documents in a business.
 
Press releases. When a company wants to publicly reveal a new product or service, they will have a technical writer author a press release, a document that describes the product's functions and value to the public.
 
Specifications are design outlines that describe the structure, parts, packaging, and delivery of an object or process in enough detail that another party can reconstruct it
. 
Descriptions are shorter explanations of procedures and processes that help readers understand how something works.
 
Rsums and job applications are another example of technical documents. 
Technical reports are written to provide readers with information, instructions, and analysis on tasks. 

Case study is a published report about a person, group, or situation that has been studied over time; also : a situation in real life that can be looked at or studied to learn about something.
 
White papers are documents that are written for experts in a field and typically describe a solution to a technological or business challenge or problem.

description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and practical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of interactive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and approaches, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and approaches, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

syllabi.outline: Welcome to the NTUT University Table Tennis Coaching Program! This semester-long course is designed to equip students with fundamental and advanced table tennis skills. From mastering the basics of racket handling to executing precision serves and advanced strokes, this course aims to foster a comprehensive understanding of the game. Whether you are a beginner or have prior experience, this class will help you enhance your technical, tactical, and physical skills while promoting teamwork and sportsmanship.
syllabi.schedule:
Course Objectives:

Build a strong foundation in table tennis basics: grip, stance, and movement.
Develop skills in forehand, backhand, serving techniques, and spins.
Introduce game strategies and foster match-play experience.
Encourage fitness, hand-eye coordination, and reflex enhancement.
Create an enjoyable learning environment promoting personal growth and sportsmanship.

16-Week Semester Syllabus
Weeks 1-2: Fundamentals of Table Tennis

Topics Covered:
Introduction to table tennis equipment
Rules and regulations overview
Correct racket grip (shakehand and penhold grips)
Proper stance and footwork basics
Activities:
Demonstrations and practice drills
Basic ball control and consistency exercises
Weeks 3-4: Forehand Technique

Topics Covered:
Forehand drive mechanics
Generating power and accuracy
Positioning and movement drills for forehand
Activities:
Forehand warm-up routines
Pair practice for forehand rallies
Target-based accuracy challenges
Weeks 5-6: Backhand Technique

Topics Covered:
Backhand drive fundamentals
Transitioning between forehand and backhand
Handling high and low backhand strokes
Activities:
Backhand drills (stationary and moving)
Consistency-building rally exercises
Match scenarios for backhand use
Weeks 7-8: Serving Fundamentals

Topics Covered:
Rules for serving in table tennis
Basic serve types (flat, topspin, backspin)
Importance of spin and placement
Activities:
Practicing basic serves
Serving accuracy and variation challenges
Partner feedback and refinement sessions
Weeks 9-10: Advanced Serves

Topics Covered:
Side-spin serves
Combination spin serves
Deceptive serves to confuse opponents
Activities:
Drill sessions for spin and speed variations
Serve-return scenarios with partners
Individual serve improvement plans
Weeks 11-12: Undercut Techniques

Topics Covered:
Mastering the undercut/backspin stroke
Defensive uses of undercut techniques
Strategies to counter opponent spin
Activities:
Undercut practice with controlled drills
Match-play emphasis on defensive skills
Game simulations focusing on undercut scenarios
Weeks 13-14: Strategy and Match Play

Topics Covered:
Developing match strategies based on opponent analysis
Tactical use of spin, speed, and placement
Combining offensive and defensive styles
Activities:
Practice matches with structured feedback
Team games to enhance collaboration
Video analysis of professional matches
Weeks 15-16: Final Assessment and Match Play

Topics Covered:
Recap of all skills learned
Preparation for final skill evaluation
Conducting tournament-style match play
Activities:
Final practical skill demonstrations
Official in-class tournament
Feedback sessions and goal setting for future growth
syllabi.assessment:
Grading: 

Skill Development: 45% (Demonstrated improvement in forehand, backhand, serving, and undercut techniques)
Match Play Performance: 45% (Tactical application of skills during matches)

Participation and Effort: 10% (Active engagement in class activities)

Absence: missing one class or one match will have 6 point reduction from final grade. Sick leave or personal affairs absence are excluded, unless otherwise specified for particular reasons.

週次(堂次)：課程主題--內容【說明】
第1週：課程說明、上課規定。熱身、對擲高遠球(及含側併步後退、對牆、向前跨步接球連續)。持拍運球、撿球、正反手上下擊球等。
第2週：前場低手擊球--握拍、正反手、擲打、隔網、對打、擊球後退出發球線
第3週：前場低手擊球--正反手挑後場高遠球
第4週：前場擊球--平推後場球
第5週：前場擊球--正反手對角短球
第6週：中後場擊球動作要領--正反手平推球
第7週：中後場擊球動作要領--正反手平推球
第8週：發球要領--正反手短球、平遠球、高遠球
第9週：期中測驗--一分鐘平推球來回
第10週：後場擊球動作要領--正反手高遠球
第11週：後場擊球動作要領--切球、放短球
第12週：後場擊球動作要領--後場擊球步法

第17週：雙打比賽--規則、禮儀、安全注意事項、技戰術及實戰

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在協助學生學習網球各項基本技巧，並學習球場禮儀及比賽規則。且在有效的學習過程中獲得成就感，同時達到鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。
教學目標：
1. 學習正確網球基本技巧，避動作錯誤造成運動傷害。 
2. 學會欣賞網球運動賽事，提升對於網球運動之興趣。
3. 了解網球運動的基本規則與禮儀。
4. 培養規律運動習慣，進而達到強身體魄之效果。
5. 培養團隊合作與運動家的精神。

The aim of this course is to assist students in learning the basic skills of tennis, as well as understanding court etiquette and game rules. Through effective learning processes, students will gain a sense of achievement while simultaneously achieving holistic physical and mental development, fostering sportsmanship, promoting teamwork, and cultivating lifelong physical activity habits.

Teaching objectives:

Learn correct basic tennis skills to avoid sports injuries caused by improper movements.
Develop an appreciation for tennis events to enhance interest in the sport.
Understand the basic rules and etiquette of tennis.
Cultivate regular exercise habits to achieve physical fitness benefits.
Foster teamwork and sportsmanship.

syllabi.schedule:
教學目標與內容
一、綜合目標:增強健康適能，內容含肌肉適能、心肺適能、柔軟度:進而了解身體組成，提高運動適能；並藉由舞蹈作品展演體現肢體美感，與提升現代人所需之”3Q-智商、情商、挫商”等人性內涵的素質。
二、單項目標與內容:
(一)彼拉提斯(Pilates mat work ):
*提升肢體覺察力與覺知力，進而正確運用肢體達到健康安全的行為模式；並增強肢體協調性、敏捷性、反應力與專注力。
*核心肌群的訓練，針對肌肉的控制與穩定，增強與維持肌肉適能。
(二) 基礎律動(Basic rhythm)藉由基礎節奏與律動增加身體協調性，反應與敏捷能力。
(三)現代舞(Modern Dance)
*體驗現代舞並能展演:學生舞蹈創作時，從學習皮拉提斯肌肉控制與柔軟度中，發展肢體美感。
*藉由舞蹈作品排練與練習過程:學習團隊合作與人際溝通。提升自我表達能力與創意。養成耐心、毅力、受挫力及克服心。
三、補充教材:歌舞電影、表演藝術欣賞或文章閱讀等。
提昇對藝術的鑑賞能力,豐富美感經驗。

教學進度:
第一週
1-教學規劃說明，含目標、內容、進度、應備知識基礎、評量方式。
2-測驗基礎肌肉適能與柔軟度。
第二週
1-身體評估。
2-了解肌肉、骨骼及神經關係。
3-剖析及了解自己日常生活時身體姿勢的狀況，躺、坐、站、走、跑、跳的正確姿勢。
第三週肢體觀察與覺知能力培養

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.outline: This course is specifically designed for international students with no prior knowledge of Chinese. It aims to enhance students' listening, speaking, reading, and writing abilities in Chinese, enabling them to meet basic communication needs in daily life. The course begins with the Pinyin and Zhuyin systems to help students learn accurate pronunciation, gradually building practical vocabulary and sentence patterns for use in various conversational contexts. Additionally, the course incorporates a variety of activities to strengthen Chinese language skills, foster an understanding of and interest in Chinese culture, and lay a solid foundation for further Chinese learning.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

description.zh: 本課程旨在透過各種英語新聞媒體如電視新聞（如CNN, BBC, NBC）、英文雜誌（如The Economist, Scientific American ）、英文報紙（New York Times, Washington Post, the Guardian等）等，來培養學生的批判性閱讀能力．並同時提升其宏觀視野與多元知識。課堂中將藉由分析英語新聞的用字遣詞、報導角度的取捨、標題與議題的呈現方式等，使學生學習如何思考報導背後之立場，從而進行批判性閱讀。此外，亦將剖析英語新聞中所含括之英美文學典故與文化傳統，帶領學生瞭解新聞英文的豐富意涵。
description.en: This course aims to (1) develop students’ critical reading abilities, (2) expand their global horizons and (3) broaden their knowledge by using diverse English news reports provided by news channels (e.g. CNN, BBC and NBC), news magazines (e.g. The Economist and Scientific American) and newspapers (e.g. New York Times, Washington Post and The Guardian). Students will learn how to read critically by analyzing word choice, reporting angles and the selection and presentation of headlines or quotations. This course will also explore literary allusions and cultural references contained in English news in order to further enhance students’ English language competence.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以英文時事為教材，訓練學生英文新聞時事字彙，並藉由增加詞彙量與練習重要句型，使學生進而能閱讀與理解國際時事英文新聞。教材將選自報紙/雜誌（如China Post與Taipei Times雙語新聞）或線上新聞（如VOA Special English）中適合學生之各類新聞（如政治、經濟、科技、娛樂與時尚新聞等），以有效提升其英文閱聽能力。  

English Description: 
This course aims to use latest and current news as teaching materials to help students build their vocabulary, familiarize themselves with basic sentence patterns and eventually develop their comprehension abilities. News reports suitable for basic-level students will be selected from newspapers or news magazines (e.g. bilingual news from China Post and Taipei Times) and online news websites (e.g. VOA Special English) to effectively enhance students’ fundamental reading skills.

It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. description.en: The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. description.zh: 本課程旨在探討如何將 AI 技術應用於語用學研究，著重多元社會情境與語境之下之語言使用分析與詮釋。此課程將深入淺出討論語用學核心理論部分，並結合 AI 大型語言模型 (例如: GPT, Gemini, 以及 Claude 等) 實際操作，讓學生親自學習辨識、分析與評估各種自然語言表現，包含言語行為 (speech acts)、會話隱含 (conversational implicature) 及禮貌策略 (politeness strategies) 等現象。本課程以專題式學習融合理論與實務, 幫助同學從全新的 AI 驅動視角進行語用學研究, 在分析人類真實語言互動行為之外, 更同時能了解 AI 生成文本在語用能力方面的優勢與局限。
description.en: AI & Pragmatics is a graduate-level course that explores how artificial intelligence (AI) can enhance the study of pragmatics by focusing on the analysis and interpretation of language use across diverse social and contextual settings. Students will integrate core theories of pragmatics with hands-on experience using Large Language Models (e.g., GPT, Gemini, and Claude) to identify, analyze, and evaluate key pragmatic phenomena such as speech acts, conversational implicatures, and politeness strategies—and, more importantly, apply these skills to real-world language tasks. Built around project-based learning, the course blends theory with practice, preparing students to conduct research in pragmatics from a fresh, AI-driven perspective. It equips them not only to analyze authentic language interactions but also to critically assess the strengths and limitations of AI-generated texts in terms of pragmatic competence.

Students will integrate core theories of pragmatics with hands-on experience using Large Language Models (e.g., GPT, Gemini, and Claude) to identify, analyze, and evaluate key pragmatic phenomena such as speech acts, conversational implicatures, and politeness strategies—and, more importantly, apply these skills to real-world language tasks. syllabi.schedule:
UNITE 1: Foundations of Pragmatics
Weeks 1–6: Understanding Key Pragmatic Concepts

W1  Introduction to Pragmatics
● What is pragmatics?
● Pragmatics vs. semantics vs. syntax
● The role of context in meaning

W2  Speech Act Theory (Austin & Searle)
● Locution, illocution, perlocution
● Different types of speech acts
● Hands-on: Identifying speech acts in dialogues

W3  Conversational Implicature and Grice's Maxims
● Cooperative Principle (CP) and Gricean Maxims
● How do implicatures create indirect meaning?
● Heads-on: Finding implicatures in real conversations

W4 Politeness Strategies & Face Theory
● Brown & Levinson's politeness theory
● Cultural variation in politeness
● Hands-on: Analyzing politeness strategies in dialogues

W5  Conversational Structure & Discourse Coherence
● Turn-taking, adjacency pairs, and repairs
● What makes discourse coherent? (pragmatic/discourse markers)
● Hands-on: Identifying coherence markers in texts

W6  Pragmatic Failures & Miscommunication
● When pragmatics go wrong: misunderstanding, humor, sarcasm
● Case studies of misinterpretation
● Hands-on: Analyzing pragmatic failure in conversations

W7  Holiday (No Class)

W8  Review Session—Bridging Pragmatics & AI
(Review of Key Pragmatic Concepts Before the Midterm)
● Recap of speech acts, implicature, politeness, discourse coherence
● How is pragmatics challenging for AI and NLP models?
● Introduction to AI-based tools for pragmatics
● Hands-on: Exploring AI-generated dialogue for pragmatic features

W9  Midterm Exam

UNIT 2: AI and NLP for Pragmatic Analysis
Weeks 10–14: Applying AI and NLP to Pragmatics

W10  Introduction to AI and NLP for Pragmatics
● Overview of AI in linguistics & pragmatics
● How do AI models process pragmatic meaning?
● Hands-on: Exploring AI-generated conversations

W11  AI and Speech Act Recognition
● Can AI detect speech acts?
● NLP models for speech act classification
● Hands-on: Using AI to classify speech acts in dialogues

W12  AI and Conversational Implicature Detection
● Can AL infer meaning beyond the literal?
● Case study: AI-generated implicatures vs, human interpretation
● Hands-on: Testing AI's ability to interpret implicatures

W13  AI and Politeness Analysis
● How do AI evaluate politeness in conversations?
● Bias in AI-generated politeness
● Hands-on: Using AI to analyze politeness in different contexts

W14  AI and Discourse Coherence–Can AI maintain Context
● How do AI models track coherence across discourse?
● Case study: Chatbot failures in maintaining coherent conversations
● Hands-on: Evaluating AI's discourse coherence

UNIT 3: AI, Bias, and Pragmatic Challenges
Weeks 15–16: Ethical and Applied Perspectives

W15  AI Bias in Pragmatics–"Who Gets to Be Polite?"
● How does AI encode social & cultural biases in pragmatics?
● Examples of AI misinterpreting pragmatic meaning
● Hands-on: Analyzing bias in AI-generated dialogue.

W16  AI-Assisted Pragmatic Research–Practical Applications
● How can researchers use AI to study pragmatic patterns?
● Workshop: Designing an AI-assisted pragmatic study.

W17  Final Presentations & Course Wrap-Up
● Students present their AI-assisted pragmatic research projects.
● Course reflection & feedback

W18  Final Project Due

name.zh: 高等電力網路規劃及分析
name.en: Advanced Electric Power Network Planning and Analysis

description.zh:
配合高科技的應用，電力系統亦朝高科技發展，以便對用戶提供高品質、高可靠性、高效率及高安全性的電力，其中所面臨的問題很多必須加以解決，此有賴於良好的電力網路規劃，及對問題的分析探討。為此，本課程針對現今及未來電力系統的發展，探討其網路之規劃及分析，主要內容包括：
1.先進電力網路之發展趨勢分析（包括發電、輸電、變電、配電等各級網路之發展趨勢分析）
2.先進電力網路規劃之範圍及要項（包括系統架構、線路及設備之型式、數量、容量、位置及配置方式等）
3.	負載特性之變化分析及負載成長預測（包括一般負載及科技產業負載）
4.先進電力網路規劃所需考慮之因數及相關條件分析（包括負載需求、能源供應、環保要求、經濟因素、區域特性、社會因素、建設成本、運轉維護、未來成長、、、）
5.先進電力網路之最佳規劃模式建立（包括目標（成本）函數及限制條件之探討及模式之建立）
6.先進電力網路最佳規劃之解空間及求解方法探討（包括單目標最佳規劃及多目標最佳規劃）
7.台灣電力網路規劃之特點
8.實際案例之演練及解說

syllabi.outline:
Advanced Robotics and Automation Applications (ARAA) course is offered only for up to 28 graduate students with programming experience. In addition to lectures on robotic manipulation, ARAA requires oral presentations and reports on robotics papers also focuses on projects with mobile robots and manipulators in the topics of interest related to:

1. Spatial descriptions and transformations  2. Manipulator kinematics  3. Manipulator inverse kinematics  4. Paper presentation and report  5. Project topics: manipulator and mobile robot control, and robot control system based on visual sensing

Course handouts will be available via iStudy web. In addition to homework assignments, a number of quizzes will be taken weekly during lectures. The quiz questions are based on problem sets in the textbook. Each student is required to make an oral presentation and submit a report based on a technical paper preferably related to proposed final project in related topics. All projects must be completed and evaluated in class under supervision of Professor and TA with particular attention to equipment operation safety.

description.zh: 生成式人工智慧(GAI) 的快速發展已經徹底改變了多媒體設計，AI生成的影片、圖像和文本已達到專業水準。本課程從神經網路的基礎理論開始，例如線性回歸、分類器、遞歸神經網路(RNN)、自編碼器(AE) 以及變分自編碼器(VAE)，最終涵蓋兩項關鍵技術的核心知識及多樣應用：大型語言模型(LLM)和擴散模型(Diffusion Model)。通過使用開源工具如Llama和Stable Diffusion進行實作練習，學生將深入了解AI的運作方式，並學習如何高效地創作高品質且具創意的 AI 內容。掌握這些技術後，學生將能將AI生成的內容整合至資訊系統中，提升系統功能、美感和用戶體驗。這門課程將幫助學生培養與AI共同創作超媒體內容的核心技能。
description.en: The rapid advancement of Generative AI (GAI) has revolutionized multimedia design, with AI-generated videos, images, and text now reaching professional standards. This course begins with foundational neural network theories such as linear regression, classifiers, RNN, AE, and VAE, and progresses to core concepts and applications of two major technologies: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Diffusion Models. Through hands-on practice with open-source tools like Llama and Stable Diffusion, students will gain a deep understanding of AI operation and learn efficient techniques for creating high-quality, innovative AI content. By mastering these technologies, students will be able to integrate AI-generated content into information systems, enhancing both functionality and user experience. The course prepares students with the essential skills for human-AI co-creation in hypermedia content.

syllabi.outline:
The breakthrough in Generative AI (GAI) technology has brought about a significant transformation in multimedia content design, with AI-generated videos, images, and text approaching the proficiency level of professionals. This course focuses on two major technologies: Large Language Models (LLM) and Diffusion Models, utilizing open-source tools such as Llama and Stable Diffusion for hands-on practice. In addition to providing an in-depth and comprehensive explanation of the working principles of LLMs and Diffusion Models, the course also teaches students the fundamental operation of AI and how to efficiently produce high-quality and creative AI-generated content. By mastering generative AI technology and its applications, students will be able to embed AI-generated multimedia content into various information systems, significantly enhancing system functionality, aesthetics, and user experience. This course aims to equip students with solid skills in learning, research, and application, achieving a human-AI co-creation of hypermedia content.

* Both theories and applications will be covered.
* Use Python + Keras for coding in W01~W06.
