description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，切入虛擬實境產業的各種可能性。從教育應用、設計工具以及虛擬實境遊戲設計、虛擬實境互動式動畫製作等，進行探討。
description.en: The main objective of the program, is taking from the application and design perspective, cut into the possibilities of virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

syllabi.outline:
Virtual reality (VR) is a fusion of art and technology, widely applied across various fields, including transportation simulators (driver training), BIM-integrated applications (building maintenance training), immersive gaming (next-generation sports, rehabilitation), immersive storytelling (film, animation), factory simulation, museums, and product previews. This course on VR applications focuses on the impact of VR on future technology and daily life, while also exploring the interplay between immersion, imagination, interaction, and human cognitive perception. The course covers the concepts, principles, and implementation methods of VR/AR and interactive haptic technologies, including an introduction to computer vision techniques, to help students understand sensory perception and interaction mechanisms in virtual environments. To enhance practical VR applications, students will be guided in developing innovative and practical multimedia human-computer interaction systems, exploring and evaluating immersive interaction models. Through a combination of theoretical instruction and hands-on practice, this course aims to equip students with core VR/AR technologies, fostering innovation, cross-disciplinary integration, and creative applications, enabling them to contribute to the future development and advancement of immersive technology.

虛擬實境是一種藝術與科技的整合，廣泛運用在不同屬性的領域，如交通模擬器(司機員訓練)、BIM整合應用(建築養護訓練)、沈浸式遊戲(新型態科技運動、復健)、沈浸式敘事(電影、動畫)、工廠模擬、博物館、成品預覽等。本虛擬實境應用之課程內容，將專注於虛擬實境應用對於未來科技、生活等不同層面的影響，同時探討沈浸、想像、互動與人類心理認知的相互關係。課程內容涵蓋VR/AR 及其互動體感技術的概念、原理與實現方法(電腦視覺技術簡介)，幫助學生理解虛擬環境中的感知與互動機制。為強化 VR 技術的實務應用，本課程將帶領學生開發創新且實用的多媒體人機互動系統，探索與評估沉浸式的操作模式。透過理論講解與實作練習，本課程將培養學生掌握 VR/AR 核心技術，並培育其創新應用與跨領域整合能力，使其在未來科技發展中發揮創造力與影響力。

description.zh: 新興數位學習媒體的開發日新月異，再加上資訊存取的高效能數位化，使得科技輔助的數位學習之路更形寬廣、開闊。電子書於知識傳遞的介面上，扮演了關鍵性的角色。傳統上以行為理論推衍而來的人機介面學習模式已然過於狹隘，因為數位時代中的學習者角色已由被動轉為主動，由行為導向轉為認知導向、意義導向以及脈絡導向，而資訊的解讀與詮釋更從單一性、制式化轉為開放性、多元化。對於致力於創新數位學習科技的開發者而言，針對學習者的學習模式重新加以審視是極為迫切的，如此方能以嶄新的角度去開發新的學習潛能和發展性。本課程目的即是從心理學、認知科學及資訊處理的角度來探討新型數位學習模式以及其應用方法，並探討數位學習成效評估系統的建立方案，形塑電子書於知識鴻海的無限可能。
description.en: The rapid development of digital learning and emerging learning technologies, as well as effective information storage platforms, have made traditional learning theory insufficient and less productive in guiding instructional designs for contemporary educational development. New available learning technologies therefore call for the need to re-consider new learning theories. For that, the definitions and mechanism of learning and learners have become more multidimensional and open-ended, instead of being singular and standardized in conventional perception. For those who are devoted to create new technological applications for learning, it is no doubt critical to construct new mechanism of learning in current highly digitized era. This course will discuss relevant cognitive learning theories from research in psychology and education, and contemplate how new e-learning solutions can be evaluated.

description.en: The rapid advancement of Generative AI (GAI) has revolutionized multimedia design, with AI-generated videos, images, and text now reaching professional standards. This course begins with foundational neural network theories such as linear regression, classifiers, RNN, AE, and VAE, and progresses to core concepts and applications of two major technologies: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Diffusion Models. Through hands-on practice with open-source tools like Llama and Stable Diffusion, students will gain a deep understanding of AI operation and learn efficient techniques for creating high-quality, innovative AI content. By mastering these technologies, students will be able to integrate AI-generated content into information systems, enhancing both functionality and user experience. The course prepares students with the essential skills for human-AI co-creation in hypermedia content.

By mastering generative AI technology and its applications, students will be able to embed AI-generated multimedia content into various information systems, significantly enhancing system functionality, aesthetics, and user experience. description.zh: 材料科學為工程教育的重要科技，材料的性質與特性，為現代工程設計中佔有相當重要的地位，金屬材料的各種性質，都基於其內部構造的變化，其內部原子聚集成規則的結晶構造，亦或聚集成非結晶構造，其所形成的各種物理特性，由最基本的結晶構造開始了解。電子顯微鏡，破壞力學，超導性，電傳導，超塑性，動態回復，動態時效應變。差排理論、結晶核的形成與成長，合金相理論，晶界自由度，鑄造物的成核與均質化，硬化現象，固體擴散現象，破壞現象及理論，潛變的形成與原因等，充分了解金屬材料特性上的理論基礎與變化軌跡。
description.en: Properties and characteristics of materials play important role in modern engineering design.Each property of materials is based on its transformation at inner structure, its atoms inside converge either a regulated crystal structure or a noncrystal structure, their physical property should be understood from the most fundamental crystalline structure, such as electronic microscope, destructive dynamics, super-conductivity, electronic conductivity, super-plasticity, dynamic recovery, dynamic aging strain , dislocation theory, the formation and growth of nucleus, alloy phase theory, degree of freedom of crystal boundary , nucleation and homogenization of casting product, hardening phenomenon, solid diffusion phenomenon, destructive phenomenon and theory, creep formation and its reason, all of these make student fully understand the theory basis and change record of the metallic material characteristics.

description.zh: 本課程著重冷凍系統和空調系統能源的分析，探討構成系統的主要元件－壓縮機、蒸發器和冷凝器的耗能，和各泵、冰水盤管、空調箱及風／水管路系統的能源耗損，進而對整個系統運轉時的效率予以檢討。最後提出各種改善方法，節約能源和減少電力契約容量的技術，以使學生具有節能省電的正確理論觀念和實務技術。
description.en:
This lesson is focused on the energy analyses of refrigeration systems and air-conditioning systems. The operating defects of compressors, evaporators and
condensers are to be investigated. Also the energy consumption's of pumps, fan coils air-handling units and duct/water systems are studied. The over all performance of the entire system is thus discussed. Several methods to improve the shortages and the techniques to energy conservation and electricity demand cut-down will be proposed.
The students should understand correctly the theory of energy conservation and the
technology to improve the systems.

description.zh: 本課程在教授學生藥用及化妝用高分子材料之相關產業製程及配方技術的實務知識，課程設計將首先介紹高分子材料的基本合成方法、物理化學性能、界面活性劑、乳化膠體及生物分解安全性。並教授高分子材料之應用區分為兩大類：其一是指在製藥之劑型加工時所用的和為改善藥物傳輸性能而採用的輔助材料(Excipients)，例如稀釋劑、潤滑劑、黏合劑、崩解劑、助流劑、緩和劑、穩定劑、保濕劑、膜包衣及膠囊殼等。藥用及化妝用輔助材料本身並不具有藥理作用，只是在藥品及化妝品的製造和使用中起從屬或輔助的作用。另一類高分子藥物則不同於前一類，它依靠連接在聚合物分子鏈上的藥理活性基團或高分子本身的藥理作用，進入人體後，能與機體組織發生生理反應，從而產生醫療美容或預防性效果。
description.en: The course is to provide the core knowledge for the development of pharmaceutical and cosmetic technology. It aims to educate and train students with the fundamental principles and applications of biodegradable polymers, surfactants, colloids, emulsions and their related physico-chemical properties. Then potential prospects of pharmaceutical and cosmetic polymers will be taught in two parts to help students understand the future frontiers in polymer science and technology. The first part of lectures will cover the wide range of polymer excipients such as diluents, lubricants, binders, disintegrants, glidants, demulcents, stabilizers, humercants, coatings, and capsules etc, which are inactive pharmaceutical ingredients used for assisting drug delivery. The second part will focus on polymer drugs, which are active pharmaceutical ingredients conjugated to polymer matrices such as polymeric micelles, liposomes, colloidosomes, and solid phase nanoparticle

description.en: This course covers the fundamentals of chemical sensors and biosensors based on chemical modifications, electrochemistry, spectroscopy, semiconductor technologies, and physiological electrical signal measurements. name.en: Analysis and strategic application of chemical engineering patents

description.zh: 專利文件是最具價值的技術研發資訊。課程除了介紹專利相關基礎知識之外，並以有效的專利檢索分析技藝洞悉未來技術趨勢，特別是針對化學工程、生物科技、生醫材料、智能程序工程、綠色能源、光電半導體、奈米材料等系所研究發展領域的專利文件。透過有系統的分析及視覺化的圖示呈現企業有用的專利情報(intelligence)，並找到其中潛在的商業利益。
description.en: Patent documents are the most valuable technology research and development information. In addition to introducing the basic knowledge of patents, the course also uses effective patent retrieval and analysis techniques to gain insight into future technological trends. The technical fields of patent documents are especially aimed at chemical engineering, biotechnology, biomedical materials, chemical process and intelligent engineering, green energy, optoelectronic semiconductors and nanomaterials. Present the useful patent intelligence of enterprises through systematic analysis and visual diagrams, and try to find the potential commercial benefits.

name.en: Development of Simulation Tools  for Engineering

description.zh:
電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。

課程訓練分兩階段進行：
第一階段確認學生具備基本程式設計能力。首先使其熟悉 Linux 平台及開源軟體的使用，運行不須理論基礎的簡易粒子模擬，針對收集到的數據進行統計分析，資料視覺化，資料定量分析及洞察等任務。以任務導向的學習方式，刺激同學針對特定問題和需求而快速擬定演算法，系統性地解決問題。
第二階段將模擬工具開發的能力應用在各科系的專業上。在進行短暫的文獻回顧後，與修課學生討論其專業領域中可用模擬解決或加速的學術研究及產業問題。針對主題制定計畫內容後，以選定的程式語言撰寫相關的應用程式，並以開發成開源軟體為最終目標。
註一、課程函授上以 GNU Fortran 和 Python3 為主要程式語言選擇，但學生可自由選擇所熟悉的語言作為工具。
註二、修課基本條件為修畢工程學院各系一年級程式設計相關之基礎課程，且具基本撰寫程式的能力。
description.en:
This course aims to provide complete training for developing modeling and simulation tools in engineering applications. Students will obtain the ability to analyze problems, formulate algorithms, write code, and implement the developed 
open-source programs in their fields of study. 
The first part of the training focuses on task-oriented coding experiences. Students will get familiar with the Linux platform and open-source programs. They will perform simple, particle-based simulations. The collected data will be analyzed, visualized, and interpreted based on the programs written by students.
The second part of the training applies the coding knowledge to students’ fields of study. After the literature survey, students will select the topic based on theirexpertise, where research or industrial problems can be accelerated by computer modeling. The final goal is to create software based on the course project.

syllabi.outline:
本課程著重學術研究能力的培養，為降低跨領域學習門檻，已大量去專業化，各系同學皆可選修。但為避同學程式基礎差異過大，不建議電資學院同學選修本門課。

電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。

本課程依循探究式教學的架構，分兩階段進行：

第一階段先簡介工程模擬的概念，引導同學思考自身專業裏需要解決的問題，以及如何以工程模擬輔助問題的解決。每週會選讀各專業裡工程模擬論文，並批判性思考論文提供資訊的可信度和影響性。最終將會提出一個簡短的報告書，說明想要研究的題目，需要使用的模擬軟體，預計要進行的分析和結果。

description.zh:
電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。

課程訓練分兩階段進行：
第一階段確認學生具備基本程式設計能力。首先使其熟悉 Linux 平台及開源軟體的使用，運行不須理論基礎的簡易粒子模擬，針對收集到的數據進行統計分析，資料視覺化，資料定量分析及洞察等任務。以任務導向的學習方式，刺激同學針對特定問題和需求而快速擬定演算法，系統性地解決問題。
第二階段將模擬工具開發的能力應用在各科系的專業上。在進行短暫的文獻回顧後，與修課學生討論其專業領域中可用模擬解決或加速的學術研究及產業問題。針對主題制定計畫內容後，以選定的程式語言撰寫相關的應用程式，並以開發成開源軟體為最終目標。
註一、課程函授上以 GNU Fortran 和 Python3 為主要程式語言選擇，但學生可自由選擇所熟悉的語言作為工具。
註二、修課基本條件為修畢工程學院各系一年級程式設計相關之基礎課程，且具基本撰寫程式的能力。
description.en:
This course aims to provide complete training for developing modeling and simulation tools in engineering applications. Students will obtain the ability to analyze problems, formulate algorithms, write code, and implement the developed 
open-source programs in their fields of study. 
The first part of the training focuses on task-oriented coding experiences. Students will get familiar with the Linux platform and open-source programs. They will perform simple, particle-based simulations. The collected data will be analyzed, visualized, and interpreted based on the programs written by students.
The second part of the training applies the coding knowledge to students’ fields of study. After the literature survey, students will select the topic based on theirexpertise, where research or industrial problems can be accelerated by computer modeling. The final goal is to create software based on the course project.

description.zh: 本課程規劃透過專業之人格特質分析方式，提供學生瞭解自我屬性於未來職場上之可能角色定位與認知感受，並針對學生畢業後進入職場將面臨的挑戰，提供應對進退之教戰策略與技巧傳授，包括壓力調適方式、溝通協調技巧、團隊合作注意事項、履歷撰寫方式、面試臨場技巧、以及職場倫理規範等，以提升學生爭取工作機會與進入職場後之適應能力與競爭實力。課程最後並安排整體課程之履歷健檢與模擬面試實作教育訓練，提供學生檢視學習成效並對未來職涯規劃預作準備。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with a professional personality analysis to understand the possible roles and perceptions of their attributes in the future workplace, and to teach them strategies and skills to cope with the challenges they will face when they enter the workplace after graduation, include stress adjustment, communication, and coordination skills, teamwork, resume writing, interviewing skills, and workplace ethics, etc. This course will also help students to enhance their adaptability and competitiveness when they enter the workplace. At the end of the course, a resume review and a mock interview will be provided to prepare students for their future career planning.

syllabi.outline:
Human-Computer Interaction Design: Autumn 2023 - Syllabus
Meeting Times and Location: Wednesday, periods: 2-4, 
Credit Hours: 3.0
Instructors: Ryan Sheng-Ming Wang
Instructor Office Location and Hours: Room 705-2, Design College bldg., 
Wednesday, 1300-1500: and Thursday 1300-1700.
Instructor Contact Information: E-mail: ryan5885@mail.ntut.edu.tw

Course Description: 
"Human-Computer Interaction Design" blends theoretical and practical perspectives in visualization and interactivity into several focused aspects using interactivity for education, entertainment, interactive media design, and industrial design purposes. 
An interface is a link between a user and a design that communicates how a design will be used, creating an experience for the people who will use it. It provides the framework, elements, and resources for a “conversation” between users and design.
This course will explore the fundamentals of interfaces and the human-computer interaction design process. Students will be introduced to and able to practice the fundamental concepts, methods, and human-computer interaction design practices. They will explore the ideas of "User Experience Observation ", "Form Follows Function," and "User Interaction Analysis and Evaluation". They will explore how interactive media create experiences and understand the role that interaction with contents and installment fulfills in human existence. Finally and most importantly, students need to learn how to improve their ability to present their design ideas.
This class is devoted to lectures, discussions, practice activities, design work sessions, and critiques of practical work. 


Course Objectives/Goals: 
At the conclusion of the course, students will be able to: 
1.	Identify how increasingly complex technologies are integrated into designs, services and events. 
2.	Define how digital or physical artifacts behave in response to user-centric interaction. 
3.	Describe, test and evaluate the usability and sustainability of user interfaces. 
4.	Apply iterative cycles of research, testing and development based on the understanding of user needs, goals and experiences. 
5.	Develop solutions and processes to common or known interface problems. 
6.	Build and test rapid prototypes for look and feel and usability. 
7.	Utilize client based concept development to develop the strategy, information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design. 
8.	Demonstrate competency in information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design.

name.en: Start to APP Design and Application

description.zh:
學習相似於Microsoft Power Point 的「拖-拉-點-選」操作方式，再加上一小部份的 Low Code程式編碼，即可以設計與製作出:「專業級的 APP」 !
本課程運用學校內的雲端平台: AgilePoint NX，改變了以往撰寫APP 的模式，不再需要撰寫複雜的程式碼，讓學生專注於 APP的邏輯流程與UI(使用者介面)，進而發展貼近市場裡的商業模式，設計出精彩的APP!
課程的教學，採用傳統臺北工專的黑手工程師訓練模式:
「由經入史」:先講解理論架構，進而延伸到產業的實務運用。
嚴格要求上課同學動手實做，達成每週的設定目標。課堂上講師所示範的範例非常豐富，下課後會有一定份量的Homework(實作型作業)。
經此系統化訓練，在APP的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。
「讓不懂IT(資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的APP! 」
description.en: Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

description.en: The main objective of the program, is taking from the application and design perspective, cut into the possibilities of virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

syllabi.outline:
Virtual reality (VR) is a fusion of art and technology, widely applied across various fields, including transportation simulators (driver training), BIM-integrated applications (building maintenance training), immersive gaming (next-generation sports, rehabilitation), immersive storytelling (film, animation), factory simulation, museums, and product previews. This course on VR applications focuses on the impact of VR on future technology and daily life, while also exploring the interplay between immersion, imagination, interaction, and human cognitive perception. The course covers the concepts, principles, and implementation methods of VR/AR and interactive haptic technologies, including an introduction to computer vision techniques, to help students understand sensory perception and interaction mechanisms in virtual environments. To enhance practical VR applications, students will be guided in developing innovative and practical multimedia human-computer interaction systems, exploring and evaluating immersive interaction models. Through a combination of theoretical instruction and hands-on practice, this course aims to equip students with core VR/AR technologies, fostering innovation, cross-disciplinary integration, and creative applications, enabling them to contribute to the future development and advancement of immersive technology.

虛擬實境是一種藝術與科技的整合，廣泛運用在不同屬性的領域，如交通模擬器(司機員訓練)、BIM整合應用(建築養護訓練)、沈浸式遊戲(新型態科技運動、復健)、沈浸式敘事(電影、動畫)、工廠模擬、博物館、成品預覽等。本虛擬實境應用之課程內容，將專注於虛擬實境應用對於未來科技、生活等不同層面的影響，同時探討沈浸、想像、互動與人類心理認知的相互關係。課程內容涵蓋VR/AR 及其互動體感技術的概念、原理與實現方法(電腦視覺技術簡介)，幫助學生理解虛擬環境中的感知與互動機制。為強化 VR 技術的實務應用，本課程將帶領學生開發創新且實用的多媒體人機互動系統，探索與評估沉浸式的操作模式。透過理論講解與實作練習，本課程將培養學生掌握 VR/AR 核心技術，並培育其創新應用與跨領域整合能力，使其在未來科技發展中發揮創造力與影響力。

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹專業英文論文的寫作格式，以及文件編修的技巧，且用深入淺出的例子作為示範，並輔以實際寫作練習與錯誤訂正。學員學習研究論文組織寫作，包含修改本身論文結構之基本技巧﹐正確組織文章的各個片段，避免口語用字寫字的陋習，使所作之文章能掌握其涵意，亦即能更有效率的利用英文寫出科技論文之佳作。
description.en: The goal of English Technical Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

description.zh:
本課程之目的在於介紹一些廣泛、基本及實際的半導體製造程序（其中最主要者為積體電路之製造程序）。
一、半導體基礎知識
1.1 半導體材料和性質
- 摻雜物質和半導體的導電性
- 能隙和能帶結構
1.2 基本的半導體器件
- 晶體二極體（Diode）
- 金屬氧化物半導體場效應電晶體（MOSFET）

二、半導體製程步驟
2.1 前端製程
- 晶圓製備
- 形成氧化層
- 光阻和光刻技術
- 擴散和離子佈植
2.2 中後段製程
- 金屬化和化學機械研磨（CMP）
- 絕緣層和封裝
- 測試和製程控制

三、先進製程技術
3.1 先進製程的發展趨勢
3.2 三維製程技術
3.3 極紫外線（EUV）製程

四、製程模擬和製程控制
4.1 製程模擬工具的應用
4.2 製程監控和優化
4.3 製程變異性和缺陷控制

五、產業應用與趨勢
5.1 半導體產業概況
5.2 新興應用領域
5.3 綠色製程和可持續性

description.zh: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位化工廠。數位化製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位化製造概論、數位化製造實例說明、商業模型分析、知識管理、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站、工作流程管理、最新數位化相關技術介紹。
description.en: Globalization has lead contract manufactures more active on seeking new strategies to survive. To increase competition, new technologies, such as computer and network technology, have applied. Computer and network technology can integrate internal and external information to establish a so-called "e-factory." This course covers different issues related to e-Manufacturing, such as Concept of e-Manufacturing, Case Study, Business Model Analysis, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Knowledge Portal (EKP), Product Data Management (PDM), Concept of Trading Systems, Concept of Data Warehousing, Enterprise Information Portal (EIP), Workflow Management, State of the Art Technologies, etc.

name.en: Taguchi Method on the Quality Design

description.zh:
(1)「田口方法」介紹
(2)完整的「田口方法」，包含以下三個主題：
(a) S/N比之理論基礎及進階應用；
(b)直交表之理論基礎及進階應用；
(c)變異分析。
(3)應用「田口方法」進行專案研究，並繳交專案主題與報告。
description.en:
(1) The course gives step-by-step to explaining the "Taguchi Method" for the students.
     (2) The course gives the fully "Taguchi Method" for the students during a short time, which including three topical subjects:
  (a) The basic theory of S/N ratio and its advanced applications.
  (b) The basic theory of Orthogonal Arrays and its advanced applications.
  (c) Analysis of Variance (ANOVA)
  (3) Students will use the "Taguchi Method" to proceeding a project study, and hand over their theme and report of project.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的學習目標是要讓學生學習「田口方法」的基本觀念，並且以實際案例做說明，讓學生學習專有名詞的定義及應用。課程內容包含：直交表實驗、品質計量方法(品質損失、S/N比之理論基礎及應用)、變異分析、案例說明。在學期結束時，應用「田口方法」進行專案主題研究，並繳交期末報告。
The learning goal of this course is to enable students to learn the basic concepts of the Taguchi Method. In addition, actual cases are used to explain, so that students can learn the definition and application of proper nouns. The course content includes: experiment with orthogonal arrays, quality measurement methods (theoretical basis and application of quality loss, S/N ratio), analysis of variance, and case description. At the end of the semester, apply the "Taguchi Method" to conduct project thematic research and submit the final report.

第二週 	「望目」理想機能之實例介紹
第三週	「原點直線型」的理想機能實例介紹

description.en: Spatial description and transformation, Manipulator kinematics, Inverse manipulator kinematics, Jacobians for velocities, Trajectory generator, Manipulator sensing and design, Linear control of manipulator.

syllabi.outline:
Robotics course is offered to junior or senior undergraduate students interested in learning fundamentals of robotics. In addition to lectures on robotic manipulation, oral presentations and reports on robotics papers are required.  Main topics in the course are as follow.
機器人學適合對機器人領域有興趣的大三或大四大學生修習，除教授機器人學相關學習內容外，鼓勵修課同學閱讀相關論文並演示簡報與撰寫報告，課程相關主題如下：
1. Spatial descriptions and transformations 空間描述與數學轉換 2. Manipulator kinematics 機械臂運動學 3. Manipulator inverse kinematics 機械臂反向運動學 4. Manipulator sensing, design, and control 機器臂感測、設計與控制  5. Paper presentation and report 論文簡報與撰寫報告。
Course handouts will be available via iStudy web. A number of homework questions, based on problem sets in the textbook, will be assigned for students to complete in class in an open-book fashion. Each student is required to make an oral presentation and submit a report based on a technical paper in related topics. 
本課程於每週課前公布講義於北科i學園+，修課同學將於課堂中開卷完成特選作業問題，藉以評估作業及學習狀況。期末簡報應研讀相關論文、撰寫書面報告並於課堂上口頭報告。

description.zh: 給水及污水工程介紹自來水及汙水工程及其操作系統所需之原理、設計工具。其主要應用到流體力學、水文學、水處理及相關之設計及計算。主要的議題包含水質參數、地表水及地下水處理、自來水處理過程、汙染物移除、管網設計、汙水處理、生物處理、下水道建設、自來水及下水道操作及維護。
description.en: The Water Supply and Sewerage provides students with engineering principles and tools for designing and operating water and sewerage systems. It facilitates application of knowledge acquired in fluid mechanics, hydrology, water quality, design and computing. Key topics include water quality parameters; groundwater and surface water treatment; water treatment process technologies; nutrient removal; simplified sewerage; decentralised water and sanitation systems; biosolids management; and operation and maintenance of water supply and sanitation infrastructure.

syllabi.outline:
給水與污水工程是土木與環境工程中重要的基礎工程課程。給水工程為自來水工程，從水源取水、導水、淨水到配水，包含一連串的工程技術與方法。污水工程則是將廢污水淨化處理，至符合國家放流水標準後排出的過程。兩者處理對象與目的不同，但其中淨水處理有相似的技術與方法。本課程著重在淨水工程部分，也是兩者的核心技術。而給水工程中的取水與輸配水屬於水利工程，本課程僅簡要介紹。淨水處理包含物理、化學、生物處理技術，根據廢污水特性以及處理目的可選擇不同的淨水方法，或者相互搭配使用以達到效率與成本等要求。本課程將說明各種處理技術的核心理論以及計算，使學生未來具有污水處理設計之能力。
Water supply and wastewater treatment engineering is the core course in the civil and environmental engineering. Water supply engineering includes series technologies from water intake to allocate water to citizens. To determine the place to intake water, to transport water, to purify water and to allocate the clean water are the missions of water supply engineers. Wastewater treatment engineering is to treat wastewater to the required concentration standard. The two engineering have different subjects and different goals. However, the water purification and wastewater treatment has the similar methods, which is the core technology in the two engineering and also the core content in this course. The methods about water withdraw and transportation belong to hydraulic engineering and is briefly introduced in this course. The wastewater treatment methods can be divided to physical, chemical, and biological methods. The use of these methods to achieve legal requirement and minimum cost and high efficiency is the mission of engineers. In this course, the theorem of the treatment methods and the associated calculations will be explained, in order to equip the student to capable of designing wastewater treatment.

description.zh: 在山坡地的開發成為必然的趨勢下，不合理的土地利用破壞了自然的平衡。水土保持學是研究如何維護自然的「水」、「土」平衡，而水土保持工程學是研擬如何配合自然的特性，應用工程方法，達到自然平衡的目的。本課程綜合土木工程各相關基本課程，講解水土保持工程基本理念及說明水土保持工程個別處理單元，讓學生瞭解物理現象並找到具體解決方法。課程旨在使學習者了解土壤沖蝕、水土保持農藝法、水土保持工程、水土保持植生法的基本知識、技術及未來發展方向。
description.en: This course covers a broad spectrum of disciplines, including hydrology, watershed management, erosion control, soil conservation practices, and the application of engineering principles to maintain the balance of water and soil.  Students are expected to learn the basics and techniques of soil erosion control, soil and water conservation with agronomic, engineering, and vegetation methodology, respectively.

description.zh: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，準備實際電機技術(元件、電路、方法)之專利申請案，讓同學模擬實際申請專利的過程，首先是進行專利檢索與分析，討論專利佈局的策略；接著讓同學進行專利說明書(含申請專利範圍)撰寫實習，模擬實際上申請各國專利之程序，然後討論專利申請後的答辯、領證繳費及後續維護事宜。
description.en: In this course, we will focus on the practice of the patent application in   electrical engineering technology. Students will learn how to do patent search and analysis, write specification/drawings/claims, and reply office action responses. In addition, the practical aspects of international patent application are presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies will be also discussed in this class.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，以實際電子電機產品或相關技術，讓同學以產業發展觀點模擬實際申請專利的過程，課程內容包含相關電機相關產品與技術服務發展需考量的相關法規、專利檢索、分析及佈局策略、專利說明書撰寫實習、專利申請程序探討、專利答辯、領證繳費及維護事宜。

name.zh: 模糊理論在災害管理之應用
name.en: Application of Fuzzy Theory in Disaster Management

description.zh:
模糊理論基本觀念
模糊數學
模糊多屬性決策分析
應用實例分析
description.en: The course introduces fuzzy theory and related models to improve the effectiveness of disaster management. The main content includes concepts of logic, fuzzy set, fuzzy relation, fuzzy math, fuzzy logic, calculation principles, and some important performance evaluation methods and application algorithms which are often used with fuzzy theory. The course may help students not only touching the key concepts of fuzzy theory, but also independently doing deeper research in fuzzy, evaluation, and management field.

syllabi.outline: 介紹模糊理論及其於方案評選、績效評估等相關研究方法之應用，並延伸簡介部分機器學習方法。內容包括戴爾菲法、集群分析、層級分析法、理想解趨近法、決策實驗室分析法、Q方法、資料包絡分析、決策樹與隨機森林、倒傳遞類神經網路等。期使學生能對模糊理論的重要觀念及應用技術有更深一層的認識，不僅提昇閱讀相關論文與期刊等文獻之能力，且對研究工作有所助益。

name.en: Introduction to Random Vibration and Time-Frequency-Domain Analysis

description.zh: 本門科目主要為介紹隨機震動學基本理論、頻譜分析與小波分析理論。主要的授課內容涵蓋基本統計理論、隨機訊號定義、期望值與相關函數、傅立葉轉換及快速傅立葉、功率頻譜密度函數、頻譜分析、非定常訊號判斷、基礎小波分析等。配合結構動力學，本科目亦講授結構系統受到隨機外力作用而產生之結構反應的頻率域動力分析應用及小波分析應用等範例。
description.en: This course is designed to introduce the basics of random vibration, spectral and wavelet analysis. The schedule includes those topics such as fundamental theories of statistics, definition of random signals, expectation and correlation functions, Fourier transform and F.F.T., power spectral density, spectral analysis, non-stationarity judgement, and basic theories of wavelet analysis. To harmony with Dynamics of Structures, this course also introduces examples of dynamic analysis of structural systems excited by random loadings in the frequency domain and applications of wavelet analysis.

syllabi.outline: The subject is designed to include two professional realms – random vibration and time-frequency domain analysis. The fundamentals of random vibration include statistics, correlation analysis, spectrum estimation, spectral analysis of the SDF system, and so on. The time-frequency domain analysis includes the FFT technique, Hilbert Transform, short-time Fourier Transform, and Wavelet analysis, and so on.

name.zh: 資訊檢索與人工智慧應用

description.zh:
資訊檢索（Information Retrieval）是搜尋引擎背後的技術基礎，以給定的查詢詞彙找出帶有相關資訊的文件，能夠處理與比較未結構化或半結構化的文字資料。在人工智慧與機器學習技術飛越成長的當代，自然語言處理（Natural Language Processing）及文本探勘（Text Mining）輔助人們在散亂的文本當中發掘有意義的資訊。傳統的資訊檢索理論在文本探勘的任務當中則扮演了重要的輔助角色，其賦與將文件以向量表達的基礎，亦即使諸多人工智慧應用能夠順利的與文本探勘任務接軌。

本課程將教導修課同學資訊檢索、自然語言處理與資料探勘的理論基礎，以及各種新穎的人工智慧與機器學習應用如何取代傳統方法。並且訓練修課同學使用現成的程式語言套件來分析自己手邊的文本資料。
description.en:
Information Retrieval (IR) is the process that retrieves the information which is relevant to a specific information need from a data collection. Search engine systems provides a famous example of IR applications. In recent years, with the growth of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing (NLP), many of the AI applications can help discover useful information in unstructured or semi-structured text collections, such a process is called Text Mining. The traditional IR technique also play an important role to support the AI applications. It can vectorize the texts and make it possible to compare the similarities between different pieces of text.

This course aims to train the enrolled students to learn the basic concept of IR, NLP, and AI applications which are relevant to Text Mining tasks. In addition, this course also trains the enrolled students to use existing tools and software packages which can support the AI applications.

name.zh: 集水區水文暨水質模擬
name.en: Watershed-Scaled Hydrologic and Water Quality Modeling

description.zh: 本課程專為有興趣透過數理模擬方法來提升集水區管理技能的學生而設計。課程內容提供了對集水區水文系統內水文過程和水質模擬所使用的原理機制和方法的全面理解。修習本課程需具備水文學和環境科學及工程的基礎知識。學生將探索多種數理模擬工具和技術，以模擬水文和水質對不同環境條件和土地利用衝擊的回應。此外，學生還需學習一些盛行的水文和水質模式並將其應用到現實場景中，以實施有效的水資源管理。本課程旨在使學生掌握必要的知識和技能，以模擬和分析水文過程及水質動態，這對於有效的水資源管理至關重要。
description.en: This course, designed for students who are interested in watershed management, will enhance their skills through modeling analysis.  It provides a comprehensive understanding of the principles and methodologies used in hydrologic processes and water quality modeling within watershed hydrologic system.  Fundamentals and basics of hydrologic and environmental science and engineering is prerequired for taking the course.  Students will explore various modeling tools and techniques that simulate hydrologic and water quality responses to different environmental conditions and land-use practices.  In addition, students are expected to learn and apply some prevailing hydrologic and water quality models to real-world scenarios for effective water resource management.  This course aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to model and analyze hydrologic processes and water quality dynamics, which are critical for effective water resource management.

syllabi.schedule:
Unit 1: Introduction to watershed hydrology (watershed processes and delineation).
Unit 2: Soil erosion and sediment transport.
Unit 3: Water quality parameters and standards.
Unit 4: Derivation of mass balance equations; advection, diffusion, and dispersion.
Unit 5: Pollution types, modeling pollutant loads, and control strategies.
Unit 6: Streeter-Phelps model; dissolved oxygen and BOD dynamics.
Unit 7: Nutrient cycling and eutrophication.
Unit 8: Watershed-Scale water quality models (model selection and frameworks).
Unit 9: Model calibration and validation techniques.
Unit10: Land-Use change and BMP scenarios. 
Unit11: Addressing uncertainty in modeling.
Unit12: Climate Change Impacts on watersheds.

Both experimental procedures and techniques base on concepts of electrode reactions and impedances are discussed during the entire presentation of this course.

name.en: The Architecture and the Urban Microclimate

description.zh:
納入「都市微氣候」的考量，是現階段精進建築設計與提升建築效能的關鍵手段之一；回饋在生活舒適度的感受、居住安全度的維護以及省能節電度的落實等面相，都可得到具體且顯著的成效。
掌握都市微氣候的特徵型態與變化脈動，擬判對建築安排可能肇致的影響及干擾，透過自然循環的流場機制及量場管制，找到本土建築規劃之最佳改善設計策略。
description.en:
Bringing the “Urban Microclimate” into consideration is one of the key methods to enhance architectural design and upgrade building effectiveness at the present time; it can get feedbacks in many aspects such as feelings of cozy life, maintenance of residential safety , and to carry out the energy-saving.
  Holding the features and changes of the Urban Microclimate, analyzing the potential affect and disturb for architecture, through the control mechanism of natural circulation in order to find the best strategy for local design enhancement.

本課程著重於藉由整合CFD環控技術於建築設計實作手法，學習掌握量體設計對都市微氣候的影響與變化，判斷建築安排可能肇致的影響及潛能，透過自然循環的被動式流場控制，找到本土建築規劃之最佳整合設計策略。

syllabi.outline: 本專題課程為歷史保存進階課程，其內容將以歷史建築的保存與再利用為主軸，概分為保存理論、保存實務二部分。前者包括國內、外歷史保存的發展概要、保存觀念發展與保存理論、哲學。後者則包括保存實踐過程—指定、調查、設計、修復施工、管理維護與再利用，有關保存與再利用之實務，進行研討、參觀與解析。期使修課同學除了對歷史保存的意義有所體認外，亦對古蹟保存之全貌有所掌握與理解。

name.en: Special Topics on Indoor Environment Quality

description.zh:
本課程主要在教導學生深入探討最新的室內環境議題與人體健康間的關係，使學生具備創造健康室內環境的相關知識及操作能力，主要授課要點如下：
1.以單一類型的建築室內環境為探討主題；
2.探討環境影響人體健康之最新研究議題；
3.進行跨領域合作提出共同改善之策略及方法；
4.學習各項環境量測儀器之原理、操作與判讀能力；
5.具備診斷與改善特殊室內環境議題之專業知識及操作能力。
description.en:
In this course students are going to be taught how to discuss the relationship between indoor environment quality and human healthy in order to promote students' recognition and abilities to create healthy indoor environment.
Contents :
1. The indoor environment of single type of building.
2. The relationship between the artificial environment and human health.
3. Providing some strategies and methods to improve indoor environment quality through cooperating with other science field.
4. Learning how to use instruments to evaluate indoor environment quality.
5. Learning how to diagnose and improve the special topics of indoor environment quality.

syllabi.outline:
為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。
本課程為第二階段之系列課程，其內容包括：一、疫學：探討關於病態建築症候群的因素與特定外來的致病物質與疫之關聯。二、家政事務：探討生活習慣、飲食生活的變化對環境、人體健康之影響。三、醫療領域：探討病態建築症候群與化學物質過敏症的差異與因應對策。四、日常領域：探討日常生活用品、居住行為對環境、人體健康之影響。

name.zh: 都市土地使用計畫與成長管理
name.en: Urban Land Use Planning and Growth Management

description.zh: 本課程主要目的在強化有關都市土地使用規劃與成長管理的理論與經驗，以及增進對都市整體建成環境未來的瞭解。因此，本課程將藉由對都市土地使用規劃與成長管理經驗特有與一般課題、對策及創新作法的基礎瞭解，以培養理論與實務的知能。故本課程主要內容包括： 一、都市成長對土地的需求。 二、土地使用管制與倫理。三、都市變遷與規劃。四、都市成長管理與政府的角色。 五、達到都市成長管理的可能途徑。 六、都市成長管理體系內的必要措施：例如環境、交通運輸、住宅、財政、風險、信託、組織等。 七、結論。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to further our knowledge about current theories and experiences with urban land use planning and growth management, and the struggle to define the collective future of our built environment. By identifying unique as well as common issues, problems, and innovations in urban growth management experiences, our hope is to improve planning practice. To examine these concerns, the course includes: 1. Land needs for urban growth. 2. Land use control and ethics. 3. Urban change and planning. 4.Growth management and the role of government. 5. Alternative approaches to growth management. 6. Balancing planning needs in growth management systems: environmental, transportation, housing, financing, risk, trust and organization concerns. 7. Conclusions

name.zh: 建築與景觀都市主義研究
name.en: Studies in Architecture and Landscape Urbanism

description.zh: 都市主義(Urbanism)最早可追溯於十九世紀末建築工程師對於空間組織與城市關係的討論，其真正的崛起始於二十世紀初對於集中生產，空間組織網絡與政治經濟市民等都市中新興現象的討論。因日趨複雜化的都市發展與環境巨變的挑戰，九十年代開始陸續出現一系列以都市主義為基盤的跨學科整合性討論，而景觀都市主義(Landscape Urbanism, 1997)則在其中扮演相當關鍵的角色。不論是庫哈斯早期在S, M, L, XL (1995)中的批判，或瓦爾德海姆在《都市景觀主義讀本》(2006)中的宣言，皆引指建築、景觀建築、都市設計與都市計畫學門，已逐漸形成一種彼此跨越亦彼此更新的領域狀態。這般跨都市主義架構，使各學門在理論發展與專業實踐上具有更開展性的方法，介入當代與未來的都市環境與城市生活。然而此跨都市主義的學理多在景觀學門的教學範疇內，但在建築專業教育中卻鮮有足夠的涉及與含括。
description.en: The term "urbanism" originated in the late nineteenth century with a focus on spatial organization of the city. The emergence of urbanism in the early twentieth century was associated with the rise of industrial distribution, spatial networks and citizenship etc. in the city. After 90’s, there were a series of new academic terms referring to this idea which created a base for interdisciplinary studies amongst related spatial terrains. Landscape Urbanism is regarded as one of the significant design and planning ethos especially in the twenty-first century.  In Koolhaas’ early work S,M,L,XL(1995)and Waldheim’s representative collection The Landscape Urbanism Reader(2006), they both shared account that architecture, landscape architecture, urban design and planning are moving toward shared form of emerging ‘practice. The body of knowledge about Landscape Urbanism has been largely developed within landscape discipline, yet merely in the architectural discourse especially in Taiwan.

description.zh:
設計的溝通扮演著如何將設計理念成功地傳達以及讓使用者清楚的理解設計本意的重要角色。
本課程將透過設計思考過程藉由文字、口說、圖面等達到設計溝通之目的及訓練，經由了解設計領域應用之文字搭配口說及圖面進而增進設計者說明設計概念的溝通能力。
課程內容包含設計溝通的基本原則、技巧及策略，以及如何利用不同的溝通媒介及工具來傳達設計理念。
課程操作包含案例分析搭配實際的簡報演練及口說訓練讓同學們累積應用經驗。
description.en:
Design Communication plays an important role in how to successfully deliver design concepts and have users understand the design intention clearly. 
This course will practice and reach the goal of design communication through design thinking by vocabulary uses, verbal speeches, and image presentations.  From understanding the proper application of design language including vocabularies and diagrams in various design fields, designers may improve their skills of concept presentation and communication.  
The course content includes basic principles, techniques, and strategies in design communication as well as how to use different media and tools to deliver design concepts.
Course activities include case studies with presentation practice and oral speech to help students have experiences in actual application.

description.zh: 目前建築工程營建產業多賴以圖文資料溝通，文件易有失誤，會提高成本、工期延長、甚至於爭議之狀況。BIM 工具之運用，可有效提升營建產業生產力。各國政府已紛紛推出 BIM 的審照制度，我國近年來於公共工程招標已要求BIM技術之整合運用。本課程針對BIM運用於建築生命週期中各產業間的介紹及效益、實例分享，並於課程中指導同學針對BIM軟體基礎工具使用。
description.en:
Architectural engineering construction industry on which 2D graphic data communication, the file is easy to form mistakes, will increase the cost of the extension of time, even controversial situation. The use of Building Information Modeling (BIM) software tools, which can effectively enhance the productivity of the construction industry. Governments around the world have now launched the BIM audit system.
In recent years, Taiwan has asked the public works bidding integrate and use of BIM technology. This course focuses on the introduction and effective life cycle of BIM for architectural industry, examples of sharing.  Guidance to students in courses based tool for BIM software.

description.zh: 本課程著重於商業溝通及實務的應用。每個實例討論均能幫助學生了解英文商務應用，並且提供學生去研習，分析並將個人論點英文表達。課程的重點有二：加強學生理解英文在商業領域的重要性，增強學生在商業案件中的綜合分析的表達能力。此外，由實際的商業實務中反應出各種未來可能出現的不同挑戰，讓學生有機會學習應對。根據課程規定，學生須具備高級英文的能力跟基本的商業知識。
description.en: The course explores the intersection of the English language communication and cases in real business world.  Each case to be discussed in this course illustrates the many aspects of business operations and provides students with the opportunities to examine, to analyze and to present their views in English. The emphasis of the course is two-fold. While reinforcing the importance of business communications in English and enhancing students' analytical competence in discussing the cases, real-world business stories reflect a multitude of challenges to resolve and opportunities to embrace in hopes that students are well-prepare to cope with all these in the future to come.  As the course prescribes, students are required to have an advanced English level and fundamental business knowledge.

This course is designed to provide students with a practical understanding of marketing and consumer market development through real-world business case studies. By analyzing different marketing strategies, consumer behavior trends, and market development approaches, students will develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and strategic analysis skills. Through case study presentations, group discussions, and written reflections, students will apply theoretical marketing concepts to real-world business challenges.This course will emphasize market expansion, brand positioning, digital marketing trends, and consumer engagement strategies, providing valuable insights for future business professionals.

syllabi.assessment:
Course Requirements
Students’ responsibilities in this class include:
1. Attendance and Participation – Regular attendance and active engagement in discussions are required.
2. Case Study Presentations
Each student (or group) will be assigned a business case focused on marketing and consumer markets. Presentations must include key insights, strategic challenges, and potential solutions. Students must provide a summary handout before their presentation.
4. Reflection Report
Students must submit a comprehensive case analysis report (4-7 pages) summarizing key takeaways and/or integrating insights from multiple case studies covered in class.

Semester Grading Policy
The six-week course will account for 33% of the total semester grade, with students assessed based on their presentations, reflection report, and participation. Grades will be prorated accordingly within the overall semester evaluation.
1. Case Study Presentations 50%
2. Reflection Report 30%
3. Attendance & Participation 20%

Attendance Policy
Students are required to attend all class sessions on time.
Each absence will result in a 10% deduction from the final semester grade.
A university-approved leave document may waive one absence penalty per semester.
AWOLs (absences without leave) will be recorded and included in the penalty calculation if not rectified within two weeks.
The instructor reserves the right to modify this syllabus. Any changes to the grading policy will be discussed in class.

description.zh: 「天然生物材料特論」旨在探討天然材料在生物系統中的結構、性質與應用。隨著對生物系統的深入研究，科學家逐步發現天然材料擁有優異的性能，如自我修復、抗菌、生物相容性等。本課程將介紹天然生物材料的最新研究進展及其在工程領域的應用，包括生物高分子、生物材料的製備技術及其在醫學、環保及工業中的潛力。本課程涵蓋以下四大主題：（1）天然生物材料概述、（2）天然材料的基本結構單元、（3）天然材料的生物功能及應用、（4）天然材料的仿生與生物製造技術。
description.en: “Natural Biomaterials” is designed to explore the structures, properties, and applications of natural materials in biological systems. Scientists have discovered that natural materials possess outstanding features such as self-repair, antimicrobial properties, and biocompatibility. This course will introduce the latest research developments in natural biomaterials and their applications in engineering fields, including biopolymers, biofabrication, and the potential uses in medical, environmental, and industrial domains. The topics covered in this course will include (1) an overview of natural biomaterials, (2) fundamental building blocks of natural materials, (3) biological functions and applications, and (4) bioinspired and biofabrication technologies.

“Natural Biomaterials” is designed to explore the structures, properties, and applications of natural materials in biological systems. Scientists have discovered that natural materials possess outstanding features such as self-repair, antimicrobial properties, and biocompatibility. This course will introduce the latest research developments in natural biomaterials and their applications in engineering fields, including biopolymers, biofabrication, and the potential uses in medical, environmental, and industrial domains. The topics covered in this course will include (1) an overview of natural biomaterials, (2) fundamental building blocks of natural materials, (3) biological functions and applications, and (4) bioinspired and biofabrication technologies.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Natural Biomaterials and Chemical Engineering Applications
•	Overview of natural biomaterials and their significance in chemical engineering.
•	Emphasizing ethical responsibilities and the societal impact of biomaterials in medicine and environmental sustainability.
Week 2: Amino Acids, Proteins, and Polysaccharides: Fundamental Chemistry
•	Detailed study of the chemical properties of amino acids, proteins, and polysaccharides.
•	Application of chemical engineering concepts to optimize biomaterials for industrial use.
Week 3: Research Planning and Methodology in Biomaterials Science
•	Introduction to planning research projects in the field of biomaterials.
•	Discussion on research ethics, data integrity, and professional responsibility in scientific research.
Week 4: Biofabrication Techniques and Innovative Problem Solving
•	Exploration of biofabrication technologies such as 3D bioprinting and their use in chemical engineering applications.
•	Case studies focusing on innovative solutions to complex problems using bio-inspired materials.
Week 5: Project Management in Biomaterials Research
•	Fundamentals of project management for research and development in biomaterials.
•	Effective communication and teamwork strategies in the context of interdisciplinary projects.
Week 6: Advanced Materials for Environmental and Medical Applications
•	Application of natural biomaterials in chemical processes for environmental protection and healthcare.
•	Discussing the social and environmental responsibilities of engineers in material design.
Week 7: Writing Research Papers and Professional Reports
•	Techniques for structuring and writing professional research papers in biomaterials.
•	Focus on clear communication, scientific rigor, and addressing societal needs in technical writing.
Week 8: Midterm Presentation and Feedback Session
•	Students present their ongoing research or theoretical projects.
•	Focus on teamwork, communication, and integration of feedback into project development.
Week 9: Surface Properties of Natural Biomaterials and Their Applications
•	Exploration of the surface chemistry of biomaterials and its influence on functionality.
•	Application of chemical engineering concepts in designing surfaces for medical devices and filtration systems.
Week 10: International Trends and Collaboration in Biomaterials Research
•	Introduction to global developments and international collaborations in biomaterials research.
•	How chemical engineers can contribute to cross-border research projects and international mobility.
Week 11: Adhesion Mechanisms in Biomaterials and Their Engineering Applications
•	Study of adhesion mechanisms in biological materials, with examples such as mussels and barnacles.
•	Application of these natural principles in engineering adhesive materials for industrial use.
Week 12: Lifelong Learning and Career Development in Chemical Engineering
•	Emphasizing the importance of continuous learning and self-improvement in chemical engineering.
•	Exploring online resources, conferences, and professional networks for staying updated in the field of biomaterials.
Week 13: Problem-Solving in Biomaterials Engineering
•	Case studies on real-world challenges in biomaterials engineering.
•	Encouraging innovative thinking and independent problem-solving through chemical engineering approaches.
Week 14: Managing Research Projects and Teams
•	Practical project management skills: organizing research teams, assigning tasks, and tracking progress.
•	Methods to improve team collaboration and integrate different scientific disciplines.

name.en: Intelligent Applications of Internet of Things

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在教授學生機器學習、大數據等人工智慧技術，並使用在物聯網的創新與應用上。課程內容包括：人工智慧概論、大數據方法、機器學習方法、資料探勘方法、最佳化方法、物聯網概論、影音處理、雲端技術、物聯網系統實作等。
description.en: This course is to instruct students the basics of artificial intelligent methods and apply these methods to innovative applications of Internet of Things. The contents include introduction to artificial intelligence, machine learning methods, data mining methods, optimization methods, introduction to internet of things, video and audio processing, cloud computing, and innovation project implementation.

syllabi.outline:
隨著人工智慧、5G通訊網路與感測技術的迅速發展，智慧物聯網應用已成為產業關注的核心領域。本課程旨在培養學生掌握人工智慧與物聯網的技術，並將其應用於創新發展。課程內容涵蓋物聯網與人工智慧的基礎概念、智慧物聯網的實作技術，幫助學生理解關鍵技術並具備實作能力。學生將學習設計與開發基於感測器與Arduino的嵌入式系統，熟悉物聯網架構，並透過各類通訊模組將感測數據傳輸至雲端平台。最後，課程將介紹如何運用人工智慧技術實現智慧化物聯網應用。
With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, 5G communication networks, and sensing technologies, smart IoT applications have become a key focus in the industry. This course aims to equip students with AI technologies and apply them to innovative IoT developments. The curriculum covers fundamental concepts of IoT and AI, as well as hands-on smart IoT implementation, enabling students to understand key technologies and develop practical skills. Students will learn to design and develop embedded systems based on sensors and Arduino, familiarize themselves with IoT architecture, and transmit sensor data to cloud platforms through various communication modules. Finally, the course will introduce the development of expert systems using AI technologies to achieve intelligent IoT applications.

description.zh:
本課程介紹了創新的本質、企業創新的原因以及如何管理創新。課程內容程涵蓋有關創新管理的一系列主題，包括創新動機、企業如何利用知識產權（如專利和商標）保護其創新、“研究與開發”（R&D )、創意人員、流程和團隊的管理，產品、服務和體驗創新的管理，“開放式創新”的採用和使用，以及創新中模塊化的採用和使用。
本課程在科技管理的部分主要介紹科技管理廠商層次(micro-level)與總體層次(macro-level)的相關理論，研究的領域與相關學術期刊。廠商層次介紹開放式創新、創業管理、智慧財產管理、資源論、技術搜尋、產業組織論等。在總體層次介紹科技政策的範疇與相關理論，包括技術典範與軌跡、國家、產業與區域創新系統、服務創新、科技計量與指標與產學合作政策等。
課程內容包括以案例研究為重點的討論，其中混合使用虛實的公司來討論管理創新的各個面向。這些討論與課程中涵蓋的主題互補，並以加強用予實際應用的想法。透過本課程，學生可以對碩/博士論文的研究課題，能有正確且有效地構建文獻探討的能力。
description.en:
This course introduces the nature of innovation, why firms innovate, and how innovation can be managed. The lectures cover a range of topics concerning the management of innovation, including motivations for innovating, how firms can protect their innovations using intellectual property rights (such as patents and trademarks), the nature and organization and management of “research and development” (R&D), the management of creative people, processes and teams, the management of product, service and experience innovations, the adoption and use of “open innovation”, and the adoption and use of modularity in innovation.

description.en: This course focuses on the theory and practice of leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is; (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for business management and (4) to apply the basic ideas of leadership and management in daily life.

name.zh: 先進光電材料與雷射應用
name.en: Advanced Photonic Materials and laser application

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹先進光學材料(包含光電半導體、奈米晶體、二維材料、有機光電材料與液晶等)的特性及其在雷射技術中的應用，包括相關材料的性能與製備、光學量測設備以及相關雷射應用的案例。透過此課程，學生將學習新的光學材料之光電物理特性，掌握雷射技術的基本原理並評估不同光學材料在雷射應用中的可能性。
description.en: This course provides a systematic introduction to the properties of advanced optical materials, such as optoelectronic semiconductors, nanocrystals, two-dimensional materials, organic optoelectronic materials, and liquid crystals, as well as their applications in laser technology. The course covers the performance analysis and fabrication methods of these materials, the operating principles of optical measurement instruments, and real-world applications through various laser technology case studies. Through this course, students will gain a solid understanding of the optoelectronic properties of advanced optical materials, comprehend the fundamental principles and mechanisms of laser technology, and develop the ability to evaluate the potential of different optical materials for laser applications.

The course covers the performance analysis and fabrication methods of these materials, the operating principles of optical measurement instruments, and real-world applications through various laser technology case studies. Through this course, students will gain a solid understanding of the optoelectronic properties of advanced optical materials, comprehend the fundamental principles and mechanisms of laser technology, and develop the ability to evaluate the potential of different optical materials for laser applications.
syllabi.schedule:
I. Fundamentals of Optics and Optoelectronic Materials
1.	Basic concepts of optics and optoelectronic materials
2.	Fundamental principles of laser technology
II. Types and Properties of Advanced Optical Materials
1.	Optoelectronic semiconductor materials
2.	Nanocrystals and quantum dots
3.	Two-dimensional materials (e.g., graphene, transition metal dichalcogenides)
4.	Liquid crystal materials
III. Preparation and Performance Testing of Advanced Optoelectronic Materials
1.	Material preparation techniques
2.	Performance testing and characterization
IV. Fundamentals and Applications of Laser Technology
1.	Principles and classifications of laser operation
2.	Core components and design of lasers
V. Applications of Optoelectronic Materials in Laser Technology
1.	Selection and design of optical gain materials
2.	Applications of nanomaterials and two-dimensional materials in laser gain
3.	Applications of liquid crystals in tunable lasers
4.	Applications of organic materials in ultrafast lasers
VI. Case Studies of Optical and Laser Applications
1.	Practical examples of material and laser device integration
2.	Applications of advanced optical materials in industry and medicine
VII. Future Developments and Challenges
1.	Emerging research directions in advanced optical materials
2.	Interdisciplinary applications and development trends of laser technology
VIII. Final Report and Group Discussion
1.	Group research on specific applications of advanced optoelectronic materials
2.	Evaluation and discussion of materials' potential in laser technology

description.zh: 電化學的領域包羅萬象，舉凡電泳作用與腐蝕現象的探討，電分析感測器或電池元件的製作，以及電鍍、拋光或鋁和氯氣的生產技術等均為電化學工程的範疇。本課程除了講述基本的電化學原理外，將著重於電化學分析方法在化學系統研究上的應用。
description.en: The field of electrochemistry includes many different phenomena (e.g., electrophoresis and corrosion), devices (electro analytical sensors and batteries), and technologies (the electroplating of metals and the large-scale production of aluminum and chlorine). In addition to an overview of the basic principles of electrochemistry, the main emphasis here is on the application of electrochemical methods to the study of chemical systems.

課程以講述電化學分析技術與原理為主，並以期刊論文中用到的電化學方法與曲線圖為案例進行說明。涵蓋的基本技術包括電位計、伏安法、計時電流或電位法、電化學阻抗譜等；延伸分析包括Tafel plot, Mott-Schottky analysis, E-pH diagram, Randles-Sevcik relation, Levich equation等的說明。涉及的領域包括腐蝕、資源化技術、電化學冶金、半導體製程(蝕刻、電沉積、CMP)、電池與電容、電催化、電還原、電沉積、電解、電化學加工、電化學感測器等。目標為讀懂且能理解電化學專業論文中的實驗設計與結果討論。 
The course focuses on the principles and techniques of electrochemical analysis, using the related methods and curves commonly found in journal papers for explanation. The basic techniques covered include potentiometry, voltammetry, chronoamperometry or chronopotentiometry, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy etc. Advanced analyses such as Tafel plots, Mott-Schottky analysis, E-pH diagrams, the Randles-Sevcik relation, and the Levich equation are also explained. The topics span various fields, including corrosion, resource recovery technologies, electrochemical metallurgy, semiconductor processes (etching, electrodeposition, CMP), batteries and capacitors, electrocatalysis, electroreduction, electrodeposition, electrolysis, electrochemical machining, and electrochemical sensors etc. The goal is to enable students to comprehend and understand the experimental design and results discussion in professional electrochemistry research papers.

description.zh:
地球自生成以來，其組成與結構一直在改變。今日的岩體即是這種長期改變的結果。地質學是研究岩體組成與結構變化的科學，目的在於掌握這種變化的軌跡，而構造地質學是地質學裡專門研究岩體結構變化的一分科。所謂的岩體結構（即地質構造）是指一個岩體的形狀、尺寸及其內部組成顆粒的排列情形。要了解結構的變化，無論是定性或定量，先要了解岩體的原始結構，從而才能了解現在所觀察到的岩體結構是否發生過變化。雖然構造地質學的目的是由現在既成的結構去了解地球的結構變化，但是就現在地球的結構，我們所能觀察到的岩體結構，大多被植生或土壤所覆蓋，即使偶有露出，也僅是其立體結構的某一表面而已，因此如何利用這些零星有限且是平面的岩體結構去推論地殼整體的結構，是必須首先解決的問題。面對這樣的問題，研究構造地質學應從大處著眼、小處著手，先從了解一個地區某一個露頭的現在結構開始，並由理論及實驗所得的結果推論這個岩體的結構變化過程，再由這些零星露頭的結構及其結構變化過程的資料，去推論、去拼湊涵蓋這些露頭地區的結構，由點而線、由線而面，終而包括整個地殼。
本課程為構造地質學的進階課程，主要討論以下之主題：岩石的力學性質與變形行為、應變分
description.en:
Structural geology is a branch of earth science. It has developed rapidly over the past decade. The reason for the recent advances in structural geology has been the realization that naturally deformed rocks seen in field outcrops contain a fantastic range of small-scale features which relate directly to large-scale orogenic deformation systems. The other reason has been the realization that rock deformation, like any other form of deformation, obeys well-defined physical and chemical laws. Base on this situation, this course is intended to serve as an accompaniment to techniques-based courses in structural geology or as an accompaniment to the laboratory portion of a postgraduate course. 
Systematic study of this advanced structural geology course includes several topics: mechanic proporties and deformation behaviors of rocks, strain analysis, ductile geologic structures, brittle geologic structures, and applied structural geology.

name.zh: 高科技專利取得與攻防
name.en: High Tech Patent Applications and Protections

description.zh: 高科技產業的專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出數十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利申請策略開始，告訴同學專利申請上常見的錯誤，如何以較低的成本取得、維護我國專利，並利用我國專利進行全球專利佈局。
description.en: Patent litigation, either initiation or defense, has become one of the high-tech industrial strategies, and more and more patent suit cases have forced the manufacturers to undertake patent design around. In fact, the industrial fields in Taiwan, theoretically, do not feel strange on design around and patent strategies. However, in practice, they perform much less. That is the reason why Taiwan still has to pay more than five billion US dollars each year for royalty. This course will start from patent filing strategy, getting patent claims well known, then following with introduction on orientation of patent strategies, and providing theory and practice on patent strategies. The outline of this course is given as follows: Patent claim interpretation; Process of patent infringement analysis; Requirements of patent design around; Patent strategy analysis; Practice on patent strategies; and Study on patent cases.

syllabi.outline: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。因此本課程主要強調專利策略與專利布局分析在企業界的運用分析。

name.zh: 材料特性與熱管理實務應用

description.zh: 在諸多工程應用實例中，如LED、晶片之散熱問題、流體在能源系統中之熱交換、燃料電池衍生之熱問題等，都與材料之規格選用、處理方法、加工方式、製造過程有明顯的相關性。本門課程主要針對材料工程與熱管理相關的技術問題，提出探討與對策，期使學生對熱管理在材料與系統工程上的應用提供適當的專業知識。
description.en: In engineering applications, such as LED, chip cooling, heat exchange in energy systems, fuel cells, are always comes with the problems of thermal generation. Meanwhile, manufacturing process and heat treatment of these products are also strongly dependent of the selection of material specifications. The purpose of this course would like to employ practical problems and lead the students in finding appropriate solutions or technical approaches to solve the related problems they could meet.

syllabi.outline:
本課程關注板金成形(全英語授課)。第一部分主要探討2系列與7系列鋁合金之材料特性，及其於潛變時效成形熱處理之析出硬化機制及變形行為。第二部分為探討鋼鐵材料於熱衝壓成型過程之材料特性及熱管理。
修課前提:須具備基礎材料科學及材料力學知識、及能解基本偏微分方程式之能力、基礎matlab程式語言能力、有限元素軟體(Forge)操作。

This course is about sheet metal forming process. The first part of this course mainly discusses about the material characteristics of 2xxx and 7xxx series Aluminum alloys and it's precipitation behavior in Creep age forming and heat treatment process. The second part discusses about the material characteristics of steel in hot stamping process and it's thermal management in heat treatment process.

Prerequisite: Basic abalities in solving partial differencial equations(PDE), matlab codes, FE software(Forge)

description.zh: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位化工廠。數位化製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位化製造概論、數位化製造實例說明、商業模型分析、知識管理、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站、工作流程管理、最新數位化相關技術介紹。
description.en: Globalization has lead contract manufactures more active on seeking new strategies to survive. To increase competition, new technologies, such as computer and network technology, have applied. Computer and network technology can integrate internal and external information to establish a so-called "e-factory." description.zh: 本課程探討的內容涵蓋國際金融基本觀念、架構、理論與應用，課程內容包括：匯率、外匯市場(即期、遠期、外匯期貨和外匯選擇權市場)、國際收支與國際貨幣制度、國際收支調整理論和均衡匯率決定理論等。同時討論國際金融環境的變化、多國籍企業如何規避匯率風險、開放經濟下的總體經濟政策等議題。此門課的修習除了有助於了解國際金融相關知識外，並可以培養對國際金融與匯兌問題之思考、探討、批判與洞察能力。
description.en: This course provides the introduction to the workings of the foreign exchange markets, the impact of economic policy on exchange rates, the nature of foreign exchange risk, and the effects of various international economic policies on domestic and world welfare. The course content will include balance of payments, determination of foreign exchange rates, and international monetary system, and cover the following topics: foreign exchange market; the interest rate parity theorem; exchange rates and inflation; purchasing power parity; balance of payments and national income accounting; the determination of the exchange rate.  In addition, we focus on how multinational corporations manage their exchange rate risk, and how they make sound investment and financing decisions factoring exchange rate fluctuations.

description.zh: 熱傳學主要內容是研究由於溫度梯度所造成能量傳遞之一門學問﹐為一般冷凍、空調、食品冷藏及各類型熱交換器設計之基本知識程,其他大如各類發電廠，小如電腦微晶片散熱亦有密切關係。本課程之安排以奠定學生在熱傳方面之智能，作為未來進入冷凍、空調與能源相關學門之踏腳石。
description.en:
1.	熱傳導定律之推導
2.	一維及多維的穩態與暫態熱傳分析，
3.	散熱片之設計，利用數值方法解熱傳導問題，
4.	對流原理之推導
5.	強迫對流方面的分析及應用-層流邊界層，管道內層流熱傳
6.	自然對流方面的分析及應用-管道外與封閉空間內自然對流        熱傳
7.	紊流的基本性，紊流邊界層，管道內紊流
8.	具相變化的熱對流:凝結與沸騰
9.	熱交換器設計介紹

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域資安之應用
name.en: Artificial Intelligence Cross-domain Applications in Information Security

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討人工智慧在跨域資安上的應用。課程將從零信任安全、人工智慧安全、個人資料與隱私保護、人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測、人工智慧在舞弊的偵測、人工智慧輔助電腦稽核、人工智慧輔助數位鑑識以及API安全等議題進行深入探討。首先，在零信任安全的概念上，探討如何使用此方法來保障資料安全，接著探討人工智慧安全的基礎知識，包括機器學習、深度學習等技術，並介紹如何將這些技術應用於資安領域。此外，在人工智慧在安全的應用上，將導入人工智慧在入侵偵測、漏洞掃描、安全威脅評估等方面的應用案例，以及如何使用人工智慧技術進行網路安全防禦。在人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測方面，將介紹如何使用人工智慧技術檢測網路攻擊，包括異常檢測、入侵檢測等技術。最後，課程還將介紹API安全，包括API安全的風險與漏洞、API保護措施等方面的內容，並介紹如何使用人工智慧技術保護API的安全性。
description.en: This course aims to explore the application of artificial intelligence in cross-domain cybersecurity. First, the course will introduce the concept of zero-trust security and discuss how this method can be used to safeguard data security. In addition, the course will also explore the application of AI in security, including case studies in intrusion detection, vulnerability scanning, security threat assessment, and how AI can be used for network security defense and protect personal data and privacy. In addition, the use of AI technology for detecting cybersecurity incidents, including detecting network attacks using techniques such as anomaly detection and intrusion detection. It will also explore fraud detection using AI, such as credit card fraud or malicious top-up fraud. Lastly, the course will introduce API security, including risks and vulnerabilities, API protection measures, and how to use AI technology to protect API security.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在探討人工智慧在跨域資安上的應用。課程將從零信任安全、人工智慧安全、個人資料與隱私保護、人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測、人工智慧在舞弊的偵測、人工智慧輔助電腦稽核、人工智慧輔助數位鑑識以及API安全等議題進行深入探討。首先，課程將介紹零信任安全的概念，探討如何使用此方法來保障資料安全，並深入探討其相關技術及應用案例。課程還將探討人工智慧在安全的應用，以及如何使用人工智慧技術進行網路安全防禦。在隱私保護方面，介紹有關個人資料與隱私保護的法律、標準與指引，以及如何在人工智慧應用中保護個人資料和隱私。課程也將深入探討人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測方面，介紹如何使用人工智慧技術檢測網路攻擊，包括異常檢測、入侵檢測等技術。
This course aims to explore the application of artificial intelligence in cross-domain cybersecurity. It will delve into topics such as zero trust security, AI security, personal data and privacy protection, AI in the detection of information security incidents, AI in fraud detection, AI-assisted computer auditing, AI-assisted digital forensics, and API security. Initially, the course will introduce the concept of zero trust security, discussing how to use this method to ensure data security, and will explore its related technologies and application cases in depth. The course will also examine the application of AI in security, and how to use AI technologies for network security defense. In terms of privacy protection, it will cover laws, standards, and guidelines related to personal data and privacy protection, as well as how to protect personal data and privacy in AI applications.

description.zh: 區塊鏈和數位資產是未來金融和科技領域的重要趨勢之一，本課程將介紹區塊鏈以及數位資產的基本知識與原理，並探討如何利用區塊鏈以及比特幣技術搭建新型態的金融基礎設施與永續的生態系統，內容包含 (1) 區塊鏈基礎；(2) 比特幣運作原理；(3) 穩定幣等數位資產；(4) 比特幣進階，含閃電網路、側鏈、智能合約層、永續挖礦…等；(5) 實體世界資產 (RWA，Real World Asset)；(6) 區塊鏈分析；(7) 法規與監管…等，為參與課程的學生建立正確的區塊鏈與數位資產的觀念。
description.en: Blockchain and Digital Asset are one of the important trends in the future of finance and technology. This course will introduce the basic knowledge and principles of blockchain and digital assets, as well as explore how to use blockchain and Bitcoin technology to build a new type of financial infrastructure and sustainable ecosystem, the content includes (1) Blockchain basics; (2) Bitcoin operating principles; (3) Digital assets such as stable coins; (4) Bitcoin advanced including Lightning Network, Rootstock, Stacks, sustainable mining...etc. (5) Real World Asset (RWA); (6) Blockchain analysis; (7) Regulations and supervision... etc., to establish a correct concept of blockchain and digital assets for students participating in the course.

syllabi.outline:
區塊鏈和數位資產是未來金融和科技領域的重要趨勢之一，本課程將介紹區塊鏈以及數位資產的基本知識與原理，並探討如何利用區塊鏈以及比特幣技術搭建新型態的金融基礎設施與永續的生態系統，內容包含 (1) 區塊鏈基礎；(2) 比特幣運作原理；(3) 穩定幣等數位資產；(4) 比特幣進階，含閃電網路、側鏈、智能合約層、永續挖礦…等；(5) 實體世界資產 (RWA，Real World Asset)；(6) 區塊鏈分析；(7) 法規與監管…等，為參與課程的學生建立正確的區塊鏈與數位資產的觀念。
Blockchain and Digital Asset are one of the important trends in the future of finance and technology. This course will introduce the basic knowledge and principles of blockchain and digital assets, as well as explore how to use blockchain and Bitcoin technology to build a new type of financial infrastructure and sustainable ecosystem, the content includes (1) Blockchain basics; (2) Bitcoin operating principles; (3) Digital assets such as stable coins; (4) Bitcoin advanced including Lightning Network, Rootstock, Stacks, sustainable mining...etc. (5) Real World Asset (RWA); (6) Blockchain analysis; (7) Regulations and supervision... etc., to establish a correct concept of blockchain and digital assets for students participating in the course.

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要講述切換式電源電路之分析與設計，包含各式電路架構操作原理分析、電路及元件之挑選與設計、PWM控制電路設計以及回授控制器之設計。所分析與設計的電路涵蓋一般的直流-直流轉換器以及具有電氣隔離之轉換器架構、乃是諧振式轉換器等。在課程中亦講述各種交流-直流轉換的功率因數修正器之分析與設計，闡述各種功率因數修正法則以及相關的控制方式。修習本課程之後，期望學生能夠瞭解切換式電源的整體架構以及相關的分析及設計，在畢業進入職場時可以與產業快速接軌。

name.zh: 全端網頁軟體系統實作

description.zh: 伴隨全球資訊網(Web)普及應用，可讓不同裝置、系統運行相同網路服務的網頁平台儼然成為當下資訊系統的主要潮流，過去網頁系統的建構可區分成1.網頁前端(Front-end)：主負責使用者看見的瀏覽器端，以及2.網頁後端(Back-end)：主負責運算、儲存資源的伺服器端，不同面向的軟體人才必須熟悉不同軟體實作技巧，然而，面臨物聯網(Internet of Things)、第5代行動通訊(5G)的挑戰，產業需要能夠同時精通前端與後端之軟體實作技術，並進一步延伸支援外部系統整合與介接的全端(Full Stack)軟體人才，本課程主旨為教授網頁前端、後端軟體實作技巧，並結合新一代網路協定，以及外部感測裝置，建構出全方位之網頁系統軟體。
description.en: With the growth of World Wide Web, the web platform can let different devices and systems operate the same network service. Thus, the web platform has become the key foundation of modern software implementation. In the past, it can be divided into (1) front-end, which represents the user-side browser, and (2) back-end, which represents the server of data processing and storage. Programmers need to learn different front-end or back-end techniques. However, regarding 5G and Internet of Things, industries need full-stack software programmers. The goal of this course is to teach the front-end and back-end software implementation. Furthermore, the course would introduce how to integrate new network protocols and connect embedded sensors. After learning in this course, students are expected to implement one comprehensive web software system.

1.	修課學生可從本課程學習Web前端(Front-end)軟體實作。

description.zh: 機器學習探討如何能由觀測到的資料中自我學習，自我進化，而能自動增進其處理效能。例如進行預測，特徵擷取，分類，模式辨認，決策，各種訊號處理，甚至建立人工智慧等等。本課程將介紹機器學習的基礎演算法、理論及工具。並讓學生嘗試在各種領域中實際實踐這些技術。課程內容包括：(a) 監督式學習（例如參數和非參數演算法、支持向量機和類神經網路等），(b) 無監督學習（例如群聚、降維和深度學習等）與 (c) 機器學習應用實例（例如語音信號處理，影像訊號處理，音訊訊號處理與自然語言處理，資訊擷取與資料搜尋等）。
description.en: Machine learning studies how to automatically learn from observed data to improve the performance of prediction, information extraction, clustering, pattern recognition, decision making, signal processing and even artificial intelligence. This course will introduce fundamental algorithms, theories and their practical applications. The content will cover (a) supervised learning, such as parametric and non-parametric algorithms, super vector machines and neural networks, (b) unsupervised learning, for example, data clustering, dimension reduction and deep learning and (c) practical applications on speech, image, audio signal and natural language processing or information retrieval and search, etc.

description.zh: 這門課程深入探討將AI技術直接整合至硬體的過程。課程從AI晶片的基本概念開始，進一步探討各種AI的數位、類比及混合訊號架構。課程內容涵蓋了對神經網路模型映射到晶片硬體的過程及優化。重要的一環是神經網路編譯器的設計與優化，並輔以實務工具和考量以實現高效的AI晶片設計。課程還探討了AI晶片的當前應用及AI硬體發展的未來趨勢。課程以學生專題為導向，將所學知識應用於創新的AI晶片解決方案。此課程旨在為學生提供在不斷進化的AI硬體領域中取得成功所需的技能和知識。
description.en: This course, titled "AI-on-Chip Design: Architectures and Applications," offers a deep dive into how AI technologies are integrated directly onto hardware. It begins with fundamental concepts of AI-on-Chip, moving into the intricacies of digital, analog, and mixed-signal architectures tailored for AI applications. The curriculum includes a thorough examination of neural network models, focusing on their optimization and the critical process of mapping these models onto hardware. A significant portion is dedicated to the design and optimization of neural network compilers, supplemented by practical insights into the tools and considerations necessary for efficient AI chip design. The course also explores current applications of AI-on-Chip and anticipates future trends that could reshape AI hardware development. syllabi.schedule:
AI-Chip and Laboratories Course Outline
1. Introduction to AI and AI-Chip Design
•	Overview of AI Hardware Evolution: GPUs, TPUs, and AI-specific hardware
•	Introduction to AI-Chip Architectures: Digital, analog, and mixed-signal approaches
•	Overview of AI Workloads and Requirements: Computational demands and data processing needs for AI models
2. Fundamentals of Chip Design
•	Digital Circuit Design Basics: Logic gates, combinational and sequential circuits
•	Analog Circuit Design: Amplifiers, filters, and signal conditioning
•	Mixed-Signal Circuit Design: ADC, DAC, and their role in AI processing
3. AI Hardware Architectures
•	Processor Design for AI: Instruction sets, RISC vs. CISC for AI
•	Accelerator Design: Introduction to accelerators like GPUs, TPUs, and NPUs
•	Memory Architectures: SRAM, DRAM, and memory hierarchies in AI chips
•	Interconnects and Data Transfer Protocols: High-speed data transfer, PCIe, NVLink, and memory coherence
4. Neural Network Processors
•	Basics of Neural Network Architecture: Feed-forward, convolutional, and recurrent networks
•	Designing Efficient NN Hardware: Specialized multipliers, accumulators, and activation functions
•	Optimization Techniques: Quantization, pruning, and sparsity to enhance performance
5. AI-Chip Laboratory Setup and Tools
•	EDA Tools Overview: Key tools for IC design and simulation (e.g., Cadence, Synopsys, MATLAB/Simulink)
•	Hardware Descriptive Languages (HDL): VHDL, Verilog, and SystemVerilog basics for AI-chip design
•	Simulation and Testing Tools: Using simulators to test functionality, power, and thermal profiles
6. Compiler and Software Stacks for AI Hardware
•	NN Compiler Overview: Compilation techniques for neural network models on hardware
•	Firmware and Driver Development: Basic driver development for AI hardware
•	Software-Hardware Co-design: Balancing computational loads between hardware and software layers
7. Real-World Applications of AI-Chips
•	Edge AI Applications: Low-power, real-time AI applications and the role of AI chips
•	Data Center Applications: High-performance AI chips for cloud infrastructure
•	Specialized AI Hardware in Industry: Robotics, automotive, and medical applications
8. Practical Laboratory Work
•	Lab 1: Basic Digital Logic Circuit Design and Simulation
•	Lab 2: Analog Signal Processing and Amplification Techniques
•	Lab 3: Mixed-Signal Processing and ADC/DAC Interfacing
•	Lab 4: Implementing Neural Network Inference on FPGA
•	Lab 5: Profiling AI Workloads and Optimizing Performance
•	Lab 6: Developing and Testing Custom NN Layers for Hardware Execution
syllabi.assessment:
Homeworks (60%)
Capstone Project (40%)
•	Project Development: Students propose and develop a small-scale AI-chip-related project
•	Integration and Testing: Practical work on implementation, testing, and performance evaluation
•	Presentation and Feedback: Final project presentation and feedback session

description.zh: 機器學習探討如何能由觀測到的資料中自我學習，自我進化，而能自動增進其處理效能。例如進行預測，特徵擷取，分類，模式辨認，決策，各種訊號處理，甚至建立人工智慧等等。本課程將介紹機器學習的基礎演算法、理論及工具。並讓學生嘗試在各種領域中實際實踐這些技術。課程內容包括：(a) 監督式學習（例如參數和非參數演算法、支持向量機和類神經網路等），(b) 無監督學習（例如群聚、降維和深度學習等）與 (c) 機器學習應用實例（例如語音信號處理，影像訊號處理，音訊訊號處理與自然語言處理，資訊擷取與資料搜尋等）。
description.en: Machine learning studies how to automatically learn from observed data to improve the performance of prediction, information extraction, clustering, pattern recognition, decision making, signal processing and even artificial intelligence. This course will introduce fundamental algorithms, theories and their practical applications. The content will cover (a) supervised learning, such as parametric and non-parametric algorithms, super vector machines and neural networks, (b) unsupervised learning, for example, data clustering, dimension reduction and deep learning and (c) practical applications on speech, image, audio signal and natural language processing or information retrieval and search, etc.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在讓學生掌握MATLAB的基本操作與機器學習技術，內容涵蓋數據導入與處理、知識發掘、回歸分析、分類演算法、聚類方法及人工神經網路等主題。此外，課程強調模型效能的優化與實務應用，透過結合理論講解與實作練習，幫助學生培養解決實際問題的能力，最終能夠獨立完成機器學習專案。This course is designed to equip students with fundamental MATLAB operations and machine learning techniques. The content includes data importing and processing, knowledge discovery, regression analysis, classification algorithms, clustering methods, and artificial neural networks. Furthermore, the course emphasizes model performance optimization and practical applications. By combining theoretical instruction with hands-on exercises, students will develop the ability to solve real-world problems and eventually complete independent machine learning projects.

name.zh: 人體生物學及生物物理學

description.zh:
在過去的60年裡，生物醫學工程學科發展已成為明確的，多樣化的，內容無所不包的領域；包括生物電現象、生物信息學、生物材料、生物力學、生物儀器、生物傳感器、生物信號處理等領域，以及生物技術、計算生物學和複雜多樣性、基因組學、醫學影像學、光學和雷射激光、輻射影像、組織工程等。
本課程主要將適用於工程學門學生，且已完成物理、化學或生物學基礎課程為佳。此基礎在大二或大三的學生應該已可做好充分的準備。本課程將學習人體解剖學、生理學、生物物理學和生物醫學工程。整合了一系列知識，以幫助修課同學瞭解生物訊息和醫學儀器，並可以用來監測這些生物醫學現象。課程的學習主要是將這些生物醫學現象，運用其基礎於電力、壓力和流量的物理現象加以說明，並將這些生物醫學現象經由電子及工程的特殊條件和應用系統而呈現。在這種學習中，課程涵蓋了相關醫學和生物學領域、化學、物理、工程的知識和方法，期使將其成功及適當應用於多種生物醫學儀器。本課程將主要研習人體結構（解剖）及其功能系統（生理學），但這些原則同樣也可能適用於其它所有生命系統。
經由醫學背景引導進入此領域，結合工程及材料師長的經驗及參與，將可含括主要生醫工程及組織工程領域的基礎
description.en: Over the past sixty years, as the discipline of biomedical engineering has evolved, it has become clear that it is a diverse, seemingly all-encompassing field that includes such areas as bioelectric phenomena, bioinformatics, biomaterials, biomechanics, bioinstrumentation, biosensors, biosignal processing, biotechnology, computational biology and complexity, genomics, medical imaging, optics and lasers, radiation imaging, tissue engineering, moral and ethical issues. This course will be designed primarily for engineering students who have completed physical equations and a basic course in statics of chemistry and biology.  Students in their sophomore year or junior year should be adequately prepared for this course.  This course will be learning about human anatomy, biophysics, physiology, and biomedical engineering. 本課程主要將適用於工程學門學生，且已完成物理、化學或生物學基礎課程為佳。此基礎在大二或大三的學生應該已可做好充分的準備。本課程將學習人體解剖學、生理學、生物物理學和生物醫學工程。整合了一系列知識，以幫助修課同學瞭解生物訊息和醫學儀器，並可以用來監測這些生物醫學現象。課程的學習主要是將這些生物醫學現象，運用其基礎於電力、壓力和流量的物理現象加以說明，並將這些生物醫學現象經由電子及工程的特殊條件和應用系統而呈現。在這種學習中，課程涵蓋了相關醫學和生物學領域、化學、物理、工程的知識和方法，期使將其成功及適當應用於多種生物醫學儀器。本課程將主要研習人體結構（解剖）及其功能系統（生理學），但這些原則同樣也可能適用於其它所有生命系統。
經由醫學背景引導進入此領域，結合工程及材料師長的經驗及參與，將可含括主要生醫工程及組織工程領域的基礎

syllabi.outline:
什麼是人體生物學及生物物理學？
人體生物學及生物物理學是一門非必修主要課程，旨在探索人體形式和功能之間的基本關係。解剖學和生理學是生命科學中兩個最基本的術語和研究領域。解剖學是指身體的內部和外部結構及其物理關係，而生理學是指研究這些結構的功能。本課程旨在定義瞭解剖學和生理學，並解釋了為什麼它們對生物醫學工程很重要。主要器官系統的解剖學和生理學將在正常和疾病狀態的背景下進行研究。

學生將學習關鍵的生物過程，如中心教條，膜擴散和運輸，細胞信號傳導，氣體交換，血流，營養吸收，血液pH平衡以及動作電位的產生和傳播。然後，學生將應用這些知識來瞭解器官如何對維持體內平衡的各種輸入做出反應。課程將納入實踐演示，為課程中提供的資訊提供實用框架：
1.根據位置，功能，關鍵成分和解剖命名法確定主要的人體系統。
2.展示對代謝功能和每個主要器官系統的生理控制的理解。
3.認識並綜合體內平衡的原理，即主要器官系統在生理上如何相互關聯以維持人類健康。

在學期階段，學生將廣泛瞭解身體系統如何在細胞，組織和器官系統水平上發揮作用，並能夠將簡單的生理過程聯繫起來，以更好地了解社會中高度流行的疾病和對生物醫學工程重要實用框架。

人體生物學及生物物理學的課程目標：
1.人體是一個實用的結構，它由四種主要類型的數十億個較小的結構組成：細胞，組織，器官和系統。
2.器官是幾種不同種類的組織，如此排列，以至於它們可以一起執行特殊功能。
3.系統是一個由不同數量和種類的器官組成的組織，它們如此排列，以至於它們可以一起為身體執行複雜的功能。
4.十個主要系統包括骨骼，肌肉，神經，內分泌，心血管，淋巴，呼吸，消化，泌尿和生殖系統。
5.身體功能是身體系統的生理或心理功能。身體的生存取決於身體維持或恢復其內部環境的體內平衡，這是一種相對恆定的狀態。
6.人類的生命過程包括組織、新陳代謝、反應性、運動、繁殖、生長、分化、呼吸、消化和排泄。所有這些過程在微調的平衡中協同工作，以維護個人的健康和維持生活。 
7.生命依賴於環境中的某些物理因素，包括水，氧氣，營養物質，熱量和壓力。

人體生物學及生物物理學課程的學習評估：
基於出勤以及課堂互動，每周提供一個帶回家的研究案例以突出所涵蓋系統的人體解剖學和生理學，每周測驗以及一個期中和期末測驗。  

人體生物學及生物物理學的課程實踐體驗：
如果人體解剖學和生理學的想法看起來很可怕，請不要擔心。本課程將通過以平易近人且相關的格式涵蓋這些主題來減輕您可能有的任何恐懼。本課程將使您對人體所有複雜的功能和系統如何協同工作更加自信，並將您從解剖學和生理學方面學到的知識與您已經瞭解的身體聯繫起來。將此視為人體使用者指南。有些人可能會說你不能沒有它！

本課程還將涵蓋身體的主要系統，並解釋它們是如何工作的，為什麼它們有時不起作用。此外，它還將檢查不同的疾病和紊亂，醫學的最新進展以及照顧身體的方法。課程包括現實生活中的例子和互動練習，讓你批判性地思考自己的經歷，並與課程建立聯繫。在整個課程中都使用全面綜合知識和理解，為您提供必要的學習材料，以便在您繼續接受教育或職業生涯時保留本課程及以後的內容。在本課程結束時，你將對人體的奇妙複雜性有更大的欣賞和理解。
