description.en: This course is concerned with the digital television (DTV) design, which includes Enhanced Definition Television (EDTV), High Definition Television (HDTV), Standard Definition Television (SDTV). Its purpose is to deal with the analysis and design of DTV system, emphasizing fundamentals as well as new paradigms that students need to master in today's industry. The course covers the following topics. 1. Introduction to Video; 2. Color space; 3. Analog video interfaces; 4. Digital Video Interfaces; 5. Digital Video Processing; 6. NTSC, PAL, and SECAM system; 7. H.261 and H.263; 8. MPEG ; 9. Digital Television (DTV).

description.zh: 愈來愈多的商業活動在網路上進行，蓬勃發展的電子商務，也對現有的法律與政策造成許多挑戰。本課程將對電子商務的發展做一概要介紹，其後由網路科技與智財法律的概論談起，接著以目前智財法規所面臨的議題為主，並挑選台灣與國際的知名案例，讓學生兼顧理論與實務，建立對電子商務法規與政策發展的認識。
description.en: Doing business online is more and more prevalent nowadays, nonetheless, as e-commerce activities striving rapidly, new legal challenges are calling for attention. This course will start with an introduction on the characteristics and developments of e-commerce activities, following by the exploration and discussion on relevant literature and cases. Noted that this course will focus on the intellectual property laws and make comparative studies in order to equip students with an in-depth understanding and knowledge on these issues.

syllabi.outline:
在數位匯流的趨勢下，網際網路不但即將成為各種傳統媒體的聚集之處，同時也不斷衍生新型態的媒體傳播方式。有鑑於此，本課程目的即在探討數位匯流時代的智財法律議題。將由實際案例為主，輔以相關分析文章及法律規定的解析，帶領同學了解數位環境的特性、數位媒體形式與媒體內容的發展，同時針對著作權、隱私權等實用智慧財產權議題，讓同學了解、並具備分析數位時代的媒體趨勢、以及智財法律策略的能力。事實上，本課程之進行，30%以英文講授、70%以中文講授，而且課堂教材以中文為主。

In the face of digital convergence, the internet seems will not only become the ultimate channel for all kinds of traditional media, but the birthplace of new types. In light of the challenges posed by the digital age, this course is aimed at helping students explore the IP legal issues with reference to the media evolution on the internet. It will begin with the introduction of the characteristics of the internet, the developments of the digital media formation and content, and followed by the discussions and analysis on the cases in the real life. In fact, the class lectures will be in English 30% and in Chinese 70%, and the class materials are mainly in Chinese.

description.en: Soil Improvement is very important for embankments and foundations in construction engineering.This course deals with the following subjects:1.definition of soft ground 2.types of soft soil.3.investigation methods of soft soils. 4.improvement methods of soft ground(include compaction method,dewatering method,preloading method,dynamic consolidation method,vibrofloation method,injection method and soil-lime stabilization method.)

syllabi.outline: Ground improvement plays a crucial role in enhancing the stability and performance of problematic soils in construction engineering. This course explores key concepts, including ground improvement measures such as compaction, dewatering, preloading, vibroflotation, soil grouting, and soil-lime stabilization, all of which are essential for strengthening weak soils and ensuring the safety and longevity of construction projects.

name.zh: 營業秘密法與公平交易法專題研究
name.en: Seminar on Monographic Study on Trade Secret Act and Fair Trade Act

description.zh: 本課程主要以公平交易法與營業秘密法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；深入分析公平交易法與營業秘密法之內涵，進而個別探討公平交易法與營業秘密法等之智財權利行使的課題。
description.en: This course majors in the purpose, evolution, and development trend of legislation on the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, with an attempt to differentiate between the two Acts in respect of objects, approaches, and choice of law that the Acts apply to.  In this course, analyses are also made, in depth, on the essence of the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, together with discussion, respectively, on implementation of Intellectual Property Rights involved in the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act.

syllabi.outline: 本課程從中美貿易戰美方指控中國竊取營業秘密及強制技術移轉談起，再以我國營業秘密法與公平交易法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；除重視營業秘密法與公平交易法之基礎內涵外，將以國際比較法的視野，論述二法律與智權行使密切相關的課題，並輔以專題探討或案例分析的方式進行之。
syllabi.schedule:
第1週：介紹授課理念、課程綱要、上課方式與評分標準，並依多數同學需求進行調整---從中美貿易戰至台積電赴美、日設廠談營業秘密保護與強制技術授權及合作技術移轉
第2週：營業秘密法與公平交易法的立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢。
第3週：營業秘密法的法理基礎。
第4週：營業秘密的標的、歸屬與應用。
第5週：營業秘密的侵害、保全程序、救濟與保護（台積電海外投資合作案之營秘保護、區塊鏈與營秘保護等）。
第6週：營業秘密與競業禁止（台積電跳巢案、美光科技挖角案）。
第7週：侵害營業秘密之刑事處罰（穩懋半導體公司營秘遭竊案、英業達公司營秘案、美光控訴聯電及中國晉華竊取半導體DRAM營秘案）。
第8週：侵害營業秘密之損害賠償（先進光賠償大立光15.22億元案）。
第9週：侵害營業秘密案件的審理與秘密保持命令。
第10週：公平交易法與智慧財產權法規範的對象、方法及競合。
第11週：公平交易法對獨占、結合及聯合行為之規範。
第12週：公平交易法對不公平競爭行為之規範。
第13週：違反公平交易法之民事、刑事及行政責任。
第14週：公平交易法與專利(授)權之行使（警告函、高通案）。
第15週：公平交易法與專利(授)權之行使（標準必要專利(SEP)、公平及合理非歧視條款(FRAND)）。
第16週：公平交易法與商標權之行使（攀附著名商標、仿冒商標〈表徵〉）。 
第17週：公平交易法與著作權之行使（電視節目版式、資料庫保護、大數據分析）。 
第18週：兩岸及國際公平交易法與營業秘密之保護（AI應用、ChatGPT使用）。


※ 實際授課內容將依同學之興趣、程度，擇要或增修主題後進行之。

※ 本課程重視問題意識之引導及積極參與式的學習，2/3以上的主題將以案例探討或業師協同教學方式授課。

第7週：侵害營業秘密之刑事處罰（穩懋半導體公司營秘遭竊案、英業達公司營秘案、美光控訴聯電及中國晉華竊取半導體DRAM營秘案）。
第8週：侵害營業秘密之損害賠償（先進光賠償大立光15.22億元案）。
第9週：侵害營業秘密案件的審理與秘密保持命令。
第10週：公平交易法與智慧財產權法規範的對象、方法及競合。
第11週：公平交易法對獨占、結合及聯合行為之規範。
第12週：公平交易法對不公平競爭行為之規範。
第13週：違反公平交易法之民事、刑事及行政責任。
第14週：公平交易法與專利(授)權之行使（警告函、高通案）。
第15週：公平交易法與專利(授)權之行使（標準必要專利(SEP)、公平及合理非歧視條款(FRAND)）。
第16週：公平交易法與商標權之行使（攀附著名商標、仿冒商標〈表徵〉）。 
第17週：公平交易法與著作權之行使（電視節目版式、資料庫保護、大數據分析）。 
第18週：兩岸及國際公平交易法與營業秘密之保護（AI應用、ChatGPT使用）。

name.en: English Communication and Application II (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh: 本課程欲讓應用英文系學生了解改變社會結構之全球議題與趨勢。特此希望學生在參與討論的過程中，能夠產出對世界有正面效益之改善之道。課堂限制之關係，課程內容將著重於閱讀、答辯，和研討篩選後之報告及新聞，藉以達到上述之目的。
description.en: This course aims to engage English major students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title:		Global Issues and Trends
Credit Hours:		2
Instructor’s Name:	Dr. Yun-Hua Yang
Contact E-Mail:	yhyang@ntut.edu.tw
Term Offered:		Spring 2025
Course Description: 	This course aims to prepare students for collaborative participation in global activities by exploring contemporary global topics, issues, and critical agendas of action. The course cultivates engaged global citizens by enhancing students’ understanding and critical evaluation of compelling evidence regarding the complexity of global issues and trends. Through an in-depth analysis of global agendas, comprehensive reviews of research studies, and socio-political-economic assessments, this course underscores collective awareness and introduces analytical approaches that emphasize individual global accountability and interconnectedness. Students will engage with diverse reports and analyses to develop discourse skills, language proficiency, and data interpretation abilities that will benefit their future careers in global settings. The core learning materials for this course include The World Ahead 2025 (The Economist), The World in 2025 (EU) and The Global Risks Report 2025 (WEF), which provide insights into major geopolitical, economic, and technological developments that will shape the global landscape.

(2)	Presentations and discussions 
i.	Students (w/ or w/o partners) can volunteer and/or will be conveniently selected to present on issues and topics through the infographics provided in reports with fully-elaborated explanations and analyses on data / concept exhibits. 
ii.	Students who prepare to give a presentation need to post handouts / study notes on Google Classroom a day before the scheduled presentation. 
iii.	Students are obligated to participate in class discussion by Q&A.
(3)	Quizzes will be administered at the instructor’s discretion, and will not necessarily be announced in advance. 
(4)	All student panelists videotape their sessions for further revisions. A complete portfolio (preferably on compact disc) including all recordings will be considered for extra credit bonus at the end of the semester.
Grading Policy: 	(1) Academic honesty is prioritized in this class. Plagiarism will not be tolerated. Students will fail the course without contention once an incident of plagiarism is identified in their work. 
(2) Final grades will be determined by a point system (X out of 100 total points). Students will be evaluated by their panel discussions, submitted materials and debates. (Adjustments will be made if necessary.) 

Presentations (voluntary and/or assigned)
(study notes and interactive feedbacks)	10% X 2 /3 = 20% / 30%
Quizzes 	20%
Midterm Oral and Final Written Exams 	20% X 2 = 40%
Attendance 	20% 
*Students are obligated to attend all class sessions on time. Each absence / lateness will generate 10% / 5% deduction of the semester grades on the 100% scale. A university approved leave of document is accepted as one absence penalty waiver in the entire semester. AWOLs will be marked and entered into the penalty calculation if not corrected in two weeks of time, and lateness upon class dismissal. 
*This syllabus is subject to change at the instructor’s sole discretion. Changes made to the grading policy will be discussed in class. 
Scoring Criteria
1.	Research & analysis: understanding information introduced in the report and seeking additional support or discovering alternative or opposing studies; selection of important information from the report, with coherent and accurate presentation of such information in relation to other information /ideas in the reading and/or concerning issues in question; highly intelligible with exhibition of a sustained discourse 
2.	Content and structure: presenting a clear progression of ideas and conveying the relevant information required by task by providing and explaining substantive ideas and arguments in the reading; making necessary clarifications on facts and data introduced and critical analyses 
3.	Language use: demonstrating good control of basic and complex grammatical structures to allow coherent, efficient expression of ideas; using advanced and domain-specific and topic appropriate registers // Delivery and session management: speech being clear, concise, fluid and sustaining; maintaining the flow of discussions, stating and explaining ideas, arguments, facts and data as planned, asking and answering questions
4.	Study notes: clear and concise outline of content in the reading (report); language support, definitions of terms, and other useful information to enhance comprehension for ensuing discussion

description.zh: 本課程將透過閱讀各種文本（包括新聞文章、社論、報告和研究論文）來檢視當代文化中之社會和政治動態。 透過引導學生觀察、分析和理解當代/流行文化的複雜性和模糊性是如何與文化傳統同步或是超出文化傳承。本課程將介紹及討論引人入勝的文化故事、事件、議題和趨勢，旨在培養學生的批判性分析能力和文化素養。
description.en: This course examines the social and political dynamics of contemporary culture by reading a variety of texts, including news articles, editorials, reports, and research papers. Students will be guided to observe, analyze and understand the complexity and ambiguity of how contemporary / popular cultural phenomena may move in lockstep with the cultural traditions or fall out of sync in the cultural continuity. The course introduces plenty of fascinating culture stories, event, issues and trends to be studied, aiming to develop students’ critical analysis ability and cultural literacy.

syllabi.outline:
透過每週的閱讀和課堂討論，本課程將幫助培養學生的英語會話和閱讀技能。  在練習這些技能的過程中，我們將專注於理解西方語言和文化的核心理念，從而理解西方文化中的人（他們的價值觀、動機、原則）的核心理念。   [本課程以往的主題包括：善與惡；體育與社會；美麗;英雄主義]。   透過審視圍繞這一主題的文章和電影，我們將思考這個重要的想法告訴我們關於西方社會及其人民的哪些資訊。

Through weekly readings and class discussion, this course will help develop students’ English conversation and reading skills.  In the course of practicing such skills, we will focus on an idea central to understanding the language and the culture of the West, and thus an idea central to understanding the people (their values, motivations, principles) of Western culture.   [Past topics for this course include: good and evil; sports and society; beauty; heroism].   Examining essays and films centered around such a topic, we will consider what the significant idea tells us about Western society and its people.

description.zh: 資訊安全保險相關事故的理賠調查，使得數位鑑識在金融或資訊領域的重要性日益提升。數位鑑識與調查課程主要說明如何找到入侵或犯罪留下的可能的足跡，並介紹如何在合法與符合鑑識程序規範的前提下蒐集足夠的證據並保護這些有用的證據，以做為未來訴訟有效的佐證。在課程的設計上將以數位鑑識相關國際證照的領域與內容為主，除了教授學生數位鑑識的專業知識外，期能輔導學生取得數位鑑識相關證照。
description.en: The cyber security incident investigation for the cyber insurance has made digital forensics more and more important in the financial or information industry. This course focuses on identifying possible footprints of intrusions or crimes and collecting sufficient evidence and protect such useful evidence in order to be effective in future litigation. In the design of the course, the domain and content of the digital forensics international certification licenses will be mainly used. In addition to teaching the professional knowledge of digital forensics, it can also help the students obtain digital forensics certification in the future.

description.zh: 區塊鏈和數位資產是未來金融和科技領域的重要趨勢之一，本課程將介紹區塊鏈以及數位資產的基本知識與原理，並探討如何利用區塊鏈以及比特幣技術搭建新型態的金融基礎設施與永續的生態系統，內容包含 (1) 區塊鏈基礎；(2) 比特幣運作原理；(3) 穩定幣等數位資產；(4) 比特幣進階，含閃電網路、側鏈、智能合約層、永續挖礦…等；(5) 實體世界資產 (RWA，Real World Asset)；(6) 區塊鏈分析；(7) 法規與監管…等，為參與課程的學生建立正確的區塊鏈與數位資產的觀念。
description.en: Blockchain and Digital Asset are one of the important trends in the future of finance and technology. This course will introduce the basic knowledge and principles of blockchain and digital assets, as well as explore how to use blockchain and Bitcoin technology to build a new type of financial infrastructure and sustainable ecosystem, the content includes (1) Blockchain basics; (2) Bitcoin operating principles; (3) Digital assets such as stable coins; (4) Bitcoin advanced including Lightning Network, Rootstock, Stacks, sustainable mining...etc. (5) Real World Asset (RWA); (6) Blockchain analysis; (7) Regulations and supervision... etc., to establish a correct concept of blockchain and digital assets for students participating in the course.

description.zh: 本課程旨在透過各種英語新聞媒體如電視新聞（如CNN, BBC, NBC）、英文雜誌（如The Economist, Scientific American ）、英文報紙（New York Times, Washington Post, the Guardian等）等，來培養學生的批判性閱讀能力．並同時提升其宏觀視野與多元知識。課堂中將藉由分析英語新聞的用字遣詞、報導角度的取捨、標題與議題的呈現方式等，使學生學習如何思考報導背後之立場，從而進行批判性閱讀。此外，亦將剖析英語新聞中所含括之英美文學典故與文化傳統，帶領學生瞭解新聞英文的豐富意涵。
description.en: This course aims to (1) develop students’ critical reading abilities, (2) expand their global horizons and (3) broaden their knowledge by using diverse English news reports provided by news channels (e.g. CNN, BBC and NBC), news magazines (e.g. The Economist and Scientific American) and newspapers (e.g. New York Times, Washington Post and The Guardian). Students will learn how to read critically by analyzing word choice, reporting angles and the selection and presentation of headlines or quotations. This course will also explore literary allusions and cultural references contained in English news in order to further enhance students’ English language competence.

Course overview and expectations
Introduction to news literacy and the importance of critical thinking in media consumption
No specific chapter reading

Reading: Chapter 1

How media manipulation works and its implications

Week 17:
Practical Applications and Case Studies
Applying learned skills to real-world examples and case studies
Reading: Chapter 7

Week 18:
Final Exam
Covering Chapters 4-7

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹人機介面設計過程中所需了解之相關專業知識，俾使學生能在進行互動介面設計中，具備充分之理論基礎，同時了解人機介面設計之相關研究與應用，始其具有能進行人機使用者介面實務製作與企劃之能力。課程內容包含介面設計概念模式、介面使用性、人機介面設計程序、使用者需求、介面原型設計、介面設計原則以及使用者測試與評估等。教學將以課堂講授、個案研討以及實作等方式進行，並以報告繳交與課堂發表及作品為評量依據。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the knowledge for human-computer interaction (HCI) design. Students can understand the basic knowledge, application and research relevant to HCI design, which make them to be capable of practical interface design and planning. This course is set up under the structure of Human-Machine-Scenario theory and case study. The contents include concept model of interface design, interface usability, HCI process, user requirements, interface prototyping, principles of interface design and user testing. description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹領導與組織管理的理論與實務。課程目的有四個：(1)了解組織領導與管理的內涵；(2)討論領導與組織管理的理論與實證發現之間的差異；(3)對實務界人士提供具體建議；(4)將領導與管理的技巧應用到生活面。
description.en: This course focuses on the theory and practice of leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is; (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for business management and (4) to apply the basic ideas of leadership and management in daily life.

本課程主要在介紹領導與組織管理的理論與實務。課程目的有四個：(1)了解組織領導與管理的內涵；(2)討論領導與組織管理的理論與實證發現之間的差異；(3)對實務界人士提供具體建議；(4)將領導與管理的技巧應用到生活面。
This course focuses on the theory and practice of leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is; (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for business management and (4) to apply the basic ideas of leadership and management in daily life.

syllabi.outline:
公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。
The corporate governance had been the enterprise framework adjustment of the main issue of the 21 century. How do the manage the corporate strategy and system of the law to make the profit for the shareholder, government and enterprise. The main purpose of the course to help the learner to understand the law of corporate and the practice of the enterprise.

description.zh: 策略管理主要是幫助製造業與服務業高階管理者作決策。一般而言，這門課程主要協助學員們具有策略思維與整合能力。學員可在策略管理學習過程活學活用，更能融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課也採用適當的製造業與服務業個案研討來幫助學員學習、研讀與熟悉策略管理的運作，以達成此門課的目標。授課主題包括研討策略管理的本質與整體架構，瞭解組織所處環境 ， 分析外部環境之時機和危機， 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 ， 探討企業不同層次之應對策略，整合策略的執行與治理等。
description.en: Strategic management deals with the decision making in manufacturing and service industry at the top management level. Generally, this course provides students with strategic thinking and knowledge integration. With case studies in manufacturing and service industry, this course also helps students learn, study, and understand the process of strategic management well to achieve the goals of the course. Topics in this course include the essence and whole framework of strategic management, in what circumstances an organization has been, analyses on the opportunities and threats of external environment, the strengths and weaknesses of internal organization, application strategies of companies at different levels, implantation on integration strategies and so forth.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域製造及物流之應用
name.en: AI Applications in Manufacturing and Logistic

description.zh: 本課程旨在概述人工智慧的應用及其對製造業和物流業的影響。 隨機器學習、深度學習、啟發式演算法和其他人工智能方法的發展，相關新興技術的應用越來越多地被應用於製造和物流行業以提高決策能力。本課程將通過介紹人工智慧的基礎知識和實際應用之案例研究闡述使用人工智慧技術對於產業決策之幫助。學生將深入了解人工智慧技術及其在製造和物流領域如需求預測、生產計劃、調度、質量控製或運輸的潛在應用，課程內容亦將應用ChatGPT做為開發製造物流問題求解方法之輔助工具。通過本課程，學生將了解人工智慧對製造和物流系統之影響及現況，評估使用人工智慧之益處和局限性，並了解人工智慧對於相關產業之改善。
description.en: This course provides an overview of AI application and its impact on manufacturing and logistics. Emerging technologies like machine learning, deep learning, heuristics are being utilized to enhance decision-making capabilities. The course covers the fundamentals of AI, practical case studies, and its benefits. Latest AI technologies and their potential applications in manufacturing and logistics such as demand forecasting, production planning, scheduling, quality control, or transportation will be introduced. ChatGPT will be used as an auxiliary tool for developing problem-solving methods. The course develops the ability to analyze the impact of AI on manufacturing and logistics systems, assess benefits and limitations, and evaluate AI improvement for related industries.

syllabi.outline:
金融科技是近年來新興的產業趨勢，影響的層面非常廣泛，不只是金融方面，更牽涉到新興科技與物聯網。本課程將從不同的角度分析金融科技的技術內容、應用領域及商業模式，並藉由國內外重要金融科技公司發展的經驗做一介紹，希望達到了解並運用此新興科技的目的。本課程內容包括:金融科技概論、金融科技商業模式、金融大數據、P2P 借貸、虛擬貨幣、雲端服務、第三方支付、群眾募資、區塊鏈、跨境電商、程式交易、機器人理財等主題。
FinTech includes two words: Finance and Technology. It is a new trend of industrial field. It has influences on lots of technical fields, not only finance, but also emerging technologies and IoT. This course will analyze FinTech from different angles, such as technology contents, application fields and business models. It also will utilize experiences of leading companies with FinTech to obtain decent knowledge of this new field. The contents of this course include introduction to financial technology, business models of financial technology, finance big data, P2P lending, virtual money, cloud services, third-party payment, crowd funding, blockchain, cross-border e-commerce, program trading, and robotic financial advisory etc.

description.zh: 本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。再者，本課程以深入淺出方式介紹投資決策之基本觀念及理論架構。將財務投資的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的投資決策。透過本課程之學習，促使投資人能獲取合理的投資報酬或擊敗大盤，領先各基金之績效，以制訂出正確的長短期投資決策。
description.en: The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. Furthermore, the major goal of this course is to help students understanding the basic principles and theories of investments. It can give students the skills to conduct a sophisticated assessment on investment decisions. Through the learning of this course, prompting investors to be able to obtain a reasonable return on investment or beat the market, ahead of the performance of each Fund, in order to work out the correct short and long term investment decisions.

description.en: The data mining (DM), which involves in Statistics, Database and Artificial Intelligence fields, prospects to seek Useful information from a great deal of data. description.zh: 新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。 新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。 課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en: Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously. The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行"突破創新"以增加競爭力之唯一生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地徹底執行它。不僅工程或服務技術要創新，管理思維更要突破創新，以有效迅速解?錯綜複雜的研發、工程與管理之諸多矛盾問題。本課程以創新構思問題解?法(TRIZ)為基礎，詳細介紹工程技術如何落實創新與管理實務創新如何執行。本課程適用於自有品牌業者、ODM或OEM製造業者、服務業者與學術單位教學研究，特點如下:完整詳實闡述TRIZ理論並輔以大量簡單案例說明TRIZ概念、工程TRIZ實務案例10餘個與TRIZ工程與管理之參數與創新原則說明簡例約800餘個，管理實務案例20餘個，包含研發管理、服務業管理、專案管理與生產管理等。案例與簡例最多，創新執行力可快速上手與實施應用。本課程TRIZ研發、工程與管理兼顧，製造業與服務業高層、中層與基層員工皆符合讀者條件，使"突破創新"輕易實務執行並成為企業文化，亦適用於大學與研究所之工管、企管(經營管理)、工商管與工程相關科系，可自行按需求選擇性深入教授講解某些章節，也替產業界事先磨練一群創新思維之活力新血，可長久伴隨您在職場(或未來進入職場)解決研發、工程與管理之困難矛盾問題。

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生建立足夠的知識與技能在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上。課程內容主要分為兩部分， 第一部分將首先介紹論文架構開始，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、TOPSIS、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided by two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin from the introduction of different quantity methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussion, assignment, term-projects and in class practices.

syllabi.outline:
本課程期透過建立學生正確的研究觀念，以培養論文研究與寫作之基礎能力。根據論文寫作方法之需求，讓學生了解研究方法的本質、研究的意義、過程與方法，以及研究設計的基本概念與特性；進而瞭解如何進行質性與量化研究、資料蒐集、資料處理與統計分析，並瞭解論文格式及架構，學習撰寫研究論文並準備口頭報告，並透過課堂互動互動與分享，強化學習。
The objectives of this course are：1. To introduce the basic concept of research methodology that applies in academic and practical research. 2. To learn the methods of conducting research processes and preparing research proposals and reports. 3. To know how to obtain the required information through appropriate approaches in writing thesis or  research reports and solving management problems.

description.zh:
本課程使學生對燃料電池的基本原理、關鍵技術、以及商品化發展與應用過程，有所瞭解並加以分析及探討。
燃料電池是一種電化學的發電裝置，其運作原理係利用電化學反應將燃料內之化學能直接轉換為電能，因其在能量轉換過程中並不經過熱機過程，因此能量轉換效率較高。本課程之授課綱要可分為以下幾項：
燃料電池簡介、燃料電池之效率、質子交換膜燃料電池、磷酸燃料電池、鹼性燃料電池、直接甲醇燃料電池、固態氧化物燃料電池、燃料電池的燃料供應、燃料電池之計算實例。
description.en:
This course enables students to fully understand the basic principles of the fuel cell, key technologies, and the commercialization of the development and the application process, and to analyze and discuss the design of fuel cell system.
Fuel cell is an electrochemical power generating device. It can directly convert the chemical energy of fuel into the electrical energy via the electrochemical reaction. Because it does not go through the process of thermal engine in the energy conversion process, and therefore a higher energy conversion efficiency. Teaching outlines of the course can be divided into the followings:
Introduction to fuel cell, Fuel cell efficiency, Proton exchange membrane fuel cell, Phosphoric acid fuel cell, Alkaline fuel cell, Direct methanol fuel cell, Solid oxide fuel cell, Fueling fuel cell, Calculation example of fuel cell.

Fuel cell is an electrochemical power generating device. It can directly convert the chemical energy of fuel into the electrical energy via the electrochemical reaction. Because it does not go through the process of thermal engine in the energy conversion process, and therefore a higher energy conversion efficiency. Teaching outlines of the course can be divided into the followings:
Introduction to fuel cell, Fuel cell efficiency, Proton exchange membrane fuel cell, Phosphoric acid fuel cell, Alkaline fuel cell, Direct methanol fuel cell, Solid oxide fuel cell, Fueling fuel cell, Calculation example of fuel cell.

description.en: Students will learn to use multichannel beamformer techniques and Matlab for speech enhancement. Students will learn: 1. Spatial sampling concept. 2. Delay-and-sum (DAS) beamforming technique. 3. Minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) beamforming technique. 4. Linearly constraint minimum variance (LCMV) beamforming technique. 5. Generalized sidelobe canceller (GSC) beamforming technique. 6. Multichannel Wiener filtering for denoising and dereverberation. 7. Integrated sidelobe cancellation and linear prediction Kalman filter (ISCLP)

name.zh: 永續能源與淨零碳規劃管理策略
name.en: Sustainable Energy and Net-Zero Carbon Planning and Management Strategies

description.zh: 本課程旨在為學生提供永續能源與淨零碳規劃管理的實務知識基礎，包括認識全球能源與環境的現況、掌握再生能源技術和能源效率提升的策略，並深入分析臺灣在永續能源發展上的政策、市場以及實際案例，並包含淨零碳規劃管理基礎概論與淨零碳盤查規範與程序概要，讓學生對於永續能源與淨零碳規劃管理策略有更詳盡的認知。本課程也將淨零碳規劃管理師考試流程和考試重點彙整至學習中，目標是協助學生通過淨零碳規劃管理師能力鑑定，使其能與產業接軌。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a practical knowledge base in sustainable energy and net-zero carbon planning and management. It includes understanding the current global energy and environmental landscape, mastering renewable energy technologies, and strategies for enhancing energy efficiency. The course offers an in-depth analysis of Taiwan's policies, market, and practical cases in sustainable energy development. It also covers the fundamentals of net-zero carbon planning and management, along with an overview of the standards and procedures for net-zero carbon auditing. The course integrates the examination process and key points of the Net-Zero Carbon Planning and Management Certification, aiming to help students pass the certification and connect with the industry.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to provide essential knowledge about the mechanical behavior and design of critical members of a building frame. The main focus will be on the beam, column, and beam-column joint for their flexure, shear, bond, and anchorage behaviors. Besides, state-of-the-art research about the deteriorated hysteresis behavior and damage evaluation of reinforced concrete columns will be presented.

6.	Moment curvature analysis and software demonstration
7.	Concentrated plasticity approach for deflection calculations

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上建立足夠的知識與技能。課程內容主要分為兩部分，第一部分將介紹論文架構，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided into two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin with the introduction of different quantitative methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussions, assignments, term-projects, and in-class practices. name.zh: 生成式人工智慧於企業實務之應用
name.en: Application of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Enterprise Practice

description.zh: 隨著科技不斷進步，人工智慧技術逐漸成熟，無論在生產流程、企業管理及分析決策等方面都陸續開始導入生成式AI工具，應用場景橫跨企業營運、數據應用以及產品與服務創新等。本課程將介紹生成式人工智慧原理並結合實作方式，透過實際案例和演練來教授生成式AI技術和應用。課程內容包括人工智慧的基礎知識，如深度學習、自然語言處理、圖像處理、推薦系統、預測分析等，並導入人工智慧在企業管理和決策、金融、數據分析、智慧製造等領域等應用案例。課程中將結合Azure OpenAI雲端服務資源，並以人工智慧跨域應用學習模式來跨域應用至數據分析、智慧運算、智慧製造及物流、商情預測、經營管理、金融等領域，以培育學生具備領先同儕之人工智慧跨域應用專業能力。
description.en: This course introduces the principles of generative artificial intelligence and combines practical exercises regarding the technology and applications of generative AI through real case studies and drills. The course covers fundamental knowledge of AI, such as deep learning, natural language processing, image processing, recommendation systems, predictive analytics, and introduces the application cases of AI in enterprise management and decision-making, finance, data analysis, intelligent manufacturing, among others. The course will also utilize Azure OpenAI cloud service resources and cross-domain application learning mode to cultivate students’ technical abilities in AI cross-domain applications, spanning across data analytics, intelligent computing, intelligent manufacturing and logistics, business forecasting, management, finance, etc., leading them to stand out among their peers.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要目的為培養學生瞭解生成式人工智慧（Generative AI）的基本概念與技術基礎，探討生成式人工智慧在不同領域的實際應用案例，學習如何將生成式人工智慧整合到企業流程中，提升效率與創新能力，掌握生成式人工智慧的實作工具與實踐方法，並且瞭解生成式人工智慧應用中的挑戰及安全倫理問題。

The main purpose of this course is to cultivate students' understanding of the basic concepts and technical foundations of generative artificial intelligence (Generative AI), explore practical application cases of generative artificial intelligence in different fields, learn how to integrate generative artificial intelligence into corporate processes to improve efficiency and innovation capabilities, master the implementation tools and practical methods of generative artificial intelligence, and understand the challenges and safety ethical issues in the application of generative artificial intelligence.

name.zh: 永續發展與淨零碳管理
name.en: Sustainable Development and Net Zero Carbon Management

description.zh: 這門課將深入探討從巴黎協定到Net Zero的全球淨零碳排發展歷程，並闡述碳訂價政策工具的概念與國際主要實踐。透過企業淨零實務分享，學生將了解目標訂定、策略制定、管理制度建立以及追蹤管理等步驟。課程還涵蓋ISO 14064碳盤查和ISO 14067產品碳足跡的概念與實作，並結合企業減碳經驗分享。最後，課程將介紹數位轉型在碳管理上的應用，包括資訊治理和低碳轉型等技術，旨在培養學生對於全球氣候行動及企業永續發展的深刻理解與實踐能力。
description.en: This course explores the evolution towards global net-zero carbon emissions, from the Paris Agreement to Net Zero, along with the concept and implementation of carbon pricing policies. Through real-world examples, students learn how companies set goals, develop strategies, and establish management systems for achieving net-zero emissions. Additionally, the course covers carbon footprint verification and product carbon footprinting practices, alongside insights from businesses reducing carbon emissions. Finally, it examines the application of digital transformation in carbon management, fostering understanding of climate action and corporate sustainability.

這門課將深入探討從巴黎協定到Net Zero的全球淨零碳排發展歷程，並闡述碳訂價政策工具的概念與國際主要實踐。透過企業淨零實務分享，學生將了解目標訂定、策略制定、管理制度建立以及追蹤管理等步驟。課程還涵蓋ISO 14064碳盤查和ISO 14067產品碳足跡的概念與實作，並結合企業減碳經驗分享。最後，課程將介紹數位轉型在碳管理上的應用，包括資訊治理和低碳轉型等技術，旨在培養學生對於全球氣候行動及企業永續發展的深刻理解與實踐能力。
This course explores the evolution towards global net-zero carbon emissions, from the Paris Agreement to Net Zero, along with the concept and implementation of carbon pricing policies. Through real-world examples, students learn how companies set goals, develop strategies, and establish management systems for achieving net-zero emissions. Additionally, the course covers carbon footprint verification and product carbon footprinting practices, alongside insights from businesses reducing carbon emissions. Finally, it examines the application of digital transformation in carbon management, fostering understanding of climate action and corporate sustainability.

description.zh: 為因應瞬息萬變的金融投資環境，期許學生具備宏觀的投資管理知識，本課程主要本課程結合資訊工具與軟體運用、以深入淺出方式介紹投資決策之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配財務軟體、財金資料庫、與財金資訊網站的應用。藉由這些資訊工具與技術，將財務投資的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的投資決策。課程內容架構包括：(1) 財務與投資學原理；(2) 資料庫的使用；(3) 財務軟體的操作；(4) 財務與投資個案分析。透過本課程之學習，促使投資人能獲取合理的投資報酬或擊敗大盤，領先各基金之績效，以制訂出正確的長短期投資決策。
description.en: In response to the rapidly changing environment of financial investments, expecting that students have knowledge of macro investment management, this course combines information and software tools to use, the major goal of this course is to help students understanding the basic principles and theories of investments. By mixing explanation and implementation using financial software and database, it can give students the skills to conduct a sophisticated assessment on investment decisions. The major topics include the following: (1) principles of investments, (2) financial database, (3) financial software, and (4) case study in investments. Through the learning of this course, prompting investors to be able to obtain a reasonable return on investment or beat the market, ahead of the performance of each Fund, in order to work out the correct short and long term investment decisions.

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

name.zh: 黃光微影製程材料及缺陷控制技術
name.en: The lithography process, materials, and defect control technology

description.zh:
半導體黃光微影技術是先進半導體製程的關鍵之一。如何優化曝光的光學系統和成像光阻的化學系統，以及控制顯影成像後的不良粒子缺陷，是決定先進半導體成敗與良率的關鍵。本課程涵蓋黃光微影技術的基本原理、步驟和光阻材料的組成，讓學員獲得整體性概念，了解黃光微影技術在晶圓製造中的角色及其對良率的影響。通過實際案例的介紹與演練，學員能更清楚地掌握專業背景知識並學以致用，培養半導體產業所需的技能，提升未來就業基礎與創新能力。
課程將分為三個階段進行。第一階段介紹微影製程的基本原理及光阻材料，幫助學員累積研發與解決問題的專業知識。第二階段通過應用和實戰案例解析，使學員了解產業運作中的實際知識與技巧，並培養從微觀角度理解與思考問題的能力，提升自學效率與興趣。第三階段以模擬演練的方式，協助學員建立問題解決的技巧，增強他們的能力與信心。
description.en: Semiconductor lithography technology is the most crucial step in advanced semiconductor processes. Optimizing the optical system in exposure parameters and the chemical system in resist formulation design, as well as controlling defects in resist and the development step, are crucial for the success of advanced semiconductor production. This course covers the fundamental principles, steps, and composition of lithography technology, providing participants with a comprehensive understanding of the role of lithography in wafer manufacturing. Through practical case studies and exercises, participants can gain a clearer grasp of professional background knowledge and apply it effectively, cultivating the skills required in the semiconductor industry and enhancing future employment foundations and innovation capabilities.

description.zh: 電源轉換器(Power Converter)設計須滿足高效率及高功率密度的要求，因應此需求需搭配轉換器架構的選用、新型寬能隙元件的應用、高頻磁性元件的設計、柔性切換技術(Soft Switching Techniques)。在本次課程將會介紹這些技術的原理及設計方法及高效能轉換器的技術核心：變壓器(Transformer)與磁性元件的設計要領及寬能隙元件應用的介紹。藉由理論探討與模擬實作，加強學生的理論知識與實作能力。
description.en: The design of power converters is being pushed to meet the requirements of high efficiency and high power density. In response to this demand, the selection of converter architecture, the application of new wide bandgap devices, the design of high-frequency magnetic components, and soft switching techniques are needed. This course introduces the principles and design methods of these technologies and the core technical aspects of high-efficiency converters, including the design of transformers and magnetic components, and the application of wide bandgap devices. This course is aimed at graduate students. Students can strengthen their theoretical knowledge and practical ability through theoretical discussion and simulation practice from this course.

description.zh: 本課程將帶領同學從兒童詩、繪本、小說、電影來品味兒童文學的真、善與美，藉此喚醒被世俗蒙塵的沉睡心靈，以重返純真的赤子心境。 教學方式以互動為主，期待藉由討論兒童文學名著，閱讀相關論文，來帶領同學進入兒童文學的殿堂。 除了閱讀與討論之外，還會教導同學創作；創作的內容含括了兒童詩及手工繪本製作。希望透過作品的完成，來喚起學生的創作興趣，並建立學生創作的信心。
description.en: This course will lead the students to read the poems, picture books, novels and films of children literature, and hope to find out the beauty of the children's world. Wish in this way can help the sleeping soul to wake up, and return to pure childhood state. This course will try to lead the classmates to appreciate the children's literature by discussing and questioning the masterpieces, hope in this happy way to help the students to get enter the children's literature. Besides reading and discussing, the course will also teach students how to write. The content of writing course would include the poem and the story which would ask the students to finish the work by themselves. Hope through the works, can arouse students' creation interest, and build up students' confidence of creation.

description.zh: 太空工程實務專題課程旨在讓學生瞭解和掌握太空工程領域的實踐技能和實務知識，以及培養學生的團隊協作、問題解決和創新思維能力。學生將進行一個實際的太空工程設計項目，通過實踐瞭解太空工程的設計、測試、實施和管理流程，並透過報告、演示和評審等形式展示項目成果。通過此課程的學習，學生可以瞭解太空工程領域的最新發展，掌握相關的技能和知識，並提升團隊合作和項目管理能力。本課程可同時藉由產學合作設計進行實際演練。
description.en: The aim of the Space Engineering Practical Project course is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

description.zh: 本課程以介紹複合動力車輛概念、設計、能量分析及最佳化控制為主，結合內燃機及馬達兩種複合動力之能量管理及配合道路狀況，教導學生熟識複合車輛動力系統。
description.en: This course presents fundamentals of Hybrid Electric Vehicles: HEV concepts and design, energy analysis, unified modeling approach, optimization and control.  The power consumption side of vehicles. Conventional power generation: IC engine overview, concepts of hybridization, general model of energy form and energy flows, on-board energy storage (fuels and batteries). Overview of electrochemical converters: motors, transmissions for HEVs, principles of fuel cells, HEV application. Principles of energy optimization in HEVs.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於建構產業分析之思維架構及洞悉市場發展之研究能力，以因應市場之快速變遷,並介紹學生瞭解總體經濟與產業景氣分析,公司經營財務報表分析,投資標的評價與技術分析。透過研究方法之介紹及預測手法之教導並輔以個案實作以達其效。
description.en: The objective of the course is to construct the infrastructure of industry analysis and to build up the research capability for changing market development. The fundamental analysis of macro economy and business cycle, financial statement analysis and investment valuation methods are also studied. By introducing the methodologies and forecasting tools, the case study is implied in this class.

description.zh:
隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅B2C市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。
面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來DIY速成個人事業及就業的能力。
description.en: Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹自適應訊號處理的基本理論與應用，涵蓋維納濾波、最小均方（LMS）演算法、遞迴最小均方（RLS）演算法及仿射投影演算法（APA）。課程將探討自適應濾波器的收斂性、穩定性與效能分析，並透過 MATLAB 模擬與實作，讓學生理解其在噪聲消除、通道均衡、回音消除等領域的實際應用。此外，學生將研讀相關研究論文，培養分析與應用自適應演算法的能力，並透過期末專題整合所學內容，解決實際工程問題。

This course introduces the fundamental theories and applications of adaptive signal processing, covering Wiener filtering, Least Mean Squares (LMS) algorithms, Recursive Least Squares (RLS) algorithms, and the Affine Projection Algorithm (APA). It explores the convergence, stability, and performance analysis of adaptive filters. Through MATLAB simulations and implementations, students will gain hands-on experience in applying these techniques to noise cancellation, channel equalization, and echo cancellation. Additionally, students will study relevant research papers to develop analytical and practical skills in adaptive algorithms. The course culminates in a final project, where students integrate their knowledge to solve real-world engineering problems.

syllabi.outline:
近年來企業為面對市場競爭的挑戰與快速改變，其經營管理活動多以專案方式來執行，以致企業各部門工作皆與專案管理息息相關，如：產品研發、行銷規劃、生產製造、教育訓練及企業經營管理等活動，多以專案方式來執行。 本課程將對於企業內全方位專案管理流程做一概述，並安排企業實例做為案例探討。課程針對研發、採購、行銷及行政專案管理等之五大流程 (起案、規劃、執行、監控、結案)及十大知識領域 (整合、範圍、時間、成本、品質、人資、溝通、風險、採購、關係人) 與各流程中所使用的技能與工具做說明與介紹。此課程之內容包含全面專案管理觀念知識的建立與應用，並著重企業全方位的相關專案實務案例講解。使其瞭解專案管理在產業界重要性，企業研究發展的正確方向，以達產學合一，並分享最新觀念與實務。
Recently, facing the marketing challenges and rapid changes, the company's business management activities are mostly carried out in a project-based manner, all departments are closely related to project management and carried out on a case-by-case basis. This course will provide an overview of the full-scale project management process within the company, and arrange enterprise practice as a case study. The course covers five major processes and ten areas of knowledge (integration, scope, time, cost, quality, human resources, communication, risk, procurement). The content of this course is based on the concept knowledge and focuses on the company's comprehensive (product R&D, marketing planning, manufacturing, and training program) case study. To make attendants understand the importance of project management in the industry to achieve the unity of production and learning, and to share the newest concepts and practices.

description.en: Understand the basic structure of programming languages. C language is used for the practice. The course includes: 1. description.en:
This course covers optoelectronics combine with biomolecular of knowledge. We will focus on discussing how the DNA, RNA, protein or cells related with optoelectronic application.
Optoelectronics is the study and application of electronic devices that source, detect and control light, usually considered a subfield of photonics. The light often includes invisible forms of radiation such as gamma rays, X-rays, ultraviolet and infrared, in addition to visible light, which is based on the quantum mechanical effects of light on semiconducting materials. A biomolecule is any organic molecule that is produced by a living organism, including large polymeric molecules such as proteins, polysaccharides, and nucleic acids as well as small molecules such as primary metabolites, secondary metabolites, and natural products. As organic molecules, biomolecules consist primarily of carbon and hydrogen, nitrogen, and oxygen, and, to a smaller extent, phosphorus and sulfur.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to illustrate the biomedical applications of photoelectric detection instruments.  This course will discuss the basic principles of optoelectronics and the knowledge of molecular biology (such as introducing the basic structure of deoxyribonucleic acid, ribonucleic acid, protein, or cell).  
Class participation is evaluated by in-class discussion on the assignments. Students must complete pre-class and after-class assignments.

description.zh: X光已經成為材料結構鑑定上一項很有用的技術。這門課將介紹如何應用X光粉末繞射與吸收光譜於材料結構鑑定，以及數據分析。
description.en: X-ray has become a powerful technique on the characterization of material structures. The course will teach how to apply the x-ray diffraction and absorption on structural characterization and even analysis.

syllabi.outline:
X光已經成為材料結構鑑定上一項很有用的技術。這門課將介紹如何應用X光粉末繞射與吸收光譜於材料結構鑑定，以及數據分析。本課程將以Matlab與GSASII軟體教導學生進行數據分析。
X-ray has become a powerful technique on the characterization of material structures. The course will teach how to apply the x-ray diffraction and absorption on structural characterization and even analysis. In the x-ray diffraction part, we will teach the fundamental scattering theory, space group, and basic crystallography. For polycrystalline materials, the Rietveld refinement will be used for powder x-ray diffraction data analysis. For soft mater like polymers, the XRD in combination with molecular modeling will be used to analysis the experimental XRD pattern. In the x-ray absorption part, the EXAFS data analysis method will be used to understand the local environment and bond length between absorbing metal and coordinated ligands.  Matlab and GSASII will be used for data analysis.

description.zh: 本課程介紹複合材料的原理，包括複合材料的高分子化學、複合材料的加工方法、複合材料的力學分析與設計、以及複合材料在高科技上的應用。加工方法包括真空袋成型法、壓力釜成形法、樹脂移送成型、編織法、纏繞成形法、拉擠成型法、模壓法…等，本課程詳述這些加工方法的原理及應用，同時介紹力學分析及設計，應力和應變之關係，複材之彎曲、靜態和動態之強度、脫層、耐久性、及以力學觀點設計複合材料，最後討論複合材料如何應用於高科技及民生工業上。
description.en: This course is to elucidate the principle and potential application of composite materials. It includes polymer chemistry, design and analysis of composite, and processing methods. The composite processings include autoclaves,vacuum vags, resin transform molding, braiding, filament winding, pultrusions, sheet molding compound,…etc. The principles and application of the methods will be elucidated. The analysis and design, strain-stress relationships, extension and bending, static and dynamic strengths, and delamination, will also be discussed. Finally, the potential application of the composite in high-tech industries will be elucidated.

description.zh: 本課內容包括高分子鏈之統計力學、高分子之界面作用力及Flory-Huggin理論。 對於紡織技術學程的規劃，本課程會注重紡織纖維的合成技術，例如用奈米技術加在Nylon纖維上，例如以clay加強Nylon的強度及磨耗性質，用理論的探討例如用Halpin-Tsai equation去預測紡織纖維的楊氏係數，另外也會加強高分子物理化學在紡織纖維成型過程中所扮演的角色。
description.en: The course includes; statistics of polymer chain, interfacial polymer force, Florry-Huggun theory. A major objective of this course is to provide a background in polymerizations, polymer structures and polymer properties. The material in this course also covers polymer characterization, polymer rheology and polymer processing. In addition, structures, properties, usages and products of rubbers, plastics and fibers are emphasized and compared. The object of this course is also to provide a background in fiber compositions, synthesis, spinning and characterization. A second goal is to introduce factors that influence fiber compositions, formation and properties.

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在探討太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，與太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的專題演講與小組討論，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The aim of the Space Science & Technology Seminar is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

name.zh: 太空載具動力學與控制

description.zh: 太空載具動力學與控制課程旨在介紹太空載具的運動學、動力學和控制理論。本課程的主要內容包括：太空載具軌道和運動學、太空載具動力學、太空載具控制系統、太空載具機動、姿態控制和軌道控制、太空載具自主導航、太空載具對接。學生將學習如何建立太空載具的運動學和動力學模型，以及如何設計控制系統來實現載具的各種機動和控制任務。
description.en: The Spacecraft Dynamics and Control course aims to introduce the kinematics, dynamics, and control theory of spacecraft. The main contents of this course include spacecraft orbit and kinematics, spacecraft dynamics, spacecraft control systems, spacecraft maneuvers, attitude and orbit control, autonomous navigation, spacecraft rendezvous and docking. Students will learn how to establish kinematic and dynamic models of spacecraft, as well as how to design control systems to achieve various spacecraft maneuvers and control tasks.

syllabi.outline:
The Spacecraft Dynamics and Control course introduces the kinematics, dynamics, and control theory of spacecraft. Students will explore key topics such as spacecraft orbit and kinematics, dynamics, control systems, spacecraft maneuvers, attitude and orbit control, autonomous navigation, and spacecraft rendezvous and docking. The course includes practical hands-on experience with the F Prime (F´) framework for modeling, simulation, and control system implementation. Students will learn to design control systems and solve real-world challenges in spacecraft operations.

太空載具動力學與控制課程旨在探討太空載具的運動學、動力學與控制理論，內容涵蓋太空載具的軌道與運動學、動力學、控制系統設計、太空載具機動、姿態與軌道控制、自主導航，以及太空載具對接技術。本課程特別著重於實務操作，學生將使用 F Prime (F´) 框架進行動態建模、模擬與控制系統的實作，學習如何解決實際太空任務中的控制挑戰，並設計控制系統以實現多樣化的太空載具任務。
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1-2: Introduction to Spacecraft Dynamics and Control - Overview of space vehicles, mission requirements, and fundamentals of Newtonian mechanics and rigid body motion; introduction to basic control systems in aerospace.

Week 3-4: Orbital Mechanics and Dynamics - Introduction to the two-body problem, Kepler's laws, orbital perturbations, and station-keeping techniques, with numerical orbit simulation.

Week 5-6: Spacecraft Attitude Dynamics - Explore rotational kinematics, torque-free and torque-induced motion, stability analysis, and principal axes of rotation.

Week 7-8: Control System Design - Learn classical control theory (PID and state-space representation) and advanced techniques like LQR, robust control, and model predictive control.

Week 9: Midterm Exam

Week 10: Introduction to F Prime (F´) Framework - Understand the F´ architecture, set up the development environment, and build basic components with telemetry and simulated sensor data.

Week 11-12: Attitude Control Implementation in F´ - Integrate dynamics models into F´, implement PID and LQR controllers, and debug control algorithms for spacecraft attitude control.

Week 13-14: Advanced Applications of F´ - Address real-time implementation challenges, integrate sensors and actuators, and explore case studies in CubeSat control and trajectory corrections.

Week 15-16: Robust Control and Fault Tolerance - Design robust control systems for station-keeping and LEO maneuvering, and implement software fault tolerance and redundancy techniques.

Week 17-18: Final Project and Presentation

System performance and report evaluation

name.en: LEO and Ground Station Communication Networks

description.zh: 本課程深入探討低軌道衛星系統和地面站行動通訊網路的整合應用。課程內容包括低軌道衛星的基本原理、系統設計，以及地面站行動通訊網路的架構和技術。學生將透過理論學習和實務操作，深入瞭解這兩個領域的相互關聯性，並學會整合應用這些技術於實際通訊系統。此外，課程亦包涵低軌道衛星系統的運作原理，包括衛星軌道、通訊協定和數據傳輸技術。以及地面站行動通訊網路的設計和運營，涵蓋行動通訊標準、網路架構和協定等方面的知識。課程將以專題形式進行，學生將參與低軌道衛星系統和地面站行動通訊網路的整合專案。透過實作，他們將應用所學的理論知識，設計出具有實用價值的整合系統。最終，本課程的目標是培養學生在低軌道衛星通訊和行動通訊網路整合方面的專業能力，使他們具備未來衛星通訊發展的技術素養。
description.en: This course explores the integration of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite systems and ground station mobile communication networks. Topics include LEO satellite principles, system design, and the architecture of ground station mobile communication networks. Through theory and hands-on practice, students gain a deep understanding of these interconnected fields and learn to apply these technologies in real communication systems. The course features project-based learning, allowing students to participate in integrated projects and apply their theoretical knowledge to design practical systems. The ultimate goal is to develop students' professional expertise in integrating LEO satellite communication and mobile networks for future advancements in satellite communication.

syllabi.outline:
本課程目的為深入研究非地面通訊網路（NTN）的相關技術和應用。課程將首先介紹NTN的基本概念，包括其定義、特點以及在通訊領域中的角色。接著，將深入研究NTN網路的架構和應用，使學生了解NTN在不同場景中的實際應用情境。課程亦將探討3GPP對NTN網路的規劃和進展，使學生瞭解NTN在國際通訊標準中的地位與發展趨勢。此外，課程還將介紹不同類型的NTN，包括各種型態的應用範疇和特點。而隨著5G的發展，課程也將討論NTN在B5G/6G系統中的應用和相關標準化。學生將了解NTN如何融入未來通訊網路的發展趨勢，以應對更高效、更智能的通訊需求。最後，課程將深入討論NTN的重要議題，包括安全性、效能優化和未來發展方向等方面。透過課程，學生將獲得對NTN技術全面且深入的理解，並具備應用和解決相關議題的能力。
This course explores the technologies and applications of Non-Terrestrial Communication Networks (NTN). Starting with the basics, it introduces NTN's definition, characteristics, and role in communication. This course then investigates NTN network architecture and applications, offering practical insights. The course also covers 3GPP's planning for NTN networks, understanding NTN's global position and development trends. Different NTN types and their characteristics are introduced, along with discussions on NTN's applications in B5G/6G systems within the context of 5G development. The course concludes with an in-depth discussion on key NTN issues, including security, performance optimization, and future directions. Students will gain a comprehensive understanding of NTN technology and the capability to address relevant issues.

description.zh: 先修課程: 負責教授同意。本課程目的在介紹蓬勃發展中的微機電系統(micro-electro-mechanical systems, MEMS)工程與最新應用。其內容包括 : MEMS之概念與特性、微觀設計原則、跨領域模擬分析、加工材料分類、主要製程技術介紹、CMOS-MEMS整合製造、封裝與測試技術、微感測器與微致動器、智慧型元件與SOC、工程應用實例介紹
description.en: The course contents include concept and characteristics of MEMS, principles of micro system design, inter-disciplinary simulation and analysis, materials for MEMS, main-stream MEMS processing technologies, CMOS-MEMS process integration, package and test techniques, micro sensors and actuators, smart devices and SOC, and closure with a number of engineering applications.

description.zh: 於2009年，ASTM定義了積層製造，並將此積層製造分成七大類型，本課程將對其中的光聚合固化及材料擠製技術進行軟硬體材料的剖析，並導入實作。本課程鼓勵學生在修課後，參加IPAS 3D列印實作考科之工程師級考試。
description.en: ASTM Committee F42 on Additive Manufacturing Technologies was formed in 2009. The myriad process names into seven standardized terms. In this course, the processes of Vat Photopolymerization and Material Extrusion, hardware, software, and material will be studied, The implementation of these two type systems will be given. The course will encourage students to take IPAS exam in 3D Printing practice.

syllabi.outline: ASTM定義了積層製造，並將此積層製造分成七大類型，本課程將對其中的光聚合固化及材料擠製技術進行軟硬體材料的剖析，並導入實作。本課程鼓勵學生在修課後，參加IPAS 3D列印實作考科之工程師級考試。

description.zh: 車輛的應用中包含許多的化學反應，例如噴漆和塗料的使用，要了解車用塗料的操作原理、和研發特用的功能，需要具備基礎化學、有機化學、高分子化學和塗料的知識。本課程針對漆的化學概念，介紹車輛中所使用化學品相關的化學理論，進一步連結到學生在現場時會遇到的實際案例，解釋所觀察到的化學反應現象。
description.en: The applications of vehicles include many chemical reactions, such as the use of paint spraying and coatings. To understand the operation principle and to develop special chemical function, it is necessary to have knowledge of general chemistry, organic chemistry, polymer chemistry and coatings. This course aims at teaching key chemical concepts, introduces chemical theories related to chemicals used in vehicles, further links to actual cases that students will encounter on the scene, and explains the chemical reaction phenomena observed.

name.zh: 企業實務講座- 半導體製程與設備

description.zh: 本課程主要學習各企業在半導體製程的各關鍵製程，包括晶圓製造、蝕刻及封裝測試等，同時深入探討最先進的半導體製造設備。透過與業界專家交流，使學生了解產業實務案例，並掌握應對半導體產業人才需求。率先引領台灣半導體產業發展以真實具體的企業經驗為教材，進而鼓勵學生追求半導體科技創新的渴望，強化學生對職涯願景的規劃。
description.en: This course focuses on studying the key processes of various companies in the semiconductor manufacturing process, including wafer manufacturing, etching, packaging, and testing, etc., and also provides an in-depth discussion of the most advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Through exchanges with industry experts, students can understand industrial practical cases and master the talent needs of the semiconductor industry. It takes the lead in leading the development of Taiwan's semiconductor industry by using real and concrete corporate experience as teaching materials, thereby encouraging students to pursue semiconductor technology innovation and strengthening students' career vision planning.

description.zh:
積層製造技術(又稱三維列印)在近十年來試圖改變整個製造技術的生態，已不再是原型的製造與小量生產，它已經達到符合經濟生產效益的經濟規模製造方法。雖然積層製造以加工方法可分為七大分類，但以工程材料分類則以金屬為最具經濟價值與工業應用最為廣泛。因此，本課程主要以金屬積層製造的方法為出發點，說明可以列印金屬的加工方法，以縮短學術與工業應用的距離。在本課程中，也說明金屬三維列印件的材料選用、列印件的設計考量、加工參數優化、列印件的使用壽命檢測、與數值模擬等。
修習本課程後，學生可以了解:
1.金屬積層製造方法的原理與材料限制
2.金屬列印件的設計考量、前處理與後處理
3.各種列印方法的加工參數設定與其對列印件的影響
4.ASTM規範金屬列印件的巨觀測試方法與微觀檢測方法
5.金屬列印件的輕量化拓樸結構優化設計與分析
6.金屬積層製造的數值分析方法
description.en:
Additive manufacturing technology, also known as 3D printing, has attempted to revolutionize the entire manufacturing ecosystem over the past decade. It has evolved beyond prototyping and small-scale production, reaching an economically viable scale for mass production. Although additive manufacturing can be categorized into seven major types based on processing methods, when classified by engineering materials, metals hold the highest economic value and are the most widely applied in industrial settings. Therefore, this course primarily focuses on metal additive manufacturing methods, explaining the processes that enable metal 3D printing, and bridging the gap between academia and industry. The course also covers material selection for metal 3D printing, design considerations for printed parts, optimization of processing parameters, life time testing of printed parts, and numerical simulation.

description.zh: 第三次數位革命中的數位構築引發了設計革命，產生了大量的建築發明和創新。設計如何使用數位製造和材料技術來校準虛擬模型和實體製品是設計領域的關鍵主題（Iwamoto，2009）。因此，該課程為學生提供了基於數位技術的明確的基於技能的指導，用於提取、開發和分析複雜幾何形狀的數據，同時促進產生合理化和可施工性的系統工作流程。該課程將透過講座和實踐教程來組織，以擴大學生的材料經驗，並透過小組專案開發獨特和具創造性的構造系統。
description.en:
Digital fabrication, in the third digital revolution, has spurred a design revolution, yielding a wealth of architectural invention and innovation. How designs use digital fabrication and material techniques to calibrate between virtual model and physical artifact is the crucial theme in the design field（Iwamoto, 2009）.
Thus, the course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in digital technologies for extracting, developing, and analyzing data of complex geometries while facilitating the production of a systematic workflow for rationalization and constructability. The course will be organized via lectures and hand-on tutorials to enlarge students' material experience and to develop unique and creative tectonic systems via group projects.

description.zh: 近年於規劃設計領域，因伴隨創新技術的發展，越來越多的決策與設計過程皆納入例如大數據分析、混成實境技術、生成式AI等技術，似乎降低了相關專業訓練的進入門檻，提升跨領域合作的可能性。然而若仔細觀察實務應用領域的情況，因為這些技術仍未普及，最終的操作還是容易掌握在特定專業人士手上，並且過度依賴抽象的數據和技術，與使用者產生隔閡，進一步影響設計成果。基於這個前提，本課程計畫藉由引進強調使用者為核心價值的「設計思考」方法作為橋樑，搭配創新科技的運用，於選定的社區針對特定議題進行參與規劃和空間設計操作，以此探索面向未來的社區設計方法。由於本課程之方法強調跨領域協作，並涉及創新創業及大學社會責任的內涵，故本課程除提供建築系大學部三、四年級選修外，也鼓勵校內其他科系同年級的學生選修。
description.en: Recent advances in planning and design have led to the integration of tools like big data, mixed reality, and generative AI into decision-making processes. While this trend lowers barriers for professional training and fosters interdisciplinary collaboration, these technologies remain limited in practical use, with final decisions often still in the hands of specific professionals. Moreover, over-reliance on abstract data can create a disconnect between designers and users. To address this, the course introduces "Design Thinking," a user-centered approach, alongside innovative technologies, to facilitate community design. Since this course emphasizes interdisciplinary collaboration and incorporates the concepts of innovation, entrepreneurship, and university social responsibility, it is offered as an elective for third- and fourth-year students in the Department of Architecture, while also encouraging students from other departments at the same level to enroll.

description.zh: 本課程名稱為 “環境與自然保育” 。它包括二大範疇：(1)自然環境和自然資源的保育，(2)自然環境的保存、維護、利用、復原及改良。它將教導學生下列主題：自然保育的基本概念（自然保育的定義、自然保育觀念的發展）、保育生物學（物種形成和滅絕、生物多樣性、物種保護的優先原則、生物入侵）、生態經濟學簡介（生態經濟學的原則、能量流與物質流分析）、自然保護區（自然保護區之概念、自然保護區的保護對象）、自然保育政策（國際自然保育策略、台灣的自然保育機構及相關法規）與自然保育運動（自然保育運動之發展、當前自然保育運動所關心的事）。整體而言, 本課程期盼提升公民生態意識和環境覺知, 使大家對環境保育做出更多貢獻。
description.en: The title of this course is “Environment and Nature Conservation”. It includes two categories: (1) conservation of the natural environment and natural resources, and (2) the preservation, maintenance, restoration and improvement of the natural environment. It will introduce to students the following themes: basic concepts of nature conservation, conservation biology, introduction to ecological economics, nature reservation, nature conservation policy, and nature conservation movement. As a whole, it aims to raise our citizens’ ecological consciousness and environmental awareness and thus enable them to make more contribution to the conservation of our environment.

syllabi.outline: 生態與自然保育是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解自然資源管理的架構，從而掌屋自然保育與生活品質的關係，再就台灣自然資源與環境管理問題，探究分析其根源，最後以自身潛力與未來方向為基礎，發想共同之願景。

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

syllabi.outline: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。

description.zh:
新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。
新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。
課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en:
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously.
    The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

description.zh:
本課程首先說明人在宇宙中的定位、生命的可貴、一生的方向；接著說明如何鍛鍊自己成為生命的勇士；最後強調如何與天地萬物和諧相處和真愛的永不止息。
課程進行方式是透過體驗活動、交流分享和有次第的講授人類共同的智慧，並安排數次的校外教學，以深入瞭解社會脈動，並運用多媒體影片教學以提升學習效果，學生每天做身心觀察學習紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。
description.en:
This course covers topics such as: the role of human beings in the universe, the dearness of life and the pursuit of life-long goals. We then discuss ways to train the students to become brave and to harmonize human beings with the nature, leading to an access to the discovery of true love.
The course is realized through activity involvement, experience sharing and lectures on human wisdom. We have some extramural visits in order to understand social pulses. Multimedia teaching materials are fully utilized to enhance the teaching and learning effects. We request that all the students take note of their mental and physical improvements on a daily basis so that they could examine the progressive path of life.

syllabi.outline:
人為萬物之靈，你相信嗎?本課程開啟思考與論辯的交流，希望一起面對人類最重要的問題，一起尋求解方。從認識自己和在乎別人開始，尋找此生的定位，認識人性的尊嚴、生命的可貴、一生的方向；接著說明如何鍛鍊自己成為生命的勇士；最後強調如何與別人對談連結，與萬事萬物和諧相處，讓真愛永不止息。

課程進行方式是透過體驗活動、交流分享和有次第的講授人類最精純的智慧，並安排人物訪談和分組活動，以深入瞭解別人的思維，運用多樣化教學以提升學習效果，學生每週做學習心得紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。

description.zh: 中國文化博大精深，淵源流長，是以本課程講授內容在於介紹中國文化的特徵，如人類的起源、文化的演進、農業社會的產生、政治制度的發展、學術思想的演變、教育設施、科學與藝術的發展、工商業的發展，以及宗教信仰等，都是本課程所要探討的內容。藉此引導學生掌握古今之間的相關性，並探索中國傳統文化對台灣、東亞與世界的影響。
description.en: Chinese culture is broad and profound, so the course introduces the characteristics of it.  It includes the origin of Chinese races, the changes of the culture and the academic thoughts, the formation of the agricultural society, the developments on politics, sciences, arts, and religions……etc. The students are expected to understand the relationship between the ancient and modern China and then do further research about the influences of the traditional culture of China on Taiwan, the eastern Asia and the whole world.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在培養學生成為具有深度文化視覺的科技人。從認識本土文化為起點，進而認識世界文化。引導學生如何探究文化現象，並且深入文化的精神境界，物質境界，瞭解文化價值與文化傳統，讓文化觀點充分融入個人的思維內涵。
The main purpose of this course is to develop the cultural cultivation of our technology majored students. Starting with the culture of our own land and extending to world-wide culture. The teachers would guide the students to explore the phenomena of the culture, and try to find out both the spirit and the material of the culture. Through the understanding of the worth and the tradition of the culture, the students might merge the cultural cultivation into their personal thinking.

description.zh: 本課程旨在欣賞篆竟藝術，認識我國歷代著名的篆竟家與優美的作品，由作品之中廣泛瞭解篆竟多樣化的美感表現與技法，並嘗試實現於創作。篆竟是我國特有的一種藝術形式，除了日常日信的實用功能之外，更普遍使用在書法或繪畫等藝術作品中。因此瞭解篆竟藝術之美，往往是面對其他藝術作品時所不可或缺的。篆竟創作必須在方寸微小的天地之內，專注構思，謹慎刻畫。如此苦心經營的體驗，同時也是十分可貴的精神陶冶。
description.en:
This course enlightens students on the art, the arlists and the masterworks of seal cutting. Form the appreciation of great works, students sharpen the understanding of the versatile beauty and skills exerted in seal cutting.
Seal cutting is a unique form of art in China. It is commonly applied in signets, and extensively connected with calligraphy and painting stampings and other artistic performance. Therefore, the understanding of seal cutting is supposed to be an inevitable way to unveil the curtain of Chinese art palace. Students are expected to work out the composition of seal cutting within centimeters;hence,their concentration and deliberation can be spontaneously molded.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.outline:
課程大綱
1、課程簡介：憲法為一個之根本大法，實質的憲法精神更是法治國的體現。憲法一般雖定性為公法，惟其觸角及影響力更深入到每一個法律領域之中，不管是民法、刑法、行政法等領域，均與憲法息息相關，多需要透過憲法之角度來檢視其他法律的正當性與是否合憲性。故憲法之重要性，當然不言而喻。
2、課程目標及授課方式：
讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺憲法於整個法律體系中之定位及地位。
側重近幾年來的重大憲法爭議，將從大法官會議解釋來探討同性婚之違憲與否、通姦除罪化之憲法觀點、罷權等之公民權行使、言論自由與憲法之保障及界線等等，建立法律學的嚴謹思維，培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
上課時雖不會點名同學回答問題，但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論，以期收教學相長之效。
syllabi.schedule:
第一周：導論：憲法課程基本介紹學習本課程之態度老師學經歷介紹。
第二周：憲法之基本觀念：什麼是法律/什麼是憲法憲法在整個法律體系中的位置憲法的繼受法性質。
第三周：憲法發展史國外發展法我國發展史。
第四周：憲法的法律性質公法或私法？憲法普通法及憲法特別法
第四周：憲法與其他法律的關係（1）：憲法與民法（大法官會議解釋）憲法與刑法憲法與行政法/勞基法憲法與經濟法憲法與智慧財產權法/著作權法。
第五周：外國憲法簡介（一）美國憲法
第六周：外國憲法簡介（二）德國憲法
第七周：我國憲法之基本結構（一）概論
第八周：我國憲法的基本結構（二）國體及人民基本權利。
第九周：基本權利（一）生命權、財產權。
第十周：基本權利（二）自由權。
第十一周：期中考。
第十二周：言論自由專論。
第十三周：憲法第22條之其他基本權利。
第十五周：憲法23條比例原則介紹（一）
第十六周：憲法23條比例原則之相關釋憲解釋。
第十七周：我國政府及三權分立

description.zh: 投資是有報酬和風險的，不同金融產品有不同的報酬率和風險，例如：存款報酬低風險低，期貨報酬高風險高。如何將資金做一個妥善分配，選擇合適的一組金融商品，就能避不必要的風險而得到不錯的報酬率。投資學課程可以使學習者了解如何以投資學理論評估各種金融商品的可能風險和報酬率，再依投資者經濟能力選擇合適的金融商品進行投資。對於理工科系人員，了解投資學課程是增強理工科系人員理財素養的重要課程之一。
description.en: Investment has its rewards and risks; different financial products have different rates of return and risk. For example: deposits have low rewards with low risks; futures have high rewards with high risks. With making a proper allocation of funds and choosing the right set of financial products, one can avoid unnecessary risks and get a good rate of return. Investment courses make students understand how to apply financial instruments theory to assess possible risks and returns in various financial instruments, and then invest the suitable financial products according to the economic capacity of investors. For science and engineering personnel, understanding the investment in science and engineering courses is one of the important programs to enhance financial literacy personnel.

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class.  This requirement applies to Freshman Sophomore and Junior students while it is an elective for senior students.  For Freshman level, Classes focus on basic physical strength training.  For Sophomore and Junior students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh:
學術論文簡報的能力是學術專業人員所必備的專業知能，以清楚簡明的方法傳遞專業科學的內容，需要報告者展現清楚的語言溝通能力。而本課程即是在培養學生具備在國際會議場合上進行學術論文簡報的能力。課程內容包括：優化學生英文基本能力、熟悉學術英文簡報的架構、學習使用資料視覺化傳遞科學研究發現，以及建立個人簡報風格等循序開展。
修課學生需要具備基本的英文能力，並具備閱讀英文撰寫之學術報告的能力。學期間授課教師以講授法與小組合作介紹學術論文簡報的架構、製作學術論文簡報的注意事項、介紹常用之學術英文表現句型，並帶領學生每週撰寫一篇10分鐘的英文演說稿，最後學生以英文進行個人學術論文簡報作為最終考核的成果。
description.en:
In today's international scientific community, an academic professional is required to present his/her scientific works in a professional manner in English. It is necessary that a scientist can deliver his/her own idea in a clear and precise language.  This course is designed to prepare the students with the ability doing academic presentation in an international conference. The contents of this course include the improvement of students' English proficiency, the introduction of the academic presentation format, and the delivery of key findings by using data visualization skills.  
It is required that the students should have basic English capacity and can read a scientific report written in English.  The course material would be delivered by the instructor through weekly class literature and the team work projects. By the end of semester, the students would know the popular sentences used to express their result findings. The students would also learn how to make their own academic p

syllabi.outline: As a researcher, it is important to communicate the research findings through academic presentation, in English particularly. In this class, the students would learn how to present their research in a professional style. The students would know how to coherently organize their research question, theoretical framework, methodology and findings. The data visualization skill would be taught in the class as well. By the end of the semester, the students should build their confidence and present their research works in English.

description.zh: 課程將探討如何將物聯網 (IoT)、大數據分析、人工智能 (AI)、自動化技術和雲端運算等嶄新技術應用於製造業的各個環節，從而實現智能工廠和自動化生產的願景。學員將通過真實案例分析、實際操作和軟硬體工具的應用，掌握工業4.0在生產流程優化、供應鏈管理、產品研發等領域的實務技能。
description.en: The course will explore how cutting-edge technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT), big data analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), automation technologies, and cloud computing can be applied to various aspects of manufacturing to achieve the vision of smart factories and automated production. Through real case studies, hands-on practice, and the use of both software and hardware tools, participants will acquire practical skills in implementing Industry 4.0 for optimizing production processes, managing supply chains, and developing products.

syllabi.outline:
邀請專家講解工業4.0相關理論、應用實例、國家政策、關鍵議題、世界趨勢，藉由演講及提問討論的方式，提供學生將視野擴大、以及對工業4.0有全面了解的機會。
This course invites experts in the field of Industry 4.0 to introduce related background theories, examples, applications, government policies, critical issues, and current trends. This course aims to provide students with an overview of Industry 4.0 by means of talk, Q&A, and discussion.

description.zh: 本課程引入生活性的學習方法來誘發學生學習動機，並培養可在社會與職場運用的四項英文基本技能。課程目標在幫助學生在生活實境習得英文，為他們裝備可溝通表達於日常、社交活動，並提升職涯的整合性英文技能。每堂課程都注重在以學生為中心的學習活動中帶入全真、應用性高的英文技巧。課程設計涵蓋的功能包括課堂分享與作業、日常互動英文以及專業英文練習。主要課題包括溝通，簡報與談判技巧，應用閱讀與寫作，聽力技巧運用，語言與文化。
description.en: This course introduces real-world based learning approaches for students to raise their learning aspirations and to develop four essential English skills that are applicable in social and professional encounters. This course aims to help students practice English in most real-life settings and to equip them with integrated skills to advance their careers. Every class session focuses on bringing authentic and applied English in student-centered leaning activities. The class design covers the functions like information sharing and task-based activities, social interactions, and professional English practices. Essential topics include communication, techniques of negotiation and presentation, applied reading and writing, strategies for developing listening skills and language learning across cultures.
