name.zh: 創業之品牌管理與行銷
name.en: The Brand Management and Marketing of Entrepreneurship

description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，同時須考慮新創事業之品牌建構，如果能在創業之初建構一個定位明確的品牌，可使新創事業立即享有良好的品牌權益，提高創業成功的機會。品牌建構完成後，須設計行銷方案，對消費者進行行銷活動，向消費者推銷新創公司之品牌，以塑造良好的品牌權益。此時，消費者對新創公司之品牌會有良好形象之認知，進而提升顧客對新創公司品牌忠誠度，增加創業者創業成功之機會。
description.en:
When entrepreneurs are building a startup company, they also need to consider its brand building. If they can construct a clear positioning of the brand in the beginning, they are able to have their new business with a better brand equity immediately, and improve entrepreneurial chances of success.
After the completion of construction of the brand, entrepreneurs need to design marketing programs for consumer marketing activities, and promote its brand to create good brand equity. In the meantime, consumers will have a better brand awareness of these new companies, enhancing customer loyalty and increasing opportunities for entrepreneurs’ entrepreneurial success.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在培養創業者所須具備的經商視野與格局，並認識品牌與行銷之整體概念。包括認識經商環境與商業模式、了解如何善用品牌與行銷的觀念拓展市場，搭配實務案例之研討，期讓同學能在理解相關商業常識與品牌、行銷的觀念後，進而能發展符合消費者需求的行銷能力，順利拓展市場。

name.en: Applications of Internet of Things ( IoT )

description.zh: 「物聯網（智慧聯網）」被視為繼個人電腦、網際網路之後，世界資訊產業的第三波浪潮。隨著科技的進步，網路早已成為人與人重要的溝通管道之一，而在未來的世界，透過物聯網技術，將賦予物件智慧並擁有與其它物件或人溝通的能力，換言之，未來網路不再只是人與人的溝通管道，更是聯繫全球物與物、人與物的橋樑。未來智慧型裝置有望相互連結、分享資料，進而改變人們的日常生活與企業的運作模式。
description.en:
The Internet of Things ( IoT ) is regarded as the third wave after the invention of personal computer and the Internet.
Through technological progress, the Internet has become an important way for people to communicate. In the future, the IoT technologies will enable objects to communicate with other objects, or human beings.
In other words, the Internet will not only become a bridge between human beings, but also between objects, or even between human beings and objects.
Future smart devices will be connected and shared across each other, changing how human beings live on a daily basis, and how enterprises operate.

syllabi.outline:
「物聯網（智慧聯網）」被視為繼個人電腦、網際網路之後，世界資訊產業的第三波浪潮。隨著科技的進步，網路早已成為人與人重要的溝通管道之一，而在未來已來的世界，透過物聯網技術，將賦予物件智慧並擁有與其它物件或人溝通的能力，換言之，未來網路不再只是人與人的溝通管道，更是聯繫全球物與物、人與物的橋樑。多數智慧型裝置有望相互連結、分享資料，進而改變人們的日常生活與企業的運作模式。

description.zh:
因是在大專教藝術欣賞的課程，我在設計課程上，即考慮雖同學們不是藝術本科學生，但秉持"雖創作，但會欣賞的原則"，我的課程安排將從上古時代人類的美術創作活動進而引導解釋什麼是人類的美感經驗。讓他們明瞭東方藝術之同與不同，再介紹東西方的繪畫潮流，如西方：從文藝復興至寫實主義，印象主義，至超印象主義，東方：從漢的畫象磚開始至中國畫，書法之演進，中西繪畫之比較，內容是繁而多的。但我將用簡潔扼要的"重點教學法",寓教於樂的方式，讓同學不再懼怕"Art'，甚至可以簡單的分辨出藝術品的年代，作者，及欣賞藝術作品的要領，這是我給此門課所訂的目標。
另一個教學重點是："理論和實際併重"。在每一單元中，我將設計一項簡的[自己動手做]大概祇花 20-30 分鐘讓學生體會和真正看見，明白，藝術家製造藝術品的過程。
很希望能帶學生至博物院或美術館一趟，或至鶯砍參觀陶工廠。總之，一切課程計劃，乃配合學生之程度與興趣。
description.en: Because most students taking this course are not art major; therefore, I adhere to the principle of "Although not creation, appreciation will be instructed."  On course design, my class starts from the artistic creation of human beings in prehistoric time and further introduces the experience of beauty sensed by man and understand the similiar and difference of eastern and western art.  Moreover, I will introduce the fashion of priniting of eastern and western culture.  For example, the western culture: from the Renaissance to realism, impressionism and super impressionism.  Western culture: from a portrait stone of Han Dynasty to Chinese painting, the develpment of calligraphy and comparison of Chinese and western paintings. The teaching content is complicated, but I will simply it and highlight teaching way to let my students enjoy it.

description.zh:
本課程首先說明人在宇宙中的定位、生命的可貴、一生的方向；接著說明如何鍛鍊自己成為生命的勇士；最後強調如何與天地萬物和諧相處和真愛的永不止息。
課程進行方式是透過體驗活動、交流分享和有次第的講授人類共同的智慧，並安排數次的校外教學，以深入瞭解社會脈動，並運用多媒體影片教學以提升學習效果，學生每天做身心觀察學習紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。
description.en:
This course covers topics such as: the role of human beings in the universe, the dearness of life and the pursuit of life-long goals. We then discuss ways to train the students to become brave and to harmonize human beings with the nature, leading to an access to the discovery of true love.
The course is realized through activity involvement, experience sharing and lectures on human wisdom. We have some extramural visits in order to understand social pulses. Multimedia teaching materials are fully utilized to enhance the teaching and learning effects. We request that all the students take note of their mental and physical improvements on a daily basis so that they could examine the progressive path of life.

syllabi.outline:

課程進行方式是透過體驗活動、交流分享和有次第的講授人類最精純的智慧，並安排人物訪談和分組活動，以深入瞭解別人的思維，運用多樣化教學以提升學習效果，學生每週做學習心得紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

syllabi.outline:
This is a history course of western classical music, of which the definition, according to The New Harvard Dictionary of Music and The Oxford Dictionary, is "art music” or "serious music", that written in a Western musical tradition, using an established form. "Classical music is generally considered to be serious and to have a lasting value.”
The styles of various periods will be introduced, from the Medieval, Renaissance, Classical, Romantic, to the Contemporary eras. The goal of this course is helping students to equip a general comprehension of Classical Music in terms of basic elements of musical art, technical theory, historical, social and cultural background extends to related arts and humanities. 

In order to pursue the most accurate references and info, the major key-points and terminology used in this course will be in English or original European text
此門課程為西洋藝術音樂史，即古典音樂歷史。根據「新哈佛音樂辭典」 ( New Harvard Dictionary of Music) 與 「牛津字典」 的詮釋，所謂古典音樂為「嚴肅藝術」音樂，以嚴謹成型的作曲公式創作音樂，經過歷史洗練的時間藝術。透過此課程學生對西洋古典音樂會有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及社會人文背景，從音樂美感構成與相關人文藝術和文化歷史的議題作連結。
syllabi.schedule:
1. 古希臘藝術與人文, 信仰: 古歐洲在基督教傳入前的文化, 音樂, 文學, 戲劇, 跟人文背景	
1st week: Introduction to Western Art Music—Greek origin as the foremost culture before Christianity entered Europe

2. 從基督教傳入, 到中世紀: 古歐洲承襲希臘時代以來的傳承, 展現於壁畫, 以及基督教傳入歐洲後對文化及藝術的影響; 音樂記譜方式, 表演方式,天主教會對社會的影響; 拜占庭建築到哥德式大教堂, 中世紀歐洲社會與歷史
2nd week: The Medieval Period--folk music, church music in relation to arts and culture

3. 中世紀到文藝復興音樂的演變(舞蹈與民謠): 庶民文化與音樂
3rd week: From Medieval to Renaissance period--Madrigals, church music, dance music.

4. 文藝復興時期: 宗教音樂由單一旋律演化為複音音樂, 作曲家 雕塑家. 畫家介紹. 以義大利為首的時代. 此時期受歡迎的樂器介紹; 源於德, 法, 蘇格蘭宗教改革與英國王室的關聯
4th week: Renaissance period--from Monophony to Polyphony; Introduction to Italian composers, artists, and some of the most popular musical instruments; the Reformed Church and Martin Luther that not only changed the society and belief system but also aethesticism in arts. 

5. 巴洛克時期: 法國巴洛克--英國巴洛克與法國巴洛克比較, 王室音樂跟庶民音樂介紹; 法王路易十四世與凡爾賽宮
5th week: Baroque--Louis XIV and his influence on French music,in comparison to English Baroque

6. 巴洛克時期:	義大利式協奏曲介紹; 巴洛克時代小型管弦曲; 宗教信仰不同形成南歐與北歐教堂建築文化迴異
6th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends--Corelli, Lully and Couperin, Introduction to Concerto Grosso

7. 巴洛克時期:	基本舞曲, 組曲形式--宮廷舞步與巴洛克芭蕾
7th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends continues--Vivaldi, Scarlatti, and Rameau--Court Dance and French Ballet

8. 巴洛克時期: 德意志巴洛克--韓德爾, 泰雷曼, 巴赫
8th week: Baroque--Comparison among Handel, Telemann, and J.S.Bach

9. 巴洛克時期: 深度探討巴赫生平與作品
9th week: Baroque--J.S. Bach in-depth--his string works, orchestral music, choral music, keyboard music, and Fugues.

10. 	期中報告	
10th week: Midterm Report

11. 古典時期: 啟蒙時代崛起, 腓特烈二世 (普魯士) 對德意志音樂藝術的影響. 波次坦忘憂宮介紹; 盧梭之民約論, 丹麥王室實現其理念; 俄羅斯凱撒琳大帝對藝術的貢獻—聖彼得堡冬宮博物館介紹
11th week: Classical period (Classicism)--The Age of Enlightenment--Frederick the Great as a passionate patron of music and art; Danish royal house contributing Jean-Jacques Rousseau's ideology in Denmark; Catherine the Great and The Hermitage

12. 古典時期: 德奧樂派 (第一代維也納樂派); 葛路克與哈布斯堡家族及其小公主,後來為法國波旁王朝最後的皇后瑪麗．安東尼; 海頓, 莫札特, 貝多芬(前期)
12th week: The First Viennese School; Gluck and Habsburg family; Marie Antoinette

13. 浪漫派時期: 從貝多芬中期開啟德奧浪漫派
13th week: Romantic period--Beethoven and the beginning of Romantic era; how Schubert was influenced by Beethoven 

14. 浪漫派時期: 法國, 北歐, 波西米亞--區域性的不同風格
14th week: The pinnacle of Romantic era--Chopin, Schumann, Brahms, Liszt, Tchaikovsky, to the late Romantic period

15. 浪漫派時期: 國民樂派, 俄羅斯音樂與十九世紀俄國芭蕾
15th week: A counterpart of Romantic style with Naionalism--Music by Bohemian and Russian composers; 19th Century Russian ballet and music

16. 二十世紀現代樂派: 法國印象樂派, 第二代維也納樂派; 法國印象畫派與樂派的相輔相成; 包浩斯學院, Art Deco (裝飾風藝術) Art Nouveau (新藝術運動) 介紹
16th week: Impressionist Music, The Second Viennese School and related art styles in the period
17. 後現代主義: 音樂學界的實驗性音樂;	Phillip Glass獨創的極簡樂風; 電腦與傳統樂器結合
17th week: The Contemporary Music--from Twelve- tone music (The 2nd Viennese School) to Existentialism, music of Minimalism, and experimental music.

18:	期末考
18th week: Final Exam.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將以「臺灣的水」為主題，探討「水」在臺灣社會發展中扮演什麼角色。課程分為3大主題：水與都市開發、水與社區、水與未來。本課程會交替運用演講、走讀、討論等方式，介紹臺灣重要的水生態與歷史文化，以及所涉及的各種社會議題。

本課程適合怎樣的你？
1.	課程需要大量小組討論、發言→適合認為自己需要多練習表達能力的你。
2.	課程期末作業為展覽或展品製作→適合喜歡把知識內容轉換為不同展覽形式的你。
3.	課程有1-2次走讀／專題演講→適合喜歡去戶外、喜歡認識校園外其他環境教育專家的你。

※ 本課綱為暫定課綱，正式課綱請以開學後所發放的課綱為主。
※ 加選同學請寫信給我（信箱：yingyingandhohoho@gmail.com），繳交一份至少500字的自我介紹。內容請說明你選修環境教育的理由。你可以從環境、自然、或是環境政治與你個人的關係闡釋為何你要修本課程（你可以從成長經驗、你的家鄉、印象深刻的地方、你很在意某些環境議題…等，說明為何自然、環境在你的生命中是重要的）。

syllabi.assessment:
本課程以教師演講搭配小組討論與走讀。我們將以 3-4 週為一個單元介紹不同的水議題，並於指定週次舉辦小組討論。此外，期末報告也是重要的知識訓練過程。

成績配分：
1. 【個人】課堂參與、小組討論 12%
2. 【個人】自我介紹 3%
3. 【個人】討論筆記 10*3 =30%
4. 【小組】期末報告 35% （教師 30%、同學評分 5%）
5. 【小組】期末報告展品說明書 10%
6. 【個人】其他小組展品評論 10%

課堂參與評分方式如下：

課堂參與、小組討論成績計算方式：
1. 每次發言+1分（發言包括但不限於：課堂問答、小組討論成果代表發言、小組發表QA回答），另外教師會視平時課堂參與（特別是參與小組討論的程度）酌加分數。
2. 學期固定點名5次（3次演講+2次隨機點名）：點名未到且未請假者，扣平時成績1分。病假請按照學校規定附上就醫證明、公假請附上公假單。事假每人每學期限請1次。


作業說明：
【期末報告】
全班分為8組，每組上限7人。
期末報告請小組針對「水與環境」挑選一個主題製作環境教育解說宣傳品（可為：網頁、海報、折頁、小冊子、模型、行程導覽等）。主題可從授課內容中挑選。我們將在第17週舉辦發表會，每組請以10分鐘的時間說明你們的作品。

期末報告評分重點為：
1) 該展品的主軸清晰程度（20%）
2) 該主題內容的資料來源標示程度（20%）
3) 該主題內容的資料的正確度（20%）
4) 該展品美觀程度（20%）
5) 該展品的吸引力（20%）

除期末報告展品外，各組請另外繳交期末報告展品說明書，用文字內容解說該展品。

期末報告展品說明書評分重點：
1) 該展品說明書是否清楚說明宣傳品的主題
2) 該展品說明書是否清楚說明小組在設計宣傳品時的思考過程、對內容的取捨
3) 該展品說明書是否清楚說明宣傳品中各種文案與符號為何這樣呈現

另外，其他同學需要針對其他7組作品給分，並針對你給最高分或最低分的作品（擇一）撰寫至少300字評論。
評論評分重點為：評論者是否針對該宣傳品內容並結合評論者看法，給分理由是否合理。

※	除展覽外，請各組「個別」成員繳交「期末報告分工互評表」（以個人為單位，截止日期另行公佈），未繳交者，小組期末作業不計分。互評表僅作為教師調整個別同學分數的參考，不計入全組作業成績。

【討論筆記】
本學期有三次討論課，每次討論課的「前一週」會發閱讀材料與討論提綱。請同學閱讀材料與討論提綱後，針對教師提示的重點作答（下限300字、上限1000字）。

※   繳交期限為討論週當週週三中午11:59。繳交到 i學園


【NG作業提示】
1) 內容空泛的作業：充斥著各種形容詞如「收穫很多」、「以前都不知道」……但缺少具體內容者。內容空泛的作業不會高於75分。
2) 分條列點的作業：你可以分段，但是不要分條列點。分條列點作業不會高於80分。
3) 幻想文、文不對題者：沒有針對作業提示、主題內容撰寫者，該作業以不及格記（0-50分）。
4) 教條文：內容充斥著「應該更加愛護環境」、「應該加強對環境的教育」、「應該更公平分配資源」等「看似標準的答案」，但是卻沒有解釋為何應該如此者，待遇同內容空泛作業（第一點）。
5) 作業：a) 檔案名稱與內文沒有寫姓名、系級、學號者扣作業成績3-5分；b) 用非word、PDF的格式繳交者，扣作業成績5分。

【優良作業特徵】
1) 清楚引證資料來源（每一句不是你自創的話都要寫下資料來源）。
2) 針對作業提示或內容主題清楚說明。
3) 用你自己的話把你要講的事情講清楚。
4) 能夠看到事情的複雜性（而非簡單跳到「標準答案」）並且說清楚。

教育部規定要寫這門課符合哪些品德教育指標，因為我們每週都在處理社會議題並且討論這些議題，所以每週都跟啟發思辨（Explanation）有關，雖然嚴格來說，「思辨」這個概念翻譯成 explaination 有點奇怪。

description.zh: 科技發展為促進人類社會進步的主要動力。現今，科技發展中的性別議題與性別政治也漸漸受到國際社會的重視。本課程首先讓學生意識到在科學教育中性別失衡的現象與其成因。之後從社會學、人類學與性別學切入當前性別科技發展中的各項議題。最後將會以全球視角與永續發展指標(SDGs)來檢視科技發展中的性別政治，給予學生更宏觀和深入的分析，培養未來具人文關懷的科技專業人才。
description.en: Science and technology development is the main driving force to promote the progress of human society. Nowadays, gender issues and gender politics in the development of science and technology have been paid more and more attention by the international community. In this class, firstly, students will be aware of the phenomenon of gender imbalance in science education and its causes. Secondly, I am going to talk about current development of gendered technology from perspectives of sociology, anthropology and gender. Finally, I will lead students to examine gender politics in science and technology from a global perspective and sustainable development indicators (SDGs). This class aims to give students a more macro- and in-depth analysis and cultivating future talented humanities and technology professionals.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將以幾波全球化為背景，首先指出性別與科技如何相互建構，接者分析機器與男性氣質的關聯性。以此為基礎，帶領同學認識性別與交織分析如何解決科技研究的盲點，最後反思工程文化的性別議題。The course will be contextualized within several waves of globalization. It will start by examining how gender and technology mutually construct each other, followed by an analysis of the correlation between machinery and masculine traits. Building upon this foundation, it will guide students to understand how gender and intersectional analysis address blind spots in technological research. Finally, it will encourage reflection on gender issues within engineering culture.

description.en: We usually use statistics in our daily life, but in many cases, we should have basic statistic concept, otherwise we maybe misleading by the data.  In this lesson, we use statistic analysis function of Excel as a useful tool.  Introduce basic method of statistic, show the procedure of questionnaire design, data collection and analysis, explanation of result etc., by use the example in our daily life.

description.en: Through series of classes to train students embracing the innovative thinking and gradually internalize it to become innovative entrepreneurship. name.en: Applications of Internet of Things ( IoT )

description.zh: 「物聯網（智慧聯網）」被視為繼個人電腦、網際網路之後，世界資訊產業的第三波浪潮。隨著科技的進步，網路早已成為人與人重要的溝通管道之一，而在未來的世界，透過物聯網技術，將賦予物件智慧並擁有與其它物件或人溝通的能力，換言之，未來網路不再只是人與人的溝通管道，更是聯繫全球物與物、人與物的橋樑。未來智慧型裝置有望相互連結、分享資料，進而改變人們的日常生活與企業的運作模式。
description.en:
The Internet of Things ( IoT ) is regarded as the third wave after the invention of personal computer and the Internet.
Through technological progress, the Internet has become an important way for people to communicate. In the future, the IoT technologies will enable objects to communicate with other objects, or human beings.
In other words, the Internet will not only become a bridge between human beings, but also between objects, or even between human beings and objects.
Future smart devices will be connected and shared across each other, changing how human beings live on a daily basis, and how enterprises operate.

syllabi.outline:

name.en: Contemporary Art and Creative Industries of Culture

description.zh: 這門課的目標是介紹並討論當代人文思潮與創作的關係與研究。18星期的課程包括一次課外教學，以及邀請演講者和學生對話與討論，並有一套精選的幻燈片和錄影帶配合講授課程。
description.en: This course is to introduce a basic understanding of prevailing trend of contemporary thought and research of its relation of contemporary creation. An 18 weeks program including one field trips and possible some discussions with guest speakers. A concise selection of slides and videotapes are applied with lectures.

syllabi.outline: 藝術不僅是審美與表達的載體，更是創新思維的催化劑。本課程探索當代藝術如何與科學、產業、社會議題交匯，我們從藝術與科學的對話出發，探討視覺藝術如何受到不同科學的影響，並探討新興領域如 Web3.0、沉浸式展演、數位IP等，如何拓展博物館與文化產業的邊界。同時，課程也關注當代藝術的社會參與，包括環境永續、身份認同與潮流文化等，並透過 Peter Cook 的建築實驗、以及時尚與藝術融合等知名創作，剖析創意如何形塑未來。課程將結合業師講座與代表性作品解析，鼓勵學生從跨領域的視角理解藝術，培養跨域與文化創新的思維模式。

name.en: The Development of Taiwan Technology History

description.zh: 台灣科技發展史將討論二十世紀前半（1900-1950）部份重要技術引入台灣後，造成的影響與社會變遷。依時間先後，先從農業技術的變革-綠色革命。其次研讀有關電力與水利的技術發展，然後進入工業化初期的台灣社會變遷，以及二次大戰期間軍需工業所引導出的初期重化工業。除了這些技術與產業變革之外，也將兼論及技術人物群像與職業教育的開端。
description.en: The main topics for class will discuss the important technology how to influence Taiwan society during 1900-1950. This class includes some important developments: Green revolution -it discuss about agriculture development; the technology development of electricity and water conservancy. In some topic we discuss about Taiwan society change in early days industrialization and chemical industry during world war II. Except those topics, technologists and the beginning of professional education in Taiwan will be introduced.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將討論二十世紀後半(1950-1990)台灣重要科技產業與經濟發展的關聯性，同時也將從日常生活科技與社會的角度分析科技物設計的緣由，最後再帶入工程文化的認識與反思。This course will discuss the relationship between technology and industrial development in Taiwan during the second half of the 20th century (1950-1990). It will also analyze the reasons behind the design of technological objects from the perspectives of everyday life technology and society. Finally, it will delve into the understanding and reflection of engineering culture.

description.zh: 「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。
description.en: “Aesthetics of living " will address the East-West cultural and aesthetic experience through series of questions that drive the discourse in contemporary life’s content and activities. Following the different lifestyles, social environment, human tries to reconstruct everyday life into contemporary aesthetics of living. This course aims to encourage students to think what is aesthetic of living, through the real life and spiritual life and concerned itself with the aesthetic problems in the lives of others.

syllabi.outline:
「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。
  在眾多的生活科學群中，生活美學是一支新秀。它把美學用到生活的考察和研究之中，從審美的角度分析和揭示生活環境營造和社會生活發展等方面的規律，以生活的美和空間特有的審美關係作為自己的研究對象，力求揭示生活空間美的創造規律和法則，分析生活空間的美化與生活空間的各項功能要求的關係，研究空間使用者的審美心理和審美教育問題，從而達到提高空間美的創造和感受能力，促進空間美化的目的。

“Aesthetics of living " will address the East-West cultural and aesthetic experience through series of questions that drive the discourse in contemporary life’s content and activities. Following the different lifestyles, social environment, human tries to reconstruct everyday life into contemporary aesthetics of living. This course aims to encourage students to think what is aesthetic of living, through the real life and spiritual life and concerned itself with the aesthetic problems in the lives of others.

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

syllabi.outline:
主題：美好關係探索與實踐(請耐心看完說明)

本課程從家庭關係開啟自我探索、情緒舒展、自我擁抱到關係開展，融入簡單的理論概念，透過繪本、影片、體驗、互動、討論分享、塗繪、書寫等表達性藝術，在舒緩的氣氛中，引導同學逐步建構自我與人我關係發展的力量。

●溫馨提醒：
這門課從社會教育出發，僅提取部分心理學基礎概念，非學理性課程，亦非單向式講授，注重體驗互動，屬生活應用與實踐性質，課中常需跨出腳步與人互動連結，是一趟向內也向外的心靈探險，採類工作坊模式進行，請審慎評估再選課；第一堂須出席。

description.zh: 新經濟與舊經濟的分野不是在有『e』還是沒有『e』，而是在有『i』還是沒有『i』，而『i』就是『Innovation，創新』。二十一世紀的『腦力經濟』最重要的戲規則就是『智慧財產權』，同時也是WTO會員國必須遵守的重要規範之一。課程內容主要包括三個最基本的智慧財產權課題：專利權，商標權，以及著作權；而為配合本校學生學科背景，本課程將較著重於『專利』方面的實務知識，並且講授『如何激發創意，以培養學生日後能好好應用『智慧財產權』的保護。
description.en: The difference between New-economy and Old-economy is not caused by having "e" or not having "e", but caused by owining "i" or not owning "i". where "I" means "Innovation:.  Intellectual Property is not only the most importance business rule of the :Brain economy era:, but also one of the most important agreements among WTO members.  This course includes the basic three subjects of Intellectual Property:Patent, Trademark, and Copyright.  In order to accommodate the learning background for most of NTUT students, the contents of this course will focus more on the practical practice of the Patennt.  In addition, it also includes the subject of "how to activate your creativeness:so as to make students can use what they learn, "Intellectual Property:, to protect their intellectual work.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在引介我國憲法的要義、探討憲政體制的運作、研析權利義務的實務及詮釋相關法律的適用等，期能使學生掌握國家憲政體制運作的實況、認識憲法與人權保障間的關係，進而體現人權立國與人性尊嚴的價值。
This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

description.zh: 人的身體一接觸自然界，便開始各個器官的功能，人不如機器，無法汰換零件，加上身體機能遇到問題之後，許多人往往不知如何處理應對，甚至身體出現徵兆也渾然不知。所以此科目最主要的目的是希望藉由對醫學的認識，讓大學生們更瞭解自己的身體，進而保護並時時自我偵測身體是否正常運作，要培養健全的大學生，而不是只會讀書的大病貓。
description.en: Once the human body contacts the natural environment, the organs of the body begin to function.  But the human body can not change it's organizational like machine.  So when our body's function is in trouble, we always have no idea how to solve it, either to find out.  One of these course's objection is to let college students understanding their own body by learning some important medical concepts.  We hope that our country both has excellent and healthy college students,  and not all sick.

syllabi.outline:
什麼是醫學和生活（健康管理）？
1.影響人們健康實踐變化以及與此類醫學變化相關的知識和態度的過程。 
2.教學過程提供健康的基本知識和實踐，以便被詮釋為正確的健康行為。
醫學和生活（健康管理）課程的目標 
1. 促進健康和預防疾病。
2. 早期診斷和管理。
3. 利用現有的醫學和生活服務。 
醫學和生活（健康管理）課程的內容
1. 個人衛生
2. 正確的健康習慣
3. 營養教育
4. 個人預防措施
5. 安全規則
6. 正確使用醫學和生活服務 
7. 心理健康
8. 性教育
9. 特殊教育(職業，....等)
醫學和生活（健康管理）課程的具體實踐 
1. 使健康成為學生重視的資產。
2. 增加學生對影響健康的因素的瞭解。
3. 鼓勵促進和保持健康的行為。 
4. 爭取對公共衛生措施的支援，並在必要時敦促學生採取適當行動。 
5. 鼓勵學生適當利用衛生服務，特別是預防性服務。 
6. 向學生宣傳醫學進步、用途和局限性。
醫學和生活的學習評估: 
基於出勤以及課堂互動，每周提供一個帶回家的研究案例以突出所涵蓋醫學和生活的內容，每周測驗以及一個期中和期末測驗。  
醫學和生活（健康管理）課程的想法或實踐 - 五個步驟  
1. 意識（知道）
2. 興趣（詳情）
3. 評估（優點與缺點）
4. 審判（實踐）
5. 行動（習慣） 
醫學和生活課程的動機和教育    
1. 意識階段 - 人們意識到醫學和生活新出現的問題，例如「Long COVID,   
   Vaccines…」。它如果被敏感化，那麼他們就會更容易接受健康教育資訊，並  
   圖尋求有關健康問題的更多資訊。  
2. 評估階段 – 在媒體和一切可能的宣傳廣告手段，向公眾提供資訊。接受的
   人會吸收並理解這種疾病的影響。這裡的想法是人們相互討論並變得更加知
   識淵博。
3. 教育階段 - 這是無利害關係和真正教育階段。
4. 態度轉變的階段
5. 動機和行動階段
6. 生活轉型階段（生活變革）

description.zh: 病毒可說是介於無生命和有生命之間的物質。它小至用光學顯微鏡看不見除非在電子顯微鏡下。儘管看不見卻無所不在，與人類關係異常密切。人類基因體約8%是從病毒來的。目前最難解決的傳染病問題也是由病毒引起。病毒結構看來似乎很簡單，但為了生存也進化出非凡的策略。人類從研究病毒得到非常多重要的知識和研究工具。讓我們能夠對分子、細胞和生物體的結構和功能得到更深地了解，進而對疾病問題得到解決。本課程將以深入簡出的方式讓同學認識病毒: 從病毒的起源，病毒如何進入宿主細胞與複製，並在宿主群體間存活和傳播所必須具備的機制。通過一系列較具代表性的人類病毒為例子進行介紹病毒複製的基礎、人類與病毒的相互作用以及如何導致疾病。同時認識人體4006的疫系統如何對抗病毒。了解為什麼新興病毒的出現並造成疫情。人類應如何應對。最後介紹兩種不尋常的傳染因子- 類病毒和狂牛病蛋白。它們與病毒似乎都是在生命起源中在化學演化時期殘留下來的分子。
description.en: This course will emphasize the mechanisms necessary for the virus to successfully enter and reproduce in the host cell, and survive and spread in the host population. Through a series of representative examples of human viruses, I will introduce the general basis of virus replication, the interaction between the virus and the host, and how these factors cause diseases and our immune system against virus. Finally, I will briefly introduce two unusual infectious agents- viroid and prion.

syllabi.outline:
病毒可說是介於無生命和有生命之間的物質。它小至用光學顯微鏡看不見除非在電子顯微鏡下。儘管看不見卻無所不在，與人類關係異常密切。人類基因體約8%是從病毒來的。目前最難解決的傳染病問題也是由病毒引起。病毒結構看來似乎很簡單，但為了生存也進化出非凡的策略。人類從研究病毒得到非常多重要的知識和研究工具。讓我們能夠對分子、細胞和生物體的結構和功能得到更深地了解，進而對疾病問題得到解決。本課程將以深入簡出的方式讓同學認識病毒: 從病毒的起源，病毒如何進入宿主細胞與複製，並在宿主群體間存活和傳播所必須具備的機制。通過一系列較具代表性的人類病毒為例子進行介紹病毒複製的基礎、人類與病毒的相互作用以及如何導致疾病。同時認識人的疫系統如何對抗病毒。了解為什麼新興病毒的出現並造成疫情。人類應如何應對。最後介紹兩種不尋常的傳染因子- 類病毒和狂牛病蛋白。它們與病毒似乎都是在生命起源中在化學演化時期殘留下來的分子。
Virus is between life and no-life substances. It is Invisible to the naked eye unless under an electron microscope. However, virus is existed everywhere and has a very close relationship with humans. 8% of the human genome comes from viruses. At present, the most difficult to solve infectious disease problem is caused by virus. Although the structure and composition seems simple, virus has evolved an extraordinary strategy for survival. Virology enable us to insight the structure and function of molecules, cells, and organisms. From studying virus, people has gained a lot of important knowledge and research tools, which help people solving disease problems. This course will emphasize the mechanisms necessary for the virus to successfully enter and reproduce in the host cell, and survive and spread in the host population. Through a series of representative examples of human viruses, I will introduce the general basis of virus replication, the interaction between the virus and the host,and how these factors cause diseases and our immune system against virus. Finally, I will briefly introduce two unusual infectious agents- viroid and prion.

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。

description.zh: 現今企業面臨嚴峻的挑戰，諸如科技變革、市場波動、政治鬥爭、氣候變遷等，變動頻繁的經濟、社會、自然環境，都是對企業永續經營的考驗。近年來，「永續創新」幫助企業永續發展的作用引起學者、經理人和政策制定者的廣泛關注，由於創新是解決經濟、社會和環境問題的關鍵，企業愈來愈傾向於投入永續創新，透過全新或改良的產品、服務、管理流程、系統程序、商業模式等，創造共享的社會和商業價值，減少對環境造成的負面影響。因此，永續創新指的是持續提升產品、流程與人力品質，共同為您的客戶、員工與環境打造一個更光明永續的未來。
description.en: Nowadays, firms face severe challenges, such as technological revolutions, market fluctuations, political conflict, and climate change. This swiftly transforming economic, social, and environmental milieu poses rigorous tests to corporate sustainability. In recent years, the concept of "sustainable innovation" has garnered significant attention from academics, executives, and policymakers, acting as a cornerstone in facilitating the sustainable progression of organizations. Innovation stands as an essential tool in grappling with economic, societal, and environmental quandaries, prompting an increasing number of companies to channel resources towards sustainable innovation. Such investment aims to generate shared socio-economic value and curtail adverse environmental impacts by pioneering or refining business products, services, processes, procedures, and methodologies. Therefore, sustainable innovation refers to continuously improving the quality of products, processes and people, and

第12週	永續產品設計(實踐個案)	綠色材料、降低排放量，或使用可回收且效率更高的耗材

第16週	永續經營(施振榮先生之王道心法)	宏碁集團創辦人施振榮先生創業四十年來，對於現代企業的文化、經營、管理都有獨到的看法，他曾出版過一系列相關的好書，我曾拜讀過《利他，最好的利己》及《微笑走出自己的路》，對他的經驗和智慧欽佩不已。
第17週	從變局到新局─隱形冠軍的永續之路	「台灣產業本身就可視為一種隱形冠軍的概念，已在全球供應鏈上享有關鍵影響力。帶動轉型思維並培養更具競爭力的產業新世代。
第18週	期末報告	聚焦於永續性的三大面向：環境、社會及經濟。在審視產品生命週期時，製造商應當預期會有在生命週期之初引入永續概念的必要，產品設計及工程階段都迫切需要永續方面的改進。模仿個案作法,以團體做出一個簡易創新的想法與如何實踐。(以國外案例優先)

name.en: The Development of Taiwan Technology History

description.zh: 台灣科技發展史將討論二十世紀前半（1900-1950）部份重要技術引入台灣後，造成的影響與社會變遷。依時間先後，先從農業技術的變革-綠色革命。其次研讀有關電力與水利的技術發展，然後進入工業化初期的台灣社會變遷，以及二次大戰期間軍需工業所引導出的初期重化工業。除了這些技術與產業變革之外，也將兼論及技術人物群像與職業教育的開端。
description.en: The main topics for class will discuss the important technology how to influence Taiwan society during 1900-1950. This class includes some important developments: Green revolution -it discuss about agriculture development; the technology development of electricity and water conservancy. In some topic we discuss about Taiwan society change in early days industrialization and chemical industry during world war II. Except those topics, technologists and the beginning of professional education in Taiwan will be introduced.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將討論二十世紀後半(1950-1990)台灣重要科技產業與經濟發展的關聯性，同時也將從日常生活科技與社會的角度分析科技物設計的緣由，最後再帶入工程文化的認識與反思。This course will discuss the relationship between technology and industrial development in Taiwan during the second half of the 20th century (1950-1990). It will also analyze the reasons behind the design of technological objects from the perspectives of everyday life technology and society. Finally, it will delve into the understanding and reflection of engineering culture.

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

syllabi.outline:
音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

description.zh: 鋼琴擁有寬廣的音域，無論獨奏或合奏，鋼琴都能恰如其分地奏出悠揚音樂。這門課程將介紹鋼琴的起源與構造、各個時代的經典鋼琴作品與著名的鋼琴家，並且讓同學體驗彈奏鋼琴短曲的樂趣。期許能透過欣賞與實作，讓同學更深刻地理解鋼琴音樂之美，培養終身的興趣。
description.en: The piano possesses a broad tonal range, and whether in a solo or ensemble context, it adeptly delivers enchanting music. This course will provide an introduction to the piano's origins and construction, classic piano compositions spanning different periods, and celebrated pianists. Moreover, it will afford students the opportunity to relish the pleasure of playing short piano pieces. By engaging in both appreciation and hands-on practice, students are anticipated to enhance their comprehension of the beauty of piano music and develop a lifelong interest.

name.zh: 二十世紀中國現代文學與文化建構
name.en: The modern literature and cultural construction in twentieth century China

description.zh: 本課程關注的焦點將以都市文學和民族/文化/現代建構為基底，以“五四”文學以來的總體概述為起始的一個發現之旅。課程將以夏志清的中國現代小說史為起點，進而以李歐梵對於民國初年出版商和作家和他們的貢獻作為對照，來做為現代城市文化風景的呈現。課程中將以安德森”想像的共同體”為背景，解釋它被各種文化論述所引用的觀點，以各種面向來看待文學作品對於民族建構的貢獻。
description.en: We arrange the course that is based on urban literatures, with issues about the race, culture and the construction of the modern world. The students in the course will be guided into a tour of discovery, which is summed up and initiated from “May 4th Movement”. The progress of course will be mapped out from “A History of Modern Chinese Fiction” compiled by C. T. Hsia (夏志清), and then the analysis from Leo Lee, and other writers, will be compared to exhibit the style and features of modern urban literatures. According to the theory of “Imagined Communities” which is authored by B. Anderson, we will also explain the viewpoints from different cultures, and comment on the analyses to the race construction with varied points of view.

syllabi.outline:
This course adapts a genealogy perspective and begins with a general overview of modern Chinese literature as a journey of discovery. The course will start with an introduction of A new literary history of modern China edited by Wang David Der-wei Wang (王德威), and then review how Wang succeeded Chih-tsing Hsia’s (夏志清)   work to present a new, diversify, and historically poetic version of Chinese literature history. This course will take these authors as cases for discussion, mapping Lu Hsun (魯迅)and Eileen Chang (張愛玲). With further navigating their positions in the literary genealogy, the lecturer aims to address how their literary works construct contemporary culture. In addition, two films, Spring in a Small Town and New Women, will be discussed in order to understand the cultural situation at that time.
本課程將以華語譜系為視角，以中國現代文學的總體概述為起始，進行一場發現之旅。課程將以王德威的《哈佛新編中國現代文學史》切入，介紹王德威如何繼承夏志清的工作，呈現新格局、輻射的、「史蘊詩心」的中國文學史呈現。課程中將著重介紹魯迅、張愛玲的文學地位，解釋他們在文學系譜上承前啟後的位置，以各種面向來看待文學作品對於當代文化建構的貢獻。此外，也將特別探討《小城之春》與《新女性》兩部電影，以了解當時的文化情境。

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

本課程從家庭關係開啟自我探索、情緒舒展、自我擁抱到關係開展，融入簡單的理論概念，透過繪本、影片、體驗、互動、討論分享、塗繪、書寫等表達性藝術，在舒緩的氣氛中，引導同學逐步建構自我與人我關係發展的力量。

syllabi.notes:
SDGs
第3項良好健康與社會福利：著重在良好心靈健康
每堂課皆以建構心靈健康為設計，如自我內在關係、家人關係、情緒釋壓、人我關係連結等，第一週到第十七週皆然。
第4項優質教育：確保包容和公平的教育
課堂互動中，以邀請與鼓勵取代勉強與責罰，尊重學生。課程引導尊重個人差異，欣賞不同特質展現，並提供多元且開放式的參與機會。
如：第二週：同理裝備：如何聽、怎麼說？
第六週：與人連結：自在的做自己  
第十六週：向內探索：從隱藏我到未知我
第十七週：從我到我們：發現獨特珍貴的我
第5項性別平等
本課程從廣義的尊重性別平等出發，提取性別權力關係與互動，並延伸情感教育的溝通協商與處理情感挫折的能力，融於第九週：愛的存款與表達練習、第十二週親密關係：愛、差異與界線、第十六週：與人連結，自在的做自己課程，進行體驗式學習。 
第17項夥伴關係
課程重視人際互動與群體合作，許多環節設計都需小組討論、策畫執行才有辦法完成，如第一週：搭起團體共學之橋、第三週：團體連結：大集繪創作、第六週：與人連結：自在的做自己  、第九週：愛的存款與表達練習 、第十四週：冒險一試：勇氣行動體驗、第十七週：從我到我們：發現獨特珍貴的我、第十八週期末報告：勇氣行動

description.zh: 新經濟與舊經濟的分野不是在有『e』還是沒有『e』，而是在有『i』還是沒有『i』，而『i』就是『Innovation，創新』。二十一世紀的『腦力經濟』最重要的戲規則就是『智慧財產權』，同時也是WTO會員國必須遵守的重要規範之一。課程內容主要包括三個最基本的智慧財產權課題：專利權，商標權，以及著作權；而為配合本校學生學科背景，本課程將較著重於『專利』方面的實務知識，並且講授『如何激發創意，以培養學生日後能好好應用『智慧財產權』的保護。
description.en: The difference between New-economy and Old-economy is not caused by having "e" or not having "e", but caused by owining "i" or not owning "i". where "I" means "Innovation:.  Intellectual Property is not only the most importance business rule of the :Brain economy era:, but also one of the most important agreements among WTO members.  This course includes the basic three subjects of Intellectual Property:Patent, Trademark, and Copyright.  In order to accommodate the learning background for most of NTUT students, the contents of this course will focus more on the practical practice of the Patennt.  In addition, it also includes the subject of "how to activate your creativeness:so as to make students can use what they learn, "Intellectual Property:, to protect their intellectual work.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.outline:

This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. description.zh:
性、性別是人類與生俱來的課題，其與各時代之政治體系、法律規範及社會變遷有密不可分的關係法律中的性別議題，既是法律問題也是社會問題，需要結合法律領域與社會領域的知識，作跨領域教學與學習。
本課程配合性別平等教育政策趨勢，分就不同面向的法律規範中的相關性別議題，來讓學生了解近年來性別平等之相關法律意涵希望能在認知、情意、行動等層面，讓學生習得正確的性別權利意識，進而在國家公私領域中運用相關知識落實性別平等，以促進多元文化之下兩性平權發展。
description.en:
Sex and gender are inherent issues of human beings, and they are inseparable from the political system, legal norms and social changes of all ages. Gender issues in the law are both legal and social issues and need to be combined with the legal field and society Domain knowledge for cross-domain teaching and learning.
This course is in line with the gender equality education policy trend, and divides the relevant gender issues in different aspects of legal norms to let students understand the relevant legal implications of gender equality in recent years. Hopefully, students can learn from the levels of cognition, affection, and action. Correct awareness of gender rights, and then apply relevant knowledge to implement gender equality in the public and private sectors of the country, so as to promote the development of gender equality under multiculturalism.

課程目標：
透過資訊安全教育，培養學生的資安意識與技能，增進科技素養，建立防禦思維與實作能力，提升資訊應用中的安全性，並啟發其持續學習與探索資訊安全領域的興趣，以奠定終身學習與生涯發展的基礎。本課程之內容為：一、資訊與網路安全簡介，二、安全與風險管理，三、存取控制概念，四、網路攻擊技術與防禦，五、安全操作系統與應用，六、資訊安全弱點與威脅，七、資安事件處理與應變，八、資通安全框架應用。

This course is designed to cultivate students' awareness and skills in information security through education, enhance their technological literacy, establish defensive thinking and practical abilities, improve the security of information applications, and inspire continued learning and exploration in the field of information security. The course aims to lay the foundation for lifelong learning and career development. The course includes: 1. An introduction to information and network security; 2. Security and risk management; 3. Concepts of access control; 4. Network attack techniques and defenses; 5. Secure operating systems and applications; 6. Information security vulnerabilities and threats; 7. Incident handling and response; 8. Applications of cybersecurity frameworks.

description.zh: 現代人的健康問題50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。
description.en: More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

description.zh:
未來，網際網路中存在著如「互聯網＋」和「互聯網應用」等機會，而我們每天的食衣住行育樂所衍生出的各項產業，又如何與互聯網相加，創造無限商機與無限可能呢？工具＋社群的商業模式，產生了數化經濟。數位經濟不是艱深的研究專題，原來與我們的生活息息相關！ 
平日網購的電子商務平台、行動支付、演算法出現的廣告都屬於數位經濟的範疇。數位科技的創新，需要建立在解決使用者的痛點上，因此它就不單純是一項技術創新的議題，同時要兼具對於人類社會與行為的觀察力，對於既有市場的洞
察力，因此科技來自於人性這句話，也可以理解為科技來自於人的需求。這本書帶您認識數位科技在商業經濟上的運用實例：行動支付、訂閱制、會員制、嵌入式廣告、遊戲化……等等。並提供經濟學的思考方式，核心理念是商業模式思考要有經濟學的基本功，了解市場運作的經濟邏輯，再了解全球創新商業模式，從中找到適合自身企業的模式。
description.en:
E-commerce platforms for daily online shopping, mobile payments, and algorithm-based advertisements all fall into the category of the digital economy. Innovation in digital 
technology needs to be based on solving the pain points of users. Therefore, it is not just a matter of technological innovation, but also requires observation of human society and behavior, as well as insight into the existing market. Therefore, The saying that technology comes from human nature can also be understood to mean that technology 
comes from human needs. It also provides a way of thinking in economics. The core concept is that when thinking about business models, you need to have basic skills in economics, understand the economic logic of market operations, and then understand global innovative business models to find a model that suits your own enterprise.

syllabi.outline:
首先運用大量的創意思考工具與國內外實際案例，啟發創新與創業思維，並深入探索新興市場機會，能夠讓學生輕鬆愉快地領悟創業的過程。次而利用產業分析的工具，教導學生如何研究創新產業與分析，進而讓學生們了解創新產業的價值和未來工作的方向。
Using a creative thinking tools and practical cases to inspire innovation and entrepreneurial thinking, and in-depth exploration of emerging market opportunities, students can easily and happily understand the process of entrepreneurship. It also conducts industrial analysis and management technology for innovative industries.

description.zh: 鋼琴擁有寬廣的音域，無論獨奏或合奏，鋼琴都能恰如其分地奏出悠揚音樂。這門課程將介紹鋼琴的起源與構造、各個時代的經典鋼琴作品與著名的鋼琴家，並且讓同學體驗彈奏鋼琴短曲的樂趣。期許能透過欣賞與實作，讓同學更深刻地理解鋼琴音樂之美，培養終身的興趣。
description.en: The piano possesses a broad tonal range, and whether in a solo or ensemble context, it adeptly delivers enchanting music. This course will provide an introduction to the piano's origins and construction, classic piano compositions spanning different periods, and celebrated pianists. Moreover, it will afford students the opportunity to relish the pleasure of playing short piano pieces. By engaging in both appreciation and hands-on practice, students are anticipated to enhance their comprehension of the beauty of piano music and develop a lifelong interest.

description.zh: 個人或國家都無法自外於當今的國際社會；政治、經濟、社會、文化各層面皆受到國際間互動的影響下，為增進知識青年具備國際化的視野與認知，以因應時代發展趨勢，在強化技術研究的基礎上，拓展國家、社會與個人的發展空間。本課程內容包括基本理論與國際關係的動態，涵蓋國際社會的結構與演變、國際行為的類型及支配此行為的各種力量、國際事務的現象、本質及因果關係。
description.en: An individual or a country may not keep alien to today's internatonal community. Owing to internationally interactive influence with respect to politic, economy, society and culture, the purpose of the course is to equip intellectual youths with internaitonalized sight and awareness to keep pace with the develolpment trend of times, and to expand the space for national, social and individual development on basic of reinforced technical research. The contents of the course include basic theory and the situation  of international relations, covering the structure and changes in the international community, the type of international behavior, and various forces dominating such behavior, the phenomenon, essence, cause and consequence of international affairs.

syllabi.outline:
全球化時代，無論是個人或是國家都無法自外於國際結構而不受其影響；因此，我們必須對國際現勢有基本了解，對於國際事件以及重要趨勢應該有所掌握。本課程會以議題討論方式進行，是以當週或當月國際重要事件為主題，帶入國際關係學的基本概念，介紹國際關係學者如何看待與分析這些問題。課程的目的是要透過深入淺出的方式，客觀地建立國際關係的系統性認知，培養同學在資訊量爆炸的年代，具有獨立思考與正確解讀資訊的能力。

description.zh: 婚姻是一般人所必經的過程，家庭是生活的場所，關係著人生的幸福與美滿。本課程強調美滿婚姻與幸福家庭是一門學問，因此，課程內容包括：對婚姻與家庭有正確的認知、積極的態度、完整的規劃，並培養有認真努力去實踐的方法與能力。如何追求真正的快樂與幸福？除了在婚姻與家庭中追求平等化、合理化、自由化、公平化外，自我成長、相互尊重都是本課程的學習目標，以協助學生思考婚姻與家庭的終生大事。
description.en: Marriage is a process that most people will go through.  Family is where you belong to, and where the satisfaction and happiness come from. We believe that it is a kind of scholarship to have a high-quality marriage and a wonderful family.  The contents of this course include having the correct understanding of marriage and family, cultivating positive attitude, developing complete plans, and realizing them with all efforts. This course will help students think totally about marriage and family, learn to pursue equality, reasonableness and liberty, keep growing and respect each other, so that we can obtain the real delight and happiness.

description.zh:
中國的崛起正在改變全球的政治、經濟和文化，而台灣與港澳都是已然成型的大中華經濟圈成員，吾人必須要趁早了解中國市場崛起的原因，並開始作好準備。
 
本課程帶領學生深入瞭解中國崛起的背景、所代表的意義、以及如何去面對隨之而來的新挑戰。課程中並將描繪出世界的未來走向、美國霸權的逐日衰退、和各種產業即將面臨的威脅/挑戰/機遇。
 
中國已經成為世界最大的經濟體，未來台灣的企業、經濟前景、甚至個人生活都會感受到巨大的衝擊。中國的經濟成長何以會影響到所有的全球性產業和消費者，並分析許多工作即將面臨的威脅。
 
本課程由總體宏觀角度出發，逐步進入細部剖析，期末再以全球觀點回顧大中華經濟圈的發展，並對未來趨勢提出分析。
description.en:
This is an introductory level course on the rise of China as a major power and the emergence of the Greater China Economic Circle. Through intensive reading and in-class discussion, the students are expected to gain an in-depth understanding of the developmental causes, path, and trajectory of the GCEC.

Both positive and negative factors will be critically examined in the assigned readings. The role of Taiwan in the development of GCEC will also be reviewed.

本課程帶領學生深入瞭解中國崛起的背景、所代表的意義、以及如何去面對隨之而來的新挑戰。課程中並將描繪出世界的未來走向、美國霸權的逐日衰退、和各種產業即將面臨的威脅/挑戰/機遇。
 
中國已經成為世界最大的經濟體，未來台灣的企業、經濟前景、甚至個人生活都會感受到巨大的衝擊。中國的經濟成長何以會影響到所有的全球性產業和消費者，並分析許多工作即將面臨的威脅。
 
本課程由總體宏觀角度出發，逐步進入細部剖析，期末再以全球觀點回顧大中華經濟圈的發展，並對未來趨勢提出分析。
This is an introductory level course on the rise of China as a major power and the emergence of the Greater China Economic Circle. Through intensive reading and in-class discussion, the students are expected to gain an in-depth understanding of the developmental causes, path, and trajectory of the GCEC.

Both positive and negative factors will be critically examined in the assigned readings. The role of Taiwan in the development of GCEC will also be reviewed.

syllabi.outline:
膳食是生活上一件非常重要的事， 所謂「 You are what you eat.」，「今日的飲食造就明日的細胞組成」，都明白闡述出飲食習慣對個人健康具有直接的影響力。現代人生活上還面臨著各項挑戰，例如我們經常要面對各式各樣的壓力，以及生活環境遭受污染充斥著各種毒素等問題，因此我們必須先瞭解如何避食品毒物，再藉由選擇正確的食物與良好的飲食習慣來維持身體的健康。
本課程前半部先探討近期台灣近期發生的食品安全事件，藉由事件來瞭解如何避開毒物；後半部介紹食物內各種營養素的功能，再進一步探討如何選擇有益的食物來調整身體機能，並促進健康。

description.zh: 現代人的健康問題50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。
description.en: More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

description.zh:
新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。
新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。
課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en:
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously.
    The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

syllabi.outline:
The knowledge of life sciences is closely related to us. College students should have basic knowledge of the life sciences. There are all kinds of living things on the earth we live in, each consisting of basic life units-the cells, which evolve into various organisms to form diverse biological species. Human beings appear to be “advanced” in some way; however, we share many similarities to other creatures, including cell structures, biochemical and physiological pathways, nutrient acquiring processes, disease production manner, etc. Studying the science of life help us to learn how to make a better way to live on, for example, diagnosis and treatment of diseases, drug invention. Another important point is, we must respect other species as the earth is shared by everyone.

description.zh:
近年來各大學積極推動「大學社會責任實踐（University Social Responsibility, USR）計畫」，期許大學師生對在地方發展及公共議題發揮熱情與創意，與地方居民及企業協力推動社區及產業發展。
大學社會責任工作主要是透過社會創新，解決社會問題，來實踐社會責任所謂社會創新，就是用創新的方法來解決社會問題，產生「社會影響力」（Social Impact），並設法改變處在社會問題「當中的人」以及與這個人有關的「社會情境」（social context），來產生長久的社會影響
本課程，將向同學生講解社會責任基本觀念，以介紹學社會責任的理念構想與實踐經驗，並移地教學，地方場域問題作為主題報告討論素材等方式，來增強學生進行社會創新的態度、認知和行為。
description.en: In recent years, universities have actively promoted the "University Social Responsibility (USR) Program", expecting university teachers and students to show enthusiasm and creativity in local development and public issues, and work with local residents and enterprises to promote community and industrial development. This course will explain the basic concepts of social responsibility to the students, introduce the concepts and practical experience of each USR project team of our school, and use the case experience to share and discuss, and use USR field issues as the topic report discussion material. Guide students to participate in university social responsibility work, and enhance the attitude, cognition and behavior of social innovation.

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

syllabi.outline:
為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。

如果你想體驗創業前該具備的專業與過程，如果你想學習在未來不論是升學(簡報設計、創業計畫書)或就業(Wix網站、Line官方帳號)或探索自己(行銷、財務)，任何一項能力都能讓你在未來年薪百萬甚至創業，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。

To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change.

If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 課程將以體驗式教學訓練，提升學員表達技巧、舞台技巧、臨場反應。本課程主要目的在教授學生以設計思考思維與策略，運用主題式課程實戰小組簡報及個人簡報，快速釐清簡報製作及表達過程中重點，提升修課學員個人簡報製作能力及表達能力，幫助學生在未來創業及就業上以出色之個人簡報能力獲得面試者及投資者的青睞，領先於起跑點取得優勢。
description.en: The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在教授學生創新創業的實務，讓學生實際組成團隊進行創業，並有老師全程指導實踐創業，學校並提供基本創業基金與創業場地，輔導學生實際體會創業的過程。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、經營模式建立、創業財務、創業專題進行、創業競賽等。
description.en: This course is to instruct students to practice the entrepreneurship and innovation. Students will form an entrepreneurship team. Teacher will guide the students throughout the entrepreneurship processes. University will offer students initial funds and incubation assistances. Students will gain practical experiences on how to establish entrepreneurship. The contents include entrepreneurial thoughts and actions, design thinking, self-understanding, team formation, business model development, entrepreneurship finance, entrepreneurship practices, entrepreneurship contests, and so on.

description.zh: 本校為強化學生的就業能力，加強學生的職場競爭力，開設「職涯講座課程」，藉由業界主管與人員介紹不同種類的工作模式，如派遣、公職、舒活族、獵人頭公司、國外企業等，提升學生對於國內外職場的認識，並進一步提升學生的就業率與競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance student’s competitive ability in the workplace. description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. syllabi.outline:
為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。

如果你想體驗創業前該具備的專業與過程，如果你想學習在未來不論是升學(簡報設計、創業計畫書)或就業(Wix網站、Line官方帳號)或探索自己(行銷、財務)，任何一項能力都能讓你在未來年薪百萬甚至創業，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。

To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change.

If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 本課程著重於商業溝通及實務的應用。每個實例討論均能幫助學生了解英文商務應用，並且提供學生去研習，分析並將個人論點英文表達。課程的重點有二：加強學生理解英文在商業領域的重要性，增強學生在商業案件中的綜合分析的表達能力。此外，由實際的商業實務中反應出各種未來可能出現的不同挑戰，讓學生有機會學習應對。根據課程規定，學生須具備高級英文的能力跟基本的商業知識。
description.en: The course explores the intersection of the English language communication and cases in real business world. Each case to be discussed in this course illustrates the many aspects of business operations and provides students with the opportunities to examine, to analyze and to present their views in English. The emphasis of the course is two-fold. While reinforcing the importance of business communications in English and enhancing students' analytical competence in discussing the cases, real-world business stories reflect a multitude of challenges to resolve and opportunities to embrace in hopes that students are well-prepare to cope with all these in the future to come. As the course prescribes, students are required to have an advanced English level and fundamental business knowledge.

Course Syllabus
Course Title:		Business Case Studies in English
Credit Hours:		3
Instructor’s Name:	Dr. Yun-Hua Yang
Contact E-Mail:	yhyang@ntut.edu.tw
Term Offered:		Spring, 2012
Office Hours:      By appointment
Required Texts:  Harvard Business School Cases
Course Description: This course will look at a broad array of issues and cases of business in practices. All cases discusses in class present real-business environment and situations in which corporations and business professionals have made business operations more sophisticated and yet prosperous. Through the learning of real business cases, many of them well-known corporations and brand names, this current course centers its emphasis on scaffolding knowledge and experiences governing certain business disciplines in which students are most likely to pursue a successful career. In addition, students will be required to meet with and learn from invited project advisors, who are currently middle to senior managers in renowned companies in Taiwan.
Course Objectives:  At the successful conclusion of this course, students shall be able to
(1) develop thorough understanding of several prestigious corporations and brand names
(2) acquire the essential business concepts by studying key terminology
(3) establish critical and analytical ability to integrate all necessary information for problem solution
(4) understand the opportunities and benefits presented through the cases and further construct a strong sense of career development to navigate future career pursuit
Course Requirements:
(1)	Students are required to read the case materials thoroughly, whether in responsible for session presentation. The purpose of this course, and the study of cases, is established on abundant discussions and by the exchange of ideas and thoughts.
(2)	Students are responsible for presenting at least one to two cases.
(3)	Students are scheduled to meet with the course instructor to ascertain that the case has been fully studied for its presentation.
(4)	An elaborated outline is required along with the presentation. Based on the case, five essay questions are to be designed and write a full-length essay to each question. The questions will also be used for student essays.
(5)	Three in-service professionals are invited to class to share with students their professional expertise in a variety of business operations. Reflection papers regarding the respective speeches are required.
(6)	Attendance: Students are required to attend the class as scheduled.
i.	Each unexcused absence will result in 10% semester grade deduction.
ii.	At the sole discretion of the instructor, some absence penalties may be waived with valid proof and just cause. No Penalty waiver request will only be accepted in two weeks of the date of absence. Students forfeit the right of contention after that. It is important to know that only ONE- time penalty waiver will be granted to any student.
iii.	Lateness to class: Any arrival to class after the instructor finishes the second-round roll call is considered lateness. Two times of lateness will, in effect, incur a grade penalty of 5% semester grade deduction.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供全面的網際網路行銷理論與實務內容，幫助學生理解數位時代中行銷的運作模式與挑戰。課程內容涵蓋 搜尋引擎優化（SEO）、搜尋引擎行銷（SEM）、內容行銷、社群媒體行銷、A/B testing應用在電商決策的制定、.熟悉Google的8種廣告類型與應用 等重點領域，並結合實務工具如 Google Ads、Surfer、SSEMrush 、GA4、GTM、Canva和15種AI的多媒體工具來製作內容行銷廣告，讓學生具備操作與優化行銷活動的能力。
此外，課程強調數據導向的行銷思維，學生將學習如何運用 Google Analytics 等分析工具，追蹤並解讀行銷數據，進一步評估行銷績效，並根據數據結果調整策略，達到最大化行銷效果的目標。
實作部分的重點在【GA4的網絡流量追蹤，GTM網站客戶行為代碼追蹤，Google Looker行銷數據視覺化，用15種AI工具製作內容行銷廣告影片，關鍵字搜尋提升SEO實作，熟悉Google的8種廣告類型與應用】

This course provides comprehensive theoretical and practical content on internet marketing, helping students understand the operational models and challenges of marketing in the digital age. The course covers key areas such as **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**, **Search Engine Marketing (SEM)**, **Content Marketing**, **Social Media Marketing**, and **Email Marketing**, while integrating practical tools like **Google Ads**, **SEMrush**, and **Canva** to equip students with the ability to execute and optimize marketing activities effectively.

Furthermore, the course emphasizes a data-driven marketing mindset. Students will learn to use analytics tools like **Google Analytics** to track and interpret marketing data, evaluate marketing performance, and adjust strategies based on data insights to maximize marketing effectiveness.

Ultimately, the course will culminate in a capstone project, where students will integrate their knowledge to design, implement, and analyze a complete marketing plan. Through theoretical learning, practical tool applications, and teamwork, students will develop the core competencies and market competitiveness necessary for conducting internet marketing in the digital era.

description.en: When it comes to digital marketing, few things are as important as the tools digital marketers rely on to get their works done. Allowing digital marketers to create, test and measure the performance of their Internet marketing campaigns, digital marketing tools ensuring that marketers can launch and start campaigns quickly and effectively. syllabi.outline:
本課程以「數位行銷工具」為主軸，結合理論學習與實作操作，旨在培養學生掌握現代數位行銷工具的應用能力。課程內容涵蓋數位行銷策略規劃、流量分析、用戶行為追蹤、9種電商廣告類型的應用、內容創作與AI工具應用等核心技能。數位行銷的主要領域包括：『搜尋引擎行銷SEO/SEM、內容行銷、A/B testing應用在電商決策的制定、社群行銷等』。
本課程教學目標包括：
1.理解數位行銷主要領域（SEO、SEM、內容行銷、社群行銷等），並能制定數位行銷平台策略。
2.掌握數據追蹤與分析工具：學習並實作 GA4（Google Analytics 4） 與 GTM（Google Tag Manager），實現用戶行為追蹤及流量來源分析，並進一步串接數據資料進行整合分析。
3.A/B testing應用在電商決策的制定：使用SPSS軟體做統計檢定（獨立樣本t檢定，單因子變異數分析ANOVA檢定，Tukey HSD事後檢定，Shapiro–Wilk非常態檢定，Kruskal-Wallis檢定，Dunn事後檢定，Welch ANOVA檢定＋Games-Howell事後檢定）
4.熟悉Google的8種廣告類型與應用。
5.數據視覺化與解讀能力：熟悉 Google Looker Studio 和 Tableau 兩大數據視覺化工具，掌握數據儀表板的設計、數據過濾與交互功能，並能透過圖表呈現分析結果，協助行銷決策。
6.內容行銷與創意製作能力：透過15種 AI工具（如Krea、Midjourney、Suno、Vidu等）製作AI圖案商標、AI音樂配樂、AI自動生成廣告影片與AI腳本，提升行銷內容的吸引力與創意表現。
7.整合工具結合 GA4、GTM、Looker Studio、Tableau 等工具，製作完整的行銷數據報告、影片及AI廣告內容，強化學生的專案執行力與團隊合作能力。


The course focuses on **"Digital Marketing Tools"**, combining theoretical learning with practical implementation, aiming to equip students with the ability to apply modern digital marketing tools. The course content covers core skills such as digital marketing strategy planning, traffic analysis, user behavior tracking, data visualization, content creation, and AI tool applications. The main domains of digital marketing include **Search Engine Marketing (SEO/SEM), Content Marketing, Social Media Marketing**, and more.  

The course objectives include:  
1. **Understanding the main domains of digital marketing** (SEO, SEM, content marketing, and social media marketing) and developing strategies for digital marketing platforms.  
2. **Mastering data tracking and analysis tools**: Learning and implementing **GA4 (Google Analytics 4)** and **GTM (Google Tag Manager)** to track user behavior and analyze traffic sources, as well as integrating and analyzing data comprehensively.  
3. **Data visualization and interpretation skills**: Becoming proficient in two major data visualization tools, **Google Looker Studio** and **Tableau**, to design dashboards, filter and interact with data, and present analytical results through visual charts to assist in marketing decision-making.  
4. **Content marketing and creative production skills**: Using various AI tools (such as **Krea**, **Midjourney**, and **Vidu**) to create graphics, logos, videos, and scripts, enhancing the appeal and creativity of marketing content.  
5. **Tool integration for comprehensive projects**: Combining tools like **GA4, GTM, Looker Studio**, and **Tableau** to produce complete marketing data reports, videos, and AI-generated advertising content, strengthening students' project execution and teamwork capabilities.

description.zh:
新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。
新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。
課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en:
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously.
    The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

In the first half of the courses, students have to outline their interests of Taiwanese architecture in certain approaches. They might be architectural styles (ex. Brick, RC, etc.), particular types of architecture, one or two individual architects, etc. Students should present their plans of their final reports in the mid-term class about 10 minutes, in order to collect some feedback from colleagues and class instructor for further develop to achieve the final report.

One should submit his/her thesis by 6/20 12:00pm to Dr. Wu. The words of the thesis should not be less than 3000 words. It should be in thesis format (word) instead of brief presentation format (power point).

name.zh: 當代城市中都市社會基礎設施再思
name.en: Rethinking urban social infrastructure in contemporary cities

description.zh:
由於九零年代後，城市急速擴張與超越領域性(de-terrorization)的連結等新興狀態萌生，基礎設施(infrastructure)的定義逐漸開始難以精確認定，而身為城市興衰論述的經常主體，基礎設施自身的論述與再定義卻在空間學門中成為那缺落的一塊。

基於此，本課程期望透過幾項特定學門角度，提供一個對於基礎設施為研究主題的論述框架，進而連結建築學門與相關空間學門間對於當代全球城市論述中之縫隙，能在跨學門田野研究中提出他種可能性(alternatives)。 本課程將以兩種方項進行基礎設施當代性的"實踐"; 部分課程內容將邀請德國杜賓根大學台灣研究中心，以空間社會學角度提供授課交流。另一部分將透過雙邊學生，以共同主題進行台北與德國城市的實際田野調查並以比較分析的方式進行合作討論。課程架構則以建築學與空間社會學為主軸剖析，分為五個部分:全球城市與多尺度論述，當代基礎設施與建築/地景對話，社會基礎設施的物質性與再生產，看不見的基礎設施與田野調查為總結。預計學生能透過不同學門角度的切入、於不同文化背景學生間合作討論、多種教學方式的引導，培養基礎辯證思考之能力並進一步對當代都市基礎設施的空間性研究之興趣。
description.en:
In the contemporary word, especially in globalized cities, infrastructure is hard to define for many reasons and at some points infrastructure is also often invisible to its users.

This class will therefore seek to rethink the subject of infrastructure from particular perspectives which frame the structure of this module. We then proposed a join-class with Taiwan study centre at University of T?bingen, Germany for wider debates and teaching possibilities as well. There will be two academic discourses-Architecture and sociology involved and formed into five sessions which can be seen in course syllabus. In so doing, it will focus on firstly by reading theory; secondly, by examining specific case studies that illustrates how these theories manifests themselves; and thirdly, by considering how these infrastructures may be changing the understanding of contemporary globalized cities and reproducing urban networks in different fields and countries.

description.zh: 本門課藉由濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程，分析人體舒適與空氣品質之需求，及各種空調設備系統之設計。本門課在空調負荷計算原理與方法涵蓋輻射熱、熱傳導及熱儲存效應等之分析，系統設計包括送風與送水系統之計算與設計，及室內送風分佈之理論與設計。
description.en: Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. Design of air-conditioning equipment and systems are introduced. Air-conditioning load analysis includes radiation, transfer, and heat storage effects. System design includes design and calculation air and water moving systems. Air distribution principles and design are also covered.

description.zh:
以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。
教學目標為：
1.介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。
2.訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。
3.熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en:
This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.
The objectives are:
1.Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2.Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3.Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

syllabi.outline:
Seeing is a creative process that involves our eyes and mind to transform what we see into what we know, but sometimes the process is reversed—we rely on what we know to interpret what we are seeing. To draw what we see can, therefore, be a process of the interaction of seeing and understanding. The goal of this course will focus on this seeing, thinking, and drawing interaction while drawing architecture on location. This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.

1. Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2. Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3. Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

# The one-minute elevator pitch used by Silicon Valley startups


### Lesson 1 - Understanding the Elevator Pitch
- What is an elevator pitch?
- Why do you need an elevator pitch?
- The key elements of a successful elevator pitch
- Case Study: Successful and Failed Elevator Presentations

### Lesson 2 - Target Audience Analysis
- Identify your target audience
- Understand audience needs and pain points
- Tailor your message to suit different audiences
- Practical Exercise: Audience Analysis Worksheet

### Lesson 3 - Extracting the Core Message
- Identify your unique value proposition
- Problem statement skills
- Solution presentation method
- Practical Exercise: Establishing the Core Message Framework

### Lesson 4 - Elements of Persuasion
- Data application skills
- Storytelling method
- Emotional connection building
- Practical Exercise: Integrating Data and Stories

### Lesson 5 - Oral Expression Skills
- Tone and speed control
- Use of body language
- Eye contact skills
- Practical exercises: video self-evaluation and feedback

### Lesson 6 - Improvisational skills
- Time management skills
- Problem Solving Methods
- Coping with stressful situations
- Practical Exercise: Improvisational Presentation Challenge

### Lesson 7 - Presentation Optimization
- Peer feedback and suggestions
- Content adjustment and modification
- Performance improvement strategies
- Practical Exercise: Presentation of revised presentation

### Lesson 8 - Summary and Practice
- Final presentation
- Professional review feedback
- Continuous improvement suggestions
- Course summary and future applications

description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為培養學生將點子成功轉化為可行性募資提案，以柏克萊新創加速營模式，培養學生新創募資相關知識及提案簡報技能。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、顧客導向產品設計、提案規劃、簡報表達、募資、行銷、創業相關法律知識等。
description.en: The primary goal of this course is to equip students with the ability to successfully transform ideas into feasible crowdfunding proposals. Using the Berkeley startup accelerator model, the course helps students develop knowledge related to startup fundraising and presentation skills for proposals. Course content includes topics such as entrepreneurial spirit, innovative thinking, self-awareness, team formation, customer-oriented product design, proposal planning, presentation skills, fundraising, marketing, and legal knowledge related to entrepreneurship.
